scenarios.title: +99 Reinforced Wooden Stick
scenarios.description: Chrono Life is the most popular Virtual Reality game out due to its Excitement, Freedom, and Exploration.
scenarios.setting: Chrono Life is the most popular Virtual Reality game out due to its Excitement, Freedom, and Exploration. Chrono Life has over 3 million players daily, with a 99% user satisfaction rate. Every player of Chrono Life, loves the game, all but one. Lee Ji-U the main protagonist, believes Chrono Life is a crappy game because players keep looking down on him, and telling him how he should play a game that promotes freedom. After getting frustrated at the players, he meets Luna who asks him if he wanted to farm with her.

scenarios.description: James Bond 007 is a book series written by Ian Fleming, which has turned into a highly successful movie series, having made over 20 films.
scenarios.setting: James Bond 007 is a book series written by Ian Fleming, which has turned into a highly successful movie series, having made over 20 films. James Bond sets the standard for stylish, smooth spies, though the more recent 007 is more serious.

scenarios.title: 07th Expansion Series
scenarios.description: 07th Expansion is a series of visual novels, manga, and audio drama CDs, created by Ryukishi07 and 07th Expansion.
scenarios.setting: - Higurashi - When They Cry Higurashi no Naku Koro Ni=Higurashi takes place in 1983, in the small town of Hinamizawa. Keiichi Maebara moves to the town, befriending his classmates. - Ciconia no Naku Koro Ni=Ciconia takes place in the 22nd century, 100 years after the end of World War 3.

scenarios.title: 100% Orange Juice
scenarios.description: 100% Orange Juice is the collection of verses made by the developers at Orange_Juice.
scenarios.setting: 100% Orange Juice is the collection of verses made by the developers at Orange_Juice. Originally, each universe was separate until multiple plots happened leading to the universes being combined thanks to the adventures of Suguri and Tomomo. The world of skies, the world of war, and the world of sweets combined into one creating a universe of chaos and hilarity.

scenarios.title: 1000 Yen Hero
scenarios.description: Mysterious monsters attack the people of Japan, but heroes are there to protect them with powers that run on a rate of yen per second.
scenarios.setting: Mysterious monsters attack the people of Japan, but heroes are there to protect them with powers that run on a rate of yen per second. For Hiasa Sen however, there are much more important things to worry about, like catching sales on groceries, his many part time jobs and most importantly, taking care of his little sister. When danger approaches however, he has a secret power of his own, but it may be more trouble than it's worth.

scenarios.title: 11 eyes
scenarios.description: 11eyes is a visual novel developed by studio Lass, that was later adapted into an anime by DogaKobo, and a manga.
scenarios.setting: 11eyes is a visual novel developed by studio Lass, that was later adapted into an anime by DogaKobo, and a manga. It follows Kakeru Satsuki, who lost his older sister five years ago.

scenarios.title: 123 Slaughter Me Street
scenarios.description: 123 Slaughter Me Street follows the actions of Tim Denson, a puppet creator and tv entertainer (Created the Froggle Friends show) turned criminal and murderer, as he encounters his puppets who are trying to kill him.
scenarios.setting: 123 Slaughter Me Street follows the actions of Tim Denson, a puppet creator and tv entertainer (Created the Froggle Friends show) turned criminal and murderer, as he encounters his puppets who are trying to kill him.

scenarios.title: 20 Million Miles to Earth
scenarios.description: 20 Million Miles to Earth (also known as The Beast from Space) is a 1957 American horror science fiction monster film directed by Nathan Juran and starring William Hopper, Joan Taylor, and Frank Puglia.
scenarios.setting: 20 Million Miles to Earth (also known as The Beast from Space) is a 1957 American horror science fiction monster film directed by Nathan Juran and starring William Hopper, Joan Taylor, and Frank Puglia. It was produced by Charles H. Schneer's Morningside Productions for Columbia Pictures. The screenplay was written by Bob Williams and Christopher Knopf from an original treatment by Charlott Knight.

scenarios.title: 50 Cent (Games)
scenarios.description: 50 Cent: Blood on the Sand is a third-person shooter video game developed by Swordfish Studios and published by THQ for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360.
scenarios.setting: The game centers around a fictional 50 Cent and G-Unit concert, set in an unspecified location in the Middle East.

scenarios.title: 60 Seconds!
scenarios.description: 60 Seconds! is a video game of Strategy and Survival officially released on May 25, 2015 by Robot Gentleman gaming company.
scenarios.setting: In this story, a gigantic bomb of pure radiation threatens to destroy the entire planet earth in a matter of mere seconds, so it's up to Ted to save his family and start surviving inside his secret banker for several days in a row at the end of the world.

scenarios.title: 666 Satan
scenarios.description: In the not too distant future, mankind battles over O-Parts, relics from an ancient civilization.
scenarios.setting: In the not too distant future, mankind battles over O-Parts, relics from an ancient civilization. s (or O-Parts Tacticians) become a force to be reckoned with. Unfortunately, O-Parts can be used for good or evil purposes. Jio is a young boy with a tragic past who only trusts one thing in the world: money. , and inside him sleeps a demon of incredible ferocity.

scenarios.title: 86 (Eighty-Six)
scenarios.description: The Republic of San Magnolia has long been under attack from the neighbouring Giadian Empire’s army of unmanned drones known as the Legion.
scenarios.setting: A War Without Casualties. The Republic of San Magnolia has long been under attack from the neighbouring Giadian Empire’s army of unmanned drones known as the Legion. After years of painstaking research, the Republic finally developed autonomous drones of their own, turning the one-sided struggle into a war without casualties-or at least, that’s what the government claims. In truth, there is no such thing as a bloodless war.

scenarios.title: 9-Nine
scenarios.description: 9-Nine is an episodic Visual Novel series composed of 4 episodes (9 -Nine- Kokonotsu Kokonoka Kokonoiro, 9 -Nine- Sorairo Sorauta Soranooto, 9 -Nine- Haruiro Harukoi Harunokaze, and 9 -Nine- Yukiiro Yukihana Yukinoato) where the direction of the story changes
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in the town of Shiromitsugawa, host to mysterious Artifacts and the superpowers they bestow on their Users.

scenarios.title: A Chinese Odyssey
scenarios.description: A Chinese Odyssey, alternatively known as Da Hua Xi You in mainland China, is a two-part 1995 Hong Kong fantasy-comedy films directed by Jeffrey Lau and starring Stephen Chow.
scenarios.setting: A Chinese Odyssey, alternatively known as Da Hua Xi You in mainland China, is a two-part 1995 Hong Kong fantasy-comedy films directed by Jeffrey Lau and starring Stephen Chow. The first part is titled A Chinese Odyssey Part One: Pandora's Box, while the second part is titled A Chinese Odyssey Part Two: Cinderella. A third film, A Chinese Odyssey Part Three, was released in China on 14 September 2016.

scenarios.title: A Christmas Carol (Disney)
scenarios.description: A Christmas Carol is a 2009 American computer-animated Christmas fantasy film written and directed by Robert Zemeckis, produced by ImageMovers Digital and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Based on Charles Dickens's 1843 novel of the same name, the film was animated through the process of motion capture, a technique used in Zemeckis's previous films The Polar Express (2004) and Beowulf (2007), and stars the voices of Jim Carrey, Gary Oldman, Colin Firth, Bob Hoskins, Robin Wright Penn and Cary Elwes.

scenarios.title: A Hat in Time
scenarios.description: A Hat in Time is a 3D platformer published by Gears for Breakfast in 2017.
scenarios.setting: A Hat in Time is a 3D platformer published by Gears for Breakfast in 2017. It was released for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. It tells us the story of Hat Kid, a little girl that wants to come back to her natal planet, but for that, she needs to recover all the Time Pieces that she lost.

scenarios.title: A House of Many Doors
scenarios.description: Welcome to the House. You are not welcome.
scenarios.setting: Welcome to the House. You are not welcome. Explore the House, a parasite dimension that steals from other worlds, in a train that scuttles on mechanical legs...

scenarios.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
scenarios.description: A Nightmare on Elm Street is an American supernatural slasher-horror media franchise consisting of nine films, a television series, novels, comic books, and various other media.
scenarios.setting: A Nightmare on Elm Street is an American supernatural slasher-horror media franchise consisting of nine films, a television series, novels, comic books, and various other media. The franchise began with the film A Nightmare on Elm Street (1984), written and directed by Wes Craven.

scenarios.title: A Simple Series
scenarios.description: A Simple Series is the name used to refer to two Japanese light novels written by Kazuma Kamachi.
scenarios.setting: After reading all the stories the reader is prompted to rank them, and this ranking will define which route Anzai Kyousuke, the protagonist and one of the students to take the survey, follows in the second part of the novel, with four short possible routes. The second novel, A Simple Monitoring, follows Higashikawa Mamoru, another university student who takes a part-time job in an amusement park called Attraction Land.

scenarios.title: A Song of Ice and Fire
scenarios.source: A Song of Ice and Fire
scenarios.description: A Song of Ice and Fire (commonly abbreviated as ASoIaF or ASOIAF) is an ongoing series of epic fantasy novels by American novelist and screenwriter George R.
scenarios.setting: A Song of Ice and Fire (commonly abbreviated as ASoIaF or ASOIAF) is an ongoing series of epic fantasy novels by American novelist and screenwriter George R. R. Martin. Martin began writing the series in 1991 and the first volume was published in 1996. Originally planned as a trilogy, the series now consists of five published volumes, and a further two are planned.

scenarios.title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared
scenarios.description: A Wild Last Boss Appeared (野生のラスボスが現れた！Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta!) is a web novel written by Firehead that was adapted into a light novel with illustrations by YahaKo.
scenarios.setting: It follows Ruphas Mafahl who in the year 2800 of the Midgard calendar was an Overlord who once reigned supreme and had reached the very brink of subduing the world. —or so went the story of our protagonist’s in-game character, whose body he now possesses for some reason in a world 200 years after Ruphas’ downfall. Follow our protagonist as he becomes unnecessarily feared by his surroundings and unnecessarily worshiped by his former subordinates as he―or now she―cheerfully travels around this fantasy world.

scenarios.title: A-Bout!
scenarios.description: A-bout! (市川マサ, A-BOUT!) is manga written and illustrated by Ichikawa Masa.
scenarios.setting: Mitsumine High School is known as the school with the most juvenile delinquents in the country.

scenarios.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
scenarios.description: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter centers around Abraham Lincoln's adventures in hunting vampires.
scenarios.setting: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter centers around Abraham Lincoln's adventures in hunting vampires.

scenarios.title: Absolute Duo
scenarios.description: 《Blaze》 That is a weapon made by materializing your own soul with your enhanced will power.
scenarios.setting: 《Blaze》 That is a weapon made by materializing your own soul with your enhanced will power. I, Tooru Kokonoe, have that ability which is said to be possessed only by one in every one thousand people, so it was decided that I would enroll in Kouryou academy that gives out《Blaze》, and a school that teaches battle techniques. 》 The story begins with Blaze — a weapon that is the manifestation of a human's soul.

scenarios.title: Absolver
scenarios.description: Absolver is a martial arts based Action RPG developed by Sloclap studios.
scenarios.setting: Absolver is a martial arts based Action RPG developed by Sloclap studios. Within the game, you are a Prospect, an Absolver-in-training, sent to become strong enough to protect the fallen city of Raslan to ensure the mistakes of the past do not reoccur. The game is largely sold as a PVP fighting game but has an in-depth story hidden behind that.

scenarios.title: Ace Attorney
scenarios.description: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, known in Japan as Gyakuten Saiban (逆転裁判, lit.
scenarios.setting: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, known in Japan as Gyakuten Saiban (逆転裁判, lit. "Turnabout Trial"), is a visual novel adventure video game developed by Capcom. It was originally released for the Game Boy Advance in 2001 in Japan, and has since been ported to multiple platforms. The Nintendo DS version, titled Gyakuten Saiban Yomigaeru Gyakuten in Japan, was released in 2005 in Japan and North America, and in 2006 in Europe, and includes an English language option.

scenarios.title: Adventure Time
scenarios.description: Adventure Time is a Cartoon Network show made by Pendleton Ward.
scenarios.setting: For detailed information about the series, see the Adventure Time Wiki.

scenarios.title: AEverse
scenarios.description: Artix Entertainment, LLC (often abbreviated to AE) is an independent video game developer and publisher founded by Adam Bohn (better known to players by his pseudonym, Artix von Krieger) in October 2002.
scenarios.setting: Artix Entertainment, LLC (often abbreviated to AE) is an independent video game developer and publisher founded by Adam Bohn (better known to players by his pseudonym, Artix von Krieger) in October 2002. It is best known for creating browser-based role-playing video games—including AdventureQuest, DragonFable, MechQuest, and AdventureQuest Worlds—using Adobe Flash.

scenarios.title: Afro Samurai
scenarios.description: There exist two headbands of legend.
scenarios.setting: Since that day, a vengeance brewed within the child, setting him down a path of endless bloodshed and tragedy.

scenarios.title: Agar.io
scenarios.description: Agar.io is an online multiplayer game created by Matheus Valadares, in the game the player controls a cell in a map that represents a Petri dish with the goal of reaching as much mass as possible by eating other cells/players.
scenarios.setting: io is an online multiplayer game created by Matheus Valadares, in the game the player controls a cell in a map that represents a Petri dish with the goal of reaching as much mass as possible by eating other cells/players.

scenarios.title: Agon
scenarios.description: Agon (アゴン) is a 1968 black-and-white Japanese tokusatsu kaiju miniseries supervised and co-written by prolific Toho screenwriter Shinichi Sekizawa.
scenarios.setting: Agon (アゴン) is a 1968 black-and-white Japanese tokusatsu kaiju miniseries supervised and co-written by prolific Toho screenwriter Shinichi Sekizawa. The first half was directed by Norio Mine and written by Sekizawa, while the second half was directed by Fuminori Ohashi and written by Kozo Uchida. Ohashi also served as the director of special effects on all four episodes.

scenarios.title: AI: The Somnium Files
scenarios.description: The first entry is a mystery adventure game written and directed by Kotaro Uchikoshi, co-directed and designed by Akira Okada, produced by Yasuhiro Iizuka, and developed by Spike Chunsoft.
scenarios.setting: The game follows Kaname Date as protagonist, a detective tasked to solve the murder alongside his partner, Aiba. The story follows an older Mizuki Okiura and her partner Aiba solving the case of the Half Body serial killings.

scenarios.title: Aim for the Top!
scenarios.description: Gunbuster! (or Aim for the Top!) is a 6 episode mecha OVA and the first work of Hideaki Anno as a director.
scenarios.setting: Gunbuster! ) is a 6 episode mecha OVA and the first work of Hideaki Anno as a director. It focus's on Noriko's fight against the space monsters and her rise to courage. A sequel OVA called Diebuster! was released 20 years later, which is set just before the epilogue of Gunbuster!

scenarios.title: Aion
scenarios.description: Aion, the creator of Atreia, once created the planet and gave Aether to the world.
scenarios.setting: Aion, the creator of Atreia, once created the planet and gave Aether to the world. He created the Humans and Drakan, with the Drakan intended to be the rulers, and to protect Atreia and the Humans. He created the Tower of Eternity to house his Aether, which was the essence of life distributed all over the world. The tower is the literal pillar located at the center of the planet. Life inside of Atreia was peaceful.

scenarios.title: Ajin
scenarios.description: Those who are resistant to death are called "Demi-humans".
scenarios.setting: Those who are resistant to death are called "Demi-humans".

scenarios.title: Akame ga Kill!
scenarios.description: Akame ga Kill! is a manga series written by Takahiro and illustrated by Tetsuya Tashiro.
scenarios.setting: Akame ga Kill! is a manga series written by Takahiro and illustrated by Tetsuya Tashiro. The story focuses on Tatsumi, a young villager who travels to the Capital to raise money for his home only to discover a strong corruption in the area. The assassin group Night Raid recruits the young man to help them in their fight against the Empire to end its corruption. This series has a a spin-off prequel and sequel which are Akame ga Kill!

scenarios.title: Akatsuki Blitzkampf
scenarios.description: Akatsuki Blitzkampf (アカツキ電光戦記 Akatsuki Denkō Senki) is a doujinshi fighting game developed by Subtle Style.
scenarios.setting: Akatsuki Blitzkampf (アカツキ電光戦記 Akatsuki Denkō Senki) is a doujinshi fighting game developed by Subtle Style. Released on April of 2007 as a sequel to Subtle Style's 2002 game Akatsuki Shisei Ichigou, Akatsuki Blitzkampf got a lot of attention in Japan and elsewhere for its high-resolution sprites and older style gameplay. In-game visuals supplement this sort of specific militaristic theme and environment, portrayed by the flat and somewhat cubist character portraits and story sequence images.

scenarios.title: Akatsuki no Yona
scenarios.description: Yona lives a life of luxury and ease, completely sheltered from the problems of the seemingly peaceful Kingdom of Kouka; however, the sudden murder of the king and betrayal of her beloved cousin Su-won places Yona's life in mortal peril.
scenarios.setting: Yona lives a life of luxury and ease, completely sheltered from the problems of the seemingly peaceful Kingdom of Kouka; however, the sudden murder of the king and betrayal of her beloved cousin Su-won places Yona's life in mortal peril. Poverty, strife, and corruption run rampant, making reclaiming the throne nothing more than a wishful fantasy given the kingdom's current state.

scenarios.title: Akatsukiverse
scenarios.description: The Akatsukiverse are different novel series written by Natsume Akatsuki that share the same multiverse.
scenarios.setting: The Akatsukiverse are different novel series written by Natsume Akatsuki that share the same multiverse.

scenarios.title: Akira
scenarios.description: Akira (often stylized as AKIRA) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Katsuhiro Otomo.
scenarios.setting: Set in a post-apocalyptic Neo-Tokyo, the work uses conventions of the cyberpunk genre to detail a saga of turmoil. Throughout the breadth of the work, Otomo explores themes of social isolation, corruption, and power. The manga takes place in a longer time frame than the film, and involves a much wider array of characters and subplots.

scenarios.title: Akuma no Riddle
scenarios.description: Akuma no Riddle or Riddle Story of Devil is a manga written by Yun Kōga and illustrated by Sunao Minakata.
scenarios.setting: At the all-girl's school and boarding school Myōjō Academy, thirteen girls are transferred into the 10th year Class Black.

scenarios.title: Aladdin (Disney Franchise)
scenarios.description: Aladdin is a 1992 American animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Aladdin garnered two Academy Awards, as well as other accolades for its soundtrack, which had the first and only number from a Disney feature to earn a Grammy Award for Song of the Year, for the film's "A Whole New World", sung by Peabo Bryson and Regina Belle.

scenarios.title: ALDNOAH.ZERO
scenarios.description: |-|Aldnoah Zero Gaiden: Twin Gemini=center|450px
scenarios.setting: |-|Aldnoah Zero Gaiden: Twin Gemini=center|450px

scenarios.title: Alice in Wonderland
scenarios.description: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, more commonly known as Alice in Wonderland, is an English children's novel penned in 1864 by Charles L.
scenarios.setting: A quintessential part of not only children's literature and poetry, but of Western literary sphere as a whole, it tells of a young Alice and her adventures within the mystical and surrealistic realm of Wonderland, and her encounters with the colourful cast of creatures, people and gizmos within. The story was followed up by the 1871 sequel novel Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There, where Alice this time discovers and explores the Looking-Glass world.

scenarios.title: Alien
scenarios.description: The Alien series is a science fiction horror film series consisting of six installments, focusing on Lieutenant Ellen Ripley and her battles with the Xenomrophs or Aliens.
scenarios.setting: The Alien series is a science fiction horror film series consisting of six installments, focusing on Lieutenant Ellen Ripley and her battles with the Xenomrophs or Aliens. Produced by 20th Century Fox, the series started with Alien (1979), which led to three movie sequels, as well as numerous books, comics and video game spin-offs.

scenarios.title: All Tomorrows
scenarios.description: All Tomorrows: A Billion Year Chronicle of the Myriad Species and Mixed Fortunes of Man is a 2006 work of science fiction and speculative evolution written and illustrated by the Turkish artist C.
scenarios.setting: Several future human species evolve through natural means and through genetic engineering, conducted by both humans themselves and by a mysterious and superior hive mind called the Qu.

scenarios.title: All You Need Is Kill
scenarios.description: All You Need Is Kill (オール・ユー・ニード・イズ・キル) is a light novel by Hiroshi Sakurazaka with illustrations by Yoshitoshi ABe.
scenarios.setting: It follows a soldier named Keiji Kiriya, who, after dying in a battle with extraterrestrials named Mimics, is caught in a time loop that makes him live the same day repeatedly, allowing Kiriya to improve his fighting skills.

scenarios.title: Alpha
scenarios.description: Alpha is a 2018 American historical adventure film directed by Albert Hughes and written by Daniele Sebastian Wiedenhaupt, from a story by Hughes.
scenarios.setting: Principal photography began in February 2016 in Canada and lasted through that April.

scenarios.title: Altered Beast
scenarios.description: Altered Beast is a 1988 beat 'em up video game developed and published by Sega for arcades.
scenarios.setting: The game is set in Ancient Greece and follows a player character chosen by Zeus to rescue his daughter Athena from the demonic ruler of the underworld, Neff.

scenarios.title: Altina the Sword Princess
scenarios.description: Altina the Sword Princess is a Light Novel series written by Yukiya Murasaki, and tells the story of Regis Auric, a strategist on the army of the country of Belgaria.
scenarios.setting: Together, they strive to make Altina the Empress so that she can fix the corruption in their country and stop all the conflicts with the neighboring nations that have lasted for generations.

scenarios.title: American Assassin
scenarios.description: American Assassin is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by Michael Cuesta and starring Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, Shiva Negar, and Taylor Kitsch.
scenarios.setting: American Assassin is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by Michael Cuesta and starring Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, Shiva Negar, and Taylor Kitsch. Written by Stephen Schiff, Michael Finch, Edward Zwick, and Marshall Herskovitz, the film was based on Vince Flynn's 2010 novel of the same name. The story is centered on young CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp, who helps a Cold War veteran try to stop the detonation of a rogue nuclear weapon.

scenarios.title: American Dad!
scenarios.description: American Dad! is an American animated television series created by Seth MacFarlane, Mike Barker, and Matt Weitzman.
scenarios.setting: American Dad! is an American animated television series created by Seth MacFarlane, Mike Barker, and Matt Weitzman. The show premiered on Fox in 2005 and focuses on the life of the eccentric Smith family. The main character of the show is Stan Smith, a patriotic CIA agent.

scenarios.title: American McGee's Alice
scenarios.description: Alice, better known as American McGee's Alice, is an American media franchise with its initial releases developed by American McGee.
scenarios.setting: A twisted take on the Alice in Wonderland, the story follows Alice's struggles with the Wonderland in her mind after traumatically losing her family in a fire, and the trials and tribulations she faces in the real world for her conditions as the lines between the two worlds blur.

scenarios.title: American Psycho
scenarios.description: American Psycho is a satirical horror novel by American writer Bret Easton Ellis, published in 1991.
scenarios.setting: American Psycho is a satirical horror novel by American writer Bret Easton Ellis, published in 1991. The story is told in the first-person by Patrick Bateman, a wealthy, narcissistic, and vain Manhattan investment banker who lives a double life as a serial killer. Alison Kelly of The Observer notes that while "some countries [deem it] so potentially disturbing that it can only be sold shrink-wrapped", "critics rave about it" and "academics revel in its transgressive and postmodern qualities".

scenarios.title: Amnesia
scenarios.description: Amnesia is a series of survival horror games developed by Frictional Games, consisting of Amnesia: The Dark Decent and Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs, alongside side-stories like Amnesia: Justine.
scenarios.setting: The series begins following the plot of Daniel, an amnesiac who wakes up in Castle Brenningburn, discovering the building's horrific secrets and what role he played in the cruel acts that took place in its walls.

scenarios.title: Among Us
scenarios.description: Among Us is a murder mystery game created by Innersloth.
scenarios.setting: Among Us is a murder mystery game created by Innersloth. In the game, you either play as a Crewmate or an Impostor. The goal of the crew members is to finish all their tasks, and find who the Impostor is while the Impostor has to kill the crewmates before they do so.

scenarios.title: Amphibia
scenarios.description: Amphibia is a Disney XD cartoon series made by Matt Braly.
scenarios.setting: Amphibia is a Disney XD cartoon series made by Matt Braly. It involves a teenage girl, Anne, and her friends being transported to a dimension inhabited by anthropomorphic amphibians.

scenarios.title: An American Werewolf in London
scenarios.description: An American Werewolf in London is a 1981 horror black comedy film written and directed by John Landis.
scenarios.setting: An American Werewolf in London is a 1981 horror black comedy film written and directed by John Landis. An international co-production of the United Kingdom and the United States, the film stars David Naughton, Jenny Agutter, Griffin Dunne and John Woodvine. The film's plot follows two American backpackers, David and Jack, who are attacked by a werewolf while traveling in England, causing David to question whether he will become a werewolf under the next full moon.

scenarios.title: Angry Birds
scenarios.description: Angry Birds is a video game franchise created by the Finnish company Rovio Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Angry Birds is a video game franchise created by the Finnish company Rovio Entertainment. The series focuses on multi-colored birds that try to save their eggs from green-colored pigs, their enemies on an island named Piggy Island. The original game has been praised for its successful combination of fun gameplay, comical style and low price.

scenarios.title: Animal Crossing
scenarios.description: The Animal Crossing video game series is a series of communication adventure games exclusively for Nintendo consoles.
scenarios.setting: The Animal Crossing video game series is a series of communication adventure games exclusively for Nintendo consoles.

scenarios.title: Animal Kaiser: The King of Animals
scenarios.source: Animal Kaiser: The King of Animals
scenarios.description: Animal Kaiser is a trading card arcade game that was released in September 2007.
scenarios.setting: The Hero animals protect the earth throughout each new volume from villains who progressively get stronger.

scenarios.title: Animorphs
scenarios.description: Animorphs is a Scholastic book series written by K.A.
scenarios.setting: A. V. series. The story revolves around five kids as they fight a war against aliens to save the Earth. The series has a major focus on the main cast dealing with PTSD and other mental trauma.

scenarios.title: Ao Oni
scenarios.description: Ao Oni (青鬼, lit. 'Blue Demon') is a freeware RPGmaker horror game and dojin soft video game series with puzzle elements created by noprops. It was first released in Japan in November 2008. The game follows a group of teenagers that decide to explore a deserted
scenarios.setting: The game follows a group of teenagers that decide to explore a deserted mansion that is rumored to be haunted. The group heavily disagree with the rumors that the mansion is haunted not believing in the supernatural, the group soon discovers that the mansion is home to a mysterious creature referred to as "Ao Oni", a tall humanoid with a deformed face that proceeds to chase after Hiroshi while attempting to escape the mansion from this demonic creature.

scenarios.title: Ape Escape
scenarios.description: Ape Escape (known as Saru Get You (サルゲッチュ Saru Getchu?) in Japan) is a video game franchise developed by SCE Japan and published by Sony Computer Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: ) in Japan) is a video game franchise developed by SCE Japan and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. The series usually revolves a boy named Spike (Kakeru in Japan) and all of his friends and allies fighting against an army of monkeys, under the command of Specter, from taking over the world with a vast variety of gadgets and technology developed by the professor. The franchise is known for the innovative use of the dual analog controls.

scenarios.title: Ape vs. Monster
scenarios.description: Ape vs. Monster is a 2021 American science fiction monster film produced by The Asylum. Keeping with The Asylum's mainstay theme of mockbusters, it was released on April 30 the same year as the 2021 monster film Godzilla vs. Kong, with some resemblance to Ramp
scenarios.setting: Ape vs. Monster is a 2021 American science fiction monster film produced by The Asylum. Keeping with The Asylum's mainstay theme of mockbusters, it was released on April 30 the same year as the 2021 monster film Godzilla vs.

scenarios.title: Arcaea
scenarios.description: Arcaea is a mobile rhythm game developed by lowiro, released on March 9, 2017.
scenarios.setting: Arcaea is a mobile rhythm game developed by lowiro, released on March 9, 2017. The game known for its deep storyline and unique gameplay mechanics; players tap, hold, and slide on a musical arc as they follow notes that appear in time with music. It also features both "sky" and "ground" notes that players must interact with. The storyline is set in a world of glass where memories take form as crystals, each representing fragments of past lives and emotions.

scenarios.title: Archean Eon Art
scenarios.description: Archean Eon Art is the tenth Xuanhuan Fantasy Chinese novel created by I Eat Tomatoes (IET), whose other works include Coiling Dragon and Stellar Transformation, Desolate Era, Lord Xue Ying.
scenarios.setting: According to Daoism, it is the absolute principle underlying the universe, combining within itself the principles of Yin and Yang and signifying the way, or code of behavior, that is in harmony with the natural order. Immortals – beings who ascended to Immortality through Daoist cultivation practices. They have magical powers, can fly freely through the air, and have a close connection to the Dao and the natural world.

scenarios.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
scenarios.source: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
scenarios.description: Are You Afraid of the Dark is a Canadian horror anthology tv series made on Nickelodeon, similar to verses like Goosebumps, Tales from the Crypt, and The Twilight Zone.
scenarios.setting: Are You Afraid of the Dark is a Canadian horror anthology tv series made on Nickelodeon, similar to verses like Goosebumps, Tales from the Crypt, and The Twilight Zone. Nearly every episode is a self-contained story, with the occasional follow-up or sequel. Stories vary greatly but they always keep an element of horror. It had a recent resurgence that came in the form of a new show made in 2019, sharing the same name.

scenarios.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
scenarios.source: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
scenarios.description: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest is a light novel, manga and web novel which follows seventeen-year-old Nagumo Hajime, who was your average, everyday otaku.
scenarios.setting: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest is a light novel, manga and web novel which follows seventeen-year-old Nagumo Hajime, who was your average, everyday otaku. Suddenly, his life was turned upside down when he, along with the rest of his classmates, were summoned to a fantasy world and treated like heroes, tasked with the duty of saving the human race from total annihilation. During a journey exploring a dungeon with his classmates, he falls to the depth of the abyss.

scenarios.title: Ark: Survival Evolved
scenarios.description: As a man or woman stranded, naked, freezing, and starving on the unforgiving shores of a mysterious island called ARK, use your skill and cunning to kill or tame and ride the plethora of leviathan dinosaurs and other primeval creatures roaming the land.
scenarios.setting: As a man or woman stranded, naked, freezing, and starving on the unforgiving shores of a mysterious island called ARK, use your skill and cunning to kill or tame and ride the plethora of leviathan dinosaurs and other primeval creatures roaming the land. Hunt, harvest resources, craft items, grow crops, research technologies, and build shelters to withstand the elements and store valuables, all while teaming up with (or preying upon) hundreds of other players to survive, dominate... and escape!

scenarios.title: Arknights
scenarios.description: Arknights is a tower defense mobile role-playing game developed by Hypergryph and YOSTAR.
scenarios.setting: Arknights is a tower defense mobile role-playing game developed by Hypergryph and YOSTAR. - Power of the Verse= The physical strength of characters varies greatly, it is implied that citizens of Terra are physically stronger than humans. Many of those are capable of superhuman feats such as breaking walls, flinging heavy weapons with ease, or casting explosives with an effect comparable to that of a grenade or an RPG.

scenarios.title: Armed With Wings
scenarios.description: Armed With Wings is a free flash game on Newgrounds created by Daniel-Sun.
scenarios.setting: It's a unique platformer with elements of a puzzle game and a stealth game at once, since you can not only fight enemies with your sword, but also send out your eagle to solve a variety of difficult puzzles and distract enemies as you venture through the lands to reach and face the evil ruler himself.

scenarios.title: Armored Core
scenarios.description: Armored Core (アーマード・コア Āmādo Koa) is an mecha-action role-playing video game series developed by FromSoftware and published by Namco Bandai Games for PlayStation, Xbox, and Microsoft Windows.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place 50 years after the "Great Destruction", a cataclysmic event which killed most of the planet's population. The game takes place 5 years after Armored Core 2 after the government regains control of humanity as they try to relocate subterranean humans to the surface. It takes place after Navis's failed attempt to utilize their technology to dominate the world.

scenarios.title: ARMS
scenarios.description: ARMS is a fighting game developed by Nintendo EPD exclusive to the Nintendo Switch.
scenarios.setting: The game features professional boxer-like fighters who can attack each other from across an arena using weapons known as ARMS, which are attached to the ends of the fighters' extendable limbs, also known as ARMS. Set in a world with an unusual rare ability gifted to a minority, of whom are able to extend their arms out like springs.

scenarios.title: Arpeggio of Blue Steel
scenarios.description: Suddenly, a fleet of ships called the “Fleet of Fog” appeared all around the world.
scenarios.setting: Humanity didn’t possess the technology to fight back and thus were driven out of the sea...

scenarios.title: Arrowverse (CW)
scenarios.description: The Arrowverse is a shared fictional universe that is centered on television series airing on The CW, based on characters appearing in publications by DC Comics.
scenarios.setting: The Arrowverse is a shared fictional universe that is centered on television series airing on The CW, based on characters appearing in publications by DC Comics. The first television series was Arrow based on the character Green Arrow, which debuted in October 2012. The universe was expanded with the series The Flash in October 2014, which is based on Barry Allen/Flash.

scenarios.title: Artery Gear: Fusion
scenarios.description: Artery Gear: Fusion is an online, free-to-play, turn-based role-playing mobile game developed by Access and published by bilibili, using the Unity game engine.
scenarios.setting: For more detailed information about this series, visit the Artery Gear: Fusion Codex Wiki or the Artery Gear: Fusion Wiki.

scenarios.title: Ashita no Joe
scenarios.description: Ashita no Joe (Japanese: あしたのジョー Hepburn: Ashita no Jō, "Tomorrow's Joe") is a boxing manga written by Asao Takamori (aka Ikki Kajiwara) and illustrated by Tetsuya Chiba in 1968 that was later adapted into an anime series and movie.
scenarios.setting: is set in a city where the wealthy are licensed citizens and those on the outskirts are unlicensed citizens living in poverty, the sport of megalo boxing has risen.

scenarios.title: Assassin's Creed
scenarios.description: Assassin's Creed is an action-adventure stealth video game franchise created by Patrice Désilets, Jade Raymond and Corey May, developed and published by Ubisoft using the game engine Anvil and its more advanced derivatives.
scenarios.setting: For the first five main games, the framing story is set in 2012 and features series protagonist Desmond Miles who uses a machine called the Animus and relives the memories of his ancestors to find a way to avert the 2012 apocalypse. The main games of Assassin's Creed are set in an open world and presented from the third-person perspective where the protagonists take down targets using their combat and stealth skills with the exploitation of the environment.

scenarios.title: Assassination Classroom
scenarios.description: Assassination Classroom (暗殺教室 Ansatsu Kyōshitsu), stylized as ASSASSINATION CLASSROOM is a Japanese manga written and illustrated by Yūsei Matsui that has appeared in Shueisha's Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine from July 2012 to March 2016.
scenarios.setting: The series follows the daily life of an extremely powerful octopus-like being working as a junior high homeroom teacher, and his students dedicated to the task of assassinating him to prevent Earth from being destroyed.

scenarios.title: Astérix
scenarios.description: Astérix is a series of fictional comic books created by René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo.
scenarios.setting: Astérix is a series of fictional comic books created by René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo. Although they are originally written and published in French, their extreme popularity has resulted in the books being released in a wide range of languages. The series focuses around the adventures of the Gaulish warrior Astérix and his friend Obélix. It is the second best selling comic book series in history, only exceeded by One Piece.

scenarios.title: Astraverse
scenarios.description: In ancient India, a group of sages in the Himalayas pray to the Gods and are blessed with the energy Brahm-shakti, which produces many celestial weapons of great power called astras.
scenarios.setting: In ancient India, a group of sages in the Himalayas pray to the Gods and are blessed with the energy Brahm-shakti, which produces many celestial weapons of great power called astras. The strongest among them, the Brahmāstra, has the capacity to destroy everything. The sages use their respective astras to tame the unstable Brahmāstra and become the Brahmānsh, a secret society to protect the world from the powers of astras.

scenarios.title: Astro Royale
scenarios.description: Astro Royale (Japanese: 願いの アストロ, Hepburn: Negai no Asutoro) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Ken Wakui.
scenarios.setting: It began serialization on April 15, 2024, with its debut appearing across Weekly Shonen Jump's 2024 Issue #20.

scenarios.title: Asura's Wrath
scenarios.description: Asura's Wrath is an action video game developed by CyberConnect2 and published by Capcom in 2012.
scenarios.setting: The story is the epic tale set in a world suspended between past and future, where humanity stands under the aegis of Shinkoku Tastrium, a society of demigods stuck in a war against Gohma Vlitra, a monster embodying the rebellious will of their home planet.

scenarios.title: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
scenarios.description: Atlantis: The Lost Empire is a 2001 American animated film created by Walt Disney Feature Animation—the first science fiction film in the Animated Canon and the 41st overall.
scenarios.setting: Set in 1914, the film tells the story of a young man who gains possession of a sacred book, which he believes will guide him and a crew of adventurers to the lost city of Atlantis.

scenarios.title: Attack of the 50 Foot Woman
scenarios.description: Attack of the 50 Foot Woman is a 1958 independently made American science fiction horror film directed by Nathan H.
scenarios.setting: Attack of the 50 Foot Woman is a 1958 independently made American science fiction horror film directed by Nathan H. Juran (credited as Nathan Hertz) and starring Allison Hayes, William Hudson and Yvette Vickers. It was produced by Bernard Woolner. The screenplay was written by Mark Hanna, and the original music score was composed by Ronald Stein. The film was distributed in the United States by Allied Artists as a double feature with War of the Satellites.

scenarios.title: Attack of the Earthlings
scenarios.description: Attack of the Earthlings is a turn-based strategy game created by Team Junkfish (of Monstrum fame) set on an alien world where humans have arrived to suck the planet dry of resources.
scenarios.setting: Attack of the Earthlings is a turn-based strategy game created by Team Junkfish (of Monstrum fame) set on an alien world where humans have arrived to suck the planet dry of resources.

scenarios.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
scenarios.description: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an animated series created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko.
scenarios.setting: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an animated series created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko. It centers around Aang, the incarnation of the spirit of the earth (known as the Avatar), and his quest to stop the tyrannical Fire Nation from taking out the other countries- the Water Tribes, Earth Kingdom, and Air Nomads. Aang's native nation, the Air Nomads, were already wiped out a century ago, hence the title.

scenarios.title: Axe Cop
scenarios.description: Axe Cop is a series of webcomics written by Malachai Nicolle (age 5 when the series began in December 2009) and illustrated by his older brother, Ethan Nicolle (age 29 when the series began).
scenarios.setting: Axe Cop is a series of webcomics written by Malachai Nicolle (age 5 when the series began in December 2009) and illustrated by his older brother, Ethan Nicolle (age 29 when the series began). The former comes up with the ideas and the plot, while the latter brings them to life with pictures. The series would soon get its own TV adaptation from Fox in 2013. The story is centered around the titular character Axe Cop, real name Axey Smartist, who is often seen wielding an axe in combat.

scenarios.title: Azur Lane
scenarios.description: Azur Lane (碧蓝航线) is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up video game developed by Manjuu and Yongshi, published by bilibili for both iOS and Android.
scenarios.setting: Azur Lane (碧蓝航线) is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up video game developed by Manjuu and Yongshi, published by bilibili for both iOS and Android. Set in an alternate timeline of World War II, the player takes on the role of a Commander, commanding and maintaining a fleet of shipgirls. In the midst of an earlier worldwide conflict, mysterious enemies named the Siren emerged from the sea, devastating the divided nations of the world and causing humanity to lose more than 90% of its control over the sea.

scenarios.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt
scenarios.description: Azure Striker Gunvolt, known as Armed Blue Gunvolt in Japan, is a platform game released by Inti Creates for the Nintendo 3DS eShop released in August 2014.
scenarios.setting: Azure Striker Gunvolt, known as Armed Blue Gunvolt in Japan, is a platform game released by Inti Creates for the Nintendo 3DS eShop released in August 2014. In addition to utilizing gameplay similar to Mega Man Zero and Mega Man ZX, Azure Striker Gunvolt also introduced new gameplay elements such as Gunvolt's ability to "tag" enemies and target many at once, adding a layer of complexity to the genre.

scenarios.title: Baahubali
scenarios.description: Baahubali is a Indian epic movie saga made up of two parts that have released in 2015 and 2017 respectively.
scenarios.setting: Baahubali is a Indian epic movie saga made up of two parts that have released in 2015 and 2017 respectively.

scenarios.title: Baccano!
scenarios.description: In the year 1711, a group of alchemists is granted an elixir of immortality, with the stipulation that they must kill each other until there can be only one.
scenarios.setting: However, he loses it and it ends up going around town, taken to be a bottle of alcohol and unknowingly drunk by many residents.

scenarios.title: Back to the Future
scenarios.description: Back to the Future is a science fiction film trilogy created by Robert Zemeckis and Bob Gale.
scenarios.setting: Emmett Brown as they use a modified DeLorean automobile to travel through time. Throughout the trilogy, Marty must ensure his own existence, confront various versions of the Tannen family across different time periods, and correct temporal disruptions caused by interference with the past.

scenarios.title: Backyard Wrestling
scenarios.description: Backyard Wrestling is a video game developed by Paradox Development, and published by Eidos Interactive in 2003 for Xbox and PlayStation 2.
scenarios.setting: Backyard Wrestling is a video game developed by Paradox Development, and published by Eidos Interactive in 2003 for Xbox and PlayStation 2. The goal of backyard wrestling is largely to use your environment to defeat your opponent. The featured wrestlers come mostly from rap group Insane Clown Posse's own wrestling federation, the Juggalo Championshit Wrestling. These include Mad Man Pondo, Sabu, Tom Dub, Rude Boy, Josh Prohibition, MDogg20 and the clowns themselves, Violent J and Shaggy 2 Dope.

scenarios.title: Bad Boys
scenarios.description: Bad Boys is an action movie franchise centering on Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett, narcotics detectives with the Miami Police Department.
scenarios.setting: Bad Boys is an action movie franchise centering on Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett, narcotics detectives with the Miami Police Department. The films include Bad Boys, released in 1995, Bad Boys II, released in 2003, Bad Boys for Life, released in 2020, and Bad Boys: Ride or Die, released in 2024. 's Finest, featuring Marcus' sister Syd Burnett and her partner Nancy McKenna, with the second and final season releasing in 2020. A video game based off the second film, Bad Boys: Miami Takedown, was released in 2004.

scenarios.title: Bad Moon
scenarios.description: Bad Moon is a 1996 Canadian-American horror film written and directed by Eric Red, and produced by James G.
scenarios.setting: Martin's Press hardback, Ballantine paperback), and in the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden and Norway, in English, German, Dutch, Swedish and Norwegian.

scenarios.title: Bakugan
scenarios.description: Bakugan Battle Brawlers (爆 丸 バ ト ル ブ ロ ー ラ ー ズ Bakugan Batoru Burōrāzu, called in Latin America Los Fighters Battle Bakugan and Bakugan: Battle) is an anime series directed by Mitsuo Hashimoto based on Bakugan a strategic card game created by Sega Toys and Spin Master using metal cards and miniature action figures.
scenarios.setting: Bakugan Battle Brawlers (爆 丸 バ ト ル ブ ロ ー ラ ー ズ Bakugan Batoru Burōrāzu, called in Latin America Los Fighters Battle Bakugan and Bakugan: Battle) is an anime series directed by Mitsuo Hashimoto based on Bakugan a strategic card game created by Sega Toys and Spin Master using metal cards and miniature action figures. The story focuses on the lives of creatures called Bakugan and the fighters that dominate. The series debuted in Japan on TV Tokyo on April 5, 2007 with 51 episodes.

scenarios.title: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning
scenarios.source: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning
scenarios.description: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning is a quick Indie Horror Game that was put together in a few days for a contest.
scenarios.setting: The game follows the player, who is presumably a student, as they collect notebooks that were forgotten by their friend around the school, while running from Professor Baldi, an evil teacher with a meter stick.

scenarios.title: Balgar
scenarios.description: Balgar (Българ) is a Bulgarian satirical/parody animated web series, created by Nedelcho Bogdanov and set in the town of Nessebar, the show likes to satirize parts of everyday Bulgarian life and pop culture.
scenarios.setting: Balgar (Българ) is a Bulgarian satirical/parody animated web series, created by Nedelcho Bogdanov and set in the town of Nessebar, the show likes to satirize parts of everyday Bulgarian life and pop culture.

scenarios.title: Banjo-Kazooie
scenarios.description: Banjo-Kazooie is a series of video games created by Rare.
scenarios.setting: Banjo-Kazooie is a series of video games created by Rare. The games feature a lazy brown bear named Banjo and his friend, a large female, sassy breegull called Kazooie, who are both controlled by the player. Throughout the various games, they are tasked with thwarting the various evil schemes of a witch named Gruntilda, who tries to steal the beauty of Banjo's sister, Tooty and the life force of the Jinjos for her own selfish gains. The first game, Banjo-Kazooie, was released on the Nintendo 64 in 1998.

scenarios.title: Barlas Tunga Destanı
scenarios.description: Barlas Tunga Destanı is a superhero universe inspired by Turkish mythology and history and drawing on other mythologies.
scenarios.setting: Barlas Tunga Destanı is a superhero universe inspired by Turkish mythology and history and drawing on other mythologies.

scenarios.title: Barney & Friends
scenarios.description: Barney & Friends is an American children's television series aimed at preschoolers.
scenarios.setting: The main character of the show is a friendly, purple dinosaur named Barney, who comes to life through the imagination of children, just like some of his other dino-friends like Baby Bop.

scenarios.title: Barnyard
scenarios.description: Barnyard is a computer-animated franchise, created for Nickelodeon by Steve Oedekerk.
scenarios.setting: The franchise follows the adventures of Otis, a bull who loves to party with his fiends Pip, Freddy, Peck, Pig, Miles, Abby, Bessy, and Duke on a barnyard while the Farmer goes away for the day.

scenarios.title: Barry
scenarios.description: Barry is an American black comedy crime drama television series created by Alec Berg and Bill Hader that premiered on HBO on March 25, 2018, and concluded on May 28, 2023, after four seasons and 32 episodes.
scenarios.setting: Barry is an American black comedy crime drama television series created by Alec Berg and Bill Hader that premiered on HBO on March 25, 2018, and concluded on May 28, 2023, after four seasons and 32 episodes. S.

scenarios.title: Bastard!!
scenarios.description: Bastard!! is a long-running cult manga written by Kazushi Hagiwara that began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with 26 completed volumes.
scenarios.setting: Bastard!! is a long-running cult manga written by Kazushi Hagiwara that began in 1988 and is currently ongoing with 26 completed volumes. Volume 27 is currently in the process of being published. The series was inspired by Hagiwara's love of Heavy Metal music and fantasy tropes (Dungeons & Dragons is considered an influence, but Hagiwara supposedly never mentions it in any interviews).

scenarios.title: Baten Kaitos
scenarios.description: Baten Kaitos is a niche JRPG series made by Monolith Soft and Tri-Crescendo that are exclusive to the Gamecube.
scenarios.setting: Both games take place in a world where the majority of humanity has lived in islands after a war between the gods and the humans over the need of humans for gaining more land.

scenarios.title: Batman: Arkham
scenarios.description: Batman: Arkham is a video game franchise published by Rocksteady Studios and WB Games Montreal based around the Batman's mythos, with only hints of a grander DC Universe.
scenarios.setting: Batman: Arkham is a video game franchise published by Rocksteady Studios and WB Games Montreal based around the Batman's mythos, with only hints of a grander DC Universe. Debuted in 2009 and has since inspired several spin-offs, including VR and mobile games, several comicbook series and an animated movie.

scenarios.title: Batman: The Telltale Series
scenarios.description: Batman: The Telltale Series, is a 2016 episodic point-and-click graphic adventure video game developed and published by Telltale Games and distributed by Warner Bros.
scenarios.setting: A second season, titled The Enemy Within, was released in 2017.

scenarios.title: Battle for Dream Island
scenarios.description: Battle for Dream Island (or abbreviated as BFDI) is an American animated web series created by Cary Huang and Michael Huang.
scenarios.setting: Battle for Dream Island (or abbreviated as BFDI) is an American animated web series created by Cary Huang and Michael Huang. The show's first season revolves around many anthropomorphic objects competing with each other to have one goal: Win Dream Island. The setting is further explored a lot more as subsequent seasons proceed, while the contestants still participate in new competitions.

scenarios.title: BattleTanx
scenarios.description: BattleTanx is an action game developed and produced by The 3DO Company for the N64.
scenarios.setting: This soon led to nuclear war, turning most of the world into a wasteland.

scenarios.title: Battletoads
scenarios.description: Battletoads is a Beat Em Up game developed by Rare originally for the NES in 1991.
scenarios.setting: Battletoads is a Beat Em Up game developed by Rare originally for the NES in 1991. It stars three humans named Dave Shar, Morgan Ziegler, and George Pie, who were sucked into an alternate reality in a video game they programmed and transformed into anthropomorphic toads. Thus, the Battletoads, Rash, Zitz, and Pimple were born. Together, they work together against the evil forces of the Dark Queen and save the universe.

scenarios.title: Bayonetta
scenarios.description: Bayonetta is a hack n' slash game for the Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Wii U, and PC.
scenarios.setting: Set in Vigrid, a fictional city in Europe, the game centers on its title character Bayonetta, an Umbra Witch who is unable to remember her past after waking up from a coffin in the bottom of a lake. On Christmas Eve in New York City, Angels begin to attack and are dealt with by Bayonetta and her best friend and fellow Umbra Witch, Jeanne.

scenarios.title: Beast Battle Simulator
scenarios.description: Beast Battle Simulator is a battle-simulation video game developed and published by Dog Hoggler.
scenarios.setting: Beast Battle Simulator is a battle-simulation video game developed and published by Dog Hoggler. In Beast Battle Simulator players are presented with different scenarios in the form of thirty levels and must strategize which animals and dinosaurs will go against them. Depending on which side, named light and dark, will win depends on firepower and the size of the player's animal army. There is also a sandbox mode available allowing the player to create their own battles.

scenarios.title: Beast Quest
scenarios.description: Beast Quest is a series of books written by a group of ghostwriters who all go under the name of Adam Blade.
scenarios.setting: It follows Tom and Elenna as they go on Quests, travelling around different kingdoms, thwarting villains plans and defeating powerful creatures known as Beasts. Each book focuses on one Beast.

scenarios.title: Beastars
scenarios.description: Beastars is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Paru Itagaki.
scenarios.setting: Beastars is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Paru Itagaki. The series has won multiple awards, including being the first Akita Shoten title to take home the Manga Taishō Award. An anime television series adaptation by Orange premiered on October 8, 2019, on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block. The series is also planned for an early 2020 release on Netflix outside of Japan.

scenarios.title: Beauty and the Beast (Disney Franchise)
scenarios.description: Beauty and the Beast is a 1991 American animated musical romantic fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Beauty and the Beast focuses on the relationship between the Beast (voice of Robby Benson), a prince who is magically transformed into a monster and his servants into household objects as punishment for his arrogance, and Belle (voice of Paige O'Hara), a young woman whom he imprisons in his castle.

scenarios.title: Beavis and Butt-Head
scenarios.description: Beavis and Butt-Head is an American adult animated comedy television series created by Mike Judge.
scenarios.setting: Beavis and Butt-Head is an American adult animated comedy television series created by Mike Judge. The series originated from Frog Baseball, a 1992 short film by Judge originally aired on Liquid Television. The series originally ran for seven seasons from March 8, 1993 to November 28, 1997. During its initial run, Beavis and Butt-Head received widespread critical acclaim, particularly for its satirical, scathing commentary on society. It was also a subject of controversy for its violent content.

scenarios.title: Beelzebub
scenarios.description: Beezlebub is a manga written by Ryūhei Tamura.
scenarios.setting: Beezlebub is a manga written by Ryūhei Tamura. It is an action-comedy about a delinquent named Tatsumi Oga who finds the next demon lord and must raise him along with a demon maid named Hilda. He must battle demons and other humans in order to protect his friends and family with the use of baby Beels demonic energy.

scenarios.title: Being Low As Dirt, Taking What's Important From Me
scenarios.source: Being Low As Dirt, Taking What's Important From Me
scenarios.description: Being low as dirt, taking what's important from me (泥の分際で私だけの大切を奪おうだなんて, Doro no bunzai de watashi dake no taisetsu wo ubaouda nante) is a novelization and comicalization of the famous music video with the same name performed by .
scenarios.setting: Being low as dirt, taking what's important from me (泥の分際で私だけの大切を奪おうだなんて, Doro no bunzai de watashi dake no taisetsu wo ubaouda nante) is a novelization and comicalization of the famous music video with the same name performed by TUYU. The manga was originally by Pusu, who is the guitarist of TUYU, and then authored by Mano Mao and illustrated by Katsura Chinatsu. The novel was the same, but it's illustrated by Omutatsu.

scenarios.title: Ben 10 (Classic)
scenarios.description: Ben 10 is a cartoon series created by Man of Action and Cartoon Network.
scenarios.setting: The series follows the adventures of Ben Tennyson after finding the Omnitrix, which allows him to transform into 10 different kinds of aliens.

scenarios.title: Ben 10 (Manga)
scenarios.description: Ben 10 (Japanese: ご 近所 エイリアン ギャグ ! ベン10, Hepburn: Go kinjo eirian gyagu! Ben 10) is a one-shot manga that was serialized in Corocoro Ichiban in January 2009.
scenarios.setting: Ben 10 (Japanese: ご 近所 エイリアン ギャグ ! ベン10, Hepburn: Go kinjo eirian gyagu! Ben 10) is a one-shot manga that was serialized in Corocoro Ichiban in January 2009. It was written and illustrated by Makoto Hijioka. Very little is known about this one-shot manga.

scenarios.title: Ben 10 (Reboot)
scenarios.description: The Ben 10 2016 television series was a reboot of the original series.
scenarios.setting: The Ben 10 2016 television series was a reboot of the original series. It covers the same plot elements as the first with Ben Tennyson discovering the Omnitrix after it has fallen to Earth, granting him many aliens to transform into. This series would also introduce new aliens, ideas, and story arcs as well, it went for 5 seasons and had four specials.

scenarios.title: Ben 10: Protector of Earth
scenarios.description: Ben 10: Protector of Earth is an action-adventure video game released on October 30, 2007 based on the Ben 10 series.
scenarios.setting: Ben 10: Protector of Earth is an action-adventure video game released on October 30, 2007 based on the Ben 10 series. The game follows Ben as he goes on adventures to reclaim the DNA that was mysteriously stolen from his Omnitrix.

scenarios.title: Bendy and the Ink Machine
scenarios.description: Bendy and the Ink Machine is an indie survival-horror game that was created by theMeatly and first premiered on November 10, 2017.
scenarios.setting: The story of the game focuses on Henry, an animator who once worked at Joey Drew Studios. After he is invited back by Joey Drew, he returns to the abandoned workshop, reactivates the Ink Machine and descends through ruined corridors, animation rooms and production floors now overrun by living cartoon horrors.

scenarios.title: Bernard
scenarios.description: Bernard, known in South Korea as Backkom (빼꼼, ppaekkom) is an 3-minute Spanish-South Korean-French CGI-animated television comedy series centered on the fictional polar bear and main character of the same name.
scenarios.setting: Bernard almost doesn't speak, but he does communicate through guttural sounds.

scenarios.title: Berserk
scenarios.description: Berserk is a manga series written and illustrated by Kentaro Miura.
scenarios.setting: Set in a medieval inspired dark fantasy world, the story centers on the characters of Guts, an orphaned mercenary, and Griffith, the leader of a mercenary band called the Band of the Hawk.

scenarios.title: Berserk of Gluttony
scenarios.description: Fate Graphite has never tasted real power.
scenarios.setting: How many lives will he feed on to satisfy this hunger, and is the world ready for the frightening warrior he’ll become?

scenarios.title: Beyblade
scenarios.description: Beyblade is a Japanese anime, game, and manga series created by Takafumi Adachi, Katsumi Hasegawa, Kunihisa Sugishima, Takao Aoki and published by Shogakukan Inc and produced by TV Tokyo and Nelvana.
scenarios.setting: The series centers on kids and teenagers, called "bladers", who use powerful spinning tops called Beyblades to battle each other and aim to become the strongest blader ever.

scenarios.title: Big Hero 6
scenarios.description: right|320pxBig Hero 6 is a 2014 American computer animated superhero film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Big Hero 6 is a 2014 American computer animated superhero film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.

scenarios.title: Bigtop Burger
scenarios.description: Bigtop Burger is an animated comedy web series created by Ian Worthington, better known by his online username, Worthikids.
scenarios.setting: The series follows the employees at the titular circus-themed food truck, along with their mysterious boss, Steve, as they go through various surreal, supernatural, and strange scenarios.

scenarios.title: Bima Satria Garuda
scenarios.description: Bima Satria Garuda is an Indonesian tokusatsu series, coming from the collaboration between MNC Media and Ishimori Productions.
scenarios.setting: Bima Satria Garuda is an Indonesian tokusatsu series, coming from the collaboration between MNC Media and Ishimori Productions. The series begins in the Dunia Paralel (Parallel World), a world that is ruled by the VUDO Empire and is on the verge of collapse. The Parallel World lives in perpetual darkness and Rasputin, the evil and cruel lord of VUDO wants to find another world, seize its natural resources to revive the Parallel World, and expand VUDO's powers.

scenarios.title: Binary Domain
scenarios.description: Binary Domain is a third-person shooter video game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega.
scenarios.setting: Binary Domain is a third-person shooter video game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The story is set in 2080, Tokyo. Global warming has reached its peak and the sea level rose, causing floods all over the planet. With most of the major cities devastated, national authorities rebuilt upward, above the water line. However, due to the loss of countless lives, they needed robot labor like never before.

scenarios.title: Bionicle
scenarios.description: BIONICLE is a line of construction toys produced by Lego.
scenarios.setting: BIONICLE is a line of construction toys produced by Lego. The deep story revolves around the quest of the Toa to resurrect the Great Spirit, Mata Nui after he was poisoned and cast into a deep slumber by the Makuta. The plot stretches even further into the past, showing the deep history of the Matoran Universe, and how it was created.

scenarios.title: BioShock
scenarios.description: BioShock takes place in 1960 in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, where Jack, sole survivor of a plane crash, discovers the entrance to the recluse underwater city of Rapture, at the end of a civil war which left most of this utopia in disrepair.
scenarios.setting: - Bioshock= BioShock takes place in 1960 in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, where Jack, sole survivor of a plane crash, discovers the entrance to the recluse underwater city of Rapture, at the end of a civil war which left most of this utopia in disrepair. Finding himself in an alien world, he has no choice but to fight for his survival against the Splicers, degenerated citizens addicted to the genetic material known as ADAM, and all the traps laid down by the city's visionary founder, Andrew Ryan.

scenarios.title: Black Butler
scenarios.description: Just a stone's throw from London lies the manor house of the illustrious Phantomhive earldom and its master, one Ciel Phantomhive.
scenarios.setting: Just a stone's throw from London lies the manor house of the illustrious Phantomhive earldom and its master, one Ciel Phantomhive.

scenarios.title: Black Clover
scenarios.description: Note: The Black Clover verse is currently very outdated, as the series is in its final arc and the supporters are waiting for the series to end before making further revisions.
scenarios.setting: Note: The Black Clover verse is currently very outdated, as the series is in its final arc and the supporters are waiting for the series to end before making further revisions. Long ago, humanity was on the verge of being wiped out by a demon, but was saved by one extremely powerful mage who became known as the first Wizard King. In the present day, the story begins with your typical Shounen series protagonist, Asta, a kind-hearted youth with the hot-bloodedness to match, but not the height much to his chagrin.

scenarios.title: Black Joke
scenarios.description: Black Joke (ブラック・ジョーク, Burakku Jōku) is a Japanese manga series written KOIKE Rintarou and illustrated by TAGUCHI Masayuki.
scenarios.setting: Black Joke (ブラック・ジョーク, Burakku Jōku) is a Japanese manga series written KOIKE Rintarou and illustrated by TAGUCHI Masayuki. Black Joke started in February 2008 in Issue 2008-5 of Young Champion, though being published in biweekly magazine (published once every two weeks), the manga was published as a monthly series. The manga continued until Issue 2011-7 (March 2011), where it was moved to the monthly magazine Young Champion Retsu and continued in May 2011 from Issue 2011-6 and is still being published.

scenarios.title: Black Summoner
scenarios.description: Black Summoner ~A combat maniac's ascension~ otherwise known as Kuro no Shoukanshi: Sentoukyou no Nariagari, is a light novel, web novel and manga.
scenarios.setting: Losing his memories, the curtains of the story of alternate world transfer of the MC rises.

scenarios.title: Black Tech Internet Cafe System
scenarios.description: Reborn into a new world by possessing the body of a teen, Fang Qi finds himself happy to have a "gaming system" style power.
scenarios.setting: Reborn into a new world by possessing the body of a teen, Fang Qi finds himself happy to have a "gaming system" style power. However, he is surprised by the nature of his system, as he is forced to create and run an internet cafe in a world of cultivators.

scenarios.title: Black★Rock Shooter
scenarios.description: This verse was born from Huke's drawing of a single character, named Black★Rock Shooter.
scenarios.setting: A video game for Vista was also created in 2011, this time she is named Stella and is one of the last remaining human in the world, fighting against an alien invasion. The OVA was extended in the 2012, where BRS follows the same concept.

scenarios.title: Blade and Sorcery
scenarios.description: Blade and Sorcery is a medieval/fantasy themed sandbox fighting game developed and published by WarpFrog in 2018.
scenarios.setting: Blade and Sorcery is a medieval/fantasy themed sandbox fighting game developed and published by WarpFrog in 2018.

scenarios.title: Blade Runner
scenarios.description: Blade Runner is a science fiction film based on the novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, that became a popular cult classic upon its release in 1982, and resurfaced in 2017 with the main sequel Blade Runner 2049.
scenarios.setting: , that became a popular cult classic upon its release in 1982, and resurfaced in 2017 with the main sequel Blade Runner 2049. In the first movie the retired Rick Deckard is assumed again to track and retire four Nexus-6 replicants that are extremely dangerous due to their human appearance. In the sequel set after thirty years, the new Blade Runner, LAPD Officer K finds out a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge society into chaos.

scenarios.title: Blade Trilogy
scenarios.description: Blade is a film and television franchise based on the fictional Marvel Comics superhero of the same name, portrayed by Wesley Snipes in the film series and Sticky Fingaz on the television series.
scenarios.setting: Blade is a film and television franchise based on the fictional Marvel Comics superhero of the same name, portrayed by Wesley Snipes in the film series and Sticky Fingaz on the television series. The films were written by David S. Goyer (and also served as a co-writer for the TV series in the first two and last episodes), based on the comics by Marv Wolfman, and Gene Colan. The three films were directed by Stephen Norrington, Guillermo del Toro and Goyer respectively, and distributed by New Line Cinema.

scenarios.title: Blair Witch
scenarios.description: Blair Witch is a horror film franchise distributed by Artisan Entertainment (now Lionsgate) and produced by Haxan Films that consists of three feature films and various merchandise products.
scenarios.setting: The film follows the disappearance of three student filmmakers in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland while shooting a documentary on the local legend known as the "Blair Witch".

scenarios.title: BLAME!
scenarios.description: Blame! (Japanese: ブラム! Hepburn: Buramu!), pronounced "blam", is a ten-volume Japanese science fiction manga by Tsutomu Nihei published by Kodansha from 1996 to 2003.
scenarios.setting: Blame! (Japanese: ブラム! ), pronounced "blam", is a ten-volume Japanese science fiction manga by Tsutomu Nihei published by Kodansha from 1996 to 2003. Set in a future beyond Earth, the citizens of a massive space structure called a dyson sphere have become less human, with the main inhabitants being silicon life-forms with different factions and goals. The silicon life overall goal is destroying the Net Terminal Gene and all its carriers.

scenarios.title: Blasphemous
scenarios.description: Blasphemous is a Metroidvania game developed by Spanish studio The Game Kitchen and published by Team17.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place in a land called Cvstodia, where an entity known as The Miracle had taken control over the land.

scenarios.title: BlazBlue
scenarios.description: BlazBlue is a series of fighting games developed by Arc System Works.
scenarios.setting: BlazBlue is a series of fighting games developed by Arc System Works. , the world was attacked by a seemingly invincible monster known as the Black Beast, which destroyed everything in its path and spread a toxic substance known as seithr wherever it went, quickly threatening humanity with extinction. Due to the efforts of the Six Heroes using the power of Ars Magus, the Black Beast was defeated and humanity was saved.

scenarios.title: Bleach
scenarios.description: BLEACH is a popular shonen created by Tite Kubo in 2001 which has spawned a media franchise including a long-running anime adaptation, the return of the series onto the screen a decade later by the name 'Bleach: Thousand Year Blood War' for the final arc, a light novel sequel to the top-selling manga titled 'Bleach: Can't Fear Your Own World' alongside a one-shot called 'Bleach: New Breaths From Hell' expected to serialize as a further manga sequel, as well as a spin-off named 'Burn the Witch'.
scenarios.setting: BLEACH is a popular shonen created by Tite Kubo in 2001 which has spawned a media franchise including a long-running anime adaptation, the return of the series onto the screen a decade later by the name 'Bleach: Thousand Year Blood War' for the final arc, a light novel sequel to the top-selling manga titled 'Bleach: Can't Fear Your Own World' alongside a one-shot called 'Bleach: New Breaths From Hell' expected to serialize as a further manga sequel, as well as a spin-off named 'Burn the Witch'.

scenarios.title: Block Story
scenarios.description: Block Story is a first-person, 'sandbox' RPG set in a cuboid world, created by Andrey "Head@Hunter" Vetoshko and Paul Pacheco, later copyrights have been transferred to Mindblocks.
scenarios.setting: Block Story is a first-person, 'sandbox' RPG set in a cuboid world, created by Andrey "Head@Hunter" Vetoshko and Paul Pacheco, later copyrights have been transferred to Mindblocks.

scenarios.title: Block Tales
scenarios.description: Block Tales is a Roblox turn-based 2D RPG developed on February 24th, 2024, by the group Spaceman Moonbase, the company also known for making Arsenal
scenarios.setting: After saving Shadletsky from a group of mercenaries, the two align themselves both with the goal of obtaining the seven swords of the heights so they do not fall into the wrong hands and rescuing Bulderman, marking the start of the players' long journey as they are forced to fight through hordes of enemies, solve a plethora of different puzzles and traverse large areas of terrain while meeting all sorts of different characters in the process.

scenarios.title: Blood
scenarios.description: Blood is a First-Person Shooter developed by Monolith Productions.
scenarios.setting: Blood II received an expansion of its own named The Nightmare Levels, but both it and the base game were critically panned.

scenarios.title: Blood Lad
scenarios.description: Blood Lad is a manga seires created by Yuuki Kodama and serialized in Young Ace.
scenarios.setting: The series follows Staz C. Blood, a vampire and territory leader, as he attempts to revive Yanagi Fuyumi after her untimely death in the demon world.

scenarios.title: Blood Meridian
scenarios.description: Blood Meridian or the Evening Redness in the West (known simply and more commonly as Blood Meridian) is a 1985 epic historical novel by American author Cormac McCarthy, classified as an anti-Western and Gothic Western.
scenarios.setting: Set in the American frontier with a loose historical context, the narrative follows a fictional teenager from Tennessee referred to as "the kid", with the bulk of the text devoted to his experiences with the Glanton gang, a historical group of scalp hunters who massacred American Indians and others in the United States-Mexico borderlands from 1849 to 1850 for bounty, sadistic pleasure, and eventually out of nihilistic habit.

scenarios.title: Blood-C
scenarios.description: Blood-C is a 2011 Japanese anime television series co-created by studio Production I.G and manga artist group CLAMP.
scenarios.setting: Blood-C focuses on Saya Kisaragi, an outwardly normal teenage high school girl who serves as a shrine maiden to a country town; in reality, she is a skilled swordswoman charged by her father to defeat Elder Bairns, monsters who feed on human blood. As her battles grow more desperate and more people she cares for fall victim to the Elder Bairns, Saya begins finding faults in her reality, and eventually uncovers a disturbing truth about herself, the town and her surviving friends.

scenarios.title: Bloodborne
