scenarios.description: Bloodborne is an action role-playing video game directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki, developed by FromSoftware, and published by Sony Computer Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Bloodborne is an action role-playing video game directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki, developed by FromSoftware, and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Officially announced at Sony's Electronic Entertainment Expo 2014 conference, the game was released worldwide for the PlayStation 4 in March 2015. Bloodborne follows the player character, the Hunter, through the fictional decrepit Gothic city of Yharnam, whose inhabitants have been afflicted with an abnormal blood-borne disease.

scenarios.title: BloodRayne
scenarios.description: BloodRayne is an action-adventure hack and slash video game series that follows the titular character - Rayne - on her quest of vengeance against her father Kagan.
scenarios.setting: Set during World War 2, it follows Rayne on a globe-trotting mission from the Brimstone Society to eliminate all members of the Gegengeist Gruppe - an occult paramilitary organization attempting to use demons to empower Nazi Germany. A direct sequel to BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2 takes place in 2004 in an unnamed Metropolis and follows Rayne's investigation into the Cult of Kagan - a cult founded and run by her father and her half siblings.

scenarios.title: Bloodstained
scenarios.description: Bloodstained is a Metroidvania, specifically Igavania, created as a spiritual successor to IGA's Castlevania games.
scenarios.setting: The first game, abbreviated as CotM, is a pixel graphic throwback to the old Castlevania games, it focuses on Zangetsu's journey to get rid of his "Curse of the Moon" placed on him by demons. It is centered around Miriam, who awoke after 10 years to find her world invaded by demons by none other than her childhood friend, who's like a brother to her, Gebel.

scenarios.title: Bloons Tower Defense
scenarios.description: Bloons Tower Defense, or Bloons TD for short, is a series of tower defense games made by Ninja Kiwi.
scenarios.setting: Bloons Tower Defense, or Bloons TD for short, is a series of tower defense games made by Ninja Kiwi. It is the flagship franchise made by Ninja Kiwi, even moreso than the original Bloons series, and Ninja Kiwi's other intellectual properties.

scenarios.title: Blue Archive
scenarios.description: Blue Archive (ブルーアーカイブ) is a free-to-play tactical role-playing game with gacha game mechanics developed by Nexon Games, published in Japan by Yostar and worldwide by Nexon for both IOS and Android.
scenarios.setting: After the player repels an assault from a student that had escaped from the custody of the Federal Corrections Bureau and was seeking revenge on the council, they regains control of the Sanctum Tower and transferred its control to the council for them to regain their lost power and are then tasked by the remaining members of the council to help search for the missing president and help resolve the issues surrounding the city's students.

scenarios.title: Blue Lock
scenarios.description: The Japan Football Union hires the football enigma Ego Jinpachi.
scenarios.setting: His master plan to lead Japan to stardom is Blue Lock, a training regimen designed to create the world's greatest egotist striker. Yoichi Isagi, an unknown high school football player conflicted about his playing style, decides to join the program in order to become the best striker in the world.

scenarios.title: Blue Reflection
scenarios.description: Blue Reflection is a magical girl Japanese role-playing game (JRPG) series created by Gust.
scenarios.setting: She gets transported to a school surrounded by an endless ocean, known as Oasis, and meets Kokoro Utsubo, Rena Miyauchi, and Yuki Kinjou. Thus, Ao becomes a Reflector and leads her team throughout various Heartscapes to regain each Reflector's memories and uncover the truth behind Oasis.

scenarios.title: Blue String
scenarios.description: Blue String is a shared webtoon universe owned by YLAB based on the lives of teenagers and people in their twenties.
scenarios.setting: Blue String is a shared webtoon universe owned by YLAB based on the lives of teenagers and people in their twenties.

scenarios.title: BNA: Brand New Animal
scenarios.description: BNA: Brand New Animal is set in a world where humans coexist uneasily with beastmen, humanoid animal shapeshifters who can transform between human and animal forms.
scenarios.setting: BNA: Brand New Animal is set in a world where humans coexist uneasily with beastmen, humanoid animal shapeshifters who can transform between human and animal forms. Because of discrimination and violence, beastmen have founded a refuge city called Anima City, where they can live freely. The story follows Michiru Kagemori, a seemingly ordinary human high-school girl who suddenly transforms into a tanuki beastman.

scenarios.title: Bob's Burgers
scenarios.description: Bob's Burgers is an animated sitcom that revolves around the Belcher family running a struggling burger restaurant called Bob's Burgers.
scenarios.setting: The show follows the daily misadventures and quirky interactions of Bob Belcher, his wife Linda, and their three children: Tina, Gene, and Louise.

scenarios.title: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo
scenarios.description: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo is a comedy action/adventure manga that takes place in a post-apocalyptic setting on Earth.
scenarios.setting: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo is a comedy action/adventure manga that takes place in a post-apocalyptic setting on Earth. Shinsetsu Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo takes place a year after part 1, after the Maruhage Empire and Reverse Maruhage Empire have been defeated, and now the world is ruled by the Neo Maruhage Empire, led by Tsuru Tsurulina III.

scenarios.title: Bolt (Disney Film)
scenarios.description: Bolt is a 2008 American computer animated comedy-adventure film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Bolt is a 2008 American computer animated comedy-adventure film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. When his beloved 13-year-old costar and owner, Penny (Cyrus), is “kidnapped” on the show, Bolt runs away, eventually teaming up with sarcastic alley cat Mittens and Bolt super-fan Rhino the hamster on a cross-country journey back home.

scenarios.title: Bomberman
scenarios.description: This verse centers around the story of Bomberman - a young robot alien from the planet Bomber - who tries to protect the galaxy and even the universe from dangers.
scenarios.setting: This verse centers around the story of Bomberman - a young robot alien from the planet Bomber - who tries to protect the galaxy and even the universe from dangers.

scenarios.title: Bonnie's Bakery
scenarios.description: Bonnie's Bakery is a video game created by Melty Crown Studio and was officially released on July 14, 2023.
scenarios.setting: In this story, we follow a city that has a great bakery and restaurant owner who is much loved and cherished by the general public, Bonnie. She has always made incredible and delicious food for the people of the city, thus earning recognition as a great chef and bakery and restaurant chef. Which makes many of the inhabitants of that city suspicious of the success of all this and go out to find out for themselves why these foods were so well praised by the public.

scenarios.title: Borderlands
scenarios.description: Borderlands is a video game series created by Gearbox Software.
scenarios.setting: Borderlands is a video game series created by Gearbox Software. Set on the world of Pandora, it focuses on powerful Vault Hunters and their search for the Vault, said to contain bountiful amounts of riches and wealth.

scenarios.title: Bourneverse
scenarios.description: There are five entries in the Bourne film series, consisting of the first trilogy, and two sequels.
scenarios.setting: There are five entries in the Bourne film series, consisting of the first trilogy, and two sequels. The first trilogy, The Bourne Identity, The Bourne Supremacy, The Bourne Ultimatum feature Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) as the starring character. The trilogy also shares the same names as the first three novels in the series, though only the first film, The Bourne Identity, is based (though somewhat loosely) on a novel in the series. The following two films are related in title only.

scenarios.title: Brandon Rogers
scenarios.description: Brandon Rogers is a channel on YouTube that houses many comedy sketches and shows of the comedy variety.
scenarios.setting: Brandon Rogers is a channel on YouTube that houses many comedy sketches and shows of the comedy variety. Brandon is famous for his crude humour and the overall explicit nature of his videos. His videos usually star a variety of quirky and dysfunctional characters mostly played by Brandon himself, with a recurring supporting cast that regularly plays different characters as well.

scenarios.title: Brave Chronicle
scenarios.description: Kimi kara Uketsugu Brave Chronicle (君から受け継ぐ英雄系譜〈ブレイブ・クロニクル〉), known on English as Brave Chronicle: The Ruinmaker, is a light novel by Kenya Atsui with illustrations by Saori Toyota.
scenarios.setting: Kimi kara Uketsugu Brave Chronicle (君から受け継ぐ英雄系譜〈ブレイブ・クロニクル〉), known on English as Brave Chronicle: The Ruinmaker, is a light novel by Kenya Atsui with illustrations by Saori Toyota.

scenarios.title: Brave Frontier
scenarios.description: Brave Frontier is a Japanese mobile role-playing game developed and published by A-Lim.
scenarios.setting: Brave Frontier is a Japanese mobile role-playing game developed and published by A-Lim. It focuses on the protagonist, known as the Summoner, as they take down the Four Fallen Gods and save the world of Grand Gaia from destruction.

scenarios.title: Bravely Series
scenarios.description: Bravely Default: Where the Fairy Flies, known in Japan as Bravely Default: Flying Fairy, is a role-playing video game developed by Silicon Studio and Square Enix for the Nintendo 3DS handheld video game console.
scenarios.setting: Bravely Default: Where the Fairy Flies, known in Japan as Bravely Default: Flying Fairy, is a role-playing video game developed by Silicon Studio and Square Enix for the Nintendo 3DS handheld video game console. It was originally released in 2012, while an expanded edition released in 2013 in Japan, Europe and Australia, and 2014 in North America and South Korea. Its sequel Bravely Second: End Layer, was released in 2015 in Japan and a year later in other countries.

scenarios.title: Brawl Stars
scenarios.description: Brawl Stars is a free mobile video game published by the video game company Supercell, which also makes famous games such as Clash Royale and Clash of Clans.
scenarios.setting: Brawl Stars is a free mobile video game published by the video game company Supercell, which also makes famous games such as Clash Royale and Clash of Clans. It was released worldwide on December 12, 2018 on iOS and Android. There are multiple maps and different gameplay patterns in the game. The characters (Brawlers) are divided into common, rare, super rare, epic, mythic, legendary and ultra legendary. There are also gadgets and star powers with different abilities for each character.

scenarios.title: Brawlhalla
scenarios.description: Brawlhalla is a 2D fast-paced platform style brawler developed by Blue Mammoth Games.
scenarios.setting: Brawlhalla is a 2D fast-paced platform style brawler developed by Blue Mammoth Games. Brawlhalla includes a large roster of playable characters, ranging from medieval knights to ninjas to alien warlords, and far more. Each of these characters is known as a Legend, and are among the best fighters to have ever existed. A Legend possesses two weapons and unique skillsets and stats which set them apart from their peers and gives them a fighting chance to win in the Grand Tournament of Valhalla.

scenarios.title: Break-In (Roblox)
scenarios.description: Break In is a story game developed by Cracky4.
scenarios.setting: A major event called “The Purge” is currently taking place in Roblox. The Purge is a group of villains led by Scary Larry, who raid Roblox games and cause chaos throughout the neighborhood.

scenarios.title: Breaking Bad
scenarios.description: Breaking Bad is an American neo-Western crime drama television series created and produced by Vince Gilligan.
scenarios.setting: The show focuses on Walter White, a brilliant high school chemistry teacher who gets diagnosed with lung cancer on his 50th birthday.

scenarios.title: Breath of Fire
scenarios.description: Breath of Fire is a JRPG series created by Capcom.
scenarios.setting: The games revolve around beings called the Endless and their involvement in a world occupied with anthropomorphic creatures, all during a timespan of many millennia.

scenarios.title: Broforce
scenarios.description: Broforce is a side-scrolling run-and-gun platform video game developed by Free Lives and published by Devolver Digital.
scenarios.setting: When evil threatens the world, the world calls in Broforce - an under-funded, over-powered paramilitary organization dealing exclusively in excessive force.

scenarios.title: Brooklyn 99
scenarios.description: "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a popular American television series that originally aired from 2013 to 2021.
scenarios.setting: "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a popular American television series that originally aired from 2013 to 2021. The show is a comedy that revolves around the lives and adventures of the detectives of the fictional 99th precinct of the New York City Police Department, located in Brooklyn.

scenarios.title: Bruce Almighty
scenarios.description: Bruce Almighty is a 2003 American fantasy comedy film starring Jim Carrey.
scenarios.setting: The film follows Bruce Nolan, a down-on-his-luck television reporter who complains to God (played by Morgan Freeman) that he is not doing his job correctly and is offered the chance to try being God himself for one week.

scenarios.title: Bubsy
scenarios.description: Bubsy is an infamous video game series revolving around the many misadventures of the anthropomorphic, comedian bobcat, Bubsy.
scenarios.setting: Bubsy is an infamous video game series revolving around the many misadventures of the anthropomorphic, comedian bobcat, Bubsy. Bubsy protects the environment from hunters and has the world's biggest yarn collection, but this is all thrown into mayhem when the Woolies, an intergalactic and evil alien race bent on gathering all the yarn in the galaxy, arrive on Earth lightyears away from their home planet Rayon to steal all of Bubsy's coveted yarn collection.

scenarios.title: Bucchigiri?!
scenarios.description: Bucchigiri?! (ぶっちぎり?!) is an original Japanese anime television series animated by MAPPA.
scenarios.setting: Bucchigiri?! ) is an original Japanese anime television series animated by MAPPA. It is directed by Hiroko Utsumi and written by Taku Kishimoto, with Michiru Ōshima as music composer and Takahiro Kagami as character designer. [2][3] The opening theme song is "Sesame", performed by Kroi,[1] while the ending theme song is "Love je t'aime" (らぶじゅてーむ), performed by Mahiru Coda.

scenarios.title: Buck Bumble
scenarios.description: Buck Bumble is an action video game for the Nintendo 64 developed by British video game company Argonaut Software and released by Ubi Soft in 1998.
scenarios.setting: The year is 2010, and as the result of a previous spill at a chemical factory in London, England, the insects in the surrounding area have mutated. Several different types of these mutated insects gather together becoming the evil "Herd", who are bent on taking over the garden, and eventually the whole world.

scenarios.title: Buckshot Roulette
scenarios.description: Buckshot Roulette is a indie Tabletop Horror Video Game created by Mike Klubnika and published by Critical Reflex.
scenarios.setting: Buckshot Roulette is a indie Tabletop Horror Video Game created by Mike Klubnika and published by Critical Reflex. It revolves around The Dealer challenging The Player to a high stake game revolving around the usage of a shotgun, with The Player winning $70,000 if they are able to defeat The Dealer in their game. Notably, this game's continuity extends beyond Buckshot Roulette, as Mike Klubnika has confirmed it to take place in the same universe as his previous games.

scenarios.title: BuffyVerse
scenarios.description: Buffy and Angel are the television shows that make up the Buffyverse.
scenarios.setting: They were both directed by Joss Whedon, and ultimately based around the verse's protagonist, Buffy Summers, the girl who fights vampires and other monsters in order to protect the world.

scenarios.title: Bug Fables
scenarios.description: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling is an RPG starring a trio of insects, namely a beetle named Kabbu, a bee named Vi, and a moth named Leif, who form an adventuring team and travel through Bugaria in order to find legendary artifacts for the ant queen, Elizant II.
scenarios.setting: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling is an RPG starring a trio of insects, namely a beetle named Kabbu, a bee named Vi, and a moth named Leif, who form an adventuring team and travel through Bugaria in order to find legendary artifacts for the ant queen, Elizant II.

scenarios.title: Bujingai: The Forsaken City
scenarios.description: Bujingai: The Forsaken City is a third person, hack and slash game developed by Taito and Red Entertainment for the PlayStation 2.
scenarios.setting: Bujingai: The Forsaken City is a third person, hack and slash game developed by Taito and Red Entertainment for the PlayStation 2. The story is set in the 23rd century, around 100 years after global catastrophe wiped out a majority of the Earth's population with those remIning gaining magical powers that came from the Earth.

scenarios.title: Bullet Train
scenarios.description: Bullet Train is a 2022 American action comedy film directed by David Leitch.
scenarios.setting: Bullet Train is a 2022 American action comedy film directed by David Leitch. It is based on the 2010 novel Maria Beetle (titled Bullet Train in the UK and US editions), written by Kōtarō Isaka and translated by Sam Malissa, the second novel in Isaka's Hitman series, of which the first novel was previously adapted as the 2015 Japanese film Grasshopper.

scenarios.title: Bully
scenarios.description: Bully, known as Canis Canem Edit in Europe, is a 2006 open-world video game developed and published by Rockstar Games, the same company that created Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead, Manhunt, Max Payne, and L.A.
scenarios.setting: A. Noire. The game's story revolves around Jimmy Hopkins, a troubled but good-hearted teenager who is enrolled at Bullworth Academy for a year, which is stated and shown to be the worst school in the country. Disgusted by the school's bullying and corruption, Jimmy gradually rises through the ranks of the school to pacify it.

scenarios.title: Bungou Stray Dogs
scenarios.description: The plot begins after Atsushi Nakajima is kicked out of another orphanage for reasons beyond his understanding.
scenarios.setting: Desperate, sleep-deprived, and starving, he decides to try and rob the first person he comes across, so he can buy himself a meal...

scenarios.title: Bunny Kill
scenarios.description: Bunny Kill is a flash series created by Mottis on Newgrounds.
scenarios.setting: Bunny Kill is a flash series created by Mottis on Newgrounds. It was heavily inspired by the Madness Combat series. It consists of several episodes surrounding the protagonist Snowball, and his many murder sprees. Despite having been originally inspired by Madness Combat, the series soon proved itself to be it's own unique cartoon. Over the years while Madness delved into darker, and edgier themes, Bunny Kill explored far more fantastical environments like Space and a Feudal Japan style area.

scenarios.title: Bunny Mask
scenarios.description: Bunny Mask is a horror-mystery comic series created by writer Paul Tobin and artist Andrea Mutti, and published by Aftershock Comics.
scenarios.setting: Bunny Mask is a horror-mystery comic series created by writer Paul Tobin and artist Andrea Mutti, and published by Aftershock Comics. Centering on the enigmatic character of the same name, the story explores the interaction of humanity with the Shadows, mysterious god-like creatures of the old that prey on men.

scenarios.title: Burn the Witch
scenarios.description: BURN THE WITCH is a manga series by Tite Kubo, connected to his previous work Bleach.
scenarios.setting: It follows the adventures of witches Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole in Reverse London, a hidden realm populated by dragons.

scenarios.title: Busou Shoujo Machiavellianism
scenarios.description: Busou Shoujo Machiavellianism is a series and franchise revolving around its protagonist, Nomura Fudou, a young man who was recently expelled from his old school as a result of a great and violent struggle.
scenarios.setting: Busou Shoujo Machiavellianism is a series and franchise revolving around its protagonist, Nomura Fudou, a young man who was recently expelled from his old school as a result of a great and violent struggle. He pursues a normal life, but the new school to which he has been transferred is the Aichi Symbiosis Private School, where female students have violently oppressed their fellow men and forced them to dress in order to live in school.

scenarios.title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunt
scenarios.description: Cabela's Inc. is a subsidiary of Bass Pro Shops, an American direct marketer and specialty retailer of outdoor recreation merchandise based in Sidney, Nebraska. Cabela's was founded by Richard N. Cabela in 1961.
scenarios.setting: Cabela's Inc. is a subsidiary of Bass Pro Shops, an American direct marketer and specialty retailer of outdoor recreation merchandise based in Sidney, Nebraska. Cabela's was founded by Richard N. Cabela in 1961. Cabela's mail-order catalogs are shipped to 50 states and 120 countries.

scenarios.title: Call of Duty
scenarios.description: Call of Duty is one of the most famous FPS franchises to date, published by Activision and made by three different studios (Treyarch, SledgeHammer, Infinity Ward).
scenarios.setting: When the studios split to become Treyarch and Infinity Ward respectively, a new era of FPS games was made that would revolutionise the genre forever creating the basic formula for the games in the future. Infinity also made Call of Duty Ghosts which takes place in the future, as well as having its own special mode called “Extinction” which featured soldiers take on a wide variety of aliens.

scenarios.title: Call Of The Night
scenarios.description: Call of the Night (よふかしのうた Yofukashi no Uta?) is an original Japanese manga series by mangaka Kotoyama that's serialized in Shogakukan's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine.
scenarios.setting: Call of the Night (よふかしのうた Yofukashi no Uta ? ) is an original Japanese manga series by mangaka Kotoyama that's serialized in Shogakukan's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine. It began on August 28, 2019 and is currently ongoing. A teenager who hangs out with a vampire. Unable to sleep or find true satisfaction in his daily life, Kou Yamori stops going to school and begins wandering the streets at night.

scenarios.title: Camp Camp
scenarios.description: Camp Camp is an animated comedy show created by .
scenarios.setting: Originally the show focused on escaping the camp, but now focuses on the problems around the camp: Some being spies, others being financial, but all being odd.

scenarios.title: Camp Lakebottom
scenarios.description: Camp Lakebottom is a Canadian animated series that follows the story of three kids, McGee, Gretchen, and Squirt who are sent to the wrong camp and try to survive and enjoy their summer.
scenarios.setting: Camp Lakebottom is a Canadian animated series that follows the story of three kids, McGee, Gretchen, and Squirt who are sent to the wrong camp and try to survive and enjoy their summer.

scenarios.setting: Since for all mortal who live in the world, none can assume a power to match his!

scenarios.title: Captain Commando

scenarios.setting: Set in the year 2026, the game follows the adventures of the heroic "Commando Team", a group of four vigilantes which fight to prevent the wicked Scumocide and his band of mutants from conquering the galaxy.

scenarios.setting: Captain Pronin (Капитан Пронин, Kapitan Pronin) is a Russian animated cartoon parody series created by Mikhail Zaitsev. The series consists of four short animated films produced at T/O Ekran between 1992 and 1994, then expanded into a book series and a video game. Its story revolves around the eponymous protagonist, the grandson of Major Pronin, and his adventures which parody various film clichés.

scenarios.title: Captain Tsubasa
scenarios.description: Captain Tsubasa (キャプテン翼), also known as Flash Kicker (United States dub), or Super Campeones (Latin America dub) is a popular long running Japanese manga, created by Yoichi Takahashi in 1980, which had its anime and video game series.
scenarios.setting: The manga tells a story of an 11-year-old Tsubasa Ozora who dreams to become the world's best football player and win the World Cup for Japan; his thoughts and dreams revolve almost entirely around the joy of football.

scenarios.title: Captain Underpants
scenarios.description: Captain Underpants is a children's novel series centering around the misadventures of elementary schoolers George and Harold.
scenarios.setting: Captain Underpants is a children's novel series centering around the misadventures of elementary schoolers George and Harold. " One day as a prank they hypnotize the school's abusive principal Mr. Krupp into believing he's Captain Underpants. Trouble ensues now as the boys have to look after Krupp who tries to fight crime thinking that he's a superhero. Then things only get worse when he accidentally gains superpowers, fully bringing Captain Underpants to life.

scenarios.setting: The Care Bears are a fictional group of multi-colored bear characters originally painted in 1981 by artist Elena Kucharik to be used on greeting cards from American Greetings. The characters were turned into plush teddy bears in 1983, and since then, they have appeared in numerous television series, feature films, books, video games, and more.

scenarios.title: Carnivores

scenarios.setting: This story tells the story of a man who ended up having an enormous thirst for revenge against the police in his region for not being able to save his wife from a serial killer wanted by the entire city in their home. So he starts building new special animtronics so that they can complete their revenge plan against the police station in his city.

scenarios.title: Catch! Teenieping
scenarios.description: Catch! Teenieping is a a Korean television series produced by SAMG Entertainment, who are also known for co-producing shows like Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir and the Sonic Boom television show.
scenarios.setting: Catch! Teenieping is a a Korean television series produced by SAMG Entertainment, who are also known for co-producing shows like Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir and the Sonic Boom television show. The series is about a pre-teen girl named Romi who lives in a place called the Emotions Kingdom who accidentally sets free a large amount of creatures known as "Teeniepings" onto earth. Romi is sent to earth and has to retrieve all of the teeniepings to their original world.

scenarios.title: Cattails
scenarios.description: Cattails and its sequel, Cattails: Wildwood Story are games inspired by the Warrior Cats series.
scenarios.setting: The next day, another feral cat named Coco, who was apparently also abandoned, gives the protagonist a tour of the land they're now in and teaches them the ways of their society, which is organized into three rival groups called "colonies" and watched over by a spirit in the form of a mountain lion, known simply as the Forest Guardian. However, the Forest Guardian has disappeared, and the forest's balance becomes broken.

scenarios.title: Cave Story
scenarios.description: Cave Story is the name of a metroidvania indie game released by Daisuke "Pixel" Amaya in 2004.
scenarios.setting: Cave Story is the name of a metroidvania indie game released by Daisuke "Pixel" Amaya in 2004. The game takes place within a large floating island, suspended in the air by the Core. During the game, you play as Quote, a robot who has lost all memories of where he is and what he used to be. He comes across a village of Mimigas, who are being captured and enslaved by The Doctor, as well as his subordinates Misery and Balrog.

scenarios.title: Cavewoman
scenarios.description: Cavewoman is an American alternative comic book created by writer-artist Budd Root, and published from 1993 to 2009, primarily by Basement Comics and additionally by Caliber Comics and Avatar Press.
scenarios.setting: The story follows superhuman Meriem Cooper, a 19-year-old jungle woman who battles dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures in the Cretaceous period.

scenarios.title: Celeste
scenarios.description: Celeste is a game telling the story of Madeline, a teenage girl with severe anxiety and panic attacks, along with heavy self-doubt.
scenarios.setting: Celeste is a game telling the story of Madeline, a teenage girl with severe anxiety and panic attacks, along with heavy self-doubt. When she decides to climb Celeste Mountain, reality is flipped upside down as all of her inner emotions are personified by its power in a challenging adventure, where she not only has to overcome her negative emotions on the inside, but on the outside as well.

scenarios.title: Cells at Work!
scenarios.description: Cells at Work is a manga series created by Akane Shimizu, starting in 2015.
scenarios.setting: Cells at Work is a manga series created by Akane Shimizu, starting in 2015. It features humanized cells, mainly those from the immune system, in their fight against bacteria, viruses and infected cells. The series has a somewhat education side, giving information on the cells, organs and diseases encountered in each chapter, creating large appeal to those with an interest in biology. An anime adaptation of the series began airing in 2018.

scenarios.title: Chained Soldier
scenarios.description: This battle fantasy manga from the author of Akame ga Kill! follows several heroines who protect people from the monsters that appear through a gate connecting to an alternate world known as the Mato (magic capital).
scenarios.setting: follows several heroines who protect people from the monsters that appear through a gate connecting to an alternate world known as the Mato (magic capital).

scenarios.setting: is a multi-part manga series written and illustrated by Fujimoto Tatsuki. In Part One, the , we follow Denji - an impoverished teen paying off his deceased father's debt to the yakuza by working as a Devil Hunter with his devil dog companion, Pochita.

scenarios.title: ChalkZone

scenarios.setting: ChalkZone is an American animated television series created by Bill Burnett and Larry Huber for Nickelodeon. While serving detention for being distracted with drawing cartoons in class, 10 year-old Rudolph "Rudy" Tabootie happened to pick up the piece of Magic Chalk that would lead to a world beyond anything even his own extraordinarily creative mind could have imagined.

scenarios.title: Channel Zero
scenarios.description: Channel Zero is a horror series based around Creepypasta stories.
scenarios.setting: Channel Zero is a horror series based around Creepypasta stories. Though they are based on stories like Candle Cove and its mythos, it takes its own vastly different interpretation on the iconic horror stories.

scenarios.setting: Sabrina Spellman must reconcile her dual nature as a half-witch, half-mortal while fighting the evil forces that threaten her, her family, and the daylight world humans inhabit.

scenarios.setting: However as seven victors are found, the revelation of MATE and his warriors change the situation, and it becomes clear that the world itself is in danger.

scenarios.setting: Choujin X is the new series created by Sui Ishida, who became famous for his first manga: Tokyo Ghoul. The story of Choujin X follows two very different friends, Azuma Higashi and Tokio Kurohara, who live in Yamato Prefecture, which has been destroyed by supernaturally gifted humans called the Choujins. One day, on their way home, they meet one of these humans who threatens to kill them.

scenarios.setting: H. Greenblatt, who is well known for being a former writer and storyboard artist for Spongebob Squarepants and The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy. Chowder revolves around the eponymous cat/bear/rabbit hybrid who dreams of becoming a successful chef one day. He is an apprentice to popular chef Mung Daal and lives in his catering company's building. Mung serves as Chowder's fatherly figure, always offering him helpful advice and is incredibly patient with his ineptitude.

scenarios.setting: The game's story follows a group of adventurers who travel through time to prevent a global catastrophe.

scenarios.title: Chrono Clock

scenarios.setting: Rei inherited one very important item from his grandfather, a pocket watch within which a mysterious power lurks, the power to go back in time five minutes.

scenarios.title: Clancyverse
scenarios.description: Clancyverse is a general term to refer to the works of Tom Clancy, be they in the form of books, movies, or video games.
scenarios.setting: Clancyverse is a general term to refer to the works of Tom Clancy, be they in the form of books, movies, or video games. Tom Clancy's works are known for their similarity to real life military actions and harsh political critique, as most pieces of his combined verse center on some facet of military politics. Common themes include the war on drugs, terrorism, and espionage- among other common tropes.

scenarios.title: Clash of Clans

scenarios.title: Classmate, Kamimura Yuuka wa Kou Itta

scenarios.description: Classmate, Kamimura Yuuka wa Kou Itta is a psychological and romance manga authored by Sakurai Tsutsushi and illustrated by Kawakami Masaki.
scenarios.setting: He is incredibly bored by his unchanging daily school life and he ends up falling in love with his weird classmate Kamimura Yuuka, who rants about changing the world to his uninterested classmates. However, when she reveals the truth about the nature of their world to him, everything will quickly become stranger than he would ever have expected!

scenarios.title: ClayFighter
scenarios.description: ClayFighter is a fighting game franchise developed by Visual Concepts and Interplay.
scenarios.setting: ClayFighter is a fighting game franchise developed by Visual Concepts and Interplay. It is fairly parodic in nature, largely taking jabs and inspiration at games such as Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter, being quite similar in nature, only with the basic premise of all of the fighters being cartoonish characters made out of clay. The first game, simply titled Clayfighter, was released in 1993 with its Tournament Edition releasing that following year.

scenarios.title: Claymore
scenarios.description: Claymore is a manga and anime series by Norihiro Yagi.
scenarios.setting: Claymore is a manga and anime series by Norihiro Yagi. It is about female warriors called Claymores (named after the swords they wield) who are tasked to fight monsters known as Youma.

scenarios.title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
scenarios.description: Clifford the Big Red Dog is an American children's book series about the adventures of a precocious girl named Emily Elizabeth and her titular pet: a giant, red-furred dog named Clifford.
scenarios.setting: Clifford the Big Red Dog is an American children's book series about the adventures of a precocious girl named Emily Elizabeth and her titular pet: a giant, red-furred dog named Clifford. It was first published in 1963 and was written by Norman Bridwell.

scenarios.setting: The game allowed players to control customizable penguin avatars and explore a snowy island filled with different areas.

scenarios.title: Code Geass
scenarios.description: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion (コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ Kōdo Giasu: Hangyaku no Rurūshu?), often referred to as simply Code Geass, is a Japanese Anime series created by Sunrise, directed by Gorō Taniguchi, and written by Ichirō Ōkouchi, with original character designs by manga authors Clamp.
scenarios.setting: Set in an alternate timeline, the series focuses on how the former prince Lelouch Vi Britannia obtains a power known as Geass and decides to use it to obliterate the Holy Britannian Empire, an imperial monarchy and a superpower that has been conquering various countries.

scenarios.setting: The series follows the employees of Game-A-Vision, as they lampoon many events of the early 1980s in video games and relative real world topics of the time.

scenarios.title: Code Vein
scenarios.description: Code Vein is an action RPG soulslike released by Bandai Namco Entertainment in September 2019.
scenarios.setting: It is set in a post-apocalyptic world following an event known as the Great Collapse, which razed the Earth's surface with giant constructions known as the Thorns of Judgement. It was after the Great Collapse that a mysterious, giant red mist surrounded a major city, creating a society known as Vein.

scenarios.title: Code: Breaker
scenarios.description: Sakurakouji Sakura is a girl who appears modest and graceful but in reality is skilled in martial arts.
scenarios.setting: He is a seemingly cold-blooded killer who follows the principle of "an eye for an eye", to "use evil against evil".

scenarios.title: Codename: Kids Next Door
scenarios.description: Codename: Kids Next Door (also known as simply "Kids Next Door", or by its acronym KND) is an American animated series aired on Cartoon Network and created by Tom Warburton about a global organization of children that battle adult tyranny and defend kids worldwide.
scenarios.setting: Each KND operative is known by a numerical codename, spelled "Numbuh" and grouped into teams called "Sectors", located throughout the world.

scenarios.title: Colossal
scenarios.description: Gloria (Anne Hathaway) is an out-of-work party girl who finds herself in relationship trouble with her sensible boyfriend, Tim (Dan Stevens), and is forced to move back to her tiny hometown to get her life back on track.
scenarios.setting: Meanwhile, on the other side of the world, a larger-than-life creature begins attacking Seoul, South Korea on a nightly basis, captivating spectators around the world.

scenarios.title: Colossal Kaiju Combat!
scenarios.description: Colossal Kaiju Combat! (shortened as CKC) is a multiple media franchise, though only the card game was semi-sustainable (only one part of the comic was produced, and the video games are in development hell).
scenarios.setting: CKC's verse follows an expansive multiverse and many kaiju and mecha that inhabit it, created and brought together by the supreme beings of the verse, the Kaijujin.

scenarios.title: Comix Zone
scenarios.description: Comix Zone is a beat 'em up/puzzle solving video game developed and published by Sega for the Sega Genesis in 1995.
scenarios.setting: Comix Zone is a beat 'em up/puzzle solving video game developed and published by Sega for the Sega Genesis in 1995. The motif of the game is that it is set within the panels of a comic book with dialogue shown within speech bubbles and sprites and backgrounds possessing the aesthetic and drawing style favored by popular American superhero comics.

scenarios.title: CookieRun
scenarios.description: CookieRun is a video-game series (& now a card game, called CookieRun: Braverse, along with having various series of comics & graphic novels) created by Devsisters Corporation in 2009, with the first game being titled OvenBreak, released for mobile devices.
scenarios.setting: The current CookieRun games which exist are: CookieRun: OvenBreak, CookieRun: Puzzle World, CookieRun: Kingdom, CookieRun: Witch's Castle, CookieRun: Tower of Adventures, CookieRun: The Darkest Night, CookieRun India, 冲呀! The main story of CookieRun: Witches Castle involves GingerBrave & others trying to save GingerDozer from the Shadow Witch. The main plotline of CookieRun: Tower of Adventures involves GingerBrave & his friends travelling through the Pancake Tower to halt the evils leaking from an oven within.

scenarios.title: Corpse Party
scenarios.description: Corpse Party (コープスパーティー, Kōpusu Pātī) is a survival horror, adventure, and dōjin soft video game series originally created by Makoto Kedōin and developed by Team GrisGris.
scenarios.setting: Corpse Party (コープスパーティー, Kōpusu Pātī) is a survival horror, adventure, and dōjin soft video game series originally created by Makoto Kedōin and developed by Team GrisGris. The first game in the series was developed using the RPG Maker software version RPG Tsukūru Dante 98 and released in 1996 for the PC-9801. Repeated Fear, which was released for the PlayStation Portable on August 12, 2010, and iOS on February 9, 2012. The game was released in North America and Europe by Marvelous USA under the title Corpse Party.

scenarios.title: Counter-Strike
scenarios.description: Counter Strike is a series of first person shooter created by Valve.
scenarios.setting: The series as a whole is one of the most popular online FPS in the world, and one of the most popular E-Sports as a whole.

scenarios.title: Crash Bandicoot
scenarios.description: Crash Bandicoot is a video game platformer franchise that debuted on the PlayStation 1.
scenarios.setting: Crash Bandicoot is a video game platformer franchise that debuted on the PlayStation 1. The series centers around the eponymous character, Crash Bandicoot, created by the evil scientific genius, Dr. Neo Cortex, to lead an army of evil mutants. However, the experiment backfired, and the resourceful bandicoot foiled Dr. Cortex's plans and rescued Tawna.

scenarios.title: Crazy Frog
scenarios.description: Crazy Frog, originally known as The Annoying Thing, is a Swedish series of CGI-animated music videos focused around the frog singer of the same name.
scenarios.setting: Crazy Frog, originally known as The Annoying Thing, is a Swedish series of CGI-animated music videos focused around the frog singer of the same name. It was created by actor and playwright Erik Wernquist in 2003. The Crazy Frog spawned a worldwide hit single with a remix of Axel F, which reached the number one spot in Turkey, New Zealand, Australia and most of Europe.

scenarios.title: Creep
scenarios.description: The Creep franchise consists of found footage psychological-horror installments, including two streaming exclusive and video on demand feature films, and a spin-off television series.
scenarios.setting: The Creep franchise consists of found footage psychological-horror installments, including two streaming exclusive and video on demand feature films, and a spin-off television series. Based on an original story by Patrick Brice and Mark Duplass, the movies have co-starred the pair, in addition to a supporting cast.

scenarios.title: Critters
scenarios.description: The Critters franchise, includes American science fiction comedy-horror installments consisting of five feature films, and one television series.
scenarios.setting: The storyline for the first two films involves alien bounty hunters who hunt the Krites in a small American town. The setting for the third movie is a city, and the fourth film takes place on a space station.

scenarios.title: CrowsxWorst
scenarios.description: Crows (クローズ Kurōzu) is a manga series created by Takahashi Hiroshi that ran in Monthly Shōnen Champion magazine from 1990 to 1998.
scenarios.setting: The story follows the exploits of teenage delinquents in and around the fictional Japanese town of Toarushi, particularly the students of the infamous Suzuran All-Boys High School.

scenarios.title: Cruelty Squad
scenarios.description: Cruelty Squad is a tactical first-person shooter developed by Finnish studio Consumer Softproducts and released in early access on Steam on 4 January 2021 and fully released in 16 June 2021.
scenarios.setting: The game has been described by the developer as “an immersive power fantasy simulator with tactical stealth elements set in a sewage infused garbage world”.

scenarios.title: Crusader Kings
scenarios.description: Crusader Kings is a strategy video game produced by paradox interactive.
scenarios.setting: Crusader Kings is a strategy video game produced by paradox interactive. While initially intended to be historical in nature, the series adapted various fantasy elements to it. The game has no set objective to it and is sandbox in nature.

scenarios.title: Cry of Fear
scenarios.description: Cry of Fear is a survival horror game developed by independent Swedish studio Team Psykskallar.
scenarios.setting: The player must navigate the city solving puzzles and fighting monsters to progress. The game switches between normal gameplay levels representing the city and surrounding areas, and "nightmare" levels, similar to those found in the Silent Hill series of games.

scenarios.title: Crysis
scenarios.description: Crysis is a first-person-shooter video game series developed by German video game developer Crytek GmbH and published by Electronic Arts.
scenarios.setting: Crysis is a first-person-shooter video game series developed by German video game developer Crytek GmbH and published by Electronic Arts. They are made using Crytek's in-house CryEngine and are well known for their graphical fidelity and taxing hardware requirements. The first game in the series, 2007’s Crysis, and its 2008 standalone expansion Crysis Warhead, premiered running on the CryEngine 2 game engine. The games were well received and became particularly notorious for their very high hardware requirements.

scenarios.title: CubexCursedxCurious
scenarios.description: CubexCursedxCurious, also known as C3, is a light novel series written by Hazuki Minase and illustrated by Sasorigatame.
scenarios.setting: A Japanese student called Yachi Haruaki receives a package from his father, who travels around the world looking for cursed items.

scenarios.title: Cultivator Against Hero Society
scenarios.description: Cultivator Against Hero Society, or CAHS for short, is a Chinese Manhua series.
scenarios.setting: The story revolves around the main character, Yan Sen, who leaves his realm to cultivate, and then, upon learning that his sect has been destroyed, returns and destroys everyone responsible, resulting in his being sealed and exiled to another realm, our world, and his interactions with the heroes of that realm.

scenarios.title: Cuphead
scenarios.description: Cuphead is a game released in 2017.
scenarios.setting: Cuphead is a game released in 2017. The game follows two anthropomorphic cartoon cups, Cuphead and Mugman, as they bet and lose their souls to the Devil and his casino. In order to save their own souls, the two protagonists make a deal to retrieve the souls of other debtors who, like themselves, played the Devil's game and lost. Along the way they encounter a colorful cast of enemies, not the least of which includes the Devil's own sleazy lackey, King Dice.

scenarios.title: Cutie Honey
scenarios.description: Cutie Honey is a manga series by Go Nagai that tells the adventures of Honey Kisaragi, otherwise known as Cutie Honey.
scenarios.setting: Cutie Honey is a manga series by Go Nagai that tells the adventures of Honey Kisaragi, otherwise known as Cutie Honey. Unlike the anime version, the manga focuses much more on Honey's battle against Panther Claw than her time in school and relationships in said place. The manga was serialized in Weekly Shonen Champion's 41st issue in 1973, and was made into two volumes after production.

scenarios.title: CY BORG
scenarios.description: CY_BORG is an official hack of MÖRK BORG, an award-winning tabletop roleplaying game about the end of the world set in a "pitch-black" setting.
scenarios.setting: CY_BORG is an official hack of MÖRK BORG, an award-winning tabletop roleplaying game about the end of the world set in a "pitch-black" setting. CY_BORG follows a similar idea, except set in a futuristic Cyberpunk-inspired reality ruled by ruthless megacorporations, tech-infused death cults, and massive private military groups.

scenarios.title: Cyanide and Happiness
scenarios.description: Cyanide & Happiness (C&H), also known as Cyanide and Happiness, is a webcomic written and illustrated by Rob DenBleyker, Kris Wilson, Dave McElfatrick and formerly Matt Melvin, published on their website explosm.net.
scenarios.setting: net. It was created on December 9, 2004, and started running daily on January 26, 2005. It has appeared on social networking sites such as Myspace, Quora, LiveJournal, and Facebook, where, in April 2006, it had generated more than a million visits per week. The comic's authors attribute its success to its often controversial nature, and the series is noted for its dark humor and sometimes surrealistic approach.

scenarios.title: Cyberpunk (Games)
scenarios.description: The Cyberpunk series is a pen & paper RPG created by Mike Pondsmith and published by his company, R.
scenarios.setting: The Cyberpunk series is a pen & paper RPG created by Mike Pondsmith and published by his company, R. Talsorian Games. It was created in 1988 and was heavily inspired by the novels of Phillip K. Dick and William Gibson, and in particular the 1982 film Blade Runner.

scenarios.title: D.Gray-Man
scenarios.description: D.Gray-Man is a serialized manga and anime created by Katsura Hoshino that has been published in Weekly Shonen Jump and Jump Square Rise.
scenarios.setting: Gray-Man is a serialized manga and anime created by Katsura Hoshino that has been published in Weekly Shonen Jump and Jump Square Rise. In a world full of sorrow, the enigmatic leader of the so-called Noah Clan, the Millennium Earl, grants second chances to the recently departed at the behest of their loved ones - with the caveat of turning them into a rampaging Akuma monster as a side effect.

scenarios.title: D.I.C.E.
scenarios.description: D.I.C.E./DICE: The Cube That Changes Everything is a Korean Webtoon created by YUN Hyunseok.
scenarios.setting: /DICE: The Cube That Changes Everything is a Korean Webtoon created by YUN Hyunseok. Dongtae hated himself, and his life, being a bullied kid with bad looks, no smarts, and even less wits. The only ray of hope in his life was Eunjo, a girl that he had a crush on. However, that too was taken away when a new transfer student, Taebin, became her boyfriend. Having (a self-admittedly irrational) distrust for Taebin, he ends up stalking him, and find a weird die shiny that he had left behind.

scenarios.title: Daddy DJ
scenarios.description: Daddy DJ is a French dance act consisting of David Le Roy and Jean-Christophe Belval.
scenarios.setting: Daddy DJ is a French dance act consisting of David Le Roy and Jean-Christophe Belval. Daddy DJ's music videos feature a 13-year-old boy known as Kross. Kross has blonde dreadlocks and a white bucket hat. He wears a black shirt and purple pants. He is known in all of the music videos as a child DJ prodigy, who is more adapted at being a DJ than his father.

scenarios.title: Daigoro vs. Goliath
scenarios.description: "Daigoro vs. Goliath" is a Japanese kaiju film released in 1972. The movie revolves around Daigoro, a small kaiju (monster) who befriends a young boy named Hiroshi. Daigoro is a gentle and friendly creature, in contrast to the typical destructive nature of kai
scenarios.setting: Hiroshi and Daigoro form a unique bond as they work together to confront Goliath and save the world from destruction.

scenarios.title: Daikaiju Yuki
scenarios.description: Daikaiju Yuki is a series of books written by Raffael Coronelli that pay homage to the kaiju genre, as well as giant monsters in general.
scenarios.setting: Set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, humanity is still recovering from a vicious war that reshaped all that they knew, their total annihilation only averted by the Pantheon Colossi, great beings that saw the good in humanity, and even gave them the ability to form special bonds with them through sacred amulets. Enter Yuki Tsubaki, a young woman sent to locate a temple dedicated to one of the Colossi in order to investigate the disappearance of a former comrade.

scenarios.title: Daisaiyuuki Bokuhi Seiden - The Story of a Very Handsome Man
scenarios.source: Daisaiyuuki Bokuhi Seiden - The Story of a Very Handsome Man
scenarios.description: 500 years ago, The Monkey King, Son Goku, suddenly vanished, while a secret that the Heavens kept was that Konzenshi, the second disciple of Buddha, also vanished.
scenarios.setting: Bokuhi, who dreams on becoming a Mangaka, changes his plans upon meeting Moku the 13th Elder and being told of his past, now setting out on a quest in order to find the reincarnation of Konzenshi to save the World.

scenarios.title: Dakotaverse
scenarios.description: The Dakotaverse, now officially rebranded as Earth M, is the name of a shared comic book universe starring minority superheroes from different races, religions, and sexualities.
scenarios.setting: While the classic continuity was a fairly interconnected universe in its own right, the Milestone Returns era tells a large scale saga about police brutality, government apathy; and malice, and the many issues that hold minorities down throughout their various' series while also keeping much of the storylines self-contained.

scenarios.title: Dan the Man
scenarios.description: Dan the Man is a mobile platformer game by Halfbrick based on a webseries by Studio Joho.
scenarios.setting: Dan the Man is a mobile platformer game by Halfbrick based on a webseries by Studio Joho. The main protagonist, Dan, must save his love interest, Josie, and the village from the king's guards.

scenarios.title: Dandadan
scenarios.description: Dandadan (ダンダダン) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yukinobu Tatsu.
scenarios.setting: Dandadan (ダンダダン) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yukinobu Tatsu. It has been serialized in Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+service since April 2021, with its chapters collected into seven tankōbon volumes as of October 2022. Plot: Momo Ayase is a high school girl who believes in ghosts but not aliens, while her classmate Okarun believes in aliens but not ghosts.

scenarios.title: Danganronpa
scenarios.description: Danganronpa is a Japanese murder-mystery video game franchise, created by Kazutaka Kodaka under the company of Spike Chunsoft, centering on a group of high school students with 'Ultimate' talents trapped in a "killing game" by robotic bear named Monokuma.
scenarios.setting: The story is shown from the perspective of the protagonist, Makoto Naegi, who starts a new year at the elite private Hope's Peak Academy. However, every year the school hosts a raffle in which every average student nationwide is entered, and a random student is selected to enter the school as the "Ultimate Lucky Student" - as is the case with Makoto Naegi and is shown through the short story, Makoto Naegi's Worst Day Ever.

scenarios.title: Danger Verse
scenarios.description: Henry Danger follows the journey of 13-year-old Henry Hart, whose life takes a dramatic turn when he lands a secret part-time job as Kid Danger, the sidekick-in-training to Swellview's resident superhero, Captain Man.
scenarios.setting: Henry Danger follows the journey of 13-year-old Henry Hart, whose life takes a dramatic turn when he lands a secret part-time job as Kid Danger, the sidekick-in-training to Swellview's resident superhero, Captain Man. Balancing school, friendships, and his new superhero responsibilities proves to be a challenge for Henry, as the job thrusts him into a world of danger and excitement far beyond the ordinary.

scenarios.title: Dante's Inferno (Video Game)
scenarios.description: Dante's Inferno is a third person action-adventure game published by Electronic Arts and developed by Visceral Games.
scenarios.setting: Dante's Inferno is a third person action-adventure game published by Electronic Arts and developed by Visceral Games. The comics and animated movie were accepted as canon in this thread.

scenarios.title: Dark Cloud
scenarios.description: Dark Cloud is an action role-playing video game developed by Level-5 and published by Sony Computer Entertainment.The game follows the story of a teenage boy named Toan who was saved and chosen by the Fairy King to rebuild half the world destroyed by an entity known as the Dark Genie.
scenarios.setting: Along the way, Toan gains several allies who help him battle his way through monster infested dungeons in an attempt to defeat the Dark Genie and save the world. It follows the story of two teenagers, Maximillion and Monica Raybrandt, as they travel across the world in order to restore the future and save the world from the evil Emperor Griffon, who is using the power of an Atlamillia to time travel to achieve his goal of completely annihilating the human race.

scenarios.title: Dark Deception
scenarios.description: Dark Deception is an episodic first-person pacman-like horror game, developed and published by Glowstick Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Dark Deception is an episodic first-person pacman-like horror game, developed and published by Glowstick Entertainment.

scenarios.title: Dark Shadows
scenarios.description: Dark Shadows is a 2012 dark fantasy film based on the gothic television soap opera of the same name.
scenarios.setting: Dark Shadows is a 2012 dark fantasy film based on the gothic television soap opera of the same name. Directed by Tim Burton, the film stars Johnny Depp, Michelle Pfeiffer, Helena Bonham Carter, Eva Green, Jackie Earle Haley, Jonny Lee Miller, Chloë Grace Moretz, and Bella Heathcote in a dual role. Christopher Lee has a small role in the film, his 200th film appearance and his fifth and final appearance in a Burton film.

scenarios.title: Darker Than Black
scenarios.description: Darker than Black, known in Japan as Darker than Black: The Black Contractor (Japanese: DARKER THAN BLACK -黒の契約者- Hepburn: Dākā Zan Burakku -Kuro no Keiyakusha-), is an anime television series created, directed and written by Tensai Okamura and animated by Bones.
scenarios.setting: It premiered across Japan from April 5, 2007 on MBS, TBS, and its affiliated broadcast stations, with its satellite television premiere in Japan on Animax in May 2007.

scenarios.title: Darksiders
scenarios.description: Darksiders is a Hack and Slash game originally developed by Vigil Games and Published by THQ.
scenarios.setting: It takes place in a fantasy setting loosely based on the Book of Revelation from The Bible.

scenarios.title: Darkstalkers
scenarios.description: Darkstalkers, known as Vampire in Japan, is a fighting game series produced by Capcom; its first entry was produced during the fighting game craze of the 1990s.
scenarios.setting: Darkstalkers, known as Vampire in Japan, is a fighting game series produced by Capcom; its first entry was produced during the fighting game craze of the 1990s. In contrast to the martial arts-themed fighting games of the time, the game's characters are (mostly) based on classic literary or film monsters — including Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolf Man, and the Creature from the Black Lagoon — and boast zany combos and attacks to help set the game apart from others.

scenarios.title: Darwin's Game
scenarios.description: Darwin's Game is a monthly action/survival manga series written by FLIPFLOPs, a duo of authors.
scenarios.setting: Darwin's Game is a monthly action/survival manga series written by FLIPFLOPs, a duo of authors. It centers around a high school boy named Kaname Sudo who is invited to try out a new mysterious mobile app game called Darwin's Game, but later realizes that he's in for more than he's bargained for when he finds out that there's no way to quit the game. Other players, attracted by the lure of gain and the thrill of the fight, are ready to do anything to find him, after he proves himself to be very capable.

scenarios.title: Dashbored
scenarios.description: Dashbored is a series of RPG Maker titles created by FadingClub/Karbonic.
scenarios.setting: Dashbored is a series of RPG Maker titles created by FadingClub/Karbonic. The series is ambiguously tied to other Karbonic projects such as Dreamwilds and Psychopomp.

scenarios.title: Date A Live
scenarios.description: Date A Live (デート・ア・ライブ) is a Japanese light novel series written by Kōshi Tachibana and illustrated by Tsunako that is published by Fujimi Shobo under their Fujumi Fantasia Bunko label since March 2011.
scenarios.setting: Shido Itsuka, a seemingly ordinary high schooler comes across a mysterious girl at the ground zero of a spacequake and learns from his sister Kotori she is one of the "Spirits" who are the real cause of the spacequakes that occur when they manifest themselves in the world.

scenarios.title: Dawn of the Mummy
scenarios.description: In Egypt, in the year 300 B.C., Zafiamam, a man dedicated to war with many followers who would also have to die with him, is mummified.
scenarios.setting: , Zafiamam, a man dedicated to war with many followers who would also have to die with him, is mummified. Then, a sphinx ordered to keep all the gold he possessed and to add a curse; it consisted in that Zafiamam himself would rise and kill during the next years, as well as all his followers who would also be mummified, kept and buried for many, many years.

scenarios.title: Days Gone
scenarios.description: Days Gone is an action-adventure survival horror video game developed by SIE Bend Studio and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment for PlayStation 4 on April 26, 2019.
scenarios.setting: Set in a post-apocalyptic Oregon two years after a global pandemic, former outlaw-turned-drifter Deacon St.

scenarios.title: DC Comics
scenarios.description: DCU. Short for the Detective Comics Universe. DC is a company that publishes many of the most popular comic book characters and franchises, such as Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, the JLA, etc.
scenarios.setting: DCU. Short for the Detective Comics Universe. DC is a company that publishes many of the most popular comic book characters and franchises, such as Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, the JLA, etc.

scenarios.title: DC Serial
scenarios.description: The DC Serial is a series of TV series adapting DC Comics' stories.
scenarios.setting: Columbia Pictures was one of the last Hollywood studios to continue in postwar years with the serial format. The Vigilante, marketed as The Vigilante: Fighting Hero of the West, is a 1947 American Western film serial directed by Wallace Fox. He follows a legend about a mysterious White Queen, but his path is full of difficulties, by an inhospitable jungle, and the man who will lose the fortune if the girl is found alive.

scenarios.title: DC Super Hero Girls
scenarios.description: DC Super Hero Girls is an animated spin-off of DC Comics' characters airing on Cartoon Network, focusing on it's most famous heroines in an alternate continuity, living together as high school students who fight crime on the side.
scenarios.setting: DC Super Hero Girls is an animated spin-off of DC Comics' characters airing on Cartoon Network, focusing on it's most famous heroines in an alternate continuity, living together as high school students who fight crime on the side.

scenarios.title: DDtank
scenarios.description: DDtank (彈彈堂 or 新弹弹堂) is a free online Chinese game developed and published by .
scenarios.setting: DDtank (彈彈堂 or 新弹弹堂) is a free online Chinese game developed and published by 7Road. DDtank Origin (弹弹堂 origin) and DDtank Mobile are the mobile version of the game, also developed and published by 7th Road.

scenarios.title: Dead Alive
scenarios.description: Braindead (also known as Dead Alive in North America) is a 1992 New Zealand splatstick zombie comedy film directed by Peter Jackson, produced by Jim Booth, and written by Jackson, along with Fran Walsh and Stephen Sinclair.
scenarios.setting: The film follows Lionel, a man living with his mother Vera in a Victorian mansion, who gets into trouble for his relationship with a Spanish shopkeeper's daughter, Paquita.

scenarios.title: Dead by Daylight
scenarios.description: Dead by Daylight is an asymmetric survival horror video game developed by Behavior Interactive and published by Starbreeze Studios.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place across four locales which are based on the places the killers became murderers.

scenarios.title: Dead Cells
scenarios.description: Dead Cells is an independently released "Roguevania" (combining the traditional Rouge-like and Metroidvania styles) game developed by Motion Twin.
scenarios.setting: The game revolves around a nearly endless cycle of attempting to escape the island it takes place on and merely returning to the starting point to do it again.

scenarios.title: Dead or Alive
scenarios.description: Dead or Alive is a video game series produced by Tecmo that is primarily composed of fast-paced fighting games.
scenarios.setting: DOATEC (Dead or Alive Tournament Executive Committee), a massive corporation with unknown motives, holds the fighting competition in arenas ranging from the North Pole to the Amazon rain forest.

scenarios.title: Dead Rising
scenarios.description: It is a series of survival horror beat 'em up video games set in an open world created by Keiji Inafune.
scenarios.setting: It is a series of survival horror beat 'em up video games set in an open world created by Keiji Inafune. It was originally developed by Capcom until Blue Castle Games (now known as Capcom Vancouver) took over developing the franchise.

scenarios.title: Deadman Wonderland
scenarios.description: Latest manga from the creators of Eureka Seven tells the story of Ganta Igarashi, a boy who is wrongly accused of the murder of his fellow classmates and is sentenced to death.
scenarios.setting: Latest manga from the creators of Eureka Seven tells the story of Ganta Igarashi, a boy who is wrongly accused of the murder of his fellow classmates and is sentenced to death. So he's shipped to Deadman Wonderland, a prison that doubles as a theme park (yes it even gets visitors to a place where murderous convicts are held). Soon as he arrives, he learns that he can manipulate blood as a weapon called a Branch of Sin. Those with these kinds of powers are known as Deadmen.

scenarios.title: Death and Destiny
scenarios.description: A trilogy by paranormal romance author, ND Jones (see ).
scenarios.setting: Through a deal with Sekhmet, they asked for the power to protect their witches. It was through this deal that warlocks gained the ability to turn into cats, and gradually lost their warlock abilities until they lost their ability to use magic entirely. These spirits are typically determined through biology, such that if one's father is a lion, then a son birthed to him will likely be a lion as well.

scenarios.title: Death Forest
scenarios.description: Death Forest (死の森 'Death Forest') is a freeware Japanese survivial horror game created by Kazz.
scenarios.setting: Death Forest (死の森 'Death Forest') is a freeware Japanese survivial horror game created by Kazz. It was orginally released around 2014. The game follows a Japanese man named Kazuki Uchida driving on his motorbike through Aokigahra when it suddenly breaks down. Kazuki must now find items to repair his motorbike while avoiding various monsters that roam the forest in order to escape. Since then, the game has somewhat gained a cult following, getting a series of Japanese live-action horror films.

scenarios.title: Death Note
scenarios.description: Death Note is a Japanese manga series written by Tsugumi Ohba and illustrated by Takeshi Obata.
scenarios.setting: The story follows Light Yagami, a high school student who discovers a supernatural notebook from a shinigami named Ryuk that grants its user the ability to kill anyone whose name and face he knows. The series centers around Light's subsequent attempts to create and rule a world "cleansed of evil" as a "God" using this found notebook, and the efforts of a detective known as L to stop him.

scenarios.title: Death Road To Canada
scenarios.description: Death Road to Canada is a 2016 roguelike video game developed by Rocketcat Games and Madgarden, and published by Rocketcat Games.
scenarios.setting: In Death Road to Canada, the player takes control of a party of random jerks as they make their way through the zombie apocalypse in a multi-day car trip from Flordia to the border of Canada, the one country on Earth not overrun with zombies.

scenarios.title: Death Stranding
scenarios.description: Death Stranding[c] is an action game developed by Kojima Productions.
scenarios.setting: The game is set in the United States during the aftermath of the eponymous Death Stranding, which caused destructive creatures from a realm between life and death to begin roaming the Earth.

scenarios.title: Deathgarden: BLOODHARVEST
scenarios.description: Deathgarden: BLOODHARVEST is a survival game, where you can play as either a survivor or a hunter.
scenarios.setting: As a hunter, you are trying to entertain those within the Enclave as well as keep the "filth" from joining the organization without being tested.

scenarios.title: Debby the Corsifa is Emulous
scenarios.description: Debby the Corsifa is Emulous (JP: デビィ・ザ・コルシファは負けず嫌い; Debby the Corsifa wa Makezugirai) is a Japanese comedy manga series written and illustrated by Masahiro Hirakata.
scenarios.setting: The series revolves around the self-proclaimed "Strongest Demon": Debby the Corsifa, who initially entered the human world to kill some time.

scenarios.title: Deep Rising
scenarios.description: Deep Rising is a 1998 American action horror film directed by Stephen Sommers and starring Treat Williams, Famke Janssen and Anthony Heald.
scenarios.setting: Deep Rising is a 1998 American action horror film directed by Stephen Sommers and starring Treat Williams, Famke Janssen and Anthony Heald. It was distributed by Hollywood Pictures and Cinergi Pictures and released on January 30, 1998.

scenarios.title: Deep Sea Embers
scenarios.description: Deep Sea Embers is a popular webnovel written by  Yuan Tong (远瞳) It is the story of Zhou Ming, a high school teacher, who stepped through the thick fog and confronted a completely subverted and fragmented world―the old order had vanished, strange phenomena dominated the endless seas beyond civilized society, and isolated island city-states and fleets of ships challenged the ocean that had become the last ember of light for the civilized world.
scenarios.setting: Deep Sea Embers is a popular webnovel written by Yuan Tong (远瞳) It is the story of Zhou Ming, a high school teacher, who stepped through the thick fog and confronted a completely subverted and fragmented world―the old order had vanished, strange phenomena dominated the endless seas beyond civilized society, and isolated island city-states and fleets of ships challenged the ocean that had become the last ember of light for the civilized world.

scenarios.title: Deepwoken
scenarios.description: Deepwoken is an adventure rogue-like RPG.
scenarios.setting: Deepwoken is an adventure rogue-like RPG. It was developed by Monad Studios, a roblox dev group that also made Rogue Lineage The game is about a world that is slowly dying out due to the certain actions of those living in it, mostly the overuse of the Song, which is the main source of magic in the Deepwoken universe. After figuring out how to use the Song, The humans started an era of technological prowess and enlightenment. That golden age is known as "the Canticlysm".

scenarios.title: Def Jam
scenarios.description: Def Jam Recordings is a street fighting game verse based off real life Hip-Hop stars of the 90s-00s created by Electronic Arts.
scenarios.setting: Def Jam Recordings is a street fighting game verse based off real life Hip-Hop stars of the 90s-00s created by Electronic Arts.

scenarios.title: Defender's Quest: Valley of the Forgotten
scenarios.source: Defender's Quest: Valley of the Forgotten
scenarios.description: Defender's Quest: Valley of the Forgotten is a Tower-Defense/RPG hybrid.
scenarios.setting: Defender's Quest: Valley of the Forgotten is a Tower-Defense/RPG hybrid.

scenarios.title: Deltarune
scenarios.description: Deltarune is a role-playing game developed and published by indie developer Toby Fox.
scenarios.setting: Deltarune is a role-playing game developed and published by indie developer Toby Fox. It is the second game within the UNDERTALE Series. In the game, the player controls a human teenager named Kris, who, after being forced to partner with their class bully, falls along with her into a Dark World: An alternate world built from the shadows that fill a room in what is known as the Light World. Dark Fountains shape the Dark Worlds, and reflect their will as they form their respective worlds.

scenarios.title: Dengeki Stryker
scenarios.description: Dengeki Stryker is a visual novel that follows Yuuki Yamato, a young boy who has a great sense of justice and aspires to be a hero.
scenarios.setting: Dengeki Stryker is a visual novel that follows Yuuki Yamato, a young boy who has a great sense of justice and aspires to be a hero. Yamato always tried to protect his childhood friend Haruna when she was being bullied, but he always got beat down instead. One day, Haruna was going to move away and wanted to say goodbye to him. However, he despaired that he was never able to protect her once in the end.

scenarios.title: Depth
scenarios.description: Depth is a multiplayer survival horror game where you can play as either sharks or divers.
scenarios.setting: Depth is a multiplayer survival horror game where you can play as either sharks or divers. As divers you collect gold and other treasures while trying to avoid being killed by sharks. As the sharks you are tasked with killing the divers to keep them from collecting gold and completing their objectives. There are also other game modes that change the formula.

scenarios.title: Der Werwolf: The Annals of Veight
scenarios.source: Der Werwolf: The Annals of Veight
scenarios.description: Der Werwolf: The Annals of Veight follow the reborn werewolf known as Veight, who now leads the Demon Lord's third regiment under the title of Vice-Commander.
scenarios.setting: Having conquered the trading hub known as Ryunheit, he soon learns the struggles of governing a city of mixed human/demon population.

scenarios.title: Designated Bully
scenarios.description: After dropping out of high school, Daegun Kwon is working part-time at a convenience store while preparing to get his GED.
scenarios.setting: After dropping out of high school, Daegun Kwon is working part-time at a convenience store while preparing to get his GED. After being harassed by a group of punks during work and teaching them a lesson, Daegun is approached by a woman from the Education Foundation about a project called “Designated Bully”. After being offered another chance at a normal life, Daegun accepts the offer and attends school to perform his one duty as the designated bully: To take down the other bullies, and restore order to the school.

scenarios.title: Desolate Era
scenarios.description: Desolate Era is a Xianxia novel written by the author, I Eat Tomatoes, whose other works include Lord Xue Ying, Coiling Dragon, Stellar Transformations and Archean Eon Art.
scenarios.setting: Desolate Era is a Xianxia novel written by the author, I Eat Tomatoes, whose other works include Lord Xue Ying, Coiling Dragon, Stellar Transformations and Archean Eon Art. The novel follows the life of Ji Ning, a teenager who, while being bedridden due to constant illness and predicted to die young, decided that he'd spend his life building an online fortune and use it to help those less fortunate than himself.

scenarios.title: Despicable Me
scenarios.description: Despicable Me is a popular animated film series produced by Illumination Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Despicable Me is a popular animated film series produced by Illumination Entertainment. With the first film being released in 2010, it launched a series of films and spinoffs. It follows the adventures of Felonius Gru, a former supervillain turned good. It is also notable for being the franchise that introduced the Minions into pop culture.

scenarios.title: Destination of Crybird
scenarios.description: Destination of Crybird (鳴いた鳥のゆく先は, literally "The Destination of the Crowed Birds") was a web novel series posted in Syosetsu written by Youno Touzai, however, the series was left incomplete before being deleted by its author, making it an example of lost media (although an English translation of its first third still exists).
scenarios.setting: This man was born into a different world that has concepts such as magic, skills and levels as Larcus Crybird with the memories of his previous life. However in this world, there are countless monsters that cannot be beaten by merely relying on swordsmanship or magic. In such a world how will Larcus, who keeps aiming to be the strongest while faltering from time to time, end up?

scenarios.title: Destiny
scenarios.description: Destiny is a video game series created by Bungie and published by Activision.
scenarios.setting: Destiny is a video game series created by Bungie and published by Activision. The series has the player take on the role of a Guardian, a resurrected individual empowered by a cosmic force called the Light. This Guardian is in the service of defending The Last City (last surviving bastion of humanity) from the forces of the Darkness. Players journey into the depths of various planets, realms, and other similar areas.

scenarios.title: Detective Conan
scenarios.description: Detective Conan (名探偵コナン Meitantei Konan), is an ongoing Japanese detective manga series written and illustrated by Gosho Aoyama.
scenarios.setting: He goes to the goofball inventor who lives next to him for help, and the particular neighbor becomes one of his most trusted allies to help him solve the case through the unusual inventions.

scenarios.title: Detroit: Become Human
scenarios.description: Detroit: Become Human is a cinematic neo-noir thriller game developed by Quantic Dream and published for PlayStation 4, releasing also for Microsoft Windows.
scenarios.setting: Detroit: Become Human is a cinematic neo-noir thriller game developed by Quantic Dream and published for PlayStation 4, releasing also for Microsoft Windows.

scenarios.title: Deus Ex
scenarios.description: Deus Ex is a 2000 action role-playing video game developed by Ion Storm and published by Eidos Interactive.
scenarios.setting: Set in a cyberpunk-themed dystopian world in the year 2052, the story follows JC Denton, an anti-terrorist agent given superhuman abilities by nanotechnology, as he sets out to combat hostile forces in a world ravaged by inequality and a deadly plague.

scenarios.title: Devil Daggers
scenarios.description: Devil Daggers is a video game created and published by Sorath.
scenarios.setting: The game is a simple game devoid of any sort of story, being an arena shooter in which the player armed with the ability to shoot daggers from their fingertips fights against endless legions of demonic foes in an abyssal arena to survive as long as they can.

scenarios.title: Devil May Cry
