scenarios.description: For detailed information about this franchise, visit the Devil May Cry Wiki.
scenarios.setting: The plot of Devil May Cry follows the Demon Hunter Dante, the son of a legendary demon who sealed off the demon world named Sparda and a human named Eva. The story revolves around Dante's family and their collective journey, mostly revolving around repelling invasions from the Demon World and similar supernatural threats.

scenarios.title: Devil May Cry (Netflix)
scenarios.description: The Netflix version of Devil May Cry is an adaption of the popular game series, Devil May Cry, with the series created by Adi Shankar and animated by Studio Mir, the Nerflix version of Devil May Cry distanced itself from the original game series by having a new story, adaptation and interpretation of characters and certain events.
scenarios.setting: The Netflix version of Devil May Cry is an adaption of the popular game series, Devil May Cry, with the series created by Adi Shankar and animated by Studio Mir, the Nerflix version of Devil May Cry distanced itself from the original game series by having a new story, adaptation and interpretation of characters and certain events.

scenarios.title: Devilman (Franchise)
scenarios.description: Devilman is a manga series written and illustrated by Go Nagai.
scenarios.setting: Devilman is a manga series written and illustrated by Go Nagai. In the center of the plot, a boy named Akira, discovers the Earth is being invaded by demons. His friend Ryo convinces him that the only way to stop the demons is to have him merge with one of them. Akira gains the ability to transform into a super powerful, batlike demon – Devilman. The story itself is based on earlier work of the author of "Demon Lord Dante".

scenarios.title: Dexter
scenarios.description: Dexter is about man who deals with the complications of living with a murderous nature while attempting to live a double life.
scenarios.setting: Dexter is about man who deals with the complications of living with a murderous nature while attempting to live a double life. By day, he is an expert blood spatter analyst that helps the police investigate murders. By night, however, he hunts and kills serial killers and murderers who have escaped the justice system. Dexter first appeared as a protagonist in the Dexter series of novels written by Jeff Lindsay.

scenarios.title: Dexter's Laboratory
scenarios.description: Dexter's Laboratory (commonly abbreviated as Dexter's Lab) is an American comic science fiction animated television series created by Genndy Tartakovsky for Cartoon Network, and the first of the network's Cartoon Cartoons.
scenarios.setting: The series revolves around Dexter, a bespectacled boy-genius who possesses a secret laboratory hidden behind a bookcase in his bedroom. g. pulling out a specific book). Though highly intelligent, Dexter often fails at what he has set out to do when he becomes overexcited and makes careless choices. Although he comes from a typical all-American family, Dexter speaks with a thick accent of indeterminate origin.

scenarios.title: Dick Figures
scenarios.description: Dick Figures is an American adult animated web comedy series created, written, and directed by Ed Skudder and Zack Keller and distributed on YouTube by Mondo Media.
scenarios.setting: Dick Figures is an American adult animated web comedy series created, written, and directed by Ed Skudder and Zack Keller and distributed on YouTube by Mondo Media. The series, featuring two humanlike stick figures named Red and Blue who are best friends, aired for the first time on November 18, 2010. In 2012, Keller was nominated for an Annie Award for Directing in an Animated Television/Broadcast Production for the episode titled "Kung Fu Winners".

scenarios.title: Did I Seriously Just Get Reincarnated as My Gag Character?!
scenarios.source: Did I Seriously Just Get Reincarnated as My Gag Character?!
scenarios.description: Toru Aikawa is a university student who spends his days going through the motions of attending school and working at a local convenience store.
scenarios.setting: Toru Aikawa is a university student who spends his days going through the motions of attending school and working at a local convenience store. The only time he really feels alive is when he’s playing the massive multiplayer VR game Real World Online. One day, he has a stroke of luck: he’s hit by a runaway bus and reincarnated as his game character. But something’s gone wrong...

scenarios.title: Digimon
scenarios.description: Digimon, or Digital Monsters, was a virtual pet created by WIZ Co., Ltd.
scenarios.setting: Typically, Digimon tales unfold across two realms: the Human World and the Digital World. The Human World exists within an infinite multiverse as described by quantum physics, with some narratives sharing the same world, but most taking place in distinct worlds. The Digital World's portrayal varies across media due to its evolving structure.

scenarios.title: Dillon's Rolling Western
scenarios.description: Dillon's Rolling Western, known in Japan as The Rolling Western (ザ・ローリング・ウエスタン Za Rōringu Uesutan), is a downloadable video game developed by Vanpool and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 3DS.
scenarios.setting: Released exclusively through the system's Nintendo eShop online storefront, the game features Dillon, an anthropomorphic armadillo who must defend frontier villages from walking rock-like enemies.

scenarios.title: Dino Crisis
scenarios.description: Dino Crisis is a horror fiction video game based media franchise created by Shinji Mikami and owned by the video game company Capcom.
scenarios.setting: The overarching plot of the series focuses on multiple characters and their roles in recurring outbreaks of deadly dinosaurs and other monsters in a closed environment such as a laboratory on an island.

scenarios.title: Dinosaur King
scenarios.description: Escenario del universo de Dinosaur King.

scenarios.title: Dinosaur Simulator
scenarios.description: Dinosaur Simulator is a survival game - wherein the player can select out a variety of dinosaurs to choose from - many of which locked behind DNA (the game's currency) costs or unlockable achievements - created by the Roblox user ChickenEngineer and is currently being worked on by a group (with the inclusion of him) named Unhatched Games.
scenarios.setting: Dinosaur Simulator is a survival game - wherein the player can select out a variety of dinosaurs to choose from - many of which locked behind DNA (the game's currency) costs or unlockable achievements - created by the Roblox user ChickenEngineer and is currently being worked on by a group (with the inclusion of him) named Unhatched Games.

scenarios.title: Discworld
scenarios.description: Discworld is a comedy fantasy series by Terry Pratchett, consisting of 41 books, and a 4-book spinoff series.
scenarios.setting: Discworld is a comedy fantasy series by Terry Pratchett, consisting of 41 books, and a 4-book spinoff series. Many parts of the Discworld series parody our own society. The series is set entirely on a world on the back of four elephants which stand on the back of a giant Turtle called The Great A'tuin. Different books follow different parts of Discworld society (eg. the City Watch, the Unseen University, Death).

scenarios.title: Disenchantment
scenarios.description: Disenchantment is a 2018 Netflix series created by Matt Groening (Creator of The Simpsons and Futurama).
scenarios.setting: Disenchantment is a 2018 Netflix series created by Matt Groening (Creator of The Simpsons and Futurama). It stars Princess Bean, a princess living in medieval times, as she gets into trouble and goes on adventures with her friends Luci and Elfo.

scenarios.title: Dishonored
scenarios.description: Dishonored is a 2012 stealth action-adventure video game developed by Arkane Studios and published by Bethesda Softworks.
scenarios.setting: Set in the fictional, plague-ridden industrial city of Dunwall, Dishonored follows the story of Corvo Attano, bodyguard to the Empress of the Isles.

scenarios.title: Disney
scenarios.description: The Walt Disney Company, commonly known as Disney, is an American diversified multinational mass media corporation headquartered at the Walt Disney Studios in Burbank, California.
scenarios.setting: The Walt Disney Company, commonly known as Disney, is an American diversified multinational mass media corporation headquartered at the Walt Disney Studios in Burbank, California. Disney as the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio, and established itself as a leader in the American animation industry before diversifying into live-action film production, television, and theme parks. The company also operated under the names Walt Disney Studio and Walt Disney Productions.

scenarios.title: Disney's Dinosaur
scenarios.description: Dinosaur is a 2000 American live-action/animated adventure film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation in association with The Secret Lab, and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Dinosaur is a 2000 American live-action/animated adventure film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation in association with The Secret Lab, and released by Walt Disney Pictures. The film was directed by Ralph Zondag and Eric Leighton (in his feature directorial debut) and produced by Pam Marsden, from a screenplay written by John Harrison, Robert Nelson Jacobs, and Walon Green, and a story by the trio alongside Zondag and Thom Enriquez. B.

scenarios.title: Disney's Pinocchio
scenarios.description: Pinocchio is a 1940 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Productions and released by RKO Radio Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Pinocchio is a 1940 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Productions and released by RKO Radio Pictures. Based on Carlo Collodi's 1883 children's novel The Adventures of Pinocchio, it is the second Disney animated feature film, made after the first animated success Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937). The plot involves an old Italian woodcarver named Geppetto who carves a wooden puppet named Pinocchio and wishes that he might be a real boy.

scenarios.title: Disney's The Jungle Book
scenarios.description: Loosely based on Rudyard Kipling's 1894 novel of the same name, The Jungle Book is a Disney media franchise following a coming of age story of Mowgli, a young child abandoned in the forest, and raised by the wolves, as he leaves what he once knew as home to go
scenarios.setting: Loosely based on Rudyard Kipling's 1894 novel of the same name, The Jungle Book is a Disney media franchise following a coming of age story of Mowgli, a young child abandoned in the forest, and raised by the wolves, as he leaves what he once knew as home to go to the man-village, encountering many peculiar creatures along the way. The series consists of multiple films, books, TV shows and games, including the TV show Talespin.

scenarios.title: Disney's The Little Mermaid
scenarios.description: The Little Mermaid is a 1989 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Wright, Jason Marin, Kenneth Mars, and Buddy Hackett, The Little Mermaid tells the story of a teenage mermaid princess named Ariel, who dreams of becoming human and falls in love with a human prince named Eric, which leads her to make a magic deal with the sea witch, Ursula, to become human and be with him.

scenarios.title: Disney's The Sorcerer's Apprentice
scenarios.description: The Sorcerer's Apprentice is a 2010 American action adventure fantasy film produced by Jerry Bruckheimer, directed by Jon Turteltaub, and released by Walt Disney Pictures, the team behind the National Treasure franchise.
scenarios.setting: The Sorcerer's Apprentice is a 2010 American action adventure fantasy film produced by Jerry Bruckheimer, directed by Jon Turteltaub, and released by Walt Disney Pictures, the team behind the National Treasure franchise. The film stars Nicolas Cage and Jay Baruchel with Alfred Molina, Teresa Palmer, and Monica Bellucci in supporting roles.

scenarios.title: Disney's Theatrical Shorts
scenarios.description: This is a list of shorts and featurettes that have accompanied feature films in their theatrical releases.
scenarios.setting: This is a list of shorts and featurettes that have accompanied feature films in their theatrical releases.

scenarios.title: Dispatch
scenarios.description: Dispatch is an episodic adventure game developed by AdHoc Studio.
scenarios.setting: Dispatch is an episodic adventure game developed by AdHoc Studio.

scenarios.title: Disturbed
scenarios.description: Disturbed is an American heavy metal band from Chicago, formed in 1994.
scenarios.setting: Disturbed is an American heavy metal band from Chicago, formed in 1994. The band includes guitarist Dan Donegan, drummer Mike Wengren, lead vocalist David Draiman and bassist John Moyer. Donegan and Wengren have been involved in the band since its inception, with Draiman replacing original lead vocalist Erich Awalt in 1996 and Moyer replacing original bassist Steve "Fuzz" Kmak in 2004.

scenarios.title: Divinity
scenarios.description: A world full of magic and wonder, Divinity focuses on the individuals that shape the world they know.
scenarios.setting: Decisions are made at every turn, and the fate of the world lies within them.

scenarios.title: Doctor Nowhere
scenarios.description: Doctor Nowhere, real name Silas Orion, is a Horror Artist known for his Creatures that are posted on the Internet.
scenarios.setting: Doctor Nowhere, real name Silas Orion, is a Horror Artist known for his Creatures that are posted on the Internet. He gained notoriety first from TOE (now known as SMILEHOOD), primarily due to the creepy atmosphere of Locust bashing against the Glass Screen before rocketing into higher popularity with The Boiled One Phenomenon which made him more known to the public. Since then he has started SMILEHOOD to fully flesh out TOE and The Oddity Compendium as a way to feature his creatures.

scenarios.title: Doctor Who
scenarios.description: Doctor Who is a British Sci-Fi TV show about a time-traveling alien called The Doctor, fighting monsters with their companions using the TARDIS to travel.
scenarios.setting: Doctor Who is a British Sci-Fi TV show about a time-traveling alien called The Doctor, fighting monsters with their companions using the TARDIS to travel. It is the longest-running science fiction show in the world. The Doctor regenerates into a new form when he or she dies. So far, there have been 15 Doctors, 16 including the War Doctor. This verse can be called the "Doctor Who Universe" ("DWU" for short) or just the "Whoniverse".

scenarios.title: Dog Man
scenarios.description: Dog Man is a comedic graphic novel series written and illustrated by Dav Pilkey.
scenarios.setting: Dog Man is a comedic graphic novel series written and illustrated by Dav Pilkey. Cat Kid Comic Club is a Dog Man spin-off series that features Li'l Petey, Molly, Flippy and the other twenty-one baby frogs as the main characters. They make comics together.

scenarios.title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
scenarios.description: Doki Doki Literature Club! is a Visual Novel created by Team Salvato, led by Dan Salvato, one of the programmers of Project M.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in the eponymous literature club of the local high school.

scenarios.title: Dollars
scenarios.description: The Dollars Trilogy is an Italian film series consisting of three Spaghetti Western films directed by Sergio Leone.
scenarios.setting: All stories within the Dollars series are mostly self-contained, each book portraying a different situation.

scenarios.title: Don Quixote
scenarios.description: Don Quixote, the full title being The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha, is a Spanish novel by Miguel de Cervantes.
scenarios.setting: The novel has been labelled by many well-known authors as the "best novel of all time" and the "best and most central work in world literature". Don Quixote is also one of the most-translated books in the world and one of the best-selling novels of all time. In the first part of the book, Don Quixote does not see the world for what it is and prefers to imagine that he is living out a knightly story meant for the annals of all time.

scenarios.title: Don't Hug Me I'm Scared
scenarios.description: Don't Hug Me I'm Scared is a web series originating on youtube in 2011.
scenarios.setting: Don't Hug Me I'm Scared is a web series originating on youtube in 2011. The original series followed the three main characters going about their day until a random teacher would appear and teach them about subjects that were usually completely wrong or had a dark twist at the end of each lesson. The DHMIS TV show had a similar concept but the episodes were longer and had more time to flesh out the characters.

scenarios.title: Don't Rest Your Head
scenarios.description: Don't Rest Your Head is a Tabletop role-playing game created by Evil Hat Productions.
scenarios.setting: The protagonists are the Awake, insomniacs who discover doors to The Mad City. The Mad City is a twisted place where Nightmares stalk the streets, the impossible happens regularly, and the protagonists are always mere moments away from becoming Nightmares themselves, as they draw upon their madness to bend reality to their wills.

scenarios.title: Don't Starve
scenarios.description: Don't Starve is a third person survival game developed by Klei Entertainment and updated with various DLCs over the years.
scenarios.setting: Don't Starve : Shipwrecked is a DLC that focuses on island survival. There are stranded in an island of intelligent pigs who have built vast civilizations while grasping the concept of economy. Taking place after Charlie's rule, new and extremely powerful giants were brought into The Constant, alongside a variety of useful items.

scenarios.title: DOOM
scenarios.description: DOOM centers around the adventures of an unnamed marine (generally referred to as "Doomguy") who roams the planet Mars, killing demons as he goes.
scenarios.setting: (although it has seen a massive overhaul in newer installments within the franchise) Doomguy's motives often vary from game to game; for instance, his initial arrival on the demon-infested Mars was his punishment for disobeying a superior officer, while later on, his attempts to fight the forces of Hell stem from the death of his pet rabbit...

scenarios.title: DOORS
scenarios.description: DOORS is a multiplayer Roblox horror game inspired by Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion and nicorocks5555's Rooms co-developed by Lightning_Splash and RediblesQW.
scenarios.setting: It's based on traveling through rooms with various entities encountered along the way. The main purpose of the game is traveling through rooms containing entities trying to kill the players.

scenarios.title: Doraemon
scenarios.description: Doraemon (Japanese: ドラえもん) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by the manga writing team Fujiko Fujio.
scenarios.setting: The main manga and its anime adaptations include hundreds to thousands of daily life short stories about how Doraemon, a robot cat from the 22nd century, returns to the 20th century to help improve the life of his friend Nobita, the loser that would become the great-great-grandfather of Doraemon's friend in the 22nd century Sewashi. Doraemon often tries to help Nobita with his gadgets from the 22nd century, but they often get misused by Nobita himself, with hilarious results.

scenarios.title: Dorei Yuugi
scenarios.description: Dorei Yuugi is a manga which revolves around the main character Kai Ichihira one day receiving access to the app SLAVE GO! which allows him to capture people as slaves, this leads to his friend being kidnapped which then forces him to participate in various de
scenarios.setting: Dorei Yuugi is a manga which revolves around the main character Kai Ichihira one day receiving access to the app SLAVE GO! which allows him to capture people as slaves, this leads to his friend being kidnapped which then forces him to participate in various death games using his caught slaves.

scenarios.title: Dorohedoro
scenarios.description: Dorohedoro (ドロヘドロ) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Q Hayashida.
scenarios.setting: It tells the story of the amnesiac reptilian-headed Caiman working together with his friend Nikaido to recover his memories and survive in a strange and violent world.

scenarios.title: DotA 2
scenarios.description: Defense of the Ancients (DotA) was originally a multiplayer online battle arena mod for the video game Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and its expansion, Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, based on the "Aeon of Strife" map for StarCraft.
scenarios.setting: Over time, the verse began to expand as Valve and its community members contributed to its ever growing mass of storylines through the implementation of lore ranging from meager writings like hero biographies and item/spell descriptions to official works of art in the form of short comics and playable story campaigns and entire standalone games like Underlords and Artifact.

scenarios.title: DotHack
scenarios.description: The .hack// series consists of 2 parts, both of which take place inside an MMORPG called The World.
scenarios.setting: hack// series consists of 2 parts, both of which take place inside an MMORPG called The World. hack// tetralogy, which follows the story of Kite, who is granted the power of Data Drain by a mysterious being known as Aura and wages battle against the Eight Phases of Morganna. U.

scenarios.title: Dr. Seuss
scenarios.description: Dr. Seuss was born Theodor Geisel in Springfield, Massachusetts on March 2, 1904. After attending Dartmouth College and Oxford University, he began a career in advertising. His advertising cartoons, featuring Quick, Henry, the Flit! appeared in several leading
scenarios.setting: Note: Within versus threads, the original poster should specify which incarnation of the characters is being used.

scenarios.title: Dr. Slump
scenarios.description: Dr. Slump is a Japanese gag manga series written and illustrated by Akira Toriyama, the creator of Dragon Ball. The story revolves around Arale Norimaki who was created by Senbei Norimaki to be the perfect robot little girl. Their adventures and mischiefs span
scenarios.setting: Dr. Slump is a Japanese gag manga series written and illustrated by Akira Toriyama, the creator of Dragon Ball. The story revolves around Arale Norimaki who was created by Senbei Norimaki to be the perfect robot little girl. Their adventures and mischiefs spanned over two hundred chapters and got multiple anime adaptations.

scenarios.title: Dr. Stone
scenarios.description: After modern humanity was petrified for thousands of years, nature reclaimed the Earth, leaving humanity long lost and forgotten.
scenarios.setting: After modern humanity was petrified for thousands of years, nature reclaimed the Earth, leaving humanity long lost and forgotten. After awakening from his petrification on April 1st, 5738 AD, the main character Senku swore to recreate civilization and restore humanity using the power of science.

scenarios.title: Dracu-Riot!
scenarios.description: Dracu-Riot! is a visual novel developed by Yuzusoft.
scenarios.setting: The story begins with Mutsura Yuuto accompanying his friend on a holiday to Aqua Eden, an artificial island city where gambling and the sex industry are legal. As a vampire, he can no longer leave Aqua Eden; so with nowhere else to go, he decides to enroll in a special school for vampires on the island — and thus, his new night life begins!

scenarios.title: Dragalia Lost
scenarios.description: Dragalia Lost was a mobile action RPG that was developed by Cygames and published by Nintendo, first releasing on September 27, 2018, and shutting down on November 30, 2022.
scenarios.setting: After facing down and forging a bond with the dragon he had originally sought out for, Midgardsormr, and being led to a mysterious castle within the glen known as the Halidom, he encounters his father who is seemingly possessed by an otherworldly, demonic force, and after a harsh clash, ends up stealing away with Zethia.

scenarios.title: Drakengard
scenarios.description: Drakengard, known in Japan as Drag-On Dragoon, is a series of action role-playing video games created by Yoko Taro.
scenarios.setting: A spin-off series titled Nier, taking place in an alternative timeline set after a different ending to the first Drakengard than the one 2005's Drakengard 2 followed, was started in 2010 with the eponymous game.

scenarios.title: Drawn to Life
scenarios.description: Drawn to Life is a puzzle-platform video game franchise developed by 5th Cell in which the player assumes the role of The Creator, a being capable of bringing drawings to life.
scenarios.setting: The main protagonist, known as The Hero, is designed by the player and used to assist the Raposa, a species of anthropomorphic creatures, in restoring their world after it is threatened by shadowy forces. The narrative explores themes of imagination, creation, memory, and existential identity, particularly in later installments which introduce metafictional concepts regarding the relationship between player and fictional world.

scenarios.title: Dreamworks
scenarios.description: DreamWorks is an animation company and one of the primary competitors of Disney, though now their films are distributed by Universal Pictures.
scenarios.setting: DreamWorks is an animation company and one of the primary competitors of Disney, though now their films are distributed by Universal Pictures. DreamWorks is known for creating the likes of Shrek, How To Train Your Dragon, Kung Fu Panda, Madagascar, Monsters vs. Aliens and many other movies/films. However, much like Disney, it's unlikely that DreamWorks shares a solid continuity.

scenarios.title: Dross
scenarios.description: The verse is based on the videogame saga Dross Adventure, which focuses on Angel David Revilla a Venezuelan monster hunter, known as Dross Rotzank, and his team composed of Seraz Victoria, Fripozo, and Termi.
scenarios.setting: Note: Within versus threads, the original poster should specify which incarnation of the characters is being used.

scenarios.title: DSP Verse
scenarios.description: DSP Verse refers to a collection of games, manga and other media from the creator known as Deep Sea Prisoner.
scenarios.setting: DSP Verse refers to a collection of games, manga and other media from the creator known as Deep Sea Prisoner. It includes various characters and stories set across different worlds, but existing as part of the same multiverse. Games developed by Deep Sea Prisoner include Mogeko Castle, The Gray Garden, Wadanohara and the Great Blue Sea with future works like Carnival Rhythm in the plans.

scenarios.title: Dual Hearts
scenarios.description: Dual Hearts is an action-adventure platforming game, released in 2002 for the Playstation 2.
scenarios.setting: Dual Hearts is an action-adventure platforming game, released in 2002 for the Playstation 2. The story is centered around a treasure hunter named Ruin, who travels to the island known as Sonno Island to find the Temple of Dreams and acquire the Dream Stone. However, the keys to the temple are accidentally scattered across the island and entered the dreams of it's inhabitants. Ruin, with the help of a Baku named Tumble, enter various dreams in order to collect all the keys and get the Dream Stone.

scenarios.title: DuckTales
scenarios.description: DuckTales is an American animated television series, produced by Walt Disney Television Animation and distributed by Buena Vista Television.
scenarios.setting: Based upon Uncle Scrooge and other Duck universe comic books created by Carl Barks, the show follows Scrooge McDuck, his three grandnephews Huey, Dewey, and Louie, and close friends of the group, on various adventures, most of which either involve seeking out treasure or thwarting the efforts of villains seeking to steal Scrooge's fortune or his Number One Dime.

scenarios.title: Duel Savior
scenarios.description: Duel Savior is a visual novel developed by Giga and Team Baldrhead.
scenarios.setting: Duel Savior is a visual novel developed by Giga and Team Baldrhead. There is a prophecy that every 1000 years, when the destruction draws near, the Messiah will come from a different world to the root world of Avatar and save them all. Mia Touma, while returning home from school, finds an old but highly decorated book. When she shows it to her brother, Taiga, the book teleports them to the world of Avatar. When they awaken, they find themselves in a world resembling Medieval Europe.

scenarios.title: Dunsanyverse
scenarios.description: The Dunsanyverse refers to the works of Anglo-Irish writer and dramatist, Edward John Moreton Drax Plunkett, the 18th Baron of Dunsany, who published under the title of Lord Dunsany.
scenarios.setting: His works consist of numerous short stories, novels, plays, and essays, which account to nearly ninety books published within his lifetime, involving a series of artificial mythology. Within his works, an entity called Mana-Yood-Sushai and is sustains all of his creations by his dreaming, which include all of the gods and worlds.

scenarios.title: Durarara!!
scenarios.description: Durarara!! or DRRR!! (デュラララ!!) is a light novel series written by Narita Ryohgo, also well-known for his Baccano! series, which takes place in the same world.
scenarios.setting: Durarara!! or DRRR!! ) is a light novel series written by Narita Ryohgo, also well-known for his Baccano!

scenarios.title: Dying Light
scenarios.description: Dying Light is a several horror videos game developed by Techland and published by Warner Bros.
scenarios.setting: The player takes control of a man named Kyle Crane, an undercover agent for the Global Relief Effort (GRE) that is sent into the infected city of Harran on a secret mission. Throughout the story, the player must survive against various types of infected and other hostile survivors.

scenarios.title: E.A.r.T.h
scenarios.description: is a manga series by Yuu Kamiya, the same author who wrote No Game No Life.
scenarios.setting: The story introduces a world where beings known as Earths or Faeries, have existed long before humans were around.

scenarios.title: Earth-One (DC Comics)
scenarios.description: Earth-One was the designation for an Earth, and the universe it inhabited, that existed prior to the Crisis on Infinite Earths, and where a majority of the Silver Age stories in DC took place.
scenarios.setting: Earth-One was the designation for an Earth, and the universe it inhabited, that existed prior to the Crisis on Infinite Earths, and where a majority of the Silver Age stories in DC took place.

scenarios.title: EarthBound
scenarios.description: The "Mother" series (known as "Earthbound" in America) is a triology turn based RPG that takes place in separate towns with separate characters.
scenarios.setting: The "Mother" series (known as "Earthbound" in America) is a triology turn based RPG that takes place in separate towns with separate characters.

scenarios.title: Ecco The Dolphin
scenarios.description: Ecco the Dolphin is the collective name given to a series of action-adventure science fiction video games developed by Novotrade International (known nowadays as Appaloosa Interactive) published by Sega, which primarily take place underwater.
scenarios.setting: Ecco the Dolphin is the collective name given to a series of action-adventure science fiction video games developed by Novotrade International (known nowadays as Appaloosa Interactive) published by Sega, which primarily take place underwater. They were originally developed for the Sega Mega Drive and Sega Dreamcast video game consoles, but have since been ported to numerous systems. The games are named after their main character, Ecco, a young Bottlenose Dolphin. They are known for their high difficulty level.

scenarios.title: Ed, Edd and Eddy
scenarios.description: Ed, Edd and Eddy is a Canadian-American animated comedy television series created by Danny Antonucci.
scenarios.setting: Ed, Edd and Eddy is a Canadian-American animated comedy television series created by Danny Antonucci. It premiered on Cartoon Network on January 4, 1999. The series was designed to resemble classic cartoons from 1940's to 1970's, revolving around three adolescent preteen boys, Ed, Edd "Double Dee" and Eddy, collectively known as "the Eds", who live in a suburban cul-de-sac.

scenarios.title: Eddsworld
scenarios.description: Eddsworld is an animated web-series created in 2003 by Edward Duncan Ernest "Edd" Gould.
scenarios.setting: Eddsworld is an animated web-series created in 2003 by Edward Duncan Ernest "Edd" Gould. It's about the brave adventures of Edd and his troubling group of friends as they tackle zombies, demons, clones and everyday life.

scenarios.title: Edens Zero
scenarios.description: Edens Zero is a Japanese science fiction manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.
scenarios.setting: Edens Zero is a Japanese science fiction manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.

scenarios.title: Ejen Ali
scenarios.description: Ejen Ali is a Malaysian animated series produced by WAU Animation, focusing on the titular boy who accidentally became an agent after using Infinity Retinal Intelligent System (I.R.I.S), a device prototype created by the Meta Advance Tactical Agency (M.A.T.A).
scenarios.setting: A). S is controlled by neuro-signals enabling the wearer to perform actions programmed by the computer. A missions.

scenarios.title: Elden Ring
scenarios.description: Elden Ring is a 2022 action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Elden Ring is a 2022 action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It was directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki and made in collaboration with the fantasy novelist George R. R. Martin, who provided material for the setting. It was released for Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on February 25.

scenarios.title: Electronic Arts
scenarios.description: Electronic Arts (abbreviated as EA) is a public American video game company that creates games of many genres, most famously for sports games such as FIFA.
scenarios.setting: Electronic Arts (abbreviated as EA) is a public American video game company that creates games of many genres, most famously for sports games such as FIFA. It was founded by Trip Hawkins, a former Apple employee, in May of 1982, and is still ongoing in its operations to this day. In the modern day gaming market EA mainly prioritises in creating games for already established video game franchises, and a multitude of EA Sports titles.

scenarios.title: Elfen Lied
scenarios.description: Elfen Lied is a manga written and illustrated by Lynn Okamoto, beginning in 2002 and ending in 2005.
scenarios.setting: Abandoned as a child and subject to abuse throughout her life, Lucy would grow from an innocent young girl to a remorseless killer, fighting against the Diclonius Research Institute and their attempts to capture her.

scenarios.title: Elsewhere
scenarios.description: Amelia Earhart jumps into a portal and goes missing into a land named Korvath, where she, alongside some of the land’s natives and fellow missing person D.
scenarios.setting: Amelia Earhart jumps into a portal and goes missing into a land named Korvath, where she, alongside some of the land’s natives and fellow missing person D. B. Cooper, escape from Lord Kragen and try to help her find her way back home.

scenarios.title: Emperor's Domination
scenarios.description: Emperor's Domination is a Chinese Xuanhuan web novel written by Yanbi Xiaosheng (厌笔萧生).
scenarios.setting: Emperor's Domination is a Chinese Xuanhuan web novel written by Yanbi Xiaosheng (厌笔萧生). It tells the story of Li Qiye, a 13-year-old boy who was turned into a Dark Crow back in the Desolate Era and spent millions of years exploring the Nine Worlds, learning techniques and becoming the teacher of several Immortal Emperors, the rulers of the Nine Worlds.

scenarios.title: Encanto
scenarios.description: Encanto is a 2021 American computer-animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Encanto is a 2021 American computer-animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures.

scenarios.title: Enchanted Portals
scenarios.description: Enchanted Portals is a platform video game developed and published by Xixo Games Studio.
scenarios.setting: Enchanted Portals is a platform video game developed and published by Xixo Games Studio.

scenarios.title: Encounters (Roblox)
scenarios.description: Encounters is a fighting themed ROBLOX game owned by Jack Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Encounters is a fighting themed ROBLOX game owned by Jack Entertainment. It was released on September 17, 2021. (April 6, 2021 in the old version) The objective of the game is to get as many K'Os as possible and win the battle. Earn currency by leveling up or claim rewards. Use the currency for champions and skins.

scenarios.title: Engage Kiss
scenarios.description: Engage Kiss (エンゲージ・キス, Engēji Kisu) is an original anime produced by A-1 Pictures and written by Fumiaki Maruto with character designs by Tsunako titled Engage Kiss will premiere in 3, July 2022.
scenarios.setting: Engage Kiss (エンゲージ・キス, Engēji Kisu) is an original anime produced by A-1 Pictures and written by Fumiaki Maruto with character designs by Tsunako titled Engage Kiss will premiere in 3, July 2022. The anime is set in Baylong City, an artificial island city established in the Pacific Ocean to exploit local natural resources. The anime centers on three characters. The first is Shū, who runs a small company, though his spending habits have left him constantly penniless.

scenarios.title: Enter the Gungeon
scenarios.description: Enter the Gungeon is a rogue-like bullet hell title published by Devolver Digital and developed by Dodge Roll.
scenarios.setting: Enter the Gungeon is a rogue-like bullet hell title published by Devolver Digital and developed by Dodge Roll. The game centers around the Gungeon, a legendary gauntlet of gun-based enemies that contains the Gun That Can Kill The Past, offering any who find it a new lease on life. However, no matter what happens, the Gungeon remains.

scenarios.title: Epic Conquest
scenarios.description: Epic Conquest is a top-down Hack n' Slash RPG set in a single player world with multiple playable characters.
scenarios.setting: Epic Conquest is a top-down Hack n' Slash RPG set in a single player world with multiple playable characters. Set in a Medieval world torn apart by war that tore humankind apart only for a rift in the sky to unleash demons onto Earth, forcing all of humanity to unite on one continent to oppose them.

scenarios.title: Epic Literature
scenarios.description: Epic Literature refers to (or is the study of) the written works created by people across the world to explain nature, history, and customs, and an important part of each culture.
scenarios.setting: Epic Literature refers to (or is the study of) the written works created by people across the world to explain nature, history, and customs, and an important part of each culture.

scenarios.title: Epic Seven
scenarios.description: Epic Seven is a mobile turn-based RPG from Smilegate.
scenarios.setting: Begin a journey with powerful Heroes and prevent the destruction of the 7th World.

scenarios.title: Epithet Erased
scenarios.description: Epithet Erased is an ensemble comedy/adventure cartoon series created in partnership between VRV and Brendan Blaber.
scenarios.setting: Epithet Erased is an ensemble comedy/adventure cartoon series created in partnership between VRV and Brendan Blaber. A loose adaptation of Brendan's Roll20 Tabletop RPG campaign Anime Campaign, it's produced in a Limited Animation style similar to Brendan's aforementioned webseries—excluding a few fully-animated sequences such as the opening, which are produced by Powerhouse Animation Studios—with numerous RPG elements stylistically sprinkled in.

scenarios.title: Epoch of Twilight
scenarios.description: Epoch of Twilight (纪元黎明) is a science fiction Chinese novels written and done by Humans Shouldn't Play Humans (人勿玩人).
scenarios.setting: Law of the jungle and survival of the fittest are the new rules of the World.

scenarios.title: Ergenverse
scenarios.description: ErGenverse is a series of Chinese Xianxia novels written by Liu Yong, known by his pen name Er Gen.
scenarios.setting: ErGenverse is a series of Chinese Xianxia novels written by Liu Yong, known by his pen name Er Gen. There are a total of six novels written by him: Renegade Immortal, Pursuit of the Truth, I Shall Seal the Heavens, A Will Eternal, A World Worth Protecting, and Beyond the Timescape. The first five are finished, while the last one is ongoing.

scenarios.title: Erma
scenarios.description: Erma is a popular fantasy-dark comedy slice of life franchise that originated as a webtoon created by .
scenarios.setting: Set in the suburban town of Blairwood, Erma's journey is marked by her interactions with various characters and the challenges she faces as a half-human hybrid.

scenarios.title: Eryi's Action
scenarios.description: Eryi's Action is a platform game developed by XTAL SWORD released in June 6, 2011.
scenarios.setting: Eryi's Action is a platform game developed by XTAL SWORD released in June 6, 2011.

scenarios.title: Etrian Odyssey
scenarios.description: Etrian Odyssey is a game series made by developer ATLUS.
scenarios.setting: Etrian Odyssey is a game series made by developer ATLUS. It is an exploration type dungeon crawler style game that requires the player to draw their own map as they progress. Many people consider it a very difficult game.

scenarios.title: Everyone Else Is A Returnee
scenarios.description: Everyone Else Is A Returnee is a series by Toika about a single loner and his journey to Godhood.
scenarios.setting: Everyone Else Is A Returnee is a series by Toika about a single loner and his journey to Godhood. Earth will change. Mana will be introduced and the world will evolve. In order to provide humanity a chance, heaven implements a plan to have humanity level up and get accustomed to mana on other more evolved worlds. Yu Ilhan, the main character, was left out while every other human on Earth was transported to other worlds...

scenarios.title: Evolution (2001 Movie)
scenarios.description: The film Evolution was released in 2001.
scenarios.setting: The film Evolution was released in 2001. It is a science fiction comedy directed by Ivan Reitman. The film stars David Duchovny, Orlando Jones, Seann William Scott, and Julianne Moore. The plot revolves around the discovery of extraterrestrial life that evolves at an incredibly rapid pace. A meteor crashes on Earth, bringing with it microscopic alien organisms.

scenarios.title: Existence
scenarios.description: Existence (존재 Jonjae)  a manhwa created in 2022 by Gwang-Jin (Story) and Kim Kyungjun (Artist).
scenarios.setting: Existence (존재 Jonjae) a manhwa created in 2022 by Gwang-Jin (Story) and Kim Kyungjun (Artist). Manhwa Existence is a story about Lee Ja-in, a human who has the power of every creature he has ever reincarnated as. He has lived tens of thousands of reincarnations and lives as various kinds of animals and plants. He was born with the purpose of eradicating mankind, because he saw that humans were creatures that destroyed nature and created suffering for other beings.

scenarios.title: Exmortis
scenarios.description: Taking inspiration from verses such as Hellraiser and The Evil Dead, Exmortis is a point-and-click indie horror series developed by Ben Leffler in the early 2000s.
scenarios.setting: Taking inspiration from verses such as Hellraiser and The Evil Dead, Exmortis is a point-and-click indie horror series developed by Ben Leffler in the early 2000s.

scenarios.title: F.A.S.T.
scenarios.description: F.A.S.T. (СОБЕЗ, SOBEZ) is an 11-minute Russian animated action series created by Parovoz Animation Studio.
scenarios.setting: T. (СОБЕЗ, SOBEZ) is an 11-minute Russian animated action series created by Parovoz Animation Studio. For many years there has been a struggle between two clans led by supervillains — Hegemon the Rhino and Darwin the Atomic Monkey. Hungry for power, they have made the world a battlefield, and they would probably have destroyed it long ago...

scenarios.title: Fable
scenarios.description: The Fable series takes place in the fictional nation of Albion, a state that, at the time of the first game, is composed of numerous autonomous city-states with vast areas of countryside or wilderness in between.
scenarios.setting: The Fable series takes place in the fictional nation of Albion, a state that, at the time of the first game, is composed of numerous autonomous city-states with vast areas of countryside or wilderness in between. The setting originally resembles Medieval England ("Albion" being the oldest name for the island of Great Britain), or traditional fantasy settings like that of The Lord of the Rings.

scenarios.title: Face/Off
scenarios.description: Face/Off is a 1997 American science fiction action thriller film directed by John Woo, written by Mike Werb and Michael Colleary, and starring John Travolta and Nicolas Cage.
scenarios.setting: The film earned $245 million worldwide, making it the 11th highest-grossing film of 1997, and was nominated for an Academy Award for Sound Effects Editing (Mark Stoeckinger and Per Hallberg) at the 70th Academy Awards.

scenarios.title: Fairy Gone
scenarios.description: In the aftermath of the War of Unification, all the nations of the continent of Eastald are forcefully united under a single ruler.
scenarios.setting: In the aftermath of the War of Unification, all the nations of the continent of Eastald are forcefully united under a single ruler. During the war, special soldiers were implanted with Fairy organs, allowing them to summon powerful Fairies to fight under their command. These soldiers were dubbed Fairy Soldiers and used by all sides. However, nine years after the end of the war, conflict still remains as rogue Fairy Soldiers and criminals take advantage of the postwar instability.

scenarios.title: Fairy Tail
scenarios.description: Fairy Tail is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.
scenarios.setting: Fairy Tail is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.

scenarios.title: Faith
scenarios.description: Faith is a horror game developed by Airdorf Games and published by New Blood Interactive.
scenarios.setting: Faith is a horror game developed by Airdorf Games and published by New Blood Interactive. A lone priest who goes by the name of John Ward comes to an old house to correct old mistakes and repent for his sins, and finally save a soul he had given up on. However, things are not as it seems, and his mind slips as he dwells into things man was not meant to discover.

scenarios.title: Fallen London
scenarios.description: Fallen London is a text adventure game made in 2010 by Failbetter Games, with two spin-off games: Sunless Sea, released in February of 2015, and Sunless Skies, released in January of 2019, and with a significant amount of supplementary material released for th
scenarios.setting: Fallen London is a text adventure game made in 2010 by Failbetter Games, with two spin-off games: Sunless Sea, released in February of 2015, and Sunless Skies, released in January of 2019, and with a significant amount of supplementary material released for the universe in the form of forum posts, RPGs, comics and other such releases. The year is 1861. Prince Albert, the Consort of Queen Victoria, has died of typhoid fever.

scenarios.title: Fallout
scenarios.description: Fallout is a series of post-apocalyptic role-playing video games created by Interplay Entertainment, but bought by Bethesda Studios/ZeniMax.
scenarios.setting: Fallout is a series of post-apocalyptic role-playing video games created by Interplay Entertainment, but bought by Bethesda Studios/ZeniMax. Although the series is set during the 22nd and 23rd centuries, its atom punk retro-futuristic setting and artwork are influenced by the post-war culture of 1950s America, and its combination of hope for the promises of technology, as well as the lurking fear of nuclear annihilation.

scenarios.title: Family Guy
scenarios.description: Family Guy is an animated comedy series created by Seth MacFarlane.
scenarios.setting: The series revolves around the Griffin family, as they each go on misadventures throughout episodes.

scenarios.title: Fangs
scenarios.description: Fangs is a slice-of-life romance webcomic by Sarah Andersen, published throughout 2020, and follows the love story between a vampire and a werewolf, focusing on the various little moments in their relationship together.
scenarios.setting: Fangs is a slice-of-life romance webcomic by Sarah Andersen, published throughout 2020, and follows the love story between a vampire and a werewolf, focusing on the various little moments in their relationship together.

scenarios.title: FANT4STIC
scenarios.description: Fantastic Four, or better known in its stylized name as FANT4STIC, is a 2015 superhero film directed by Josh Trank, who co-wrote the screenplay alongside Jeremy Slater and Simon Kinberg.
scenarios.setting: Fantastic Four, or better known in its stylized name as FANT4STIC, is a 2015 superhero film directed by Josh Trank, who co-wrote the screenplay alongside Jeremy Slater and Simon Kinberg. The film is based on the Marvel Comics team of the same name, covering a somewhat darker take on the origins of Reed Richards, Susan Storm, Johnny Storm, and Ben Grimm's careers as superheroes.

scenarios.title: Fantasia
scenarios.description: Fantasia is a 1940 American animated film, produced by Walt Disney Productions and given a wide release by RKO Radio Pictures.
scenarios.setting: In part, this was due to World War II cutting off the profitable European market, but due as well to the film's high production costs and the expense of leasing theaters and installing the Fantasound equipment for the roadshow presentations.

scenarios.title: Fantastic Giants
scenarios.description: Charlton Comics was an American comic book publishing company that existed from 1945 to 1986, having begun under a different name (T.W.O.
scenarios.setting: O. Charles Company) in 1940. Charlton produced comics based on monsters featured in motion pictures such as Konga, Gorgo and Reptilicus.

scenarios.title: Far Cry
scenarios.description: Far Cry is an open world first-person shooter series created by Ubisoft.
scenarios.setting: Far Cry is an open world first-person shooter series created by Ubisoft. Each game is set in a different location, often a fictional country based off a real world location (African Sahara, Pacific Islands, Himalayan mountains) and features a protagonist getting caught up in the local turmoil.

scenarios.title: Fast & Furious
scenarios.description: Fast and Furious is a franchise that spans across multiple forms of media, the primary of which is a series of films that started in 2001.
scenarios.setting: Fast and Furious is a franchise that spans across multiple forms of media, the primary of which is a series of films that started in 2001. The series would eventually become big enough to spawn spin-offs starring characters from within the main series, and a cartoon series with wholly original characters. It is currently Universal Studios' highest grossing film franchise.

scenarios.title: Fatal Fury/Art of Fighting
scenarios.description: The Fatal Fury or Garō Densetsu (餓狼伝説 Legend of the Hungry Wolf) series started in 1991, produced by SNK and designed by Takashi Nishiyama, the creator of the original Street Fighter, and received many sequels across the years.
scenarios.setting: - Fatal Fury= The Fatal Fury or Garō Densetsu (餓狼伝説 Legend of the Hungry Wolf) series started in 1991, produced by SNK and designed by Takashi Nishiyama, the creator of the original Street Fighter, and received many sequels across the years. The first game, and the franchise as a whole, represent an actual milestone for the genre of 2D fighting games, having been among the most popular and praised series of its time.

scenarios.title: Fatal Twelve
scenarios.description: Fatal Twelve is a Ren'Py-based Visual Novel released by aiueoKompany in late March 2018.
scenarios.setting: Fatal Twelve is a Ren'Py-based Visual Novel released by aiueoKompany in late March 2018. Rinka Shishimai was a highschooler who ran a small café named Lion House in place of her grandmother. She lived her life much like any other person her age, but one day, she was caught up in an explosion while returning home on the train alongside her friend, Naomi Hitsuji. In an attempt to save her friend's life, she shields her on instinct the moment the explosion goes off, losing her life in the process.

scenarios.title: Fate/Apocrypha

The reason for this unexpected appearance is that Kang Han Soo's personality score has been graded as “F” due to his removal of all the obstacles that prevented him from killing the demon king.

scenarios.setting: Fire Emblem is a turn-based tactical RPG developed by Intelligent Systems, and published by Nintendo. The games typically take place a medieval fantasy setting, featuring different characters and worlds, but all existing within the same multiverse.

scenarios.setting: Fist of the North Star is a anime/manga series by Buronson and Tetsuo Hara which takes place basically in a post-apocalyptic world starring the martial artist Kenshiro who uses the deadly Hokuto Shinken fighting style which deals with handling opponents via pressure points and battles other strong martial artist. However, staying true to its roots, it does feature some darker and more sinister secrets beneath the surface. It drew much inspiration from world folklore, notably the works of William Shakespeare, legends of King Arthur, and Norse mythology.

scenarios.title: GARO

scenarios.title: Genshin Impact
scenarios.description: Genshin Impact is a free-to-play open-world, action role-playing game developed and published by miHoYo for PC, iOS/Android, and PS4 platforms.
scenarios.setting: The game features an open-world fantasy setting, an action-based combat system utilizing elemental magic, character switching, and a gacha monetization system that allows players to acquire new characters, weapons, and other resources. The story follows Aether and Lumine, twin travelers from different dimensions, as they become separated and stranded in the world of Teyvat after being defeated and stripped of their powers by an Unknown God.

scenarios.title: GetBackers
scenarios.description: The story is about the GetBackers, a duo of 2 best friends whose jobs are to retrieve what has been stolen.
scenarios.setting: The story is about the GetBackers, a duo of 2 best friends whose jobs are to retrieve what has been stolen. The story follows Ginji Amano and Ban Midou who are the 3rd generation of the Get Backers as they take on different requests. To continue the name of the GetBackers, "The retrievers with almost 100% success rate", they more often than not have to face against tough opponents.

scenarios.title: Getting Up
scenarios.description: Trane, a "toy" graffiti artist with the street smarts, athletic prowess, and vision to become an "All City King" - the most reputable of all graffiti artists.
scenarios.setting: Trane, a "toy" graffiti artist with the street smarts, athletic prowess, and vision to become an "All City King" - the most reputable of all graffiti artists. Along your quest, uncover the mayor's deep, dark secret and use your fighting talents and high-wire graffiti to expose the city's leader as a corrupt tyrant. As you struggle to save a neighborhood from an oppressive government, one question stands out: What if graffiti could change the world?

scenarios.title: Ghost (1990 film)
scenarios.description: Ghost is a 1990 American romantic fantasy film directed by Jerry Zucker from a screenplay by Bruce Joel Rubin, and starring Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg, Tony Goldwyn, Vincent Schiavelli, and Rick Aviles.
scenarios.setting: The plot centers on Sam Wheat (Swayze), a murdered banker, whose ghost sets out to save his girlfriend, Molly Jensen (Moore), from the person who killed him – through the help of the psychic Oda Mae Brown (Goldberg). Ghost earned five nominations at the 63rd Academy Awards: Best Picture, Best Original Score, Best Film Editing, and winning Best Supporting Actress for Goldberg and Best Original Screenplay for Rubin.

scenarios.title: Ghost B.C.
scenarios.description: Ghost, also formerly known as Ghost B.C.
scenarios.setting: The lore for Ghost follows the schemes of an organisation called The Clergy/The Ministry, who have created The Ghost Project as a means to spread their message and influence to churches, governments, and generally powerful individuals through the rock music industry, so that they can take over the world.

scenarios.title: Ghost Stories
scenarios.description: Ghost Stories (Japanese: 学校の怪談, Hepburn: Gakkō no Kaidan, lit.
scenarios.setting: Ghost Stories (Japanese: 学校の怪談, Hepburn: Gakkō no Kaidan, lit. "School Ghost Stories"), also known as Ghosts at School, is a Japanese series of children's novels written by Tōru Tsunemitsu [ja]. It was published by Kodansha, starting in 1990. The series is a collection of popular school ghost stories in Japan, rewritten specifically for a young demographic. A four-part film series based on the books was produced from 1995 to 1999.

scenarios.title: Ghost Trick
scenarios.description: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective is a puzzle adventure video game developed and published by Capcom, originally released for the Nintendo DS in June 19th, 2010.
scenarios.setting: He travels across the city in a quest to find them with the titular "ghost tricks," which allow him to possess and manipulate objects. He is also capable of travelling through time to four minutes before someone's death, which he uses many times to save characters' lives.

scenarios.title: Ghostbusters (Movie Series)
scenarios.description: Ghostbusters is a supernatural comedy franchise created in 1984.
scenarios.setting: It centers on a group of eccentric New York City scientists who investigate and capture ghosts for a living.

scenarios.title: Ghosts 'n Goblins
scenarios.description: Ghosts 'n Goblins is a run and gun platformer video game series created by Tokuro Fujiwara and developed by Capcom.
scenarios.setting: Ghosts 'n Goblins is a run and gun platformer video game series created by Tokuro Fujiwara and developed by Capcom. The first entry in the series was Ghosts 'n Goblins, released as an arcade title on September 19, 1985. The series has subsequently been released on and ported to a variety of game consoles and mobile platforms and spawned several sequels and spin-offs.

scenarios.title: GigaBash
scenarios.description: GigaBash is a kaiju fighting game developed and independently published by Malaysian studio Passion Republic Games.
scenarios.setting: GigaBash is a kaiju fighting game developed and independently published by Malaysian studio Passion Republic Games. It released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on August 5, 2022, with the game later releasing for the Nintendo Switch and Xbox consoles on August 3, 2023. The base roster is comprised of original characters.

scenarios.title: Ginger Snaps Trilogy
scenarios.description: Ginger Snaps is a 2000 Canadian supernatural horror film directed by John Fawcett and written by Karen Walton, from a story they jointly developed.
scenarios.setting: Ginger Snaps is a 2000 Canadian supernatural horror film directed by John Fawcett and written by Karen Walton, from a story they jointly developed. The film stars Emily Perkins and Katharine Isabelle as Brigitte and Ginger Fitzgerald, two morbid teenage sisters whose relationship is tested when Ginger (who has started her period for the first time) is attacked and bitten by a unknown animal, and then later, during the next full moon, slowly starts to transform into a lycanthrope (werewolf).

scenarios.title: Gintama
scenarios.description: Twenty years ago, Edo-period Japan suffered a great cultural shock—the aliens called Amanto invaded the Earth, overpowered the nation's government, and outlawed the carrying of swords by the once proud samurai.
scenarios.setting: Twenty years ago, Edo-period Japan suffered a great cultural shock—the aliens called Amanto invaded the Earth, overpowered the nation's government, and outlawed the carrying of swords by the once proud samurai. Moreover, the aliens took the people's jobs and are currently running Japan as a sweatshop using the natives as laborers.

scenarios.title: Gladiator
scenarios.description: Gladiator is a 2000 epic historical drama film directed by Ridley Scott and written by David Franzoni, John Logan, and William Nicholson.
scenarios.setting: Gladiator is a 2000 epic historical drama film directed by Ridley Scott and written by David Franzoni, John Logan, and William Nicholson. The film was co-produced and released by DreamWorks Pictures and Universal Pictures. It stars Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Ralf Möller, Oliver Reed (in his final role), Djimon Hounsou, Derek Jacobi, John Shrapnel, and Richard Harris.

scenarios.title: Gloryhammer
scenarios.description: Gloryhammer is an Anglo-Swiss Symphonic Power Metal band founded by musician Christopher Bowes, lead vocalist and keyboardist of the Scottish pirate-themed Heavy Metal band Alestorm.
scenarios.setting: Gloryhammer tells the story of the mighty and magical Kingdom of Fife, a fantasy-version of Scotland that is the seat to the greatest empire on Earth and eventually the whole Galaxy, and the eternal battle between Prince Angus McFife and his lineage, and the dark sorcerer Zargothrax (played by Bowes himself).

Throughout the first few days the characters struggle with normal problems like getting a functioning society but as the series goes on more and more supernatural events occur.

scenarios.setting: Starring Shane Jensen, Arielle Friedman, Larry Fessenden, and Leonberg's real-life dog Indy in the title role, the film takes place in a haunted house and told from the perspective of a dog.

scenarios.setting: Gorebox is a chaotic , physics-driven sandbox game where creativity meets unrestrained destruction. Unleash your wildest ideas in a environment that puts ultimate power in your hands.

scenarios.title: Gorgo

scenarios.setting: Gorgo is a 1961 science fiction monster film directed by Eugène Lourié. Shot in Technicolor, the film is an international co-production of the United Kingdom, the United States, and Ireland. The film is about Gorgo, a sea monster captured and taken to London for exploitation, and its even larger mother, which rampages across London in search of it.

scenarios.title: Gorillaz

scenarios.setting: Gorillaz are a British virtual band created in 1998 by Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett. The project includes an extensive fictional verse, surrouding the band itself, consisting of 4 virtual members. Their fictional verse is demonstrated on the site and musical clips of the band, as well as in several other media, such as short cartoons. In addition, was written the Rise of the ogre book, which includes biography of the characters and some people working over Gorillaz.

scenarios.description: Gorn, often stylized as GORN, is a 2017 virtual reality, indie, hack n' slash game developed by Free Lives, but published by Devolver Digital on PS4, PS5, Microsoft Windows and the Meta Quest.
scenarios.setting: Gorn, often stylized as GORN, is a 2017 virtual reality, indie, hack n' slash game developed by Free Lives, but published by Devolver Digital on PS4, PS5, Microsoft Windows and the Meta Quest. As a gladiator among many, your main objective is to kill your opponents in any way you see fit. However, tougher challengers called Champions will follow your blood-ridden path. If the player defeats every single one, they must take on the leader of GORN himself, Alimta, a disgusting and demanding emperor.

scenarios.title: Gotham (TV Series)
scenarios.description: Gotham is an American fantasy/action/crime/drama television series created for the Fox network by Bruno Heller.
scenarios.setting: Gotham is an American fantasy/action/crime/drama television series created for the Fox network by Bruno Heller. It is based on a number of characters from the DC Comics universe, specifically those related to the Batman mythology. The main focus of the series is the back stories of Jim Gordon and Bruce Wayne, both created by Bob Kane and Bill Finger, as well as those of several other well known Batman-related characters including the Penguin, the Riddler, and a young Catwoman.

scenarios.title: Grand Theft Auto
scenarios.description: Grand Theft Auto is an open world videogame franchise, it has become one of the most popular game franchises of all time, spawning 5 main games, various spin-offs and DLC, currently the GTA games are divided into 3 universes: the 2D Universe (All 2D classic GTA games like GTA 1, 2 & London 1961/1969), the 3D Universe (All 3D games from the 6th Generation of consoles like GTA III, Vice City, San Andreas and the handheld games for the PSP and Gameboy) and lastly the HD Universe (All 3D games for the 7th and 8th Generation of consoles like GTA IV and his expansions, V, Online and Chinatown wars).

scenarios.setting: A PC port was relased via the Steam platform on november 20th, 2018. They will come across her third big pet, the Crow kept in a secret room connected to the Meat Room and the Cellar Swamp.

scenarios.title: Grappler Baki
scenarios.description: Grappler Baki is a series and franchise revolving around its titular protagonist, Baki Hanma, and his eternal goal and struggle to become the very strongest of the world over a total of four installments.
scenarios.setting: Grappler Baki is a series and franchise revolving around its titular protagonist, Baki Hanma, and his eternal goal and struggle to become the very strongest of the world over a total of four installments. The following fourth segment of the series, Baki-Dou (Way of Baki), focuses on the revival of the legendary Japanese swordsman Musashi Miyamoto, and his campaign to obtaining his former glory.

scenarios.title: Gravity Circuit
scenarios.description: Gravity Circuit is an indie action 2D platformer heavily inspired by the Megaman franchise released in 2023 developed by Domesticated Ant Games and published by PID Games.
scenarios.setting: Gravity Circuit is an indie action 2D platformer heavily inspired by the Megaman franchise released in 2023 developed by Domesticated Ant Games and published by PID Games. Many years ago, an unknown structure dubbed the Ark was found in a digging operation, inside it, there were many hostile robots who dubbed themselves the Virus Army, and marched with destructive intent towards the city.

scenarios.title: Gravity Falls
scenarios.description: Gravity Falls is a Disney XD show created by Alex Hirsch.
scenarios.setting: It follows the adventures of two twins named Mabel and Dipper Pines, who are sent on their summer vacation to live with their Great Uncle Stan Pines in the mysterious town of Gravity Falls, Oregon. Although Dipper and Mabel quickly discover the Mystery Shack is a hoax itself, they sense there is something strange about their new town and together they begin to unlock the secrets of Gravity Falls.

scenarios.title: Gravity Rush

scenarios.setting: SexuaLobster, now known as Greasy Tales is the online handle of Australian Flash animator Chris Voigt, who created many mini verses with fully fleshed out characters and stories in them, such as Great Destiny Man, Pleasure Island and Ragemelon. While they are for the most part separate, there are many videos where characters crossover from other series, subtly hinting at it being a combined verse commonly referred to as the Greasy Moose verse.

scenarios.title: Great Teacher Onizuka
scenarios.description: Great Teacher Onizuka, officially abbreviated as GTO, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Tooru Fujisawa.
scenarios.setting: Great Teacher Onizuka, officially abbreviated as GTO, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Tooru Fujisawa. It was originally serialized in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine from January 1997 to February 2002, with its chapters compiled into twenty-five tankōbon volumes. The story focuses on 22-year-old ex-bōsōzoku member Eikichi Onizuka, who becomes a teacher at a private middle school, Holy Forest Academy, in Tokyo, Japan.

scenarios.title: Green Worldz
scenarios.description: Green Worldz is a manga by Yuusuke Osawa.
scenarios.setting: Green Worldz is a manga by Yuusuke Osawa. Plants have taken over the planet. In 2017, the vegetation in Tokyo rose up and toppled human society in moments. The few survivors are forced to live in the relative safety of a subway network, but supplies are running low. Join an average high school student named Akira as he challenges the plants in a struggle for survival!

scenarios.title: Gremlins
scenarios.description: Gremlins is a 1984 American comedy horror film directed by Joe Dante, written by Chris Columbus, and starring Zach Galligan, Phoebe Cates, Hoyt Axton, Polly Holliday, and Frances Lee McCain, with Howie Mandel providing the voice of Gizmo, the main mogwai character.
scenarios.setting: The story follows a young man who receives a strange creature as a pet, which then spawns other creatures who transform into small, destructive, mischievous monsters that all wreak havoc on a whole town on Christmas Eve.

scenarios.title: Gridman

scenarios.setting: The production is a collaboration between Tsuburaya Productions, the production company behind Gridman and the Ultra Series, and Studio Trigger.

scenarios.title: Grim Dawn
scenarios.description: The game takes place in Cairn, a dark, war-torn world where a once proud empire has been brought to ruin and the human race was driven to the edge of extinction.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place in Cairn, a dark, war-torn world where a once proud empire has been brought to ruin and the human race was driven to the edge of extinction. Small enclaves of human survivors exist scattered throughout the world, holed up in hidden refuges.

scenarios.title: Grojband
scenarios.description: Grojband is a relatively unknown Canadian cartoon created by Total Drama's former directors Todd Kauffman and Mark Thornton.
scenarios.setting: Grojband is a relatively unknown Canadian cartoon created by Total Drama's former directors Todd Kauffman and Mark Thornton. The series follows a formulaic pattern. Corey would often try to book a gig while his older sister, Trina, would try to destroy his band's plans. Often, Corey would come up with, in his own words, "a crazy plan that just might work" and use said plan against Trina.

scenarios.title: Guardian Tales
scenarios.description: Guardian Tales is a Zelda-based action role-playing game that is playable on mobile devices.
scenarios.setting: Guardian Tales is a Zelda-based action role-playing game that is playable on mobile devices. The game revolves around the attack on the Kanterbury Kingdom by the aptly named Invaders, who wish for world domination. The Dark Magician, one of the Invader generals, separated the Princess from the Knight Commander and the Queen, falling into a forest alongside the Knight. The Knight and the Princess travel across the world, gathering the Champions to defeat the Invaders and save their world.

scenarios.title: Guilty Gear
scenarios.description: Guilty Gear is a series of fighting games by Arc System Works and designed by artist Daisuke Ishiwatari.
scenarios.setting: Guilty Gear is a series of fighting games by Arc System Works and designed by artist Daisuke Ishiwatari. It's known for its detailed anime-style graphics, original characters, hard rock/heavy metal soundtrack, unique fighting mechanic such as OHKO attacks, and its numerous references to rock and heavy metal music. The story takes place in the 21st century, where three scientists pioneered the Gear project which is meant to advance human evolution, however the “Gears” are used as weapons instead.

scenarios.title: Gun x Clover
scenarios.description: Gun x Clover is a manga by Yamaguchi Mikoto and D.P.
scenarios.setting: P. Mikado High School, a school for "special people", trains the best students to be the best mercenary bodyguards. But Morito Hayama, a merc escort student with no rank whatsoever, is suddenly assigned to guard a person so highly valued that no escort has ever survived before. Will his subject survive the experience? Will HE survive?!

While the franchise has gotten several different iterations, the original movie has the most recognizable plot and is an iconic piece of horror cinema. Six year old Michael Myers murdered his older sister, Judith Myers, on Halloween night in 1963 at Haddonfield Illinois.

scenarios.title: Halloween Horror Nights

The event was originally named Universal Studios Fright Nights in 1991 and began as a 3-night event at Universal Studios Florida. The following year, it re-branded as Halloween Horror Nights, advertised as the "second annual event".

scenarios.setting: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters is a 2013 action horror film written and directed by Tommy Wirkola. It is a continuation to the German folklore fairy tale "Hansel and Gretel", in which the titular siblings are now grown up and working as a duo of witch exterminators for hire. The film stars Jeremy Renner and Gemma Arterton in the title roles with Famke Janssen, Peter Stormare, Thomas Mann, Pihla Viitala and Derek Mears as the supporting cast.
