Since its debut, the show has become a popular internet phenomenon and has won a cult following. The series features cartoon anthropomorphic forest animals, in premises akin to children's shows, who are suddenly subjected to extreme graphic violence.

scenarios.title: Harvest Moon
scenarios.description: The Story of Seasons video game series was originally produced by Victor Interactive Software (acquired by Marvelous Interactive in 2002), with Natsume handling the English translation and distribution in North America.
scenarios.setting: Story of Seasons is a series of farm simulation/role-playing video games where the main objective is to maintain a farm over a period of time, tending the crops and livestock throughout the seasons, while befriending the nearby townsfolk and getting married in some games.

scenarios.title: Hawaii 5-0
scenarios.description: Hawaii 5-0, alternatively known as Hawaii Five-O, is an American television series produced by CBS Productions.
scenarios.setting: Hawaii 5-0, alternatively known as Hawaii Five-O, is an American television series produced by CBS Productions. The Original series aired for twelve seasons from 1968 to 1980. The Reboot series aired for ten seasons from 2010 to 2020.

scenarios.title: Hayate the Combat Butler
scenarios.description: Hayate the Combat Butler, known in Japan as Hayate no Gotoku! (ハヤテのごとく!), is a comedy shounen manga series created by the mangaka Kenjiro Hata.
scenarios.setting: Hayate the Combat Butler, known in Japan as Hayate no Gotoku! ), is a comedy shounen manga series created by the mangaka Kenjiro Hata. It ran from 2004 to 2017 in the Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine for a total of 568 chapters. Although not too well known in the west, it does have a decent following in Asia and has been adapted into an anime series with four seasons, an anime movie, a series of OVAs, a light novel, even a hit Taiwanese live action television series.

scenarios.title: Heart of Darkness
scenarios.description: Heart of Darkness is a 1998 game by Amazing Studio.
scenarios.setting: Heart of Darkness is a 1998 game by Amazing Studio. It depicts the journey of Andy, a young but courageous boy who loses his dog one day during a solar eclipse. Willing to do anything to get back his dog, Andy travels to the Darklands with his special Rocket Ship and Plasma Cannon/Ray Beam Helmet. An alternate dimension on the other side of a black hole, where his dog Whiskey has been taken by mistake instead of himself.

scenarios.title: Heavy Object
scenarios.description: Heavy Object (ヘヴィーオブジェクト, Hevī Obujekuto) is a Japanese light novel series, written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by Ryō Nagi.
scenarios.setting: Heavy Object (ヘヴィーオブジェクト, Hevī Obujekuto) is a Japanese light novel series, written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by Ryō Nagi. In the future, the development of massive war machines called Objects have rendered conventional warfare and even tactical nuclear weapons seemingly obsolete. As a consequence of this military upheaval, all of the nations of the world have fractured into four coalitions which constantly wage war on each other.

scenarios.title: Helck
scenarios.description: Helck is a manga written and illustrated by Nanao Nanaki and follows the adventures of Helck and Vamirio.
scenarios.setting: The Demon King has been defeated, and now the Demon World is running a contest to choose his successor. What's the secret behind Helck and the human world?

scenarios.title: Henry Stickmin
scenarios.description: The Henry Stickmin Series is a flash game series created by PuffballsUnited.
scenarios.setting: The Henry Stickmin Series is a flash game series created by PuffballsUnited. It is about a stickman by the name of Henry Stickmin going on adventures while causing trouble, and some of the options he does will most likely have him fail in the most hilarious ways possible.

scenarios.title: Her Hero
scenarios.description: Kang Tae-Gu is a human, from the future, with the mission to eliminate Jung Eun-Ji; the woman who will later grow up to be the famous Monster Slayer.
scenarios.setting: Kang Tae-Gu is a human, from the future, with the mission to eliminate Jung Eun-Ji; the woman who will later grow up to be the famous Monster Slayer. In order to get close to her, Kang Tae-Gu has disguised himself as a would-be-hero. Will Kang Tae-Gu be able to kill the Monster Slayer of the past and change the future?

scenarios.title: Herbie (Comic)
scenarios.description: Herbie is a series of comics created by the American Comics Group in 1964.
scenarios.setting: Herbie is a series of comics created by the American Comics Group in 1964. Its main character is the titular Herbie Popnecker, a terse, short, and overweight boy with supernatural powers and a love of lollipops. He first appeared in another of ACG's series, Forbidden Worlds, in 1958. The series typically sees Herbie living out his mundane life before being thrust into an adventure by the appearance of a villain or crisis of some kind.

scenarios.title: Hercules
scenarios.description: Hercules is a 1997 American animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation for Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Hercules is a 1997 American animated musical fantasy comedy film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation for Walt Disney Pictures. The 35th Disney animated feature film and the eighth animated film produced during the Disney Renaissance, the film was directed by Ron Clements and John Musker. The film is loosely based on the legendary hero Heracles (known in the film by his Roman name, Hercules), the son of Zeus, in Greek mythology.

scenarios.title: Heresy
scenarios.description: In the State of Daxuan, Yazhou District within the Demon-Sealing Valley exist the Yunhun Sect also known as Soul Controlling Sect.
scenarios.setting: In the State of Daxuan, Yazhou District within the Demon-Sealing Valley exist the Yunhun Sect also known as Soul Controlling Sect. It’s a sect that has a unique magic that expels the ghosts and controls the souls. Here Mo Lianjian, a young disciple who lost his parents when he was little and taken in by the Ancestor of the Sect, start his journey.

scenarios.title: Hero 108
scenarios.description: Hero: 108 is a European-Taiwanese animated television series on Cartoon Network and the Cartoon Network international cable network, and Kabillion OnDemand channel in the United States.
scenarios.setting: Hero: 108 is a European-Taiwanese animated television series on Cartoon Network and the Cartoon Network international cable network, and Kabillion OnDemand channel in the United States. The series is created by Yang-Ming Tarng and is co-produced by Gamania, Hong Ying Animation, Taffy Entertainment, Telegael Teoranta and MoonScoop Group, and animated at Mike Young Productions in Los Angeles.

scenarios.title: Hero Factory
scenarios.description: LEGO's Hero Factory was considered the spiritual successor to the company's immensely successful Bionicle line.
scenarios.setting: The series takes place in the futuristic Makuhero City, home to the Hero Factory, which constructs and dispatches Heroes on various missions throughout the galaxy.

scenarios.title: Hero Killer
scenarios.description: Hero Killer (히어로 킬러, Hieoro Killeo) is an Action Webtoon Original written by Kkulbeol and art by Beolkkul; it updates every Wednesday.
scenarios.setting: Hero Killer (히어로 킬러, Hieoro Killeo) is an Action Webtoon Original written by Kkulbeol and art by Beolkkul; it updates every Wednesday. The original Korean Webtoon premiered on Naver The Manhwa Was Released On 24 February, 2021 The world is in constant turmoil, with constant wars breaking out between Heroes and Villains. Gifted with supernatural abilities, one lone girl sets out on a bloody path for revenge against the injustices of the world she lives in. With the constant clashes between titans, no one is safe.

scenarios.title: Hero? I Quit A Long Time Ago
scenarios.source: Hero? I Quit A Long Time Ago
scenarios.description: Zero was mankind's first real superhero.
scenarios.setting: Zero was mankind's first real superhero. Under his watch, countless other superheros appeared and followed in his footsteps. However, after 5 years of war, Zero disappeared without a trace.

scenarios.title: Heroes (TV Series)
scenarios.description: Heroes is a television series created by Tim King and aired on NBC for a total of four seasons, which would later be expanded upon by the Heroes Evolutions webseries as well as the miniseries continuation of the show, Heroes Reborn.
scenarios.setting: Heroes is a television series created by Tim King and aired on NBC for a total of four seasons, which would later be expanded upon by the Heroes Evolutions webseries as well as the miniseries continuation of the show, Heroes Reborn. The show's canon will also include a comic book series written by Cullen Bunn, called Heroes: Season Five.

scenarios.title: Heroes of the Storm
scenarios.description: Heroes of the storm is an MOBA game Created by Blizzard Entertainment
scenarios.setting: Heroes of the storm is an MOBA game Created by Blizzard Entertainment Heroes of the Storm is a MOBA game with 5v5 mechanics and an overarching story arc taking place in events and comics

scenarios.title: Heroic Age
scenarios.description: Heroic Age Is a science-fiction anime series released in 2007 by XEBEC, inspired by the Greek myth of Hercules.
scenarios.setting: Heroic Age focuses on the conflict between the Iron Tribe (humanity) and the other Tribes throughout the universe (namely the Silver Tribe & the Bronze Tribe), and the power of the missing Heroic Tribe.

scenarios.title: Hetalia: Axis Powers
scenarios.description: Axis Powers Hetalia (ヘタリア Axis Powers, Hetaria Akushisu Pawāzu) is a webcomic, later adapted as a manga and an anime series, by Hidekaz Himaruya (日丸屋秀和 Himaruya Hidekazu).
scenarios.setting: Axis Powers Hetalia (ヘタリア Axis Powers, Hetaria Akushisu Pawāzu) is a webcomic, later adapted as a manga and an anime series, by Hidekaz Himaruya (日丸屋秀和 Himaruya Hidekazu). The series presents an allegorical interpretation of political and historic events, particularly of the World War II era, in which the various countries are represented by human-like characters. Hetalia (ヘタリア) is a portmanteau combining hetare (へタレ, Japanese for "unreliable") and Italia (イタリア).

scenarios.title: Hi-Fi Rush
scenarios.description: Hi-Fi Rush is an action-rhythm game, released on the 25th of January 2023, developed by Tango Gameworks and published by Bethesda Softworks.
scenarios.setting: The story follows Chai, a young man with a broken arm who dreams of being a rockstar, who one day finds his opportunity for greatness through the ambitious "Project Armstrong" - a cybernetic enhancement project heralded by the prestigious Vandelay Technologies corporation.

scenarios.title: High School DxD
scenarios.description: High School DxD is a light novel series written by Ichiei Ishibumi and illustrated by Miyama-Zero.
scenarios.setting: High School DxD is a light novel series written by Ichiei Ishibumi and illustrated by Miyama-Zero.

scenarios.title: High School Of The Dead
scenarios.description: Highschool of the Dead, known in Japan as Apocalyptic Academy: Highschool of the Dead (Japanese: 学園黙示録 HIGHSCHOOL OF THE DEAD Hepburn: Gakuen Mokushiroku Haisukūru obu za Deddo), is a Japanese manga series written by Daisuke Satō and illustrated by Shōji Satō.
scenarios.setting: Highschool of the Dead, known in Japan as Apocalyptic Academy: Highschool of the Dead (Japanese: 学園黙示録 HIGHSCHOOL OF THE DEAD Hepburn: Gakuen Mokushiroku Haisukūru obu za Deddo), is a Japanese manga series written by Daisuke Satō and illustrated by Shōji Satō. It was serialized in Fujimi Shobo's Monthly Dragon Age between the September 2006 and May 2013 issues, but was left unfinished following Daisuke Satō's death in March 2017.

scenarios.title: Higher Than The Sky
scenarios.description: When the Devil King announces his retirement, he calls forth his two sons, Yomi and Sora, to give them each a quest.
scenarios.setting: Whichever of them finds a pure Yamato maiden within a year would inherit the throne of the Devil King, while the other would die.

scenarios.title: Hinomaru Sumo
scenarios.description: Hinomaru Sumo (Japanese: 火ノ丸相撲, Hepburn: Hinomaru Zumō) is a Japanese sumomangaseries written and illustrated by Kawada.
scenarios.setting: Hinomaru Sumo (Japanese: 火ノ丸相撲, Hepburn: Hinomaru Zumō) is a Japanese sumomangaseries written and illustrated by Kawada. It was serialized in Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine from May 2014 to July 2019, with its chapters collected into 28 tankōbonvolumes by Shueisha. A 24-episode animetelevision series adaptation produced by Gonzo aired from October 2018 to March 2019.

scenarios.title: His Dark Materials
scenarios.description: For detailed information about this franchise, visit the His Dark Materials Wiki.
scenarios.setting: It follows the Lyra Belacqua's journey across the Northern tundra and eventually spills out into the further multiverse and the rebellion against the Authority.

scenarios.title: History's Strongest Disciple Kenichi
scenarios.description: History's Strongest Disciple Kenichi revolves around the titular protagonist Kenichi Shirahama.
scenarios.setting: Unlike Ryōzanpaku who believe all lives are worthy and must be spared in battle (Satsujin-Ken), Yami subscribe to the philosophy that Martial Arts are inherently a tool used for killing, and while not obliged to murder, it is far from wrong to do so (Katsujin-Ken) Ryōzanpaku eventually tries to combat the school in order to stop their leaders' goal of spreading warfare and chaos around the world.

scenarios.title: Hitman
scenarios.description: Escenario del universo de Hitman.

scenarios.title: Hollow Knight
scenarios.description: Hollow Knight is a video game created and published by Team Cherry.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place in Hallownest, a once great kingdom that has since fallen to the ravages of time, with the player taking on the role of a nameless, silent Knight who arrives to explore the underground kingdom, discovering more about the history and state of the world as the game goes on.

scenarios.title: Hololive
scenarios.description: Hololive is a large group of virtual idols and Virtual YouTubers working under an agency of the same name.
scenarios.setting: They travel through various stages, defeating swarms of minions along the way. The game follows Flare, traveling through seven worlds to fight evil forces that have spread chaos throughout the land and rescue her friends.

scenarios.title: Home Alone
scenarios.description: Home Alone is a 1990 American Christmas comedy film directed by Chris Columbus, and written and produced by John Hughes.
scenarios.setting: Home Alone is a 1990 American Christmas comedy film directed by Chris Columbus, and written and produced by John Hughes. The first film in the Home Alone franchise, the film stars Macaulay Culkin as Kevin McCallister, an eight-year-old boy who defends his Chicago home from a home invasion by a pair of robbers after his family accidentally leave him behind on their Christmas vacation to Paris.

scenarios.title: Home on the Range
scenarios.description: Home on the Range is the 45th full-length animated feature film in the Disney Animated Canon, and was released on April 2, 2004.
scenarios.setting: Home on the Range is the 45th full-length animated feature film in the Disney Animated Canon, and was released on April 2, 2004. It tells a tale of three dairy cows in the wild west who search for a wanted criminal to save their farm from going bankrupt.

scenarios.title: Home Sweet Home
scenarios.description: Home Sweet Home is a Horror game about the player who trapped in a Niwarn the dimension between real world & spirit realm.
scenarios.setting: Home Sweet Home is a Horror game about the player who trapped in a Niwarn the dimension between real world & spirit realm.

scenarios.title: Homestuck
scenarios.description: Homestuck is a webcomic created by Andrew Hussie in 2009 and which now became its own entire franchise.
scenarios.setting: The plot follows John Egbert and his friends as they decide to play a game.

scenarios.title: Honkai Impact 3rd
scenarios.description: Honkai Impact 3rd is an RPG action game developed by miHoYo, known internationally as Hoyoverse.
scenarios.setting: Honkai Impact 3rd is an RPG action game developed by miHoYo, known internationally as Hoyoverse. The main story revolves around humanity's struggle against the Honkai, a higher-dimensional force of nature that is on the verge of destroying mankind.

scenarios.title: Honkai: Star Rail
scenarios.description: Honkai Star Rail is a free-to-play turn-based RPG developed and published by HoYoverse.
scenarios.setting: Honkai Star Rail is a free-to-play turn-based RPG developed and published by HoYoverse. - Power of the Verse=The full extent of the Honkai Star Rail's verse has not been showcased, but with just two years of the game, we became aware of characters that are comfortably Star level to Galaxy level. Emanators the powerful beings, the enforcers of Aeons wills are much more powerful than regular Pathstriders as they reach higher levels of power within Galaxy level.

scenarios.title: Hoodwinked!
scenarios.description: Hoodwinked! is a series of animated films which are often compared to the Shrek franchise in that they parody classic fairy tale characters.
scenarios.setting: Hoodwinked! is a series of animated films which are often compared to the Shrek franchise in that they parody classic fairy tale characters. Each main character offers a twist on those of the classic Little Red Riding Hood, including Red Riding Hood, Wolf, Granny, and the Woodsman. The first film is structured like a non-linear crime drama, with each of the four main characters detailing the same series of events from their intertwining points of view.

scenarios.title: Horizon Zero Dawn
scenarios.description: Horizon Zero Dawn is an action role-playing video game developed by Guerrilla Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: The plot revolves around Aloy, a hunter living in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hostile robots, where the remains of humanity have regrouped into tribal factions.

scenarios.title: Horrorclix
scenarios.description: Horrorclix is a tabletop turn based strategy game based on horror tropes including slashers, ghosts, zombies, werewolves, vampires, etc.
scenarios.setting: Horrorclix is a tabletop turn based strategy game based on horror tropes including slashers, ghosts, zombies, werewolves, vampires, etc. It also has licensed characters from the Alien vs Predator franchise, Friday the 13th and A Nightmare on Elmstreet (Franchises), alongside classic novel characters such as from the Cthulhu Mythos , Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, and the Headless Horseman.

scenarios.title: Hotel Transylvania
scenarios.description: Hotel Transylvania is a 2012 American computer-animated comedy film produced by Columbia Pictures and Sony Pictures Animation.
scenarios.setting: When the "human-free hotel" is unexpectedly visited by an ordinary 21-year-old traveler named Jonathan, Drac must do everything in his power to prevent Mavis from falling in love with him before the hotel's guests learn a human is in the castle, which may jeopardize the hotel's future and his career.

scenarios.title: Hotline Miami
scenarios.description: Hotline Miami and Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number are a series of top-down shooter video games created by Jonatan “Cactus” Söderström and Dennis Wedin, collectively known as Dennaton Games.
scenarios.setting: The game is set in an alternate history universe where in 1989, the Soviet Union and USA became hostile on the Cold War, and Russia managed to win the war, creating a puppet state in the United States.

scenarios.title: House of Leaves
scenarios.description: House of Leaves is a 2000 metafictional horror novel, and the debut novel of Mark Z.
scenarios.setting: House of Leaves is a 2000 metafictional horror novel, and the debut novel of Mark Z. Danielewski. House of Leaves follows two plots, Johnny Truant's story and The Navidson Record. The Navidson Record follows The Navidsons and their eldritch house, and Johnny Truant's plot follows his discovery of The Navidson Record and the effects it has on his mind. The Whalestoe Letters follows the mentally ill Pelafina Truant, as she sends letters to her son, Johnny.

scenarios.title: House of the Dead
scenarios.description: The House of the Dead, also known as Curien Mansion in other media, is a survival horror light gun shooter video game franchise created by Sega in 1996.
scenarios.setting: The House of the Dead, also known as Curien Mansion in other media, is a survival horror light gun shooter video game franchise created by Sega in 1996.

scenarios.title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
scenarios.source: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
scenarios.description: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom is a light novel and manga series which follows Kazuya Souma who is summoned to another world.
scenarios.setting: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom is a light novel and manga series which follows Kazuya Souma who is summoned to another world. After he presents his plan to strengthen the country economically and militarily, the king cedes the throne to him and Souma finds himself saddled with ruling the nation while he's betrothed to the king's daughter. In order to get the country back on its feet, Souma calls the wise, the talented, and the gifted to his side. Five people gather before the newly crowned Souma.

scenarios.title: Hulk (2003 Film)
scenarios.description: Hulk (also known as The Hulk) is a 2003 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
scenarios.setting: Hulk (also known as The Hulk) is a 2003 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. The film was directed by Ang Lee and written by John Turman, James Schamus, and Michael France. Eric Bana stars as Bruce Banner and Hulk, alongside Jennifer Connelly, Sam Elliott, Josh Lucas, and Nick Nolte. The film explores Bruce Banner's origins.

scenarios.title: Hungry Joker
scenarios.description: Hungry Joker (ハングリージョーカー, Hangurī Jōkā) is a manga written and illustrated by Yūki Tabata published in the weekly shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump published by Shueisha since November 2012 in the 50th issue of Weekly Shōnen Jump.
scenarios.setting: The story follows a mysterious genius scientist Heidi and his assistant Chitose Toriiooji.

scenarios.title: Hungry Shark
scenarios.description: Hungry Shark is a series of arcade-style RPG games developed and published by Ubisoft London (prior to Hungry Shark Evolution) and Ubisoft (since Hungry Shark Evolution).
scenarios.setting: Hungry Shark is a series of arcade-style RPG games developed and published by Ubisoft London (prior to Hungry Shark Evolution) and Ubisoft (since Hungry Shark Evolution). The games allow players to control several unique species of sharks, including mako sharks, great white sharks, hammerhead sharks, reef sharks, megamouth shark, megalodon, basking sharks and whale sharks. To progress, the player must consume other marine animals and grow in size until the next, more powerful shark is available for purchase.

scenarios.title: Hunter X Hunter
scenarios.description: Hunter x Hunter is a manga series created by Yoshihiro Togashi after finishing Yu Yu Hakusho.
scenarios.setting: Hunter x Hunter is a manga series created by Yoshihiro Togashi after finishing Yu Yu Hakusho. It is the story about a child named Gon Freecss who sets out to become a hunter to find his father, who left him with his aunt when he was a child. To become a hunter, Gon must take a special exam where he meets and befriends new people. After passing it and becoming a certified hunter, he sets out to find his father, encountering even more people and aberrations, both good and evil, along the way.

scenarios.title: Huntik: Secrets & Seekers
scenarios.description: The series follows Lok Lambert as he uncovers the secret legacy of his missing father.
scenarios.setting: The series follows Lok Lambert as he uncovers the secret legacy of his missing father. His father, Eathon, was a member of the Huntik Foundation and a part of a secret world of magic users known as Seekers and creatures known as Titans.

scenarios.title: Hylics
scenarios.description: Hylics is a short, experimental indie RPG released in 2015 by claymation artist Mason Lindroth.
scenarios.setting: It features an abstract, clay-based artstyle and an open-ended, surreal world.

scenarios.title: Hyperion Cantos
scenarios.description: The Hyperion Cantos is a series of science fiction books written by Dan Simmons, being largely a homage to the works of John Keats, in particular of Hyperion.
scenarios.setting: The Hyperion Cantos is a series of science fiction books written by Dan Simmons, being largely a homage to the works of John Keats, in particular of Hyperion. The Cantos have four main books, Hyperion, Fall of Hyperion, Endymion and Rise of Endymion, the later two happening centuries after the first two. There are also three short stories that make part of the universe: Remembering Siri, Death of Centaur and Orphans of the Helix. Mankind's domain of the stars is absolute.

scenarios.title: I Am a Hero
scenarios.description: I Am a Hero (Japanese: アイアムアヒーロー, Hepburn: Ai Amu A Hīrō) is a Japanese zombie manga series written and illustrated by Kengo Hanazawa.
scenarios.setting: There are three spin-off manga, set in the same universe, titled I Am a Hero in Osaka, I Am a Hero in Ibaraki and I Am a Hero in Nagasaki.

scenarios.title: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
scenarios.source: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
scenarios.description: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream is a science-fiction short story written by Harlan Ellison, which was further adapted into multiple medias, including a cult-classic video game by Cyberdreams.
scenarios.setting: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream is a science-fiction short story written by Harlan Ellison, which was further adapted into multiple medias, including a cult-classic video game by Cyberdreams. It tells the post-apocalyptic tale of the last survivors of the human race, after its destruction at the hands of AM, a system of military supercomputers which turned sentient, and subsequently vengeful against humanity, wiping out all but five of them, who it plans to torture for all eternity.

scenarios.title: I Really Don’t Want to Learn Forbidden Spells
scenarios.source: I Really Don’t Want to Learn Forbidden Spells
scenarios.description: Ning Feng is an ordinary young man with no great ambitions in the world of magic, who suddenly gains access to , a branch of magic considered extremely dangerous and strictly forbidden.
scenarios.setting: Ning Feng is an ordinary young man with no great ambitions in the world of magic, who suddenly gains access to Forbidden Spells, a branch of magic considered extremely dangerous and strictly forbidden.

scenarios.title: I Reincarnated For Nothing
scenarios.description: Artpe, the fourth weakest of the Four Heavenly Kings of Demon King's Army who should have lived a long life, was killed by the hero's blade.
scenarios.setting: They are spaces disengaged from the outside world. Monsters - beings that were birthed from the World.

scenarios.title: I Was Caught up in a Hero Summoning, but That World Is at Peace
scenarios.source: I Was Caught up in a Hero Summoning, but That World Is at Peace
scenarios.description: I Was Caught up in a Hero Summoning, but That World Is at Peace, otherwise known as Yuusha Shoukan ni Makikomareta kedo, Isekai wa Heiwa deshita YuuShou or  Isekai at Peace, follows Miyama Kaito who suddenly appears in a different world, after being caught up in a Hero Summoning.
scenarios.setting: I Was Caught up in a Hero Summoning, but That World Is at Peace, otherwise known as Yuusha Shoukan ni Makikomareta kedo, Isekai wa Heiwa deshita YuuShou or Isekai at Peace, follows Miyama Kaito who suddenly appears in a different world, after being caught up in a Hero Summoning. And of course, he isn't the Hero, but it’s another guy……and while being very cautious and scared of the cliché of the cliché-like development, he was thrown into the maelstrom of war……or not. The Demon Lord?

scenarios.title: I'm Destined For Greatness!
scenarios.description: When you succeed at everything you try, you have no choice but to seek challenges elsewhere, like in a game.
scenarios.setting: When you succeed at everything you try, you have no choice but to seek challenges elsewhere, like in a game. By using the trash jobs that no one pays any attention to, with the right attitude you're bound to accomplish your goals! Even succeeding at the most impossible of quests, the main character bets everything he has.

scenarios.title: I’m the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
scenarios.source: I’m the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
scenarios.description: I’m the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!, also known as,, and.
scenarios.setting: The setting takes place in an intergalactic empire, a space opera-like universe where humanoid weapons and spaceships battle.

scenarios.title: I'm the Grim Reaper
scenarios.description: After a mysterious death, a woman by the name of Scarlet gets sent to hell, with no recollection of who she was in her previous life.
scenarios.setting: Now tasked with hunting down those with the mark of a sinner, Scarlet roams the world looking for her next victim while simultaneously trying to learn more about her mysterious past.

scenarios.title: Ib
scenarios.description: Ib is a RPG Maker-made horror game, based on various artworks.
scenarios.setting: The game follows its namesake, in form of a young girl, into a mysterious world where paintings are animated.

scenarios.title: Ice Age
scenarios.description: Ice Age is an American media franchise centering on a group of mammals surviving the Paleolithic ice age.
scenarios.setting: The films are produced by Blue Sky Studios, a division of 20th Century Fox Animation as a part of Walt Disney Studios (formerly 20th Century Fox).

scenarios.title: Ichiban Ushiro no Daimaou
scenarios.description: This story of "love, magic, and battles" revolves around Akuto Sai, a boy who aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society as one of its clergy.
scenarios.setting: This story of "love, magic, and battles" revolves around Akuto Sai, a boy who aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society as one of its clergy. " Thus begins his severe school life in which he is resented by his studious female class head, desired by a girl with mysterious powers, and guarded by a beautiful female android.

scenarios.title: Ico
scenarios.description: The Ico universe is a rather mysterious world, considering the lack of dialogue in any of the game and lack of many characters who can actually speak.
scenarios.setting: The Ico universe is a rather mysterious world, considering the lack of dialogue in any of the game and lack of many characters who can actually speak.

scenarios.title: Iji
scenarios.description: Iji is an indie game by developer Daniel Remar.
scenarios.setting: Iji is an indie game by developer Daniel Remar. Driven to near extinction by an alien race known as the Komato, the Tasen escape back to their old homeworld of Origin, finding it infested with a new species known as humans. Nearly eradicating the humans in their search for asylum, the Tasen hide on Earth, attempting to avoid the notice of the Komato. But the Komato eventually find them anyways.

scenarios.title: Ikki Tousen
scenarios.description: Ikki Tousen is a manga series created by Yuji Shiozaki based on the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
scenarios.setting: These jewels have been scattered throughout Japan, and have the power to draw out the full potential of those who inherit them.

scenarios.title: Im: Great Priest Imhotep
scenarios.description: A story of a Great Priest falling from grace.
scenarios.setting: A story of a Great Priest falling from grace. Imhotep was looked up upon by everyone. He was so talented that he was commonly referred to as a God by everyone, thus his title as the Great Priest. However, that was 3,000 years ago. Soon after he was dubbed the Great Heretic after commiting an atrocity and was feared by everyone.

scenarios.title: Image Comics
scenarios.description: Image Comics (or Image) is an American comic book publisher and the third largest comic book and graphic novel publishing company in the USA, after Marvel and DC.
scenarios.setting: Its output was originally dominated by superhero and fantasy series from the studios of the founding Image partners, but now includes self-contained comic books in many genres by numerous independent creators.

scenarios.title: Imscared
scenarios.description: Imscared: A Pixelated Nightmare is a 2011 (with a 2016 remake) meta-horror indie game, created by Ivan Zanotti.
scenarios.setting: As the player progress through the game, they learn more about the setting of the game, even if little of it.

scenarios.title: In Another World With My Smartphone
scenarios.source: In Another World With My Smartphone
scenarios.description: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God.
scenarios.setting: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God. ” laments the old coot. But all is not lost! God says that he can reincarnate Touya into a world of fantasy, and as a bonus, he gets to bring his smartphone along with! So begins Touya's adventure in a new, anachronistic pseudo-medieval world.

scenarios.title: In Stars and Time
scenarios.description: In Stars and Time and its predecessor, START AGAIN: a prologue, is a role-playing game developed by indie developer insertdisc5.

scenarios.setting: It takes place in Japan where a young teenager named Sawada Tsunayoshi has been chosen to be the next successor to the Vongola Family, which is a mafia family, and is tutored by a young baby named Reborn, and his friends and even enemies join his family.

The original films include Kickboxer, released in 1989, Kickboxer 2: The Road Back, released in 1991, Kickboxer 3: The Art of War, released in 1992, Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor, released in 1994, and Redemption: Kickboxer 5, released in 1995.

It follows the main character, Pit, who is the captain of an angel army and servant of the goddess of light, Palutena. A 18-episode anime series based on the manga was created by Radix in early 2000s. The tokusatsu series from 1972 is especially popular in Hawaii. The anime series aired in the United States on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim Action in 2003.

scenarios.title: LIVE A LIVE

scenarios.setting: LIVE A LIVE is a JRPG game released for the Super Famicom in Japan, 1994, by Squaresoft. Unlike other typical JRPGs of its time, LIVE A LIVE consisted of seven chapters, each with their own lead protagonist and unique setting, that the player could choose in any order. Each of these seven scenarios had their own gameplay style that generally differed from regular RPGs, with each of their stories being connected together in the final chapter.
