scenarios.description: The Super Mario Bros. franchise is a highly popular video game franchise founded by Shigeru Miyamoto, featuring as its protagonist the plumber for whom it is named, Mario. The plot in many of its games revolves around him, and occasionally his brother, Luigi,
scenarios.setting: The Super Mario Bros. franchise is a highly popular video game franchise founded by Shigeru Miyamoto, featuring as its protagonist the plumber for whom it is named, Mario. The plot in many of its games revolves around him, and occasionally his brother, Luigi, fighting Bowser, the fire-breathing, turtle-like main antagonist, and his army in order to thwart his plans for global conquest and rescue the captured princess of the Mushroom Kingdom, Princess Peach.

scenarios.title: Markiplier
scenarios.description: The Markiplier series is a collection of YouTube original content made by Mark Fishbach, better known under his online alias of Markiplier.
scenarios.setting: The Markiplier series is a collection of YouTube original content made by Mark Fishbach, better known under his online alias of Markiplier. The series also features Tyler Scheid, Pamela Horton, Robert Rexx, Mick Lauer, and Chris Hampton as both its cast and creative team.

scenarios.title: Martial Peak
scenarios.description: The story begins with Yang Kai as a Trial disciple in High Heaven Pavilion.
scenarios.setting: Throughout his status as a Trial disciple of High Heaven Pavilion, Yang Kai has been challenged 147 times and has lost every single time. Yang Kai's life starts to change when he comes across a mysterious black book that cures him of his birth defect of being unable to cultivate.

scenarios.title: Marvel & Disney: What If…?
scenarios.description: Marvel & Disney: What If…? is a group of one off comic published in 2024 to 2025 by Marvel & Disney, where Disney ccharacters like Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck becoming Marvel superheroes like Wolverine and Iron Man.
scenarios.setting: Marvel & Disney: What If…? is a group of one off comic published in 2024 to 2025 by Marvel & Disney, where Disney ccharacters like Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck becoming Marvel superheroes like Wolverine and Iron Man.

scenarios.title: Marvel × Shonen Jump+
scenarios.description: Marvel × Shonen Jump+ Super Collaboration (MARVEL × 少年ジャンプ＋ SUPER COLLABORATION!!) is a Japanese manga series produced by the digital distribution platform Shōnen Jump+ in collaboration with the American comic book company Marvel Comics.
scenarios.setting: ) is a Japanese manga series produced by the digital distribution platform Shōnen Jump+ in collaboration with the American comic book company Marvel Comics. The series is composed of seven one-shots written by various Weekly Shōnen Jump manga artists that feature Marvel Comics characters, reimagined in the manga-inspired universe of Earth-346.

scenarios.title: Marvel Age
scenarios.description: Marvel Age refers to a line of comic books published in 2004-2005 by Marvel Comics, intended for younger readers.
scenarios.setting: While there are exceptions, most Marvel Age runs were set in Earth-50302.

scenarios.title: Marvel Comics
scenarios.description: Marvel Comics is a comic book publishing company that has created many iconic superheroes such as Spider-Man, Iron Man, Wolverine, the Hulk, and Captain America, alongside many others.
scenarios.setting: Marvel Comics is a comic book publishing company that has created many iconic superheroes such as Spider-Man, Iron Man, Wolverine, the Hulk, and Captain America, alongside many others. Beginning in 1939 as Timely Comics, its main production was focused on pulp magazines, with the Human Torch, Namor the Submariner and Captain America being some of the earliest superheroes featured.

scenarios.title: Marvel Future Fight
scenarios.description: Marvel Future Fight is a superhero-themed mobile video game developed by Netmarble Games.
scenarios.setting: Marvel Future Fight is a superhero-themed mobile video game developed by Netmarble Games.

scenarios.title: Marvel Mangaverse
scenarios.description: The Marvel Mangaverse is a series of comic books published by Marvel Comics from 2000 to 2002, with a sequel, New Mangaverse, released in 2006.
scenarios.setting: The series is set in an alternate universe to the Marvel universe, where its characters are portrayed in a manga-like style. The universe is designated within the Marvel Multiverse as Earth-2301.

scenarios.title: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects
scenarios.source: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects
scenarios.description: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects is a fighting game released in September 2005 and developed by Nihilistic Software and EA Canada.
scenarios.setting: The game follows various Marvel characters such as Spider-Man and Wolverine as they face of against the supervillain team known as The Imperfects.

scenarios.title: Marvel Rivals
scenarios.description: Marvel Rivals is a 2024 third-person hero shooter video game developed and published by NetEase Games in collaboration with Marvel Games.
scenarios.setting: Marvel Rivals is a 2024 third-person hero shooter video game developed and published by NetEase Games in collaboration with Marvel Games. The story follows a hostile meeting between Doctor Doom and his heroic 2099 counterpart, which causes a "timestream entanglement" that leads to new worlds being created and heroes and villains from across the multiverse fighting one another to defeat both Doom variants before one claims victory over the new worlds.

scenarios.title: Marvel vs. Capcom
scenarios.description: Marvel vs. Capcom, also referred to as the VS. Series, is a crossover fighting game franchise developed and published by Capcom. The series revolves around characters from Marvel Comics and Capcom's video game franchises fighting each other in tag team battles
scenarios.setting: Marvel vs. Capcom, also referred to as the VS. Series, is a crossover fighting game franchise developed and published by Capcom. The series revolves around characters from Marvel Comics and Capcom's video game franchises fighting each other in tag team battles, either in teams two or three. While the first three games were only focused on Marvel's properties, they share the same continuity as crossover titles.

scenarios.title: Marvel's Avengers
scenarios.description: Marvel's Avengers is an epic, third-person, action-adventure game that combines an original, cinematic story with single-player and co-operative gameplay.
scenarios.setting: Five years later, with all Super Heroes outlawed and the world in peril, New Jersey teenager Kamala Khan uncovers a shocking conspiracy and the only hope is to reassemble the Avengers in time to stop Advanced Idea Mechanics, one of the greatest threats Earth has ever faced.

scenarios.title: Marvel's Spider-Man
scenarios.description: Marvel's Spider-Man is a 2018 action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
scenarios.setting: Negative orchestrates a plot to seize control of New York City's criminal underworld. Negative threatens to release a deadly virus, Spider-Man must confront him and protect the city while dealing with the personal problems of his civilian persona, Peter Parker.

scenarios.title: Mary Poppins (Disney)
scenarios.description: Mary Poppins is a 1964 American musical hybrid film presented and produced by Walt Disney Productions and distributed by Buena Vista Distribution, based on the Mary Poppins series of children's books written by P.L.
scenarios.setting: It also had one of the larger parts of The Great Movie Ride, having both a poster in the "lobby" of the "theater" (the station) and a scene with an animatronic Mary and Bert.

scenarios.title: Mass Effect
scenarios.description: Mass Effect is a science-fiction third-person shooter/RPG franchise developed by Bioware.
scenarios.setting: The second game takes place two years after you managed to stop the Reaper's initial invasion. The third and final installment of the trilogy, takes place as the Reapers attack in force.

scenarios.title: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE
scenarios.description: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE is a dark fantasy/mystery game developed by Spike Chunsoft, and written by Kazutaka Kodaka.
scenarios.setting: Yuma, alongside multiple other WDO detectives, have been dispatched to Kanai Ward, a shut-off city enveloped in everlasting rain to solve its many mysteries that will lead to the final truth. Kanai Ward is run by the Amaterasu Corporation, which takes over every facet of the city and seeks to hide these truths from these detectives at all costs.

scenarios.title: Max Steel
scenarios.description: Max Steel is a verse that varies in strength through Tier 8, Tier 5, and Tier 4.
scenarios.setting: Max Steel is a verse that varies in strength through Tier 8, Tier 5, and Tier 4.

scenarios.title: Maze Runner
scenarios.description: The Maze Runner is a 2009 young adult dystopian science fiction novel written by American author James Dashner, and the first book released in The Maze Runner series, although it is the third in narrative order.
scenarios.setting: The world was consumed by a lethal virus called The Flare that killed 99% of the world's population.

scenarios.title: Mazinger
scenarios.description: Mazinger Z (マジンガーZ) is manga series written and illustrated by Go Nagai.
scenarios.setting: Kabuto were a part of during an expedition in the Greek island Bardos. The original plot is typically carried out throughout varying spin-offs and reboots, but there are a variety of scenarios where the series takes a massively different turn.

scenarios.title: Medaka Box
scenarios.description: The Medaka Box series is about a girl named Medaka Kurokami who's the student council president of Hakoniwa academy.
scenarios.setting: The Medaka Box series is about a girl named Medaka Kurokami who's the student council president of Hakoniwa academy.

scenarios.title: MediEvil
scenarios.description: MediEvil is an action-adventure hack and slash video game series developed by SCE Cambridge Studio and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment since 1998.
scenarios.setting: 500 years after the first game's events, Sir Daniel Fortesque was revived in Victorian-era London as he attempts to stop sorcerer Lord Palethorn and Jack the Ripper's plans to terrorise the city by raising the dead.

scenarios.title: Meet the Robinsons
scenarios.description: Meet the Robinsons is a 2007 American computer-animated science-fiction comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Meet the Robinsons is a 2007 American computer-animated science-fiction comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. Meet the Robinsons follows the interactions between Lewis (Fry), an orphaned 12-year-old inventor desperate to be adopted, and Wilbur Robinson (Singerman), a young time-traveler who travels to the year 2037 to visit the family.

scenarios.title: Meet Your Oshi
scenarios.description: Meet Your Oshi is an indie point-and-click survival horror video game developed by the virtual YouTuber company, VchiBan.
scenarios.setting: Meet Your Oshi is an indie point-and-click survival horror video game developed by the virtual YouTuber company, VchiBan. Inspired by the Five Nights At Freddy's franchise, the player character breaks into a convention center and must fend off animatronics long enough to print out a VIP ticket to the upcoming DweebCon. The game features animatronic versions of the members of VchiBan themselves.

scenarios.title: MEG
scenarios.description: Meg: A Novel of Deep Terror is a 1997 science fiction horror novel by American author Steve Alten.
scenarios.setting: The novel follows the underwater adventures of a Navy deep-sea diver named Jonas Taylor.

scenarios.title: Mega Man (Franchise)
scenarios.description: Mega Man is one of the longest running video game franchises of all time and once a household name in the gamer community.
scenarios.setting: Mega Man is one of the longest running video game franchises of all time and once a household name in the gamer community. For much of Capcom's life, the series served as the company's mascot, but the sharp criticism received for games such as the fourth Battle Network game and declining sales led to a steep decline for the series before the company stopped producing the series entirely in favor of other long-running titles like Street Fighter and Resident Evil.

scenarios.title: Megami Tensei
scenarios.description: Megami Tensei, often abbreviated as MegaTen, is a long-spanning game franchise currently owned by Atlus, consisting of a variety of series and sub-series covering several role-playing genres, including tactical role-playing, action role-playing, and so on.
scenarios.setting: The games usually involve the sudden appearance of the supernatural on the world, with Gods, Demons, creatures from all faiths involved, and Apocalyptic scenarios soon following. The player will find themselves split between opposing forces, Law and Chaos, seeking to shape the world according to their ideals. However, that will lead to a world of unsuppressed vice, anarchy, and war, with the survival of the fittest as the only way.

scenarios.title: Megamind
scenarios.description: Megamind is a 2010 American computer-animated superhero comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation and PDI/DreamWorks and distributed by Paramount Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Megamind is a 2010 American computer-animated superhero comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation and PDI/DreamWorks and distributed by Paramount Pictures. Directed by Tom McGrath from a screenplay by Alan Schoolcraft and Brent Simons, the film stars the voices of Will Ferrell, Tina Fey, Jonah Hill, David Cross, and Brad Pitt.

scenarios.title: Megas XLR
scenarios.description: Megas Xlr follows the adventures of Coop, Jamie, and Kiva who was a military pilot in the year 3037 who bring Megas (A powerful prototype battle robot) to past timeline to stop Glorft a powerful alien warlord from stealing it who plans to destroy the human race.
scenarios.setting: Megas Xlr follows the adventures of Coop, Jamie, and Kiva who was a military pilot in the year 3037 who bring Megas (A powerful prototype battle robot) to past timeline to stop Glorft a powerful alien warlord from stealing it who plans to destroy the human race.

scenarios.title: Megaton Rainfall
scenarios.description: Megaton Rainfall is a video game created by Pentadimensional Games for the PS4 and PC.
scenarios.setting: Megaton Rainfall is a video game created by Pentadimensional Games for the PS4 and PC. It revolves around a human who was chosen by the creator of the universe to save earth from alien invaders, while also learning about the truth of the universe and why humans were created.

scenarios.title: Melty Blood
scenarios.description: Melty Blood (メルティブラッド Meruti Buraddo), is a visual novel and fighting game extension of Tsukihime, co-developed by dōjin circles Type-Moon and French-Bread, originally released at Comiket on December 2002.
scenarios.setting: Melty Blood (メルティブラッド Meruti Buraddo), is a visual novel and fighting game extension of Tsukihime, co-developed by dōjin circles Type-Moon and French-Bread, originally released at Comiket on December 2002. ). Based on Type Moon's visual novel game, Tsukihime, it later spawned an arcade version, titled Act Cadenza, that was developed by Ecole Software and has also been ported to the PlayStation 2. Act Cadenza is the first Type-Moon title to receive a console release.

scenarios.title: Men In Black
scenarios.description: Men in Black is a semi-comedic science fiction media franchise that originated with a comic book created by the American author Lowell Cunningham.
scenarios.setting: The most notable agents within the organization are Zed, Jay, and Kay.

scenarios.title: Mercenary Enrollment
scenarios.description: Yu Ijin was the sole survivor of a plane crash when he was little.
scenarios.setting: Yu Ijin was the sole survivor of a plane crash when he was little. After becoming a mercenary to survive for 10 years, he returns to his family in his hometown after regaining his memories, but his former squadron is now hunting him due to being manipulated into believing Ijin is a traitor who faked his own death. Now Ijin Yu must protect his new life as his past life begins to come back to haunt him.

scenarios.title: Meridian 59
scenarios.description: Meridian 59 is a 1996 video game developed by Archetype Interactive and published by The 3DO Company.
scenarios.setting: Meridian 59 is a 1996 video game developed by Archetype Interactive and published by The 3DO Company. It was the first 3D graphical massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) and one of the longest running original online role-playing games. The game was launched online in an early form on December 15, 1995, and released commercially on October 7, 1996, with a flat-rate monthly subscription.

scenarios.title: Metal Gear
scenarios.description: Metal Gear (Japanese: メタルギア Hepburn: Metaru Gia) is a series of action-adventure stealth video games, created by Hideo Kojima and developed and published by Konami.
scenarios.setting: The series is famous for pioneering the stealth game genre, in which the character initially has only one weapon and has to go through the game to accomplish his mission by himself.

scenarios.title: Metal Heroes
scenarios.description: The Metal Hero Series (メタルヒーローシリーズ, Metaru Hīrō Series) is a metaseries of tokusatsu superhero TV series produced by Toei for Japanese television.
scenarios.setting: The Metal Hero Series (メタルヒーローシリーズ, Metaru Hīrō Series) is a metaseries of tokusatsu superhero TV series produced by Toei for Japanese television. The protagonists of the Metal Hero Series are mainly space, military and police-based characters who are typically either androids, cyborgs, or human beings who don "metallic" armored suits. The series revolves around a technological theme where technology, in the right hands, can be used for the greater good.

scenarios.title: Metal Slug
scenarios.description: Metal Slug is a popular video game franchise created by Nazca and now owned by SNK, who created the sequels to the original game.
scenarios.setting: With some exceptions, the games belong to the run 'n' gun genre—sidescroller platform games with shoot em' up elements, where the player must run through a stage while shooting at various enemies.

scenarios.title: Metroid
scenarios.description: It is a series of video games produced by Nintendo.
scenarios.setting: It is a series of video games produced by Nintendo. One of the company's most notable franchises, the series' popularity spans several Nintendo consoles, with the first game, Metroid, released in 1986 for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Despite its popularity, it hasn't been the best in terms of sells, and has died twice as a franchise, once after Super Metroid, and another time after Metroid: Other M. Despite these shortcomings, it still remains as one of Nintendo's primary IPs.

scenarios.title: Mickey Mouse & Friends
scenarios.description: Mickey Mouse & Friends is a cartoon franchise following the adventures of Mickey Mouse and his lively toon companions.
scenarios.setting: Throughout the 80's to 90's, Mickey's world was heavily expanded. Mickey would also see several direct-to-video movies set in this universe such as Mickey's Once Upon a Christmas and Mickey, Donald, Goofy: The Three Musketeers. After its premiere, 2001 would see House of Mouse airing, which was a massive crossover of nearly every single work in the Disney Animated Canon set in Mickey's world.

scenarios.title: Mighty No. 9
scenarios.description: Mighty No. 9 (stylized as Mighty №9) is an action-platform video game by Comcept and directed by renowned producer Keiji Inafune.
scenarios.setting: Mighty No. 9 (stylized as Mighty №9) is an action-platform video game by Comcept and directed by renowned producer Keiji Inafune.

scenarios.title: Millarworld
scenarios.description: Millarworld is a loosely connected comic book universe written primarily by famed Scottish writer Mark Millar, focusing on the superhero genre.
scenarios.setting: Pooling their powers, they remade the world to have no memories of their former heroes outside of comics and movies, with the villains ruling behind the scenes as the all-powerful Fraternity.

scenarios.title: Mimic
scenarios.description: Mimic is a science fiction horror film series directed by Guillermo del Toro, written by del Toro and Matthew Robbins, and starring Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam, Josh Brolin, Charles S.
scenarios.setting: Mimic is a science fiction horror film series directed by Guillermo del Toro, written by del Toro and Matthew Robbins, and starring Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam, Josh Brolin, Charles S. Dutton, Giancarlo Giannini and F. Murray Abraham. The film features Norman Reedus in his Hollywood debut. Related to the franchise is the 1942 short story of the same name, which inspired the film series and the upcoming TV show.

scenarios.title: Minecraft
scenarios.description: Minecraft is a sandbox independent video game originally created by Swedish programmer Markus “Notch” Persson and later developed and published by the Swedish company Mojang.
scenarios.setting: The creative and building aspects of Minecraft allow players to build constructions out of textured cubes in a 3D procedurally generated world. Multiple gameplay modes are available, including survival modes where the player must acquire resources to build the world and maintain health, a creative mode where players have unlimited resources to build with and the ability to fly, and an adventure mode where players play custom maps created by other players.

scenarios.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
scenarios.source: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
scenarios.description: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir (also named LadyBug or Lady Bug, Miraculous, or Miraculous Ladybug) is a CGI animated French series.
scenarios.setting: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir (also named LadyBug or Lady Bug, Miraculous, or Miraculous Ladybug) is a CGI animated French series. It is a co-production by ZAG Animation, Method Animation, Disney Channel EMEA, Toei Animation, SamG Animation, SK Broadband, PGS Entertainment and AB International Distribution. It premiered around the world starting in Fall of 2015. The story takes place in modern-day Paris.

scenarios.title: Mirai Nikki
scenarios.description: Mirai Nikki (未来日記, "Future Diary") is a manga series written and illustrated by Sakae Esuno.
scenarios.setting: Mirai Nikki (未来日記, "Future Diary") is a manga series written and illustrated by Sakae Esuno. It depicts a battle royale in which each combatant has a diary with entries from the future. The manga was serialized in the Kadokawa Shoten's Shōnen Ace between January 2006 and December 2010. Twelve tankōbon volumes were released in Japan.

scenarios.title: Mirror's Edge (Original Continuity)
scenarios.description: Mirror's Edge is a 2008 action-adventure platform video game developed by DICE and published by Electronic Arts.
scenarios.setting: The game is set in a colourful and vibrant metropolis that has been turned into a conformist police-state following a regime that focused on authoritarianism and totalitarianism. As a result, all communication and media in the city is heavily monitored and more restrictions have been put on day-to-day life, sparking resistance through the November Riots.

scenarios.title: MiSide
scenarios.description: MiSide is a survival horror video game in which the player character is unwillingly dragged into an in-universe mobile game.
scenarios.setting: MiSide is a survival horror video game in which the player character is unwillingly dragged into an in-universe mobile game. The game's primary antagonist, Mita, is a rogue NPC who appears to be the player's virtual love interest at first. As the game progresses, the player uncovers the seemingly innocent young woman's true nature and intentions.

scenarios.title: Mission: Yozakura Family
scenarios.description: Mission: Yozakura Family is a manga written and illustrated by Hitsuji Gondaira, that began publishing in Weekly Shonen Jump in 2019.
scenarios.setting: Set in modern-day Japan, where being a spy is a common profession, The story tells the tale of our main character, Taiyo, who has become lonely and socially inept following the deaths of his family.

scenarios.title: Moana (2016 film)
scenarios.description: Moana (also known as Vaiana or Oceania in some markets) is a 2016 American 3D computer-animated musical adventure film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Moana (also known as Vaiana or Oceania in some markets) is a 2016 American 3D computer-animated musical adventure film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Pictures. The film tells the story of Moana, the strong-willed daughter of a chief of a Polynesian village, who is chosen by the ocean itself to reunite a mystical relic with the goddess Te Fiti.

scenarios.title: Mob Psycho 100
scenarios.description: The story focuses on Shigeo Kageyama (a.k.a.
scenarios.setting: a. "Mob") who is an easy to ignore 8th grader with psychic abilities. He could bend spoons and lift objects with his mind from a young age, but he slowly began to withhold from using his abilities in public due to the negative attention he kept receiving and injuring his brother. Now, the only thing he wants is to become friends with a girl in his class, Tsubomi. With his psychic "mentor" (who has no psychic powers), he continues his daily life attempting to realize his purpose in life.

scenarios.title: Monkey Island
scenarios.description: Monkey Island is an adventure game series developed by LucasArts.
scenarios.setting: Monkey Island is an adventure game series developed by LucasArts.

scenarios.title: Monogatari
scenarios.description: The Monogatari series, written by Nisio Isin, follows Koyomi Araragi, a victim of a vampire attack who retains several vampire traits and thus follows his interactions with various girls who also maintain supernatural traits, such as being weightless and defyi
scenarios.setting: The Monogatari series, written by Nisio Isin, follows Koyomi Araragi, a victim of a vampire attack who retains several vampire traits and thus follows his interactions with various girls who also maintain supernatural traits, such as being weightless and defying physics.

scenarios.title: Monster
scenarios.description: Monster (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Naoki Urasawa.
scenarios.setting: The story follows Kenzo Tenma, a Japanese surgeon in Düsseldorf, whose life unravels after encountering Johan Liebert, a former patient.

scenarios.title: Monster House
scenarios.description: Monster House is a 2006 American computer-animated comedy horror film directed by Gil Kenan in his directorial debut and written by Dan Harmon, Rob Schrab and Pamela Pettler, about a neighborhood being terrorized by a sentient haunted house during Halloween.
scenarios.setting: Monster House received a nomination for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, but lost to Happy Feet.

scenarios.title: Monster Hunter
scenarios.description: Monster Hunter is a franchise of fantasy video games that started with the game Monster Hunter for PlayStation 2.
scenarios.setting: Monster Hunter is a franchise of fantasy video games that started with the game Monster Hunter for PlayStation 2. The series is developed and published by Capcom. As the title suggests, the player takes the role of a hunter in a fantasy environment and completes quests by hunting out specific kinds of monsters to kill or capture.

scenarios.title: Monster Musume
scenarios.description: Monster Musume no Iru Ichijou (Daily Life with Monster Girls) is a manga series written and illustrated by Okayado.
scenarios.setting: Monster Musume no Iru Ichijou (Daily Life with Monster Girls) is a manga series written and illustrated by Okayado. The story revolves around Kimihito Kurusu, a Japanese student whose life is thrown into turmoil after accidentally becoming involved with the "Interspecies Cultural Exchange" program.

scenarios.title: Monster Strike
scenarios.description: Monster Strike (モンスターストライク Monsutā Sutoraiku) is a mobile physics game with elements of role-playing, strategy and cooperative multiplayer.
scenarios.setting: Note: Within versus threads, the original poster should specify which incarnation of the monster that is being used.

scenarios.title: Monsters Resurrected
scenarios.description: Monsters Resurrected is an American edutainment television series that premiered on September 13, 2009, on the Discovery Channel.
scenarios.setting: Monsters Resurrected is an American edutainment television series that premiered on September 13, 2009, on the Discovery Channel. The program reconstructs extinct animals of both Mesozoic and Cenozoic. It is also called Mega Beasts.

scenarios.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
scenarios.description: Monsters vs. Aliens is a 2009 American 3D computer-animated monster comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation and distributed by Paramount Pictures. The film was directed by Conrad Vernon and Rob Letterman from a screenplay written by Letterman, Maya Forbes
scenarios.setting: Featuring the voices of Reese Witherspoon, Seth Rogen, Hugh Laurie, Will Arnett, Kiefer Sutherland, Rainn Wilson, Paul Rudd, and Stephen Colbert, the film involves a group of misfit monsters hired by the United States Armed Forces to stop the invasion of an extraterrestrial villain and save the world in exchange for freedom.

scenarios.title: MonsterVerse
scenarios.description: The MonsterVerse, popularly referred to as the Godzilla-Kong Cinematic Universe (MV), is an American media franchise and shared fictional universe that is centered on a series of monster films featuring Godzilla and King Kong, distributed by Warner Bros.
scenarios.setting: The first installment was Godzilla (2014), a reboot of the Godzilla franchise, which was followed by Kong: Skull Island (2017), a reboot of the King Kong franchise, then by Godzilla: King of the Monsters (2019), Godzilla vs.

scenarios.title: Monstroid
scenarios.description: Monstroid is a 1980 American monster movie produced and directed by Kenneth Herts  (as Kenneth Hartford), co-written with Herbert L.
scenarios.setting: Monstroid is a 1980 American monster movie produced and directed by Kenneth Herts (as Kenneth Hartford), co-written with Herbert L. Strock, and starring James Mitchum and John Carradine. Strock later claimed he co-directed the film uncredited. It was originally to be titled Monster when the film was first announced in 1975, and again in 1977, and suffered numerous cast changes (Keenan Wynn was still billed on some of the early video releases).

scenarios.title: Monstrum
scenarios.description: In the 2015 game Monstrum, an unnamed human protagonist awakens atop a vessel, which mysteriously appears to be completely devoid of life...
scenarios.setting: In the 2021 sequel, Monstrum II, various prisoners harvested from all over the world try to escape from Sparrow Lock, a Sea Fort in which a myriad of horrific experiments on humans are being conducted against the wills of the men and women imprisoned there.

scenarios.title: Monty Python
scenarios.description: Monty Python is a comedy series that encompasses a number of movies, television series, and comedy shorts produced by a film production group of the same name.
scenarios.setting: Monty Python is a comedy series that encompasses a number of movies, television series, and comedy shorts produced by a film production group of the same name. Their primary films consist of Monty Python and the Holy Grail, Monty Python's Life of Brian, Monty Python's Flying Circus, and Monty Pyton's Meaning of Life.

scenarios.title: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur
scenarios.description: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur is a Marvel Disney-animated series based on the Marvel Comics duo of the same name.
scenarios.setting: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur is a Marvel Disney-animated series based on the Marvel Comics duo of the same name. The story focuses on 13-year-old super-genius Lunella Lafayette and her ten-ton T-Rex, Devil Dinosaur. After Lunella accidentally brings Devil Dinosaur into present-day New York City via a time vortex, the duo works together to protect the city's Lower East Side from danger.

scenarios.title: MÖRK BORG
scenarios.description: MÖRK BORG is a self-described "pitch-black apocalyptic fantasy RPG about lost souls and fools seeking redemption, forgiveness or the last remaining riches in a bleak and dying world." The game itself focuses on the last remnants of the world as everything is closing in- the known world recedes and humanity hangs on for dear life to the final dregs of civilization.
scenarios.setting: " The game itself focuses on the last remnants of the world as everything is closing in- the known world recedes and humanity hangs on for dear life to the final dregs of civilization. Meanwhile, the undead and the heretical grow ever more present in this dying world, and those that aren't insane turn to religion, which has only prophecies of eschaton and dogmatic world-endings foretold by a pair of two-headed basilisks.

scenarios.title: Mortal Kombat
scenarios.description: Produced by Midway, co-created by Ed Boon and John Tobias, Mortal Kombat is a fighting game that debuted in 1992, it featured a technique known as digitization, in which real actors movements are used as frames for the characters.
scenarios.setting: Produced by Midway, co-created by Ed Boon and John Tobias, Mortal Kombat is a fighting game that debuted in 1992, it featured a technique known as digitization, in which real actors movements are used as frames for the characters. The story of Mortal Kombat is about a tournament held every generation to decide the fate of various realms and features many diverse types of characters, such as undead, cyborgs, sorcerers, gods, etc.

scenarios.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
scenarios.description: Mr. & Mrs. Smith is a 2005 American action comedy film directed by Doug Liman and written by Simon Kinberg. The film stars Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie as a bored upper middle class married couple, who are surprised to learn that they are assassins belonging t
scenarios.setting: Mr. & Mrs. Smith is a 2005 American action comedy film directed by Doug Liman and written by Simon Kinberg. The film stars Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie as a bored upper middle class married couple, who are surprised to learn that they are assassins belonging to competing agencies, leading to their trying to kill each other in order to protect themselves.

scenarios.title: Mr. Bean
scenarios.description: Mr. Bean is a British sitcom created by Rowan Atkinson and Richard Curtis, produced by Tiger Aspect and starring Atkinson as the eponymous title character. The sitcom consists of 15 episodes that were co-written by Atkinson alongside Curtis and Robin Driscoll;
scenarios.setting: Mr. Bean is a British sitcom created by Rowan Atkinson and Richard Curtis, produced by Tiger Aspect and starring Atkinson as the eponymous title character. The sitcom consists of 15 episodes that were co-written by Atkinson alongside Curtis and Robin Driscoll; the pilot was co-written by Ben Elton. The series was originally broadcast on ITV, beginning with the pilot on 1 January 1990 and ending with "The Best Bits of Mr. Bean" on 15 December 1995.

scenarios.title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse
scenarios.description: Trapped in the hellish Underworld, the Entity has set out to torment those responsible for locking it away, those that follow the Divine Flame, so it can be set free once more.
scenarios.setting: Trapped in the hellish Underworld, the Entity has set out to torment those responsible for locking it away, those that follow the Divine Flame, so it can be set free once more. Utilizing demonic dolls given life by ancient artifacts, one bloodline was cursed with continued torment and untimely death until finally the Chosen Ascendant, she bearing the Mark of the Pure, would stand against the Entity.

scenarios.title: Mr. Nutz
scenarios.description: Mr. Nutz is a platformer released in late 1993 for the SNES, and later released on the Mega Drive, the Game Boy, Game Boy Colour and Game Boy Advance. In it, the player controls a red squirrel, also named Mr. Nutz, across six different main stages, with the go
scenarios.setting: Nutz, across six different main stages, with the goal of defeating Mr. Nutz: Hopping Mad', its canonicity is questionable at best due to not only being made by different creators as a recolour of a game they were working on at the time, Tibbett the Flying Squirrel, but Ocean decided not to release it on any other console except the Amiga despite plans to originally.

scenarios.title: Mr. Robot
scenarios.description: Mr. Robot is an American psychological techno-thriller television series created by Sam Esmail for USA Network. It stars Rami Malek as Elliot Alderson, a cybersecurity engineer and hacker with social anxiety disorder, clinical depression, and dissociative iden
scenarios.setting: The group aims to destroy all debt records by encrypting the financial data of E Corp, the largest conglomerate in the world.

scenarios.title: Mr. Zombie
scenarios.description: Mr. Zombie (江思先生 Jiang Si Xiansheng) is a manhua created in 2023 by 朝三暮四郎Brother Three in the Morning and Four at Night (Zhaosan Musilang). Set in a world ravaged by apocalyptic events, the story follows the main character who was turned into a zombie 1,000 ye
scenarios.setting: Mr. Zombie (江思先生 Jiang Si Xiansheng) is a manhua created in 2023 by 朝三暮四郎 Brother Three in the Morning and Four at Night (Zhaosan Musilang). Set in a world ravaged by apocalyptic events, the story follows the main character who was turned into a zombie 1,000 years ago. In a world where humans relentlessly hunt the undead, survival becomes his sole focus. Over the centuries, he honed his skills and trained tirelessly, evolving from an ordinary undead creature to the king of the undead.

scenarios.title: MS Paint Adventures
scenarios.description: MS Paint Adventures is a series of 3 seemingly connected webcomics written by Andrew Hussie.
scenarios.setting: MS Paint Adventures is a series of 3 seemingly connected webcomics written by Andrew Hussie. The 4th one, Homestuck, is entirely separated and became its own franchise.

scenarios.title: MTM (Makoto Mizuta) Verse
scenarios.description: 17-year-old Iguchi Tatsuya has just been released from juvenile detention and is on probation.
scenarios.setting: 17-year-old Iguchi Tatsuya has just been released from juvenile detention and is on probation. He's been relocated to a new area, away from the bad influence of his old friends, and is under the care of his aunt. He is determined not to be sent back to lockup, and he works hard in his aunt's restaurant. However, he still has the same personality, the same tendency to violence, and still falls in with the same sort of people. It's going to be difficult for him to stay out of trouble.

scenarios.title: Mulan (Disney Verse)
scenarios.description: Mulan is a 1998 animated musical comedy-adventure drama film produced by Walt Disney Feature Animation and released by Walt Disney Pictures on June 19, 1998.
scenarios.setting: The 36th animated feature in the Disney Animated Canon and the ninth film in the Disney Renaissance, the film is based on the Chinese legend of Hua Mulan, and was the first of three produced primarily at the animation studio at Disney-MGM Studios in Orlando, Florida.

scenarios.title: Mullet MadJack
scenarios.description: Mullet MadJack features decently strong characters, capable of performing Wall level feats by violently fragmenting other robots into pieces and reaching Supersonic speeds by casually cutting bullets at point-blank range.
scenarios.setting: Mullet MadJack features decently strong characters, capable of performing Wall level feats by violently fragmenting other robots into pieces and reaching Supersonic speeds by casually cutting bullets at point-blank range.

scenarios.title: Multiversus
scenarios.description: Multiversus was a free to play platform fighting game, developed by Player First Games.
scenarios.setting: The game features a multitude of characters from across the multiverse; different series whether that be television, video games or even comics to battle out against each other, with allies, to claim victory!

scenarios.title: Murder Drones
scenarios.description: Murder Drones is an Australian-American computer-animated science, fiction, horror, and comedy web series created by American animator and show-runner Liam Vickers, produced by Glitch Productions, and funded by Screen Australia for GLITCH.
scenarios.setting: Murder Drones is an Australian-American computer-animated science, fiction, horror, and comedy web series created by American animator and show-runner Liam Vickers, produced by Glitch Productions, and funded by Screen Australia for GLITCH.

scenarios.title: Muv-Luv
scenarios.description: Muv-Luv is a visual novel series developed by Age.
scenarios.setting: Not seeing any signs of them he gets a bit worried and goes out of his house only to see the town he lived in all his life in ruins.

scenarios.title: My Adventures with Superman
scenarios.description: My Adventures with Superman is a serialized coming-of-age story catching up with twenty-somethings Clark Kent, the bright and driven Lois Lane, and their best friend Jimmy Olsen as they begin to discover who they are and everything they can accomplish together as an investigative reporting team at the Daily Planet.
scenarios.setting: The story follows Clark as he builds his secret identity as Superman and explores his own mysterious origins.

scenarios.title: My Hero Academia
scenarios.description: is a manga written and illustrated by Kōhei Horikoshi and is published in Weekly Shonen Jump.
scenarios.setting: is a manga written and illustrated by Kōhei Horikoshi and is published in Weekly Shonen Jump. The first chapter was published on July 7, 2014, in issue 32 of Weekly Shonen Jump. The manga is very Westernized, having a similar style to American Comics. People are not born equal, a realization that a 4-year-old Izuku Midoriya faced when bullied by his classmates who had unique special powers. Izuku was one of the rare cases where he was born with absolutely no unique powers.

scenarios.title: My Little Pony
scenarios.description: The franchise My Little Pony is split up into 4 Generations, with the most popular and most powerful being that of Generation 4, Friendship is Magic.
scenarios.setting: The franchise My Little Pony is split up into 4 Generations, with the most popular and most powerful being that of Generation 4, Friendship is Magic. The show follows Twilight Sparkle on her journey to discover the magic of friendship and make friends with 5 other ponies: Rainbow Dash, Applejack, Fluttershy, Rarity and Pinkie Pie.

scenarios.title: My Vampire Older Sister and Zombie Little Sister
scenarios.source: My Vampire Older Sister and Zombie Little Sister
scenarios.description: My Vampire Older Sister and Zombie Little Sister is the name used to refer to a web novel written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by Mahaya.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in a world where supernatural monsters like vampires and zombies exist, being categorized as "Archenemies". The protagonist, Satori Amatsu, lives in Kukyou City, a Disaster Prevention City prone to natural disasters.

scenarios.title: Myst
scenarios.description: Myst is a classic puzzle game developed by Cyan Inc.
scenarios.setting: They take place in the 18th through 19th centuries, and follow humans discovering an ancient civilization known as the D'ni who are descended from beings who were chosen by the creator of the multiverse.

scenarios.title: Nacho Libre
scenarios.description: Nacho Libre is a 2006 comedy film created by Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon Movies about a young friar named Ignacio (Jack Black) becoming a professional wrestler in order to provide for his church's orphanage.
scenarios.setting: Nacho Libre is a 2006 comedy film created by Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon Movies about a young friar named Ignacio (Jack Black) becoming a professional wrestler in order to provide for his church's orphanage.

scenarios.title: NAIR
scenarios.description: NAIR is a series of platform fighting games developed and published by .
scenarios.setting: NAIR is a series of platform fighting games developed and published by Teridax. They are highly simple, only having a singular attack for each game with very little options beyond that. The game was praised for it's implementation of Rollback Netcode in it's online multiplayer, being a feature sought out by fans of the genre. Later on it gained sequels, those being DAIR and the upcoming GRAB, both being based off of other moves commonly seen in platform fighting games.

scenarios.title: Nanatsu no Taizai
scenarios.description: Nanatsu no Taizai (七つの大罪, lit.
scenarios.setting: - Power of the Verse= Nanatsu no Taizai is a verse that varies in strength through Tier 8, Tier 7, Tier 6 and Tier 4 Most low tiers such as the Holy Knights and beginning-of-series Sins are Large Mountain level to Large Mountain level+. The mid tiers like Matrona and the weaker Commandments are Island level to Solar System level.

scenarios.title: Naruto
scenarios.description: The plot follows Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja who desires recognition from his peers and aspires to become the Hokage, the village's chief.
scenarios.setting: The plot follows Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja who desires recognition from his peers and aspires to become the Hokage, the village's chief. Naruto and his companions encounter numerous challenges throughout the story, from minor daily challenges to defending the world from extraterrestrial threats.

scenarios.title: Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Series
scenarios.description: Naruto Ultimate Ninja is a video game franchise developed by CyberConnect2 and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment based on the popular manga and anime series Naruto created by Masashi Kishimoto.
scenarios.setting: Naruto Ultimate Ninja is a video game franchise developed by CyberConnect2 and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment based on the popular manga and anime series Naruto created by Masashi Kishimoto. The story largely retells the Naruto Series with much of its plot following Naruto Uzumaki on his quest to become Hokage, or leader of his village, Konohagakure.

scenarios.title: Nasuverse
scenarios.description: thumb|600px|Nearly every character|center
scenarios.setting: - Summary= The Nasuverse is a collection of fantasy works by Nasu Kinoko, ranging from visual novels, games, and light novels, all of which occur within the same multiverse. Many of them have adaptations and spinoffs of varying quality and canonicity. It's infamous for its complex lore and broken powers. Because of its complexity, much of the information is present within scattered interviews and data books. Although DDD and Canaan were written by Nasu, they are not considered canon to the Nasuverse.

scenarios.title: Naughty Bear
scenarios.description: Naughty Bear is a game series about a bear known as Naughty Bear, and his life at Paradise island.
scenarios.setting: Naughty Bear is a game series about a bear known as Naughty Bear, and his life at Paradise island. Whenever the island is in trouble, whether it be due to the bears, Pirates Invading, or Aliens trying to take over, Naughty Bear does what he feels is necessary to punish the ones who caused the issue, and protect his life and house.

scenarios.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
scenarios.source: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
scenarios.description: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind is a seven volume manga series written by Hayao Miyazaki, and adapted into one of the first movies by aclaimed Studio Ghibli.
scenarios.setting: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind is a seven volume manga series written by Hayao Miyazaki, and adapted into one of the first movies by aclaimed Studio Ghibli. 1000 years after the Seven Days of Fire, great Toxic Jungles have sprung up, in which live gigantic insects. The Valley of the Wind is one of the few places humans can still safely live. It's princess, Nausicaä, has befriended the creatures of the forest, and searches for the cure to the poison, for both humanity and the world.

scenarios.title: Neechan wa Chuunibyou
scenarios.description: Neechan wa Chuunibyou is light novel which follows first year high school student Yuichi Sakaki, who one day suddenly awakens the power of “Soul Reader” within him, which allows him to see words above peoples heads that describe their true nature! With only a
scenarios.setting: Neechan wa Chuunibyou is light novel which follows first year high school student Yuichi Sakaki, who one day suddenly awakens the power of “Soul Reader” within him, which allows him to see words above peoples heads that describe their true nature! With only a glance at the people around him, he sees crazy things like “Zombie”, “Witch”, and “Vampire”… Furthermore within his class he notices that there is even a approached by "Serial Killer".

scenarios.title: Needless
scenarios.description: In the year 2130, half a century after the World War III, Japan is extremely damaged all over, surrounded by several craters known it as Black Spots.
scenarios.setting: In the year 2130, half a century after the World War III, Japan is extremely damaged all over, surrounded by several craters known it as Black Spots. From all this chaos, a new species of humankind rise from the Black Spot, with the name of Needlessness; this new humankind possesses incredible powers called fragments, the fragments of the Second Christ's powers.

scenarios.title: Nekowappa!
scenarios.description: One day, the cat gods of a shrine that is falling out of use find a human baby left outside, all alone.
scenarios.setting: One day, the cat gods of a shrine that is falling out of use find a human baby left outside, all alone. They decide to take in the baby, who they name Tama and raise her as their own. Now the little girl Tama, who knows very little about humans, is trying to grant the wishes of anyone who visits their little shrine, using the power of the cat gods!

scenarios.title: Nemesis Saga
scenarios.description: The Nemesis Saga is a series comprised of six Kaiju thriller novels written by American author Jeremy Robinson, featuring the massive Goddess of Vengeance Nemesis.
scenarios.setting: The Nemesis Saga is a series comprised of six Kaiju thriller novels written by American author Jeremy Robinson, featuring the massive Goddess of Vengeance Nemesis.

scenarios.title: Neopets
scenarios.description: Neopets (originally NeoPets) is a virtual pet website.
scenarios.setting: Neopets allows users to create and care for virtual pets called Neopets and explore the virtual world of Neopia.

scenarios.title: Never Back Down
scenarios.description: The Never Back Down franchise is a series of action films focusing on mixed martial artists.
scenarios.setting: The Never Back Down franchise is a series of action films focusing on mixed martial artists. There are currently four movies, three of which were released direct=to-video. The films include Never Back Down, released in 2008, Never Back Down 2: The Beatdown, released in 2011, Never Back Down: No Surrender, released in 2016, and Never Back Down: Revolt, released in 2021.

scenarios.title: New Earth (DC Comics)
scenarios.description: New Earth (officially Earth-0) is a reality that was created during the Crisis on Infinite Earths, which became the primary reality when the multiverse was reformed.
scenarios.setting: New Earth (officially Earth-0) is a reality that was created during the Crisis on Infinite Earths, which became the primary reality when the multiverse was reformed. From 1986 to 2011, New Earth was the dominant setting for the DC Comics continuity, and reintroduced many characters from the Golden and Silver Age into modern sensibilities, from Superman to Wonder Woman, and introduced new faces that will soon become fan-favourites like Harley Quinn, Lucifer Morningstar, Cassandra Cain and many more.

scenarios.title: Ni no Kuni
scenarios.description: Ni no Kuni (二ノ国, lit. "Second Country") is a series of role-playing video games published by Bandai Namco worldwide and developed and published by Level-5 in Japan. The animated sequences for Dominion of the Dark Djinn and Wrath of the White Witch were produce
scenarios.setting: Ni no Kuni (二ノ国, lit. "Second Country") is a series of role-playing video games published by Bandai Namco worldwide and developed and published by Level-5 in Japan. The animated sequences for Dominion of the Dark Djinn and Wrath of the White Witch were produced by Studio Ghibli, while the artwork was greatly inspired by Studio Ghibli's other productions.

scenarios.title: Nicktoons
scenarios.description: The Nicktoons verse is a collection of video games based mainly around a group of 4 prominent Nickelodeon characters, SpongeBob SquarePants, Danny Phantom, Jimmy Neutron, and Timmy Turner, who go up against various foes from their shows and more.
scenarios.setting: The Nicktoons verse is a collection of video games based mainly around a group of 4 prominent Nickelodeon characters, SpongeBob SquarePants, Danny Phantom, Jimmy Neutron, and Timmy Turner, who go up against various foes from their shows and more. The games also feature other noticeable Nickelodeon characters from other series. Note: "Nicktoons" is also used to refer to the television channel. However, this page is strictly for the video games and has no connection to the television channel.

scenarios.title: NieR
scenarios.description: NieR is an action role-playing video game developed by Platinum Games and published by Square Enix.
scenarios.setting: It is the indirect sequel to both NieR RepliCant and NieR Gestalt (NIER) and is set in the year 11945, during the 14th Machine War. - Power of the Verse= Despite its appearance, Nier is a fairly powerful universe, most characters in the Mountain echelon, and have FTL+ reactions and combat speed. Even those with more primitive technology could contend with advanced technology through the use of magic.

scenarios.title: Night at the Museum
scenarios.description: Night at the Museum is a trilogy series about a man named Larry Daley who picks up a job at a Museum, where at night, the artifacts come to life.
scenarios.setting: Throughout the movies, he faces many problems including, the old guards trying to steal The Golden Tablet of Pharaoh Ahkmenrah and pin it on him, Kahmunrah trying to take over the world, as well as other things.

scenarios.title: Night of the Living Dead
scenarios.description: The Living Dead series is a series of six zombie horror films created by George A.
scenarios.setting: The Living Dead series is a series of six zombie horror films created by George A. Romero beginning with the 1968 film "Night of the Living Dead" directed by Romero and co-written with John A. Russo. The franchise predominantly centers on different groups of people attempting to survive during the outbreak and evolution of a zombie apocalypse.

scenarios.title: Nightmare Creatures
scenarios.description: Nightmare Creatures is a 3D action adventure, survival horror video game released for the Sony PlayStation and PC in 1997, and Nintendo 64 in 1998.
scenarios.setting: The story begins in 1666, when a devil-worshipping cult called The Brotherhood of Hecate were conducting sinister experiments in London so as to take over the city, and then the world. The game takes place in 1834 when London falls victim to several evil occurrences. Jean Franciscus of New Orleans, who shows up with his daughter Nadia Franciscus in town.

scenarios.title: Nightmare Funk
scenarios.description: Kurusu Hiyori is a young policewoman and the daughter of a former police chief.
scenarios.setting: Kurusu Hiyori is a young policewoman and the daughter of a former police chief. She has the unusual curse of having predictive dreams of a person's murder the following day. Tragically, the first of these dreams she experienced showed her the death of her own father. Over time, the dreams have led to her social isolation, a kind of grim-reaper reputation, and a lot of problems at work-- the police are not fond of her habit of rushing off to investigate future crimes she saw in her dreams.

scenarios.title: Nightmare Soup
scenarios.description: Nightmare Soup is a horror series written by Jake Tri and illustrated by Andy Sciazko.
scenarios.setting: Nightmare Soup is a horror series written by Jake Tri and illustrated by Andy Sciazko. Inspired by Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark, the two books are anthology horror books that consist of stories that are meant to scary kids and adults alike.

scenarios.title: Nightmares of Alamir
scenarios.description: Nightmares of Alamir is a LitRPG book saga written and done by Noam Oswin.
scenarios.setting: - Power of the Verse= As a whole, Nightmares of Alamir is a fairly strong verse in terms of abilities and techniques prowess thanks to having a leveling system within the world.

scenarios.title: NiGHTS
scenarios.description: The NiGHTS series started in 1996 with the release of NiGHTS into Dreams for the SEGA Saturn.
scenarios.setting: The NiGHTS series started in 1996 with the release of NiGHTS into Dreams for the SEGA Saturn. A sequel titled Christmas NiGHTS into Dreams, also known as Christmas NiGHTS or Christmas NiGHTS Sampler, was a promotional sampler disc of NiGHTS into Dreams that was originally released during the 1996 holiday season for the SEGA Saturn. The triquel and most recent game of the series is NiGHTS: Journey of Dreams which was released for the Wii in 2007.

scenarios.title: Ninjago
scenarios.description: Ninjago is a line of construction toys manufactured by the Lego company.
scenarios.setting: On their travels, they discover the origins of the world and fight foes from across the multiverse whilst gaining new allies, including Lloyd Garmadon, the green ninja who is destined to inherit the powers of his grandfather and defeat The Overlord, and Kai's sister Nya, the Elemental Master of Water.

scenarios.title: Nintendo
scenarios.description: Nintendo is a Japanese electronics and gaming company, and the world's longest running and most successful one.
scenarios.setting: Nintendo is a Japanese electronics and gaming company, and the world's longest running and most successful one. It started off as a hit, ending the Video Game Crash of 1983. The first system was the Famicom, known as the Nintendo Entertainment System outside of Japan. After that, things took off, and the company never looked back. It has dozens of systems, scores of franchises, hundreds of titles, and innumerable characters under its belt.

scenarios.title: Nipponverse
scenarios.description: Nippon Ichi is a Japanese video game developer and publisher.
scenarios.setting: Nippon Ichi is a Japanese video game developer and publisher. They are responsible for such titles as Disgaea: Hour of Darkness and its sequels, Phantom Brave, La Pucelle: Tactics, and Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure. The Disgaea series is the most popular Nippon Ichi franchise, and it also expanded to have spin-off titles as well as an anime series based on the first game. More recently, particularly through their North American branch, NIS America, they have also published anime titles.

scenarios.title: Nisekoi
scenarios.description: Nisekoi (ニセコイ, Fake Love), released in English as Nisekoi: False Love, is a Japanese romantic comedy manga series written and illustrated by Naoshi Komi.
scenarios.setting: Nisekoi (ニセコイ, Fake Love), released in English as Nisekoi: False Love, is a Japanese romantic comedy manga series written and illustrated by Naoshi Komi.

scenarios.title: No Game No Life
scenarios.description: No Game No Life is a light novel series by Yuu Kamiya.
scenarios.setting: The series follows the adventures of step siblings Sora and Shiro as they get summoned by a God named Tet to an alternate world where everything is decided by games.

scenarios.title: No Man's Sky
scenarios.description: No Man's Sky is a 2016 open world title developed by Hello Games.
scenarios.setting: No Man's Sky is a 2016 open world title developed by Hello Games. Despite originally overwhelmingly critical reviews due to failing to deliver on much of it's promises, many updates have brought the game to a point of having a large and dedicated fanbase. In game, you awaken as a being known as The Last Traveller with no memory of the past. You are expected to repair your ship and explore the cosmos, and make contact with the cosmic deity known as ATLAS.

scenarios.title: No Straight Roads
scenarios.description: No Straight Roads is a rhythm-based action-adventure game developed by Malaysian studio Metronomik and published by Sold Out.
scenarios.setting: In Vinyl City, the music capital of the world, indie rock band Bunk Bed Junction, who is Mayday and Zuke, was about to impress the CEO Tatiana and some of the superstars from NSR. The duo plan to start a music revolution against the dominance of NSR and its EDM music on Vinyl City by crashing their concerts and performances with the power of rock.

scenarios.title: No, I'm Not a Human
scenarios.description: No, I'm Not a Human is a first-person horror visual novel video game developed by Russian studio Trioskaz and published by Critical Reflex.
scenarios.setting: If they are allowed inside the player's house, it is possible to further examine them.

scenarios.title: Noisy Tenant
scenarios.description: Noisy Tenant is the name of the expanded universe and setting created by Jonathan Wojcik, with its most notable story being Awful Hospital: Seriously the Worst Ever.
scenarios.setting: Noisy Tenant is the name of the expanded universe and setting created by Jonathan Wojcik, with its most notable story being Awful Hospital: Seriously the Worst Ever. The plot revolves around a mother trapped in the Hospital, an alternate and much different zone based on the concept of hospitals and medicine. There, she begins searching for her incredibly ill son.

scenarios.title: Noragami
scenarios.description: Noragami (ノラガミ, lit. Stray God) is a fantasy manga series written by Adachitoka. It began serialization in the January 2011 issue of Kodansha's Monthly Shōnen Magazine. An anime adaptation by Bones contained two seasons for a total of 25 episodes, with additio
scenarios.setting: Noragami (ノラガミ, lit. Stray God) is a fantasy manga series written by Adachitoka. It began serialization in the January 2011 issue of Kodansha's Monthly Shōnen Magazine. An anime adaptation by Bones contained two seasons for a total of 25 episodes, with additional OVAs for each season. The series has also been adapted into two stage plays.

scenarios.title: Nosferatu
scenarios.description: Nosferatu (ノスフェラトゥ) is a horror-themed action platform game developed and published by SETA Corporation for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System.
scenarios.setting: The player controls a young man known as Kyle, who rides to the vampire Nosferatu's castle in order to defeat him and save his beloved girlfriend Erin from his clutches.

scenarios.title: Nuclear Throne
scenarios.description: Nuclear Throne is a post-apocalyptic roguelike-like top-down shooter created by  .
scenarios.setting: In the said game, you play as your pick from a cast of mutants as they fight through the world picking up radiation to mutate and become stronger.

scenarios.title: Nurarihyon no Mago
scenarios.description: Rikuo Nura, a kid that is part human and a quarter youkai (demon), lives in a house full of spirits along with his youkai grandfather.
scenarios.setting: Rikuo Nura, a kid that is part human and a quarter youkai (demon), lives in a house full of spirits along with his youkai grandfather. Trying to escape his fate of acting like a demon, he does good deeds in order to avoid becoming one despite his grandfather's wish to succeed him as master of the Nura youkai clan.

scenarios.title: Octopath Traveler
scenarios.description: Octopath Traveler is a JRPG made by Square Enix.
scenarios.setting: Octopath Traveler is a JRPG made by Square Enix. And has 2 mainline games and a spinoff. Each mainline game follows the separate stories of eight characters whose first initials spell out the word OCTOPATH. The player is given an option to pick one of the starting characters to start off with, and then pick up on the stories of the other characters later. scenarios.setting: Pac-Man (Japanese: パックマン ー Hepburn: Pakkuman) is an arcade game designed by Toru Iwatani, created by the company Namco and first released in Japan as Puck Man in May 1980. Licensed for distribution in the United States by Midway Games, it was released in October 1980 when top arcade games were stark space shooters, such as Space Invaders, Galaxian and Asteroids. Pac-Man established the conventions of the maze chase genre, and is considered one of the classics of the medium and an icon of 1980s popular culture.

The Poeverse also was an influence to other writers, such as H. P.

scenarios.title: Pokémon
scenarios.description: Pokémon is a video game franchise owned by Nintendo and developed by Game Freak that made its first release on the Game Boy and has turned into one of the most successful video-game media franchises ever made by Nintendo.
scenarios.setting: Pokémon is a video game franchise owned by Nintendo and developed by Game Freak that made its first release on the Game Boy and has turned into one of the most successful video-game media franchises ever made by Nintendo. The series involves creatures of different types and elements fighting each other in a rock-paper-scissors-like fashion, with the player trying to catch and train them.

scenarios.title: Pop Team Epic
scenarios.description: Pop Team Epic (ポプテピピック Romaji: Poputepipikku), also known as Poptepipic, is a surreal comedy four-panel webcomic and digital manga series written and illustrated by Bukubu Okawa (also known as bkub Okawa)
scenarios.setting: Pop Team Epic (ポプテピピック Romaji: Poputepipikku), also known as Poptepipic, is a surreal comedy four-panel webcomic and digital manga series written and illustrated by Bukubu Okawa (also known as bkub Okawa)

scenarios.title: Popeye
scenarios.description: Popeye (also known as Thimble Theatre) is a media franchise, which was created by E.
scenarios.setting: Popeye (also known as Thimble Theatre) is a media franchise, which was created by E. C. Segar as a daily King Features comic strip in 1919 before the sailor himself appeared as a supporting character 10 years later, quickly becoming the main focus of the strip and Thimble Theatre became one of King Features's most popular properties during the 1930s. It was continued after Segar's death in 1938 by several writers and artists, most notably Segar's assistant Bud Sagendorf.
