Segar's original Thimble Theatre comic strips. The oneshot Mars Attacks Popeye is also set in this continuity.

scenarios.title: Poppy Playtime
scenarios.description: Poppy Playtime is an indie survival horror game developed by MOB Games.
scenarios.setting: The Player takes the role of a former employee, who returns to an abandoned toy factory a decade after all it's workers mysteriously disappeared.

scenarios.title: Postal
scenarios.description: POSTAL is a series of shooter video games created by Running with Scissors known for its high-speed gameplay, violence and off-color humor.
scenarios.setting: POSTAL is a series of shooter video games created by Running with Scissors known for its high-speed gameplay, violence and off-color humor. The series' mainline games span several shooter sub-genres, including top-down shooters (POSTAL and its remake, POSTAL Redux), first-person shooters (POSTAL 2 and POSTAL 4: No Regerts), and a third-person shooter (POSTAL III). The series has spawned several spin-off games and other media, including an eponymous film adaptation by Uwe Boll.

scenarios.title: Power (Starz)
scenarios.description: Power is a Starz crime drama TV series that ran from 2014–2020 and follows James "Ghost" St.
scenarios.setting: Power is a Starz crime drama TV series that ran from 2014–2020 and follows James "Ghost" St. Patrick, a wealthy New York City nightclub owner who also leads a double life as a drug kingpin. The show stars Omari Hardwick as Ghost, Joseph Sikora as his brother in arms Tommy Egan, and Naturi Naughton as his wife Tasha St. Patrick. The series explores the glamorous lives of the rich and famous in Manhattan, while also delving into the international drug trade underworld.

scenarios.title: Power Rangers
scenarios.description: Power Rangers is a long-running American entertainment meta franchise and merchandising franchise built around a live-action television series targeted at a younger audience featuring teams of costumed heroes.
scenarios.setting: Throughout the series, the Power Rangers learn the importance of teamwork and perseverance as they battle harder-to-defeat villains.

scenarios.title: Preacher (TV Series)
scenarios.description: Preacher is an television series developed by Sam Catlin, Evan Goldberg and Seth Rogen, and based off of the Preacher comic book series created by Garth Ennis and Steve Dillon, which was published under the DC/Vertigo imprint.
scenarios.setting: Preacher is an television series developed by Sam Catlin, Evan Goldberg and Seth Rogen, and based off of the Preacher comic book series created by Garth Ennis and Steve Dillon, which was published under the DC/Vertigo imprint. In the show, Jesse Custer, the show's titular preacher, becomes the host for Genesis, an extraordinary power that supposedly rivals Gods.

scenarios.title: Predator (Franchise)
scenarios.description: Predator is a science-fiction action media franchise centered on the film series depicting mankind's encounters with a race of extraterrestrial trophy hunters known as "Predators" who travel the galaxy seeking dangerous quarry to hunt for sport and honor.
scenarios.setting: Predator is a science-fiction action media franchise centered on the film series depicting mankind's encounters with a race of extraterrestrial trophy hunters known as "Predators" who travel the galaxy seeking dangerous quarry to hunt for sport and honor. The events of the series transpire during the 20th and 21st centuries and, throughout the series, mercenaries and corporations encounter the alien creatures and pursue them for different reasons.

scenarios.title: Prehistoric Park
scenarios.description: Prehistoric Park is a pseudo-documentary/TV show focusing on Nigel Marven, as he travels back in time to bring back prehistoric creature and preserve them in the Prehistoric Park wildlife sanctuary.
scenarios.setting: Prehistoric Park is a pseudo-documentary/TV show focusing on Nigel Marven, as he travels back in time to bring back prehistoric creature and preserve them in the Prehistoric Park wildlife sanctuary. The series is a Spin-Off series of the BBC produced TV pseudo-documentaries, The Trilogy of Life.

scenarios.title: PRESSURE
scenarios.description: PRESSURE is a ROBLOX multi-player horror game, mostly inspired by DOORS, Iron Lung, ULTRAKILL, and SCP: Containment Breach.
scenarios.setting: PRESSURE is a ROBLOX multi-player horror game, mostly inspired by DOORS, Iron Lung, ULTRAKILL, and SCP: Containment Breach.

scenarios.title: Preston’s Hourglass
scenarios.description: Preston’s Hourglass is the indie  created in 2023 on the 7th of October by Dreadful Studios.
scenarios.setting: Preston’s Hourglass is the indie  created in 2023 on the 7th of October by Dreadful Studios.

scenarios.title: Pretty Cure
scenarios.description: Pretty Cure (Dubbed "Glitter Force" in it's English Adaptation of Smile Pretty Cure and Doki Doki Pretty Cure) is a long-running Japanese magical girl anime series produced by Izumi Todo and Toei Animation.
scenarios.setting: Pretty Cure (Dubbed "Glitter Force" in it's English Adaptation of Smile Pretty Cure and Doki Doki Pretty Cure) is a long-running Japanese magical girl anime series produced by Izumi Todo and Toei Animation. Each entry centers around a group of girls, who are often teenagers in middle or high school, that have the ability to transform into the legendary warriors known as the Pretty Cure in order to fight against corrupted beings and evil forces that threaten the Earth and many different worlds.

scenarios.title: Primal (Cartoon)
scenarios.description: Primal is an American adult animated television series created and directed by Genndy Tartakovsky for Adult Swim.
scenarios.setting: This version was submitted in the Animated Feature Film category for the 92nd Academy Awards, but it was not nominated.

scenarios.title: Primal Carnage
scenarios.description: Primal Carnage is an asymmetrical, class-based, online multiplayer PC game released in October 2012, created by indie development team Lukewarm Media and released by Reverb Publishing.
scenarios.setting: Primal Carnage is an asymmetrical, class-based, online multiplayer PC game released in October 2012, created by indie development team Lukewarm Media and released by Reverb Publishing. The game pits a group of armed humans against predatory dinosaurs in various combat scenarios. Human gameplay takes the form of a first-person shooter, whilst the dinosaurs are controlled from a third-person perspective.

scenarios.title: Primal Rage
scenarios.description: Primal Rage is a fighting game created by Atari Games in 1994.
scenarios.setting: Primal Rage is a fighting game created by Atari Games in 1994. In the storyline, a colossal meteor strikes Earth, completely wiping out human civilization, causing mankind to regress into primitive tribes like those from the Stone Age and rearranging the surface of the planet itself.

scenarios.title: Prime Earth (DC Comics)
scenarios.description: Prime Earth (officially known as Earth-0), is a reality that was created during the Flashpoint event and subsequently featured in the New 52 relaunch of DC Comics.
scenarios.setting: Prime Earth (officially known as Earth-0), is a reality that was created during the Flashpoint event and subsequently featured in the New 52 relaunch of DC Comics. Beginning in 2011, the universe was the second line-wide continuity reset for DC since the genesis of New Earth, and is the present main continuity for DC storytelling.

scenarios.title: Primeval
scenarios.description: Primeval is a British TV series produced by Impossible Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Primeval is a British TV series produced by Impossible Pictures. It chronicles the efforts of ARC, a group formed to track and respond to Anomalies, tears in 4th-dimensional spacetime that allow organisms to pass from one time period in Earth's history to another. The series is ongoing but on hiatus, with the fifth season currently being the latest.

scenarios.title: Prince of Persia
scenarios.description: Prince of Persia is a video game franchise created by Jordan Mechner, originally developed and published by Brøderbund, then The Learning Company, and currently Ubisoft.
scenarios.setting: Prince of Persia is a video game franchise created by Jordan Mechner, originally developed and published by Brøderbund, then The Learning Company, and currently Ubisoft. The franchise is built around a series of action-adventure games focused on various incarnations of the eponymous prince. The series's first games, Prince of Persia and Prince of Persia 2: The Shadow and the Flame, were published by Brøderbund.

scenarios.title: Princess Tutu
scenarios.description: Princess Tutu (Japanese: プリンセスチュチュ, Hepburn: Purinsesu Chuchu) is a Japanese anime television series created by Ikuko Itoh and directed by Junichi Sato and Shogo Koumoto.
scenarios.setting: Inspired by ballet and fairy tales, particularly The Ugly Duckling and Swan Lake, its story follows a duck who is transformed into the mythical ballerina Princess Tutu in order to save the shattered heart of a storybook prince come to life.

scenarios.title: Prison Break
scenarios.description: Prison Break is a thrilling TV series that revolves around the protagonist, Michael Scofield, who deliberately commits a crime to get himself incarcerated in the high-security Fox River State Penitentiary in order to help his wrongly accused brother, Lincoln Burrows, escape from death row.
scenarios.setting: The series unfolds within the confines of the prison, which is fraught with dangerous inmates, corrupt guards, and a complex hierarchy. Michael's plan involves intricate tattoos on his body that hold crucial information and a network of allies both inside and outside the prison.

scenarios.title: Problem Solverz
scenarios.description: The Problem Solverz is a cartoon series that first aired on Cartoon Network in 2011, with a second season airing in 2013 exclusive to Netflix until it was removed, making it what is considered lost media.
scenarios.setting: The story follows a group of heroes who come up with bizarre solutions for wacky "problems" throughout their town.

scenarios.title: Professional Wrestling
scenarios.description: WWE: World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc., commonly shortened to its trade name WWE, is an American professional wrestling promotion.
scenarios.setting: NJPW biggest show of the year is Wrestle Kingdom which takes place at Tokyo Dome every January.

scenarios.title: Project Moon
scenarios.description: Project Moon is a South Korean indie video game studio which has created a fictional universe consisting of the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, and Limbus Company, in addition to the written works Wonderlab, The Distortion Detective, and Leviathan.
scenarios.setting: Project Moon is a South Korean indie video game studio which has created a fictional universe consisting of the games Lobotomy Corporation, Library of Ruina, and Limbus Company, in addition to the written works Wonderlab, The Distortion Detective, and Leviathan. The setting concerns a dystopian, cyberpunk future primarily centered in a megacity simply titled The City. It follows a variety of perspectives and settings in a harsh world where mercenaries are as common as sallarymen and corporations rule.

scenarios.title: Project Zomboid
scenarios.description: Project Zomboid is a zombie survival simulator developed and published by The Indie Stone.
scenarios.setting: Project Zomboid is a zombie survival simulator developed and published by The Indie Stone.

scenarios.title: Prototype
scenarios.description: Prototype is a 2009 video game developed by Radical Entertainment and published by Activision.
scenarios.setting: Prototype is a 2009 video game developed by Radical Entertainment and published by Activision. The game was released in North America on June 9, 2009, and in southwestern parts of North America as well as on June 10, and was released in Europe on June 12. Set in New York City, the game follows a powerful amnesiac named Alex Mercer who must stop an outbreak of Blacklight, a plague that mutates individuals into hideous violent monsters.

scenarios.title: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy
scenarios.description: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy is a video game, third person shooter developed by Midway Games and released for the Xbox and PlayStation 2.
scenarios.setting: He escapes and slowly begins to regain his memories and powers throughout the game while battling against his former partners and his mentor who have gone rogue.

scenarios.title: Psycho-Pass
scenarios.description: Psycho-Pass (Japanese: サイコパス Hepburn: Saiko Pasu, stylized as PSYCHO-PASS) is an anime television series that was produced by Production I.G, directed by Naoyoshi Shiotani and Katsuyuki Motohiro and written by Gen Urobuchi.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in an authoritarian future dystopia, where omnipresent public sensors continuously scan the mental states of every passing citizen.

scenarios.title: Psyren
scenarios.description: PSYЯEN follows the adventures of Ageha Yoshina, a high school student who is chosen by Nemesis Q as a participant in the Psyren games.
scenarios.setting: PSYЯEN follows the adventures of Ageha Yoshina, a high school student who is chosen by Nemesis Q as a participant in the Psyren games. The games take place in a world known initially as Psyren, which is revealed to be the real world a decade in the future. Ageha and his friends attempt to alter the future and save the world from becoming Psyren.

scenarios.title: Pucca
scenarios.description: Pucca (뿌까, Ppukka) is a franchise created by VOOZ.
scenarios.setting: Pucca (뿌까, Ppukka) is a franchise created by VOOZ. She has starred in e-cards, web animations, games, a TV show made by Jetix, and a South Korean TV show titled Pucca: Love Recipe.

scenarios.title: Puella Magi Verse
scenarios.description: For detailed information about this franchise, visit the Puella Magi Wiki.
scenarios.setting: For detailed information about this franchise, visit the Puella Magi Wiki.

scenarios.title: Pulgasari
scenarios.description: Pulgasari (Korean: 불가사리; RR: Bulgasari) is a 1985 North Korean horror-action kaiju film directed by Shin Sang-ok.
scenarios.setting: Pulgasari (Korean: 불가사리; RR: Bulgasari) is a 1985 North Korean horror-action kaiju film directed by Shin Sang-ok. It stars Chang Son Hui and Pak Sung Ho and features special effects by Duk Ho Kim, supervised by Teruyoshi Nakano. The film centers around the legend of the Bulgasari and is based on the lost 1962 film from South Korea of the same name.

scenarios.title: Pulseman
scenarios.description: Pulseman is a Platform Game released for the Sega Genesis developed by Game Freak and released in 1994.
scenarios.setting: Pulseman's dual nature allows him to freely travel through the real world and cyberspace, and he can control electricity. In the year 2015, the mysterious Galaxy Gang led by Doc Waruyama starts a series of crimes across the world to conquer the galaxy.

scenarios.title: Pumpkin Night
scenarios.description: The manga follows a deranged girl named Naoko Kirino who adopts the name “Pumpkin Night” when she escapes from a mental hospital by killing all the nurses and patients.
scenarios.setting: The manga follows a deranged girl named Naoko Kirino who adopts the name “Pumpkin Night” when she escapes from a mental hospital by killing all the nurses and patients. She goes out into the world, seeking bloody vengeance against a group of teenagers who played a prank on her and ruined her life back in middle school.

scenarios.title: Pumpkin Scissors
scenarios.description: Pumkin Scissors is a manga by Iwanaga Ryoutarou.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in a fictional world resembling inter-war Western Europe.

scenarios.title: Punch-Out!!
scenarios.description: Punch-Out!! is a video game series of boxing.
scenarios.setting: Punch-Out!! is a video game series of boxing. , which was followed by a sequel called Super Punch-Out!!.

scenarios.title: Punishing: Gray Raven
scenarios.description: Punishing Gray Raven is an online, free-to-play, 3D action role-playing mobile game developed and published by Kuro Games based on the game engine Unity3D.
scenarios.setting: Punishing Gray Raven is an online, free-to-play, 3D action role-playing mobile game developed and published by Kuro Games based on the game engine Unity3D. The game is the second production of Kuro Game's "Twintails in Battlefield" (“战场双马尾”) franchise, and was first released in China on December 5, 2019 for Android and iOS. The global version of the game was released on July 16, 2021. The story is set in a post-apocalyptic world in which mankind is almost extinct.

scenarios.title: Puyo Puyo
scenarios.description: Puyo Puyo is a verse revolving around a strategy-based puzzle game.
scenarios.setting: While there was originally one world (the world created by Compile), Sega created a new world (Amitie's world) when they took over the rights to the Puyo Puyo franchise. This would then be followed up by a third world (Ringo's world) upon the release of Puyo Puyo 7.

scenarios.title: Radiant
scenarios.description: Radiant is manga-inspired comic book series from France that is written and Illustrated by Tony Valente.
scenarios.setting: Radiant is manga-inspired comic book series from France that is written and Illustrated by Tony Valente. Nemeses — powerful and mysterious demonic entities that fall from the sky and vaporize anything they touch. The only ones who can combat these creatures are sorcerers, those who have survived an encounter with a Nemesis, but were infected in the process. Seth, a Sorcerer from Pompo Hills, sets out on an adventure to exterminate all these Nemeses.

scenarios.title: Radiant Historia
scenarios.description: Radiant Historia is a Japanese Role-Playing Game for the Nintendo DS, developed and published by Atlus.
scenarios.setting: With this power in his hands, he must travel back and forth through key events and an entirely alternate timeline to right the world's ill-fated course.

scenarios.title: Rage of Bahamut: Genesis
scenarios.description: Rage of Bahamut Genesis and its continuation Rage of Bahamut Virgin Soul are the anime adaptation to the online card game Rage of Bahamut by Cygames.
scenarios.setting: The series follows a young bounty hunter named Favaro who meets the mysterious young girl Amira who asks him to be her guide to a location she has set her mind on visiting and their adventure through a world of gods, demons and other fantastical creatures.

scenarios.title: Rain
scenarios.description: The small country Sunkwoll is in a tight spot because it's under attack of the great country Zarmine.
scenarios.setting: The small country Sunkwoll is in a tight spot because it's under attack of the great country Zarmine.

scenarios.title: Rain World
scenarios.description: Rain World is a challenging survival platformer set in a complex, apocalyptic ecosystem where you play as a slugcat trying to survive.
scenarios.setting: Rain World is a challenging survival platformer set in a complex, apocalyptic ecosystem where you play as a slugcat trying to survive. Separated from your family, you must navigate a dangerous world, find food to hibernate before deadly rainstorms, and avoid numerous predators that see you as both predator and prey. The game is known for its high difficulty, lack of hand-holding, and subtle, atmospheric world-building that reveals its lore through gameplay and exploration.

scenarios.title: Rainbow Friends
scenarios.description: The Gameplay of Rainbow Friends is fairly simple.
scenarios.setting: The Gameplay of Rainbow Friends is fairly simple. Before the game starts, Players have to stand inside a circle to enter the game. A maximum of 15 Players can join the circle. After the countdown is over, The Players enter the game. Inside the game, the Players have to collect items while avoiding different monsters.

scenarios.title: Rambo
scenarios.description: Rambo is an American media franchise centered on a series of action films.
scenarios.setting: Rambo is an American media franchise centered on a series of action films. There have been five films released so far in the series: First Blood (1982), Rambo: First Blood Part II (1985), Rambo III (1988), Rambo (2008) and Rambo: Last Blood (2019). The films follow John Rambo, a US Army veteran played by Sylvester Stallone, who is traumatized by his experience in the Vietnam War, and uses the skills he gained there to fight corrupt police officers, enemy troops and drug cartels.

scenarios.title: Rampage
scenarios.description: Rampage was originally an arcade game released in 1986 that involved multiple humans who had mutated into monsters destroying buildings.
scenarios.setting: Rampage was originally an arcade game released in 1986 that involved multiple humans who had mutated into monsters destroying buildings. Due to its popularity, it has been given many sequels on consoles along with a feature-length film.

scenarios.title: Randy Cunningham: 9th Grade Ninja
scenarios.description: Randy Cunningham: 9th Grade Ninja is an animated series created by Jed Elinoff and Scott Thomas.
scenarios.setting: The story follows a teenage boy named Randy Cunningham who becomes The Ninja, a hero who has protected the town of Norrisville for over 800 years against an evil being known as The Sorcerer.

scenarios.title: Rango
scenarios.description: Rango is a 2011 animated western directed by Gore Verbinski and produced by Nickelodeon Movies, and centers around the adventures of a chameleon within Dirt, a town in the middle of Mojave Desert populated by animals, all with a heavy metanarrative.
scenarios.setting: Rango is a 2011 animated western directed by Gore Verbinski and produced by Nickelodeon Movies, and centers around the adventures of a chameleon within Dirt, a town in the middle of Mojave Desert populated by animals, all with a heavy metanarrative. The film won the 84th Academy Awards' Best Animated Feature, and has garnered critical acclaim for its surrealistic writing, humor and visual style.

scenarios.title: Ratchet & Clank
scenarios.description: Ratchet & Clank is a series of action platformer and third-person shooter video games.
scenarios.setting: The games take place in a science fiction setting and follow the adventures of Ratchet (a feline-like humanoid known as a Lombax, who is a mechanic) and Clank (a diminutive, sentient Zoni robot) as they travel through the universe, saving it from evil forces that consistently threaten it.

scenarios.title: Ratman
scenarios.description: Ratman is also is known as The Smallest Hero manga written and illustrated by INUI Sekihiko.
scenarios.setting: Ratman is also is known as The Smallest Hero manga written and illustrated by INUI Sekihiko. The actions happen in modern Japan where for several years Superheros have appeared. With technological advancements from recent years has allowed corporations to design all sorts of heroes, igniting widespread public interest. An era where the Superheroes are commercialized.

scenarios.title: RAVE
scenarios.description: RAVE/Rave Master is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima.
scenarios.setting: RAVE/Rave Master is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima. The series follows Haru Glory, a teenager on a quest to find the five pieces of the sacred stone Rave in order to bring peace to the world by defeating the criminal group Demon Card. In 0015, the world is corrupted by Dark Bring, dark stones that bestow powerful magic with different abilities to their owners.

scenarios.title: Raw Metal
scenarios.description: Raw metal is an indie game made by Team Crucible and was released on 19th March 2024.
scenarios.setting: Raw metal is an indie game made by Team Crucible and was released on 19th March 2024. It combines both stealth and beat'em up style action with a rogue-like elements. You are The Scavenger and your main objective is to infiltrate a mining facility, Katabase-6, and stop the evil mega-corporation, Orpheus Technologies, from mining the exoplanet, Charybdis, from all its resources and turning them into weapons of mass destruction.

scenarios.title: Re:Creators
scenarios.description: Re:Creators is an anime and manga series which follows High School student Sota, who, while watching the anime Elemental Symphony of Vogelchevalier, suddenly finds himself drawn into it.
scenarios.setting: After returning to his world, the heroine of Elemental Symphony of Vogelchevalier, Selesia Uptiria, also returns with him back to his world. Several characters from anime, manga, and video games are being transported, into the realm of the gods, as they have been transported into the world in which their creators reside.

scenarios.title: Ready Player One
scenarios.description: Ready Player One is a 2018 American science fiction adventure film produced and directed by Steven Spielberg, and written by Zak Penn and Ernest Cline, based on Cline's 2011 novel of the same name.
scenarios.setting: The film takes place in 2045, when much of humanity uses the virtual reality software OASIS (Ontologically Anthropocentric Sensory Immersive Simulation) to escape the desolation of the real world. It also received nominations at the 91st Academy Awards, 24th Critics' Choice Awards, and 72nd British Academy Film Awards, all for visual effects

scenarios.title: Real Steel
scenarios.description: Real Steel is a 2011 movie based on a book titled Steel, written by Richard Matheson in 1956.
scenarios.setting: The verse takes place in a world where human boxing has been replaced by robot boxing, where the film follows the perspective of Charlie Kenton, who was one of the greatest boxers of all time.

scenarios.title: Reality Quest
scenarios.description: (Reality Quest 현실퀘스트) is a webtoon written by Joowoon Lee and illustrated by Taesung.
scenarios.setting: (Reality Quest 현실퀘스트) is a webtoon written by Joowoon Lee and illustrated by Taesung. It is published on Naver Webtoon (Korean) as well as WEBTOON (English). Its first chapter was published in the Korean Naver website on 27 October 2021 . Dowan ha is a bullied gamer, whose bullies force him to grind to obtain in-game items for them.

scenarios.title: Realizing This Is A Wuxia World After Cultivating For 300 years
scenarios.source: Realizing This Is A Wuxia World After Cultivating For 300 years
scenarios.description: Realizing This Is A Wuxia World After Cultivating For 300 years is a novel written by Sole Cloud Flying Cave/Peak (孤云飞岫).
scenarios.setting: Realizing This Is A Wuxia World After Cultivating For 300 years is a novel written by Sole Cloud Flying Cave/Peak (孤云飞岫). The plot follows Cui Heng, A transmigrator from Earth, who, upon finding himself in a world of high-level immortals, is granted a 300-year novice period by a system. During this time, he cultivates diligently, forming bonds with various individuals who inadvertently enter his secure zone. These interactions shape him as a cultivator and as a person.

scenarios.title: Rebel Inc.
scenarios.description: (and it's PC version ) is a political and military simulation  where the player generally has to balance stability and military in order to stabilize a region while trying to fend off the insurgency.
scenarios.setting: It's created by the independent game studio Ndemic Creations.

scenarios.title: Rebirth of Mothra Trilogy
scenarios.description: Rebirth of Mothra (モスラ, Mosura, released in Japan simply as Mothra) is a 1996 Japanese kaiju film directed by Okihiro Yoneda, with special effects by Kōichi Kawakita.
scenarios.setting: Rebirth of Mothra (モスラ, Mosura, released in Japan simply as Mothra) is a 1996 Japanese kaiju film directed by Okihiro Yoneda, with special effects by Kōichi Kawakita. , Ltd, the film serves as a reboot for the fictional giant monster character Mothra, and is the first installment in the Rebirth of Mothra trilogy.

scenarios.title: Reborn to Master the Blade
scenarios.description: From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand.
scenarios.setting: From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects’ well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior’s life he’d devoted himself to before his rise to power. His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future.

scenarios.title: Record of Ragnarok
scenarios.description: The Gods have decided: the apocalypse must be brought down upon humanity for their excess hubris and unappealing natures.
scenarios.setting: A Japanese manga by Takumi Fukui, Record of Ragnarok tells the tale of one Valkyrie and her sisters seeking to undermine the Gods themselves by assembling the greatest heroes from across all of time for Humanity, including Adam, Lu Bu, Nikola Tesla, Rasputin, and more to face off against and kill the likes of Zeus, Buddha, Shiva, Odin, and several other deities, with the loser of each round having their very soul obliterated.

scenarios.title: Records of The Mystic Gardens
scenarios.description: Records Of The Mystic Gardens is a Chinese manhua about the world of Kunstmeisters superhumans who continuously cultivate their souls until it is big and powerful enough to hold a Garden which in turn grows in size and power with them.
scenarios.setting: Records Of The Mystic Gardens is a Chinese manhua about the world of Kunstmeisters superhumans who continuously cultivate their souls until it is big and powerful enough to hold a Garden which in turn grows in size and power with them. The Mystics Garden cultivators then have to employ other cultivators mostly via forceful adoption to rid their Gardens off of contamination to keep their sanity. This story follows Zhen Hao the heir of the Hao family a group of martial artists studying the Body of Tumultuous Gold.

scenarios.title: Red Earth
scenarios.description: Red Earth, known as Warzard in Japan, is a fantasy-themed 2D fighting game featuring RPG elements developed by Capcom and released in 1996 as an arcade game.
scenarios.setting: It is set in the year 1999 of an alternate reality, where neither the industrial revolution nor Renaissance ever took place, and the world is ruled by sword and magic.

scenarios.title: Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
scenarios.source: Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
scenarios.description: is a a Japanese manga that has recently gotten an anime adaptation.
scenarios.setting: is a a Japanese manga that has recently gotten an anime adaptation. It stars Togo Asagaki as the titular Red Ranger (Kizuna Red), who after beating the supervillain known as Breakup King was transported into a fantasy world.

scenarios.title: Red vs Blue
scenarios.description: Red vs Blue centers around the misadventures of the Reds and the Blues (hence the name).
scenarios.setting: Red vs Blue centers around the misadventures of the Reds and the Blues (hence the name). These simulation soldiers are forced to come together by a top-secret military testing company developing the perfect soldiers and testing them on sim troops (such as the ones in the show) in a fake civil war in humanity after the destruction of their alien foes.

scenarios.title: Redo of Healer
scenarios.description: Kaifuku Jutsushi no Yarinaoshi 〜Sokushi Mahou to Skill Copy no Chouetsu Heal〜 (回復術士のやり直し 〜即死魔法とスキルコピーの超越ヒール〜, lit.
scenarios.setting: Thus, he used healing magic on the world itself to go back four years, deciding to redo everything...

scenarios.title: Regular Show
scenarios.description: Regular Show is a cartoon on Cartoon Network created by J.G.
scenarios.setting: G. Quintel. It's about the everyday adventures of Mordecai and Rigby, a jaybird and a raccoon that work at a park. Contrary to what the ironic name of the show might imply, the two often get into various extraordinary, supernatural adventures and meet countless strange figures along the way.

scenarios.title: Remembrance of Earth's Past
scenarios.description: Remembrance of Earth's Past is a science fiction novel series by Chinese writer Liu Cixin(劉慈恩).
scenarios.setting: The series follows humanity's discovery of another civilizations and dealing with incoming alien invasion from Trisolaris.

scenarios.title: Reptilicus
scenarios.description: Reptilicus is a 1961 Danish-American giant monster film about a prehistoric reptile.
scenarios.setting: The film was produced by American International Pictures and Saga Studio and separate versions were released in Denmark and in the United States.

scenarios.title: Resident Evil
scenarios.description: Resident Evil, also known as BIOHAZARD (バイオハザード Baiohazādo), is a horror fiction video game-based media franchise created by Shinji Mikami and owned by the video game company Capcom.
scenarios.setting: Resident Evil, also known as BIOHAZARD (バイオハザード Baiohazādo), is a horror fiction video game-based media franchise created by Shinji Mikami and owned by the video game company Capcom. The franchise focuses on a series of survival horror video games but has since branched out into comic books, novels and novelizations, sound dramas, a non-canonical series of live-action films and animated sequels to the games, and a variety of associated merchandise, such as action figures.

scenarios.title: Return of the Living Dead
scenarios.description: The Living Dead series is a series of six zombie horror films created by George A.
scenarios.setting: The Living Dead series is a series of six zombie horror films created by George A. Romero beginning with the 1968 film "Night of the Living Dead" directed by Romero and co-written with John A. Russo. The franchise predominantly centers on different groups of people attempting to survive during the outbreak and evolution of a zombie apocalypse.

scenarios.title: Reverse Villain
scenarios.description: Jung-woo is stuck in a reincarnation cycle along with his nemesis, Shin-Ryong.
scenarios.setting: When he is reincarnated for the sixth time, he is born into the modern world. Being born into a new world changes Jung-woo's goal, as Murim is gone. Ultimately, he prioritizes the goal of becoming stronger to defeat Shin-Ryong, while trying to adapt to this modern world where he has a family and goes to a school like a normal person.

scenarios.title: Rewrite
scenarios.description: Rewrite is a visual novel and anime set in the fictional city Kazamatsuri where tree planting and afforestation have caused the city to become overgrown with trees and flowers in much the same way that other cities are filled by buildings.
scenarios.setting: Rewrite is a visual novel and anime set in the fictional city Kazamatsuri where tree planting and afforestation have caused the city to become overgrown with trees and flowers in much the same way that other cities are filled by buildings. However, while most of the city appears to be rural, there are many traditional city elements as well. While being a modern setting, the city also gives off a strange sense of nostalgia.

scenarios.title: Rick & Morty
scenarios.description: Rick & Morty is an animated science fiction dark comedy series that airs on Cartoon Networks Adult Swim.
scenarios.setting: It features the zany and dark adventures of morally questionable Rick Sanchez and his grandson Morty through time & space, as well as their relationship with their family back home.

scenarios.title: Riddle School
scenarios.description: Riddle School is a series of flash based puzzle-solving games created by Jonochrome.
scenarios.setting: Riddle School is a series of flash based puzzle-solving games created by Jonochrome. The games revolves around an elementary school student, Phil Eggtree, trying to escape his school. The player must overcome several obstacles and use super clever thinking in order to help Phil achieve his goal.

scenarios.title: Ring Fit Adventure
scenarios.description: Ring Fit Adventure is the spiritual successor to the Wii Fit series, creating a world based solely around working out, with a race of humans that enjoy nothing more working out, monsters that are physically based off yoga equipment, and more smoothies and work
scenarios.setting: Ring Fit Adventure is the spiritual successor to the Wii Fit series, creating a world based solely around working out, with a race of humans that enjoy nothing more working out, monsters that are physically based off yoga equipment, and more smoothies and workout clothes than you can count.

scenarios.title: Riordanverse
scenarios.description: The Riordanverse is a literary urban fantasy setting centered around the premise that many ancient myths are true and that divine pantheons, hidden magically from view, influence the modern world.
scenarios.setting: The Riordanverse is a literary urban fantasy setting centered around the premise that many ancient myths are true and that divine pantheons, hidden magically from view, influence the modern world. The series began with the Camp Half-Blood Chronicles, focusing on Greco-Roman mythology, and later expanded into The Kane Chronicles, revolving around Egyptian mythology, and Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard, covering Norse mythology.

scenarios.title: Rise of Humanity
scenarios.description: Since Pangu split the Heavens and the Earth, the Three Sovereigns governed the world, and the Five Emperors established order, humanity was regarded as the spirit of heaven and earth...
scenarios.setting: - Summary= Since Pangu split the Heavens and the Earth, the Three Sovereigns governed the world, and the Five Emperors established order, humanity was regarded as the spirit of heaven and earth... At this moment, it is the late period of the Human Sovereign among the Three Sovereigns, and the Five Emperors have yet to be established. Humanity is far from being the spirit of heaven and earth.

scenarios.title: Rise of the Dead
scenarios.description: Rise of the Dead is an MMORPG zombie apocalypse game on Roblox.
scenarios.setting: The game takes place during a zombie apocalypse, during which it is noted that all the zombies are mysteriously bald, which was thought to be related to the cause.

scenarios.title: Rise of the Guardians
scenarios.description: Rise of the Guardians is a 2012 American 3D computer-animated fantasy action-adventure film produced by DreamWorks Animation and distributed by Paramount Pictures.
scenarios.setting: The film tells a story about Guardians Santa Claus, the Tooth Fairy, the Easter Bunny, and the Sandman, who enlist Jack Frost to stop the evil Pitch Black from engulfing the world in darkness in a fight of dreams.

scenarios.title: Rivals of Aether
scenarios.description: Rivals of Aether (Romanized as RIVALS OF AETHER) is an indie fighting game developed by Dan Fornace of Aether Studios.
scenarios.setting: Rivals of Aether (Romanized as RIVALS OF AETHER) is an indie fighting game developed by Dan Fornace of Aether Studios.

scenarios.title: Roald Dahl
scenarios.description: Roald Dahl was a British novelist, short story writer, poet, screenwriter, and wartime fighter pilot.
scenarios.setting: His works for children include James and the Giant Peach, Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, Matilda, The Witches, Fantastic Mr Fox, The BFG, The Twits, and George's Marvellous Medicine. Note: Within versus threads, the original poster should specify which incarnation of the characters is being used.

scenarios.title: Robin Hood (Disney Verse)
scenarios.description: Robin Hood is a 1973 American animated musical adventure comedy film produced by Walt Disney Productions and released by Buena Vista Distribution.
scenarios.setting: Based on the English folk tale of the same name, the story follows the adventures of Robin Hood, Little John, and the inhabitants of Nottingham as they fight against the excessive taxation of Prince John, and Robin Hood wins the hand of Maid Marian.

scenarios.title: RoboCop
scenarios.description: RoboCop is an American science-fiction, action, crime, superhero, cyberpunk, media franchise featuring the futuristic adventures of Alex Murphy, a Detroit, Michigan police officer, who was previously brutally gunned down in the line of duty and transformed into a powerful cyborg, brand-named Robocop, at the behest of a powerful mega-corporation, Omni Consumer Products.
scenarios.setting: Thus equipped, Murphy battles both violent crime in a severely decayed city and the blatantly corrupt machinations within OCP.

scenarios.title: Rock Hard Gladiators
scenarios.description: Hyun's Dojo is a web series of flash stick animations, a collaboration of many animators.
scenarios.setting: A trailer summary of the verse Hyun's Dojo is a web series of flash stick animations, a collaboration of many animators. Fueled and inspired by rice, many heroes challenge one another for the grain, leading to many unforgettable interactions.

scenarios.title: Rocky
scenarios.description: Rocky is a series of American boxing sports drama films.
scenarios.setting: The original film, the third and the seventh have received Academy Award nominations. Stallone has received Academy Award nominations for his portrayal of Rocky, in the first and seventh films.

scenarios.title: Rolando Locomotov. He's the master
scenarios.description: Rolando Locomotov. He's the master (Аркадий Паровозов спешит на помощь, Arkady Parovozov speshit na pomoshch) is a Russian animated series created by Vadim Volya and produced at Parovoz Animation Studio. The series narrates about a superhero who always goes to
scenarios.setting: He's the master (Аркадий Паровозов спешит на помощь, Arkady Parovozov speshit na pomoshch) is a Russian animated series created by Vadim Volya and produced at Parovoz Animation Studio.

scenarios.title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
scenarios.description: Romance of the Three Kingdoms (三國演義) is a 14th-century historical novel attributed to Luo Guanzhong.
scenarios.setting: It is set in the turbulent years towards the end of the Han dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period in Chinese history, starting in 169 AD and ending with the reunification of the land in 280.

scenarios.title: Root Double -Before Crime * After Days-
scenarios.description: Root Double -Before Crime * After Days- is a visual novel which begins on September 16, 2030 - 6:19 AM.
scenarios.setting: Root Double -Before Crime * After Days- is a visual novel which begins on September 16, 2030 - 6:19 AM. At "LABO", a giant scientific research facility built by a lake on the outskirts of "Rokumei City", an "incident" occurs...!

scenarios.title: Rosario + Vampire
scenarios.description: Rosario + Vampire (ロザリオとバンパイア Rozario to Banpaia) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Akihisa Ikeda.
scenarios.setting: Rosario + Vampire (ロザリオとバンパイア Rozario to Banpaia) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Akihisa Ikeda. The story revolves around Tsukune Aono, a boy who inadvertently enrolls in a boarding school for monsters. He quickly befriends Moka Akashiya, a vampire who soon develops an obsession with his blood, and later meets other monster girls who soon take a romantic liking to him. The manga was serialized in Monthly Shonen Jump starting with the August 2004 issue, and ending with the June 2007 issue.

scenarios.title: Ruckerverse
scenarios.description: Ruckerverse is the (unofficial) name for the shared science-fiction multiverse of American mathematician Rudy Rucker.
scenarios.setting: Ruckerverse is the (unofficial) name for the shared science-fiction multiverse of American mathematician Rudy Rucker. These compose of most of his books and several other official online stories. These stories involve esoteric philosophy, complex mathematics, aliens, metaphysics, and many other things, portrayed in a (mostly) comedic format.

scenarios.title: RuneScape
scenarios.description: RuneScape is a medieval fantasy MMORPG (massively multiplayer online role-playing game) developed and published by Jagex.
scenarios.setting: Eventually, the player assumes the title of World Guardian, and is tasked with defending the planet of Gielinor from the many gods and monsters seeking to take control of or destroy it.

scenarios.title: Rurouni Kenshin
scenarios.description: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Swordsman Romantic Story (Japanese: るろうに剣心 -明治剣客浪漫譚- Hepburn: Rurōni Kenshin Meiji Kenkaku Romantan), also known as Rurouni Kenshin and Samurai X, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Nobuhiro Watsuki.
scenarios.setting: Through encounters with Kaoru Kamiya and battles with sworn enemies who lived through the same turbulent times, he seeks answers to his atonement and how to live in a new era. Studio Gallop, Studio Deen, and SPE Visual Works adapted the manga into an anime series from January 10, 1996, to September 8, 1998.

scenarios.title: RWBY
scenarios.description: RWBY (pronounced "Ruby") is an anime-styled American CG-animated web-series created by the Rooster Teeth Productions' animation studio (known for their show Red vs Blue).
scenarios.setting: RWBY (pronounced "Ruby") is an anime-styled American CG-animated web-series created by the Rooster Teeth Productions' animation studio (known for their show Red vs Blue). The series is created and directed by animator Monty Oum (known for his animations like Haloid (Halo x Metroid crossover) and Dead Fantasy (Dead or Alive/Ninja Gaiden x Final Fantasy x Kingdom Hearts crossover)).

scenarios.title: Ryuu Kusari no Ori
scenarios.description: Solminati Academy is a gathering place for youngsters with dreams, hopes, ambitions, and various thoughts.
scenarios.setting: Solminati Academy is a gathering place for youngsters with dreams, hopes, ambitions, and various thoughts. There was a boy here who entered the school to support his beloved’s dream. However, the boy’s ability, which he had only thought of, did not improve. He was laughed at by the people around him, he had no friends, his lover was separated from him, and his steps stopped. However, he meets an old woman, and that encounter triggers a gradual change in the boy.

scenarios.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.
scenarios.description: The S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series is an open-world sandbox, first-person shooter, with minor RPG elements and a large selection of wide-open maps with plenty to raid and explore, developed by  GSC Game World. One of its key features is A-Life, a life-simulation system
scenarios.setting: R. series is an open-world sandbox, first-person shooter, with minor RPG elements and a large selection of wide-open maps with plenty to raid and explore, developed by GSC Game World. One of its key features is A-Life, a life-simulation system that was one of the first of its kind at the time Shadow of Chernobyl finally released. The game is set in the Zone, a place of unthinkable wonders and monstrosities that emerged in the wake of the second Chernobyl incident.

scenarios.title: Sage Monarch
scenarios.description: Sage Monarch/Sheng Wang (圣王) is a cultivation novel written by Divine Dreamwalker.
scenarios.setting: Through him the scope of things slowly expand, from only being able to cause small waves in his region, conquering his world, planetary system, immortal worlds, to even lifting entire starry skies, etc...

scenarios.title: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut
scenarios.description: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut (最弱無敗のバハムート, lit.
scenarios.setting: Saijaku Muhai no Bahamut (最弱無敗のバハムート, lit. "Bahamut of the Weakest Undefeated") is a light novel, manga and anime series originally written by Senri Akatsuki. It is about Lux Arcadia, former prince of the Old Arcadia Empire, who was forced to act as a handyman after his family was killed during a coup d'état. One day, he accidentally comes into Princess Lisesharte Atismata, who, in spite of the circumstances of their meeting, challenges him to a mock battle.

scenarios.title: Saiki Kusuo no Psi Nan
scenarios.description: The plot tells the story of Kusuo Saiki, Saiki Kusuo Born with innate supernatural power, Saiki Kusuo seems to have his life easy.
scenarios.setting: The plot tells the story of Kusuo Saiki, Saiki Kusuo Born with innate supernatural power, Saiki Kusuo seems to have his life easy. He possess various ESP ability including telepathy and psychokinesis among others allowing him to get anything he wants. During kindergarten, he incidentally caught media attention after rumors of how he never loses any janken match against his friends and teacher spread around town.

scenarios.title: Saints Row
scenarios.description: Saints Row is an open world action-adventure video game series created by Volition and now published by Deep Silver, that tells the story of a gang called the Third Street Saints, the title comes from the name of the district of the gang's home territory.
scenarios.setting: Typically, gameplay is presented in an open world format because of the mixture of nonlinear gameplay with action-adventure and racing sequences.

scenarios.title: Sakamoto Days
scenarios.description: Sakamoto Days is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yuto Suzuki.
scenarios.setting: The series follows Sakamoto and his family, as he tries to live as a humble convenience store owner while the world of hitmen begins to haunt him...

scenarios.title: Sakamoto desu ga?
scenarios.description: Sakamoto desu ga? is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Nami Sano.
scenarios.setting: An anime television adaptation by Studio Deen aired between April 8, 2016 and July 1, 2016.

scenarios.title: Salt and Sanctuary
scenarios.description: Salt and Sanctuary is a video game created and published by Ska Studios.
scenarios.setting: Salt and Sanctuary is a video game created and published by Ska Studios. Drawing heavy inspiration from the Souls series made by FromSoftware, Salt and Sanctuary has players act as a nameless protagonist who ends up stranded on a mysterious island when a ship they are traveling on is attacked and destroyed by a giant kraken.

scenarios.title: Sam Raimi's Spider-Man Trilogy
scenarios.description: The Spider-Man Trilogy (also known as the Spider-Man film series, the Raimiverse, or by its Earth designation of Earth-96283) is a series of films created by Sam Raimi and David Koepp starring the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man, with Tobey Maguire in the starring role.
scenarios.setting: The Spider-Man Trilogy (also known as the Spider-Man film series, the Raimiverse, or by its Earth designation of Earth-96283) is a series of films created by Sam Raimi and David Koepp starring the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man, with Tobey Maguire in the starring role. It's a mostly highly acclaimed trilogy, with the second installment considered to be one of the best superhero movies (and sequels) of all time.

scenarios.title: Samurai 8
scenarios.description: Samurai Eight: Hachimaruden (サムライ8エイト 八丸伝ハチマルデン Samurai Eito Hachimaruden), also known as Samurai 8: The Tale of Hachimaru, is a manga series created, written, and storyboarded by the creator of Naruto, Masashi Kishimoto, and illustrated by Akira Okubo.
scenarios.setting: The warrior god, Fudo Myo-o, sealed a secret that will save the entire world inside of Pandora's Box.

scenarios.title: Samurai Bringer
scenarios.description: Samurai Bringer is a roguelite action game with levels which change with every playthrough, where you cut down hordes of Samurai and Demons to collect combat techniques and polish your fighting style in order to defeat Yamata-no-Orochi, the eight-headed dragon
scenarios.setting: Samurai Bringer is a roguelite action game with levels which change with every playthrough, where you cut down hordes of Samurai and Demons to collect combat techniques and polish your fighting style in order to defeat Yamata-no-Orochi, the eight-headed dragon of Japanese mythology.

scenarios.title: Samurai Deeper Kyo
scenarios.description: Samurai Deeper Kyo was created by manga artist Akimine Kamijyo in 1999 and is set in the Feudal Era of Tokugawa, Japan, and begins by following Yuya Shiina, a bounty hunter searching for her brother's murderer.
scenarios.setting: Samurai Deeper Kyo was created by manga artist Akimine Kamijyo in 1999 and is set in the Feudal Era of Tokugawa, Japan, and begins by following Yuya Shiina, a bounty hunter searching for her brother's murderer.

scenarios.title: Samurai Jack
scenarios.description: After being sent into the future by evil demonic wizard Aku, young samurai Jack makes a quest to return to the past and undo the destruction caused by the wizard.
scenarios.setting: "Samurai Jack" was created by Genndy Tartakovsky, who had previously created "Dexter's Laboratory," one of Cartoon Network's first original series.

scenarios.title: Samurai Shodown
scenarios.description: Samurai Shodown (also known as Samurai Spirits in Japan) is a fighting game series made by SNK.
scenarios.setting: Samurai Shodown (also known as Samurai Spirits in Japan) is a fighting game series made by SNK. First released in 1993 for arcades and the Neo Geo home console, Samurai Shodown is famous for being the first major weapon-oriented fighting game. It has spawned many sequels, spin-offs and animated movies. Its characters have also made guest appearances in a number of other games.

scenarios.title: Saw (Franchise)
scenarios.description: SAW is a film series that branches off to a single comic and two video games.
scenarios.setting: SAW is a film series that branches off to a single comic and two video games. The premise revolves around a man named John Kramer, who after being diagnosed with cancer, death of his unborn child, and trying to kill himself, he had a revelation. He begins to put people he sees as ungrateful for their live, into traps to rehabilitate them. If the people escaped the trap then they should have learned to appreciate their lives. John had many apprentices over the years to help him with his traps.

scenarios.title: Saya no Uta
scenarios.description: Saya no Uta (沙耶の唄, lit.
scenarios.setting: Yet, he was rescued by experimental brain surgery that coincidentally altered his perception of the world dramatically.

scenarios.title: Scarlet Nexus
scenarios.description: Scarlet Nexus stylized as SCARLET NEXUS, is a Japanese action role-playing-game developed by Bandai Namco and Tose, and published by Bandai.
scenarios.setting: Scarlet Nexus stylized as SCARLET NEXUS, is a Japanese action role-playing-game developed by Bandai Namco and Tose, and published by Bandai. It was released on June 25, 2021 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Windows PC. The series also inspired an anime adaptation, which premiered in July 2021.

scenarios.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
scenarios.source: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
scenarios.description: Scary Stories to Tell in The Dark is a horror book series created by Alvin Schwartz for children.
scenarios.setting: Scary Stories to Tell in The Dark is a horror book series created by Alvin Schwartz for children. The books cover adaptations of urban legends and myths, put into easy to read and understand children novels. A movie came out for the series, though it is a very loose adaption.

scenarios.title: School-Live!
scenarios.description: School-Live! (Japanese: がっこうぐらし! Hepburn: Gakkō Gurashi!, lit.
scenarios.setting: School-Live! (Japanese: がっこうぐらし! , lit. ") is a Japanese manga series written by Nitroplus' Norimitsu Kaihō and illustrated by Sadoru Chiba. The series began serialization in the July 2012 issue of Houbunsha's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine and is licensed in English by Yen Press.

scenarios.title: Scissor Seven
scenarios.description: Scissor Seven (formally Killer Seven) is a Chinese animated series currently airing on Netflix.
scenarios.setting: The series follows the adventures of an amnesiac assassin named Seven as he tries to climb the ranks of the assassin rankings and earn as much money as he can to live a comfortable life, while slowly discovering his past as a legendary assassin.

scenarios.title: Scooby Doo
scenarios.description: Scooby-Doo is an American cartoon created by Joe Ruby and Ken Spears, which involves four teenagers and one great Dane investigating mysteries that are supposedly made by mystical creatures, and while the majority of those are actual humans, there is always a
scenarios.setting: Scooby-Doo is an American cartoon created by Joe Ruby and Ken Spears, which involves four teenagers and one great Dane investigating mysteries that are supposedly made by mystical creatures, and while the majority of those are actual humans, there is always a mystery that involves out worldly creatures. Please refer to this blog before adding abilities or feats to certain characters as Scooby-Doo is a massively expansive canon with branching timelines and variants.

scenarios.title: Scott Pilgrim
scenarios.description: The graphic novel series revolving around a Canadian named Scott Pilgrim, a slacker and part-time musician who lives in Toronto and plays bass guitar in a band.
scenarios.setting: The graphic novel series revolving around a Canadian named Scott Pilgrim, a slacker and part-time musician who lives in Toronto and plays bass guitar in a band. He falls in love with American delivery girl Ramona Flowers, but must defeat her seven evil exes in order to date her. The verse is heavily inspired by video games and other forms of geek media, such as anime, therefore it shares many similarities in lore to other pop cultural verses.

scenarios.title: Scott Pilgrim (Universal Continuity)
scenarios.description: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World is a 2010 romantic action comedy film directed by Edgar Wright, based on Bryan Lee O'Malley's Scott Pilgrim series of graphic novels. The movie follows Scott Pilgrim, a Canadian indie garage band musician and gamer who begins dating
scenarios.setting: the Animation also takes place within this continuity, acting as a prequel to the movie that sheds some light on the teenage lives of Scott Pilgrim and Kim Pine.

scenarios.title: Scream
scenarios.description: The Scream franchise is a series of mystery/slasher films that follow Sidney Prescott (among other characters) surviving against a serial killer known as Ghostface in a series of murder sprees spread out across several years and locations, although all killings ultimately either take place in the town of Woodsboro or are heavily to do with the prior events that took place there.
scenarios.setting: The Scream franchise is a series of mystery/slasher films that follow Sidney Prescott (among other characters) surviving against a serial killer known as Ghostface in a series of murder sprees spread out across several years and locations, although all killings ultimately either take place in the town of Woodsboro or are heavily to do with the prior events that took place there. In 2022, the Scream website featured an interactive trivia game that featured Ghostface stalking the player through Amber Freeman's house.

scenarios.title: Scribblenauts
scenarios.description: Scribblenauts is a video game series created by 5th Cell.
scenarios.setting: Scribblenauts is a video game series created by 5th Cell. It is about a boy named Maxwell, who goes around completing puzzles using his magical object-creating notebook in order to get Starites. Scribblenauts has received a crossover with DC Comics in the form of its fourth game, Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure.

scenarios.title: Scud the Disposable Assassin
scenarios.description: Scud: The Disposable Assassin is a humorous, hyperkinetic science fiction comic by Rob Schrab about a world in which one can buy robot assassins out of vending machines, the most popular of which are intelligent robots that kill a specified target and then self-destruct.

The story tells of a young boy named Haimura Moroha who comes to this private school.

scenarios.title: Seirei Gensouki ~Konna Sekai de Deaeta Kimi ni~
scenarios.source: Seirei Gensouki ~Konna Sekai de Deaeta Kimi ni~
scenarios.description: Amakawa Haruto is a young man who died before reuniting with his childhood friend who disappeared five years ago.
scenarios.setting: Amakawa Haruto is a young man who died before reuniting with his childhood friend who disappeared five years ago. Rio is a boy living in the slums who wants revenge for his mother who was murdered in front of him when he was five years old. Earth and another world. Two people with completely different backgrounds and values. For some reason, the memories and personality of Haruto who should’ve died is resurrected in Rio's body.

scenarios.title: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance
scenarios.description: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance is a light novel series written by Yuu Shimizu and illustrated by Sakura Hanpen until Volume 13, and later by Yuuji Nimura from Volume 14 and onwards.
scenarios.setting: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance is a light novel series written by Yuu Shimizu and illustrated by Sakura Hanpen until Volume 13, and later by Yuuji Nimura from Volume 14 and onwards. The setting takes place in a fantasy world, where young "pure maidens" are able to make contracts with spirits to use as companions in life and combat; this leads them to use magic related to their spirit, thus becoming elementalists/blade dancers.

scenarios.title: Sekien no Inganock
scenarios.description: Sekien no Inganock ~What a Beautiful People~, also known as Sekien no Inganock - Inganock of the Brightest Flame, is a visual novel written by Sakurai Hikaru and developed by Liar-soft.
scenarios.setting: Sekien no Inganock ~What a Beautiful People~, also known as Sekien no Inganock - Inganock of the Brightest Flame, is a visual novel written by Sakurai Hikaru and developed by Liar-soft. It has a web novel set before and after the visual novel, which is also written by Sakurai Hikaru. It is the second installment in the What a Beautiful series. The story is set in Inganock, a city in the world of Kadath that is isolated from the outside and where everything inside is distorted by a mysterious mist.

scenarios.title: Sekirei
scenarios.description: Sekirei are 108 beautiful ladies of unknown origin, who together with their Ashikabi (human partners), must battle with one another in order to determine who will ascend and claim the "prize." What is the larger purpose of this event? What are the plans of the
scenarios.setting: " What is the larger purpose of this event? What are the plans of the event's overseer, the same individual who found these Sekirei and introduced them into society? Enter Sasashi Minato, 19 years old and approaching his 2nd year as a ronin. He is about to give it all up and return home, when quite literally, Musubi falls into/onto his life. An extremely well endowed, energetic, simple and sweet girl in a short miko outfit.

scenarios.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
scenarios.description: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice, is an action-adventure video game produced by FromSoftware and published by Activision.
scenarios.setting: - Power of the Verse= The verse is fairly powerful with characters ranging from Small Building level to Building level+ via attacking with natural lighting, and Multi-City Block level via the Giant Serpent. The verse gets stronger later on in the game, with characters reaching Town level via the Divine Dragon swinging its massive sword.

scenarios.title: Self-Reference ENGINE

scenarios.setting: Self-Reference ENGINE is a science fiction novel written by Japanese author Toh EnJoe. The book is an anthology of short stories that, although seemingly unconnected on the surface, are tied together by recurring characters and concepts, with the reader being left to ponder on how each of the chapters tie together, and presented with multiple possible reading orders by the novel itself.

scenarios.title: Sengoku Youko

scenarios.title: Senran Kagura

scenarios.setting: Senran Kagura is a video game series developed by Tamsoft and produced by Marvelous Entertainment. The franchise revolves around groups of female ninjas, and has received several manga adaptations. The main series are primarily a story focused side scrolling beat-em up with the versus games as fanservice heavy arena brawlers, both share the common gimmick of dealing damage to your opponents until their clothing are fully torn.

scenarios.title: Sergio Bonelli Editore
scenarios.description: Sergio Bonelli Editore is the most prominent comic book publishing house in Italy.
scenarios.setting: The philosophical, introspecitve and mature nature of many of the stories, along with the wild sci-fi and horror elements sprinkled throughout make Dylan Dog an exception to the "adventure" rule of Bonelli, a fact that is perfectly exemplified by the main character, an anti-hero through and through, full of phobias, a pacifist who would rather get beaten up than initiate combat.

scenarios.title: Serial Experiments Lain
scenarios.description: Serial Experiments Lain deals directly with the definition of reality, which makes its complex plot difficult to summarize.The story is primarily based on the assumption that everything flows from human thought, memory, and consciousness.
scenarios.setting: The story is primarily based on the assumption that everything flows from human thought, memory, and consciousness. Therefore,events on screen can be considered hallucinations of Lain, of other protagonists, or of Lain fabricating the hallucinations of others. Story misdirection is central to the plotline; even the offscreen voices or narrations' information cannot be consideredtruthful.

scenarios.title: Seven Senses of the Re'Union
scenarios.description: The story focuses on the year 2034, in a virtual reality MMORPG called "Union".
scenarios.setting: Within that game, the Subaru guild is made of six elementary school friends. Haruto Amo, the former leader of Subaru, is invited to play it, and within that game, he is reunited with Asahi, his guildmate who had previously passed away.

scenarios.title: Sevens

scenarios.setting: Games in the tradition of glorious arcade classics such as Mortal Kombat or Tekken. The games reward skill and precision over brute force and button mashing and have been widely praised for their fighting mechanics, strictly corresponding to the motto “A minute to learn, a lifetime to master”.

scenarios.setting: Although the series takes place is the same setting as the Lord of the Ring, the games contain its own canon as it is treated as an alternate story line to the original series.

This program was designed to educated the viewer on sharks and clear up misconceptions about these marine animals. This however, has changed in recent years due to the popularity of the docufiction, Megalodon: The Monster Shark Lives.

scenarios.setting: The 2018 Reboot of She-Ra tells the tale of a teenager named Adora, who gains powers that allow her to turn into the titular heroine. Emboldened with this power, Adora leads a group of other magical princesses in an alliance to defeat the evil Horde, who are led by Lord Hordak.

But Mio and Maria’s true forms are actually a newbie Demon Lord and a succubus!?

scenarios.title: Shinomiya Ayane Never Makes An Error

scenarios.setting: The story follows Ayane Shinomiya, a teen Ghost user (Person with a supernatural ability who can switch powers with other Ghost users) who competes with her sister for their father's affection. However, despite getting a better Ghost out of the deal, things go awry when the kidnapper's boss turns out to be the strongest Ghost user in the world, Daymare, who needs one of the sisters for his plans.

scenarios.title: Shinryaku! Ika Musume

scenarios.setting: Shinryaku! Ika Musume is a popular manga and anime series that originated in japan. The titular character, Ika Musume, or Squid Girl, is a self-declared invader from the seas, who comes to the surface in an attempt to destroy humanity due to their pollution of the seas. After “invading” the Beach House Lemon, Ika Musume damages the building and is forced to work there to pay off the damages, all the while making friends and planning her invasion of the surface.

scenarios.title: Shinzo
scenarios.description: Shinzo (aka "Mushrambo" in the original version) is a 32 episode long anime series by Toei-animation that aired in 2000.
scenarios.setting: The first season is set on Earth 300 years (500 in the dub) after a devastating war between human-kind and the Enterrans, a race of genetically engineered hybrid like creatures, with the awakening of Yakumo, the MC. Season 2 takes place in the reformed timeline after the defeat of evil Mushrambo.

scenarios.setting: The series primarily focuses on Shrek, a bad-tempered but good-hearted ogre, who begrudgingly accepts a quest to rescue a princess, resulting in him finding friends and going on many subsequent adventures in a fairy tale world.

The story focuses mainly on a hero called Shy or also known as Teru Momijiyama, whose hero name is aptly named shy. The boy leads a group called Amarariruku, whose goal is to unite the world as one.

scenarios.title: SIAMÉS

scenarios.setting: Despite maintaining only one album containing ten songs (known as Bounce into the Music) as of early 2019, their online following is notable, often attracting people through their astounding animated music videos attaching a story to their music.

scenarios.title: Sinners
scenarios.description: The 2025 film Sinners follows twin brothers, Smoke and Stack, who return to their Mississippi hometown in 1932 after a life of crime and get caught up in a supernatural horror story involving vampires.
scenarios.setting: The plot is a blend of a period crime drama and horror, dealing with themes of racial oppression, cultural identity, and temptation, particularly through the lens of the vibrant blues music scene that becomes the focus of an ancient evil.

scenarios.title: Skill Taker's World Domination ~ Building a Slave Harem from Scratch
scenarios.source: Skill Taker's World Domination ~ Building a Slave Harem from Scratch

scenarios.title: Skulduggery Pleasant (Series)
scenarios.description: Skulduggery Pleasant is a series of fantasy novels written by Irish author Derek Landy.
scenarios.setting: Skulduggery Pleasant is a series of fantasy novels written by Irish author Derek Landy. The books revolve around the adventures of the skeleton detective, Skulduggery Pleasant, and a teenage girl, Stephanie Edgley (Valkyrie Cain), along with other friends. The central story arc concerns Valkyrie's struggle to stop evil forces threatening the world, finally find justice for her late uncle's death, and her internal struggle of keeping the darkness within her to stay within.

scenarios.title: Skullgirls
scenarios.description: Skullgirls is a 2-D fighting game developed by Lab Zero Games and published by Autumn Games and Konami.
scenarios.setting: Set in Canopy Kingdom, characters are fighting for the opportunity to control the mysterious Skull Heart, an artifact with the ability to grant wishes, albeit at a substantial cost.

scenarios.title: Sky High
scenarios.description: Sky High is a 2005 American superhero comedy film from Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Sky High is a 2005 American superhero comedy film from Walt Disney Pictures. It was directed by Mike Mitchell and was written by Paul Hernandez, Robert Schooley, and Mark McCorkle.

scenarios.title: Skylanders
scenarios.description: Skylanders is a toys-to-life video game series published by Activision.
scenarios.setting: Players take on the role of Portal Masters to return the Skylanders to Skylands, and do battle with the forces of evil that plague the magical world.

scenarios.title: Slam Dunk
scenarios.description: Slam Dunk (スラムダンク, Suramu Danku) is a sports-themed manga series written by Takehiko Inoue about a basketball team from Shōhoku High School.
scenarios.setting: Slam Dunk (スラムダンク, Suramu Danku) is a sports-themed manga series written by Takehiko Inoue about a basketball team from Shōhoku High School. It was first serialized in Weekly Shōnen Jump in Japan from 1990 to 1996, and had also been adapted into an anime series by Toei Animation, which had been broadcast worldwide, enjoying much popularity, particularly in Japan, several other Asian countries, and Europe.

scenarios.title: Slasher
scenarios.description: Slasher is an anthology horror television series created by Aaron Martin.
scenarios.setting: The first season, retroactively subtitled The Executioner, was co-produced by Chiller and Super Channel, and centered on a mysterious figure billed as the Executioner who terrorizes the fictional town of Waterbury, Canada. The fifth season, Ripper takes place in 19th century Toronto, where a group of rich elites are hunted down by a serial killer wearing widow's weeds, coincidentally named the Widow Note: Credit to Wikipedia for this summary.

scenarios.title: Slay The Spire

scenarios.setting: It features one out of a variety of characters climbing the titular Spire, an enormous tower large enough to reach the clouds and hold several civilizations inside it, and attempting to reach its highest floor where its heart lies, seeking to slay it to end its corruption of the lands around it.

scenarios.title: Slayers
scenarios.description: Slayers is a light novel series written by Kanzaka and illustrated by Rui Araizumi.
scenarios.setting: Slayers is a light novel series written by Kanzaka and illustrated by Rui Araizumi. Powerful, avaricious sorceress Lina Inverse travels around the world, stealing treasures from bandits who cross her path. Her latest victims, a band of thieves, wait in ambush in a forest, thirsting for revenge. When Lina is about to effortlessly pummel her would-be attackers, the swordsman Gourry Gabriev suddenly announces his presence.

scenarios.title: Sleeping Beauty (Disney)
scenarios.description: Sleeping Beauty is a 1959 animated feature produced by Walt Disney Productions and originally released to theaters on January 29, 1959, by Buena Vista Film Distribution.
scenarios.setting: The 16th animated feature in the Disney Animated Canon, it was the last animated feature produced by Walt Disney to be based upon a fairy tale (after his death, the studio returned to the genre with The Little Mermaid), as well as the last cel animated feature from Disney to be inked by hand before the studio switched to using the xerography process.

scenarios.title: Sleeping Dogs

scenarios.title: Slightly Damned
scenarios.description: Slightly Damned is a currently ongoing webcomic created by Chu, who began publishing pages on a weekly basis on March 14, 2004, and which currently has over a thousand pages in the webcomic to date.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in the world of Medius, where tensions between Angels and Demons in Heaven and Hell are setting to spark another Great War like had been waged centuries beforehand.

scenarios.title: Small Soldiers
scenarios.description: Small Soldiers is a 1998 American action comedy film directed by Joe Dante.
scenarios.setting: Small Soldiers is a 1998 American action comedy film directed by Joe Dante. It stars Kirsten Dunst and Gregory Smith, along with the voices of Frank Langella and Tommy Lee Jones. scenarios.title: SMITE

scenarios.setting: SMITE is a 3D, third-person multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game developed and published by Hi-Rez Studios. What differs SMITE from other MOBAs such as League of Legends, though, is its perspective and gameplay style. While most MOBAs have an isometric, top-down view, Smite is a third-person game, taking more inspiration from Hack n' Slash Action than Real-Time Strategy.
