scenarios.title: Sonny Boy
scenarios.description: Thirty-six students find themselves and their school building suddenly adrift in a void-like dimension.
scenarios.setting: This conflict leads them to discover that this world has its own set of rules—and following them is necessary for survival. While they deal with the unique challenges and circumstances that each world presents, the students must unravel the mysterious phenomenon and find a way back home.

scenarios.title: Sora No Otoshimono
scenarios.description: Tomoki Sakurai is a perverted teenage boy whose motto is "Peace and quiet are the best," and often has dreams of meeting an angel.
scenarios.setting: Tomoki Sakurai is a perverted teenage boy whose motto is "Peace and quiet are the best," and often has dreams of meeting an angel. He finds it difficult to live in comfort when he has to put up with Sohara Mitsuki, his next-door neighbor with a killer karate chop; Eishiro Sugata, an eccentric pseudo-scientist bent on discovering the "New World"; and Mikako Satsukitane, a sadistic Student Council President.

scenarios.title: Sorcery Hacker
scenarios.description: Sorcery Hacker >> Divulge the Magic Vulnerability is a light novel series written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by HIMA.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in a fantasy world where humans have overwhelmed all the non-human demon races and developed a modern magic society by using sorcery devices, including sorcery guns that allow humans to easily cast spells. One of said hackers, Ayato Criminaltrophy, arrives at the flying city Celedileka with his partner Teleria following a contract to investigate a group of human traffickers, and soon stumbles into a larger conspiracy that threatens the entire city.

scenarios.title: Sousei no Onmyouji
scenarios.description: Sōsei no Onmyōji (双星の陰陽師) is a manga series written and illustrated by Yoshiaki Sukeno.
scenarios.setting: Sōsei no Onmyōji (双星の陰陽師) is a manga series written and illustrated by Yoshiaki Sukeno. For centuries, terrifying creatures—known as "Kegare"—from the parallel realm Magano have wreaked havoc throughout Japan. The brave men and women resisting their onslaught are secretive Onmyouji whose one and only goal is to eradicate all the Kegare. In the present day, 14-year-old Rokuro Enmadou is a talented and powerful Onmyouji.

scenarios.title: South Park
scenarios.description: South Park is a popular long-running adult American cartoon series created by Trey Parker and Matt Stone, famous for its crude humor and coarse language.
scenarios.setting: South Park is a popular long-running adult American cartoon series created by Trey Parker and Matt Stone, famous for its crude humor and coarse language. First airing in 1997, it has 23 seasons. Set in Colorado, it focuses on four boys and the other members of the township.

scenarios.title: Spawn
scenarios.description: Spawn is the comic book published by American company Image Comics and created by Todd McFarlane.
scenarios.setting: Spawn is the comic book published by American company Image Comics and created by Todd McFarlane. The book began with a very superhero-like tone, much like McFarlane's previous work, but the title character evolved into a more flawed anti-hero. The current book has skewed significantly darker than early issues would suggest. McFarlane attributes this to being a necessary part of development.

scenarios.title: Spelunky
scenarios.description: Spelunky is a roguelike series of indie games created by Derek Yu, infamous for its difficulty.
scenarios.setting: Spelunky is a roguelike series of indie games created by Derek Yu, infamous for its difficulty. The original, freeware 2009 game, nowadays known as Spelunky Classic, sees a then-unnamed adventurer discovering Colossal Cave, an underground dungeon so difficult to navigate that death itself could not access its always-shifting caves.

scenarios.title: Spice and Wolf
scenarios.description: Spice and Wolf (狼と香辛料) is a Japanese light novel series written by Isuna Hasekura, with illustrations by Jū Ayakura.
scenarios.setting: Spice and Wolf (狼と香辛料) is a Japanese light novel series written by Isuna Hasekura, with illustrations by Jū Ayakura. ASCII Media Works has published 21 novels since February 2006 under their Dengeki Bunko imprint. 2 million copies of the first nine novels have been sold in Japan. The series has been called a "unique fantasy" by Mainichi Shimbun due to the plot focusing on economics, trade, and peddling rather than the typical staples of fantasy such as swords and magic.

scenarios.title: Spider-Man - X-Men: The Animated Series
scenarios.description: X-Men and Spider-Man were animated shows based on Marvel Comics properties of the same name, and aired on Fox Kids Network during the 1990s.
scenarios.setting: X-Men and Spider-Man were animated shows based on Marvel Comics properties of the same name, and aired on Fox Kids Network during the 1990s. The shows had an expansive roster and had adapted many arcs from the comics, including the Dark Phoenix, Age of Apocalypse, Clone Saga, Symbiote Saga, and even Secret Wars, both shows being considered as some of the best animated superheroes shows of all time. Iron Man (1994), Fantastic Four (1994), and The Incredible Hulk (1996) were also canonical to this universe.

The first season revolves around the disappearance of Will Byers, while the second season explores the repercussions of the mysterious events of season 1. scenarios.setting: Summer Time Render (サマータイムレンダ, Samā Taimu Renda) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yasuki Tanaka, that was adapted into an anime. Following the death of his parents, Shinpei Ajiro grew up with the Kofune sisters Ushio and Mio before heading to Tokyo to live alone. Two years later, he returns to his hometown of Hitogashima Island, Wakayama Prefecture to attend Ushio's funeral following news of her drowning.

scenarios.setting: Swordmasters-Youngest-Son is a South Korean web novel series written by 황제펭섭, and has been adapted into a manhwa. The story revolves around Jin Runcandel, the youngest son of the greatest Swordmaster. After he gets kicked out of their clan, he experiences a tragic fate that leads him to the brink of death. However, before he dies, a God provides him with the opportunity for a second chance. Now, with his newfound power, Runcandel must use his abilities for the greater good.

scenarios.title: System Shock

Team Fortress 2 boasted a colorful, cartoony art-style and an equally colorful cast of characters. Team Fortress is also known for its distinctive characters and extremely appealing, nonsense humor.

scenarios.title: Tears to Tiara
scenarios.description: 1,200 years after the Demon King Arawn was sealed, a priest of the "Holy Empire" conspired to free him, using the young oracle Riannon as a sacrifice.
scenarios.setting: 1,200 years after the Demon King Arawn was sealed, a priest of the "Holy Empire" conspired to free him, using the young oracle Riannon as a sacrifice. So begins their tale...

scenarios.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

A blend of science-fiction, fantasy, and normalcy, Teenage Mutant Ninjas Turtles tends to vary throughout the years but the themes of ninjutsu and brotherhood have remained core elements of the franchise.

scenarios.description: Tekken (鉄拳? lit. Iron Fist) is a series of three-dimensional fighting games developed and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, first released in Japan in 1994, becoming the best selling 3D fighting game of all time. The story of the Tekken franchise follow
scenarios.setting: The story of the Tekken franchise follows the events of the King of The Iron Fist Tournament, hosted by the Mishima Zaibatsu, where a plethora of fighters try to win the tournament and/or gain control of the company, while the conflict between the Mishima family serves as the main focus for the plot of the games, while also exploring other characters own motivations for joining the tournament and in aiming to control the Zaibatsu.

scenarios.setting: With the space program attempting to travel to Mars, 21st century scientists were tasked with warming up the planet so that humans could survive on its surface. They came up with an efficient and cost effective plan of sending cockroaches and mold to the surface so that the mold would absorb the sunlight and the insect corpses would serve as a food source for the mold. It is now the year 2577 and the first manned ship to Mars has landed on the planet and the six crew members are ready for their mission.

scenarios.title: The 100
scenarios.description: When nuclear Armageddon destroys civilization on Earth, the only survivors are on the 12 international space stations in orbit.
scenarios.setting: When nuclear Armageddon destroys civilization on Earth, the only survivors are on the 12 international space stations in orbit. Three generations later, the 4,000 survivors living on a space ark of linked stations see their resources go scarce and face draconian measures established to make sure humanity has a future. Desperately looking for a solution, the ark's leaders send 100 juvenile prisoners back to the planet to test its habitability.

scenarios.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad

scenarios.setting: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad is a 1958 American Technicolor heroic fantasy adventure film directed by Nathan H. Juran and starring Kerwin Mathews, Kathryn Grant, Torin Thatcher, Richard Eyer, and Alec Mango. It was distributed by Columbia Pictures and produced by Charles H. Schneer. It was the first of three Sinbad feature films from Columbia, the later two from the 1970s being The Golden Voyage of Sinbad (1973) and Sinbad and the Eye of the Tiger (1977).

scenarios.setting: The Adventures of Sharkboy and Lavagirl is a 2005 film written and directed by Robert Rodriguez. The movie centers around Max, a 10 year-old boy who is fascinated by his dreams, going so far as to keep a journal where he records them. His most significant dreams center around the duo of Sharkboy; a half-human, half-shark mutant, and Lavagirl; a girl made out of molten magma. Max also is the frequent victim of bullying from another boy from his school named Linus.

scenarios.setting: The Amazing Spider-Man film series (also known by its Earth designation of Earth-120703) is a duology of films created by Sony Pictures that's based on the Marvel Comics property of the same name. The films are directed by Mark Webb with Andrew Garfield playing the titular role, with these films generally being seen as a more grounded approach to the character. As of Spider-Man: No Way Home, this universe and its Spider-Man are now connected to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as a part of its multiverse.

scenarios.setting: RealAnnoyingOrange (also known as The Annoying Orange) was one of YouTube's most popular web series. The first episode was released on October 9, 2009.

scenarios.setting: The series is set in a fantasy country inspired by the Tang Dynasty of early medieval China and follows a girl named Maomao, who was trained from an early age by her apothecary father, and was sold as a servant to the emperor's palace while she secretly employs her pharmacologist skills in the service of the people of the palace.

scenarios.title: The Aquabats! Super Show!

scenarios.setting: The Backrooms is an analog horror series made by Kane Pixels. It centers on the Async Research Institute, a research organization that creates a gateway into The Backrooms, a dimension consisting of a seemingly endless series of liminal spaces. Subsequently, thousands of people began falling through reality and entering the Backrooms. The series follows workers at Async and those who fell out of reality as they brave the dangers of The Backrooms, as well as the workings of Async.

scenarios.title: The Banana Splits
scenarios.description: The Banana Splits is a children's television variety program starring The Banana Splits.
scenarios.setting: The Banana Splits is a children's television variety program starring The Banana Splits. Created by Hanna-Barbera, it ran thirty-one episodes over two seasons on NBC, from 7 September 1968 to 5 September 1970, this era of the show also got a movie, and comics by Gold Key. It also had a revival in 2008 that is poorly documented. In 2019 Syfy made a direct to video horror movie. In 1999 Cartoon Network used The Banana Splits for one of their Web Premiere Toons.

scenarios.title: The Batman Epic Crime Saga
scenarios.description: The Batman Epic Crime Saga is a series of films and TV series adapting DC Comics' Batman stories.
scenarios.setting: The Batman Epic Crime Saga is a series of films and TV series adapting DC Comics' Batman stories. Together, they comprise a shared continuity, beginning in 2022 with Matt Reeves' The Batman. The Batman (2022), directed by Matt Reeves and starring Robert Pattinson as Bruce Wayne/Batman, presents a darker and more grounded take on the iconic DC superhero.

scenarios.title: The Battle for Wesnoth
scenarios.description: The Battle for Wesnoth is an open source turn-based strategy game initially developed by David White and released in June 2003.
scenarios.setting: The Battle for Wesnoth is an open source turn-based strategy game initially developed by David White and released in June 2003. The title encompasses 17 single player campaigns set in a high fantasy theme on the world of Iryda, in which Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, Trolls, Undead, Drakes, Dragons, Saurians, Nagas, Mermen, Woses, Ogres, and monsters of all sorts battle for dominance with blades and magics.

scenarios.title: The Beast from 20,000 Fathoms
scenarios.description: The Beast from 20,000 Fathoms is a 1953 American science fiction monster film directed by Eugène Lourié, with special effects by Ray Harryhausen.
scenarios.setting: The film is about the Rhedosaurus, a dinosaur that is released from its frozen hibernating state by an atomic bomb test in the Arctic Circle and begins to wreak a path of destruction as it travels southward, eventually arriving at its ancient spawning grounds, which includes New York City.

scenarios.title: The Beginning After The End
scenarios.description: The Beginning After The End follows the journey of King Grey, who, after his untimely and mysterious death, is reincarnated as Arthur Leywin.
scenarios.setting: The Beginning After The End follows the journey of King Grey, who, after his untimely and mysterious death, is reincarnated as Arthur Leywin. Determined to correct his past mistakes, he finds himself in Dicathen, a vibrant world filled with magic and fantastical creatures. Armed with the wisdom of a powerful king in his mid-thirties, Arthur grows up as the magic-wielding child of two retired adventurers, gradually discovering a sense of purpose that eluded him in his previous life.

scenarios.title: The Big Lez Show
scenarios.description: The Big Lez Show is an Australian surrealist comedy webseries on YouTube, written by friends Jarrad Wright, Izak Whear, and Tom Hollis.
scenarios.setting: The Big Lez Show is an Australian surrealist comedy webseries on YouTube, written by friends Jarrad Wright, Izak Whear, and Tom Hollis. The show's narrative is usually that of comedic shenanigans, with the main characters Big Lez, Sassy, Donny and Mike Nolan engaging on a number of wacky adventures, but also delves into psychedelic humor, action, and philosophical/surrealist themes from time to time.

Lee kyungho’s mind was engulfed with ending his life due to bullying and the loss of his mother. He attempts to, but is saved. His determination to commit suicide somehow entices Sierra, a grim reaper who later offers him a contract. This contract blesses him with the ability to borrow the powers of the dead in their previous life in return of sacrificing years from his lifespan.

scenarios.title: The Boys
scenarios.description: The Boys is a comic book franchise that includes a television series adaptation.

scenarios.title: The Carpet People
scenarios.description: The Carpet People is a novel by Terry Pratchett, written when the author was only seventeen.
scenarios.setting: The Carpet People is a novel by Terry Pratchett, written when the author was only seventeen. It was later remastered by the same author to be up to his current standards. The idea of the story is a fantasy setting set entirely on a normal-sized carpet. The microscopic protagonists must work to save the Dumii Empire from The Fray, which is, in fact, a vacuum cleaner.

scenarios.title: The World of Otome Games is Tough For Mobs
scenarios.source: The World of Otome Games is Tough For Mobs
scenarios.description: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs also known as MobuSeka is a Japanese light novel series written by Yomu Mishima and illustrated by Monda.
scenarios.setting: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs also known as MobuSeka is a Japanese light novel series written by Yomu Mishima and illustrated by Monda. The story follows Leon Fou Bartfort, an office worker who dies and finds himself reincarnated into the otome game that he was forced to complete by his sister. In this world, women reign supreme in the social hierarchy, and survival is tough for 'mobs', background characters like him.

scenarios.title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
scenarios.source: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
scenarios.description: The greatest assassin on Earth knew only how to live as a tool for his employers—until they stopped letting him live.
scenarios.setting: He has to eliminate a super-powerful hero who will bring about the end of the world unless he is stopped.

scenarios.title: The Yellow Submarine
scenarios.description: The Yellow Submarine is an animated movie about how a group of singers known as The Beatles come to help far off place called Pepperland.
scenarios.setting: The Yellow Submarine is an animated movie about how a group of singers known as The Beatles come to help far off place called Pepperland. A species known as The Blue Meanies had taking over the area and left everyone and everything turned gray, lifeless, and incapable of moving. The Beatles set out to cross the many seas and lands before coming to Pepperland and freeing them from The Blue Meanies rule.

scenarios.title: Them's Fightin' Herds
scenarios.description: In the world of Fœnum, sapient ungulates used to live in fear of carnivorous animals known as the Predators.
scenarios.setting: In the world of Fœnum, sapient ungulates used to live in fear of carnivorous animals known as the Predators. The Horned Prophet was able to seal the Predators away in an otherworldly realm called The Hold, but they have found a way to escape it.

scenarios.title: Things as They Are
scenarios.description: Things as They Are is a role-playing game developed by Si Kuai Er Tea Party.
scenarios.setting: Things as They Are is a role-playing game developed by Si Kuai Er Tea Party.

scenarios.title: Thomas and Friends
scenarios.description: Thomas & Friends (originally known as Thomas The Tank Engine & Friends or Thomas the Tank Engine; also known as Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures! in the twenty-second season) is a British children's television series.
scenarios.setting: Thomas & Friends (originally known as Thomas The Tank Engine & Friends or Thomas the Tank Engine; also known as Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures! in the twenty-second season) is a British children's television series. In the United Kingdom, it had its first broadcast on the ITV network in Great Britain in 1984. In the United States, it had its first broadcast on Shining Time Station in 1989.

scenarios.title: Threads of Fate
scenarios.description: Threads of Fate, also known as Dewprism (デュープリズム Dyūpurizumu) in Japan, is a 1999 action platform video game developed and published by Square for the PlayStation console.
scenarios.setting: It follows the story of two characters, Rue, a mysterious boy with no memory of who he truly is, and Mint, a energetic princess with a smart mouth.

scenarios.title: Three Kingdoms (2010 TV Series)
scenarios.description: Three Kingdoms (三国) is a 2010 Chinese television series adopted from Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
scenarios.setting: Three Kingdoms (三国) is a 2010 Chinese television series adopted from Romance of the Three Kingdoms. To distinguish it from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, the 1994 Chinese television series which is unofficially nicknamed as Old Three Kingdoms (老三国), it is unofficially nicknamed as New Three Kingdoms (新三国). Three Kingdoms has caused controversy among critics and fans, with many commenting that the TV series has veered too far from the novel and real history.

scenarios.title: Throne of Glass
scenarios.description: Throne of Glass is a young-adult fantasy adventure novel series written by Sarah J.
scenarios.setting: The series tells a coming of age story for young assassin Celaena Sardothien and her journey to achieve the throne of Terrasen and free her country from Ardarlan oppression under her true name of Aelin Galathynius

scenarios.title: Tibia
scenarios.description: Tibia is a German MMORPG created by CipSoft, becoming widely popular through Brazil and Poland and receiving notable attention, to the point of having multiple wikias dedicated to it.
scenarios.setting: Tibia is a German MMORPG created by CipSoft, becoming widely popular through Brazil and Poland and receiving notable attention, to the point of having multiple wikias dedicated to it. The game has grown to get quite a community following. Before everything, there were two beings, Fardas the Creator and Uman Zathroth. Tired of living in the nothingness, they fused parts of themselves to create two separate entities, Uman the Sage and Zathroth the Destroyer.

scenarios.title: Tiger & Bunny
scenarios.description: Tiger & Bunny (タイガー＆バニー Taigā Ando Banī?) is a 2011 Japanese anime television series produced by Sunrise under the direction of Keiichi Satou.
scenarios.setting: ) is a 2011 Japanese anime television series produced by Sunrise under the direction of Keiichi Satou. The screenplay was written by Masafumi Nishida, with original character design by Masakazu Katsura. The series began its broadcast run in Japan on April 3, 2011 on Tokyo MX, followed by rebroadcasts on BS11 and MBS, and ended on September 17, 2011. Viz Media are also simulcasting the series, streaming on Hulu and Anime News Network.

scenarios.title: Tigtone and the Series
scenarios.description: Tigtone and the Series is an animated comedy show on Adult Swim.
scenarios.setting: It follows the adventures of Tigtone, a melodramatic quest-addicted hero who lives in a satirical fantasy world.

scenarios.title: Tim Burton's Batman Film Anthology
scenarios.description: The Batman Film Anthology is an anthology consisting of four movies that is based off the DC Comics character itself.
scenarios.setting: The Batman Film Anthology is an anthology consisting of four movies that is based off the DC Comics character itself. As Tim Burton directed the first two movies (Batman (1989) and Batman Returns (1992)) and Joel Schumacher directed the last two (Batman Forever (1995) and Batman & Robin (1997). At first, the original movies were originally going for a more darker and gothic tone, but seeing how Warner Bros.

scenarios.title: Time Crisis
scenarios.description: Time Crisis is a first-person on-rails light gun shooter series of arcade video game series created by Namco, introduced in 1995.
scenarios.setting: in short) who assigns its highly skilled agents to deal with a major security threat to either one nation or the world (Time Crisis II) by a hostile organization, which has ranged from criminals, terrorists, to hostile military outfits, and mostly take place within fictional locations across the world.

scenarios.title: To Deprive a Deprived Person
scenarios.description: To Deprive a Deprived Person is a web novel written by Mino in 2013.
scenarios.setting: One day, he is transported into a different world with cheat like stealing ability.

scenarios.title: To Love-Ru
scenarios.description: To Love-Ru (To LOVEる -とらぶる, To LOVEru -Toraburu-) is a manga series written by Saki Hasemi and illustrated by Kentaro Yabuki, creator of Black Cat, which was serialized in Shueisha's Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine.
scenarios.setting: To Love-Ru (To LOVEる -とらぶる, To LOVEru -Toraburu-) is a manga series written by Saki Hasemi and illustrated by Kentaro Yabuki, creator of Black Cat, which was serialized in Shueisha's Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine. A sequel of the manga called To Love-Ru Darkness (To LOVEる -とらぶる- ダークネス To LOVEru -Toraburu- -Dākunesu-) was serialized in Shueisha's Jump Square magazine. The manga series' title, とらぶる (Toraburu), is the English gairaigo (loan word) "trouble" and "rabu" (ラブ) is the English loan word "love".

scenarios.title: Toaru Majutsu no Index
scenarios.description: The Toaru Series, or A Certain Series, is a media franchise, and shared universe that is centered on a series of novels authored by Kamachi Kazuma and illustrated by Haimura Kiyotaka and multiple spin-off manga series illustrated and edited by other people, but is still written and advised by Kamachi Kazuma.
scenarios.setting: The Toaru Series, or A Certain Series, is a media franchise, and shared universe that is centered on a series of novels authored by Kamachi Kazuma and illustrated by Haimura Kiyotaka and multiple spin-off manga series illustrated and edited by other people, but is still written and advised by Kamachi Kazuma. The franchise has also been popular enough to receive anime adaptations, manga adaptations for the light novels, games and has even done crossovers with other franchises.

scenarios.title: Toei Tokusatsu
scenarios.description: Toei Tokusatsu encompasses a number of Toei produced franchises that exist in the same universe.
scenarios.setting: Likely recognizable through the American adaptation of certain seasons known as Power Rangers. The franchise would spawn multiple shows taking place in the same continuity and even a reboot movie that crossed over with Kamen Rider Gaim.

scenarios.title: Toilet in Wonderland
scenarios.description: Toilet in Wonderland is a surreal exploration game made in RPG Maker 2000.
scenarios.setting: The world's fate hinges on her constipation, so as her constipation levels drop, beings within the world will vanish, and reality will gradually fade away.

scenarios.title: Tokyo Babel
scenarios.description: A Divine Calamity has occurred: the gates of Heaven have been closed shut, the realm of Hell has been consumed by a flood, also, countless parallel worlds have withered away, one after another.
scenarios.setting: In response to this, the surviving angels and demons have gathered at the city they believe to be their final chance at salvation: the floating purgatory of "Tokyo Babel". Joined by humans, they embark on a pilgrimage across the seven layers of Babel, hoping to ascend Jacob's Ladder in order to re-open the gates of Heaven, and meet God. Joining his savior, Lilith, the Witch of the Night, he begins a journey across Tokyo Babel to find the answer why he still possesses the will to keep on living.

scenarios.title: Tokyo Ghoul
scenarios.description: The story of Tokyo Ghoul follows Ken Kaneki, who barely survives a deadly encounter with Rize Kamishiro, a woman who reveals herself as a ghoul, a human-like creature that hunts and devours human flesh, and is taken to the hospital in critical condition.
scenarios.setting: The story of Tokyo Ghoul follows Ken Kaneki, who barely survives a deadly encounter with Rize Kamishiro, a woman who reveals herself as a ghoul, a human-like creature that hunts and devours human flesh, and is taken to the hospital in critical condition. After recovering, Kaneki discovers that he underwent organ transplantation that transformed him into a half-ghoul, and just like them, must consume human flesh to survive as well.

scenarios.title: Tokyo Mew Mew
scenarios.description: Tokyo Mew Mew is a manga and anime series.
scenarios.setting: Tokyo Mew Mew is a manga and anime series.

scenarios.title: Tokyo Revengers
scenarios.description: Tokyo Revengers is a manga series written and illustrated by Ken Wakui in 2017.
scenarios.setting: Tokyo Revengers is a manga series written and illustrated by Ken Wakui in 2017. Takemichi Hanagaki, the main protagonist, wakes up one day to discover that his girlfriend back in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, has been killed by the Tokyo Manji Gang. After being pushed on the tracks of a train he finds himself sent back 12 years into the past. Takemichi, determined to turn his life around, resolves in saving his girlfriend and later the friends he made along the way from their fates in the future.

scenarios.title: Tom and Jerry
scenarios.description: Tom and Jerry is an American animated series of theatrical shorts, television shows and specials, a feature film, home films created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera for Metro-Goldwyn Mayer that centered on a never-ending rivalry between a cat Tom and a mouse Jerry whose chases and battles often involved slapstick humor.
scenarios.setting: Tom and Jerry is an American animated series of theatrical shorts, television shows and specials, a feature film, home films created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera for Metro-Goldwyn Mayer that centered on a never-ending rivalry between a cat Tom and a mouse Jerry whose chases and battles often involved slapstick humor.

scenarios.title: Tomb Raider
scenarios.description: Tomb Raider, also known as Lara Croft: Tomb Raider between 2001 and 2007, is a media franchise that originated with an action-adventure video game series created by British gaming company Core Design.
scenarios.setting: Formerly owned by Eidos Interactive, then by Square Enix after their acquisition of Eidos in 2009, the franchise focuses on a fictional British archaeologist Lara Croft, who travels around the world searching for lost artefacts and infiltrating dangerous tombs and ruins. The gameplay generally focuses on action-adventure exploration of environments, solving puzzles, navigating hostile environments filled with traps, and fighting numerous enemies.

scenarios.title: TOME
scenarios.description: In the year 2020, Netking Software released a virtual reality game called the Terrain of Magical Expertise… TOME.
scenarios.setting: In the year 2020, Netking Software released a virtual reality game called the Terrain of Magical Expertise… TOME. Within this expansive, interactive world, players of all ages, gender, and race from across the globe unite together to a single community of social networking and gaming.

scenarios.title: Tomodachi Game
scenarios.description: Katagiri Yuuichi believes that friends are more important than money, he knows the hardships of not having enough funds.
scenarios.setting: - Adult Tomodachi Game= After the fourth game, Yuuichi and his friends are given some freedom for some time where they can freely roam in their real world with freedom.

scenarios.title: Toriko
scenarios.description: In a world where the taste and texture of food is extremely important there exist individuals known as Bishokuya (luxury food providers) who specialize in the acquisition of rare ingredients and animals.
scenarios.setting: In a world where the taste and texture of food is extremely important there exist individuals known as Bishokuya (luxury food providers) who specialize in the acquisition of rare ingredients and animals. The titular character and leading protagonist, Toriko, is one of these hunters and it is his dream to find the most precious foods in the world and create the ultimate dinner course.

scenarios.title: Torture Princess: Fremd Torturchen
scenarios.description: Torture Princess: Fremd Torturchen (異世界拷問姫 Isekai Goumon Hime, "Torture Princess of Another World") is a Gothic Splatter Horror Light Novel series written by Keishi Ayasato and illustrated by Saki Ukai (Black Bullet), and very much not for the faint of heart.
scenarios.setting: Torture Princess: Fremd Torturchen (異世界拷問姫 Isekai Goumon Hime, "Torture Princess of Another World") is a Gothic Splatter Horror Light Novel series written by Keishi Ayasato and illustrated by Saki Ukai (Black Bullet), and very much not for the faint of heart. It was published in Japan by MF Bunko J from May 2016 to February 2020, and translated to English by Yen On beginning in May 2019.

scenarios.title: Total Drama
scenarios.description: Total Drama is an animated parody series created by Jennifer Pertsch and Tom McGillis which pays homage to various reality survival tv shows such as Survivor and Fear Factor.
scenarios.setting: Total Drama is an animated parody series created by Jennifer Pertsch and Tom McGillis which pays homage to various reality survival tv shows such as Survivor and Fear Factor. The series is made up of seven seasons (eight if one believes Pahkitew Island is its own season) and two spin-offs: The Ridonculous Race (which served as a continuation of the original Total Drama series) and Total Dramarama.

scenarios.title: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
scenarios.description: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator (Or TABS), is a singleplayer comedy physics based tactics game released in early access in November 2016.
scenarios.setting: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator (Or TABS), is a singleplayer comedy physics based tactics game released in early access in November 2016. Since this release the game followed multiple updates and changed drastically, while still having the same premise. The full version of the game released on April 1, 2019. The game consists of 11 factions currently, each based on a different historical time, with their own aesthetic and original troops. The game has around 100 different units in total.

scenarios.title: Totally Spies!
scenarios.description: Totally Spies! is an French animated action comedy TV series with heavy anime influences made by Vincent Chalvon-Demersay and David Michel.
scenarios.setting: Totally Spies! is an French animated action comedy TV series with heavy anime influences made by Vincent Chalvon-Demersay and David Michel. The show focuses on three teenage high-schoolers named Sam, Clover, and Alex. While schoolgirls in Beverly Hills, they are also spies for the World Organization of Human Protection, or WOOHP, fighting nefarious villains all over the world with their martial arts skills and gadgets.

scenarios.title: Touge Oni
scenarios.description: In the ancient kingdom of Yamato, between the eras of gods and men, there was a time when the two coexisted.
scenarios.setting: Miyo is chosen to serve as a human sacrifice to her village's god, Kippuuson-no-Mikoto, but she's not ready to die!

scenarios.title: Tougen Anki
scenarios.description: Ichinose Shiki, an inheritor of the blood of Oni had lived out his entire childhood oblivious to this fact.
scenarios.setting: In a world where Oni and Momotarou have never been able to coexist, join Ichinose in his struggle for power and unifying the two races!

scenarios.title: Tough
scenarios.description: Kōkō Tekken-den Tough (Japanese: 高校鉄拳伝タフ, literally "High School Iron Fist Legend Tough"), is a martial arts manga series written and illustrated by Tetsuya Saruwatari, starting in 1994.
scenarios.setting: Kōkō Tekken-den Tough (Japanese: 高校鉄拳伝タフ, literally "High School Iron Fist Legend Tough"), is a martial arts manga series written and illustrated by Tetsuya Saruwatari, starting in 1994. A sequel series, titled simply as Tough (TOUGH—タフ— Tafu) was introduced in 2004 which continues the story further after the first series ended its run, and a third, currently ongoing series, Tough Gaiden: Ryuu wo Tsugu Otoko, serialized since 2015, details the rise of a new protagonist.

scenarios.title: Touhou Project
scenarios.description: Touhou Project (東方 Project) is a franchise consisting of several 2D scrolling shooting games and 2D fighters created by Team Shanghai Alice headed by a man named ZUN.
scenarios.setting: Touhou Project (東方 Project) is a franchise consisting of several 2D scrolling shooting games and 2D fighters created by Team Shanghai Alice headed by a man named ZUN. It follows the various misadventures of Reimu and Marisa, a shrine maiden and a magician in the magical land of Gensokyo that's inhabited by all manner of spirits, demons, and aliens. Each game focuses on an incident causing trouble for the denizens of Gensokyo, and the incident resolvers naturally resolving these.

scenarios.title: Tower of Saviors
scenarios.description: Tower of Saviors (神魔之塔) is a mobile match-3 puzzle role-playing game.
scenarios.setting: Tower of Saviors (神魔之塔) is a mobile match-3 puzzle role-playing game.

scenarios.title: Town of Salem
scenarios.description: Town of Salem is a browser-based game created by BlankMediaGames that challenges players on their ability to convincingly lie as well as detect when other players are lying.
scenarios.setting: Town of Salem is a browser-based game created by BlankMediaGames that challenges players on their ability to convincingly lie as well as detect when other players are lying. The game ranges from 7 to 15 players. These players are randomly divided into alignments - Town, Mafia, and Neutrals. If you are a Town member (the good guys) you must track down the Mafia and other villains before they kill you. The catch?

scenarios.title: Toy Story
scenarios.description: Toy Story is a CGI-animated media franchise created by Pixar and distributed by Walt Disney Pictures, beginning with the original 1995 film, Toy Story.
scenarios.setting: The franchise focuses on a group of toys that secretly come to life and end up unexpectedly embarking on life-changing adventures. The first two films of the franchise were directed by John Lasseter, the third by Lee Unkrich, co-director of the second film, and the fourth by Josh Cooley, a storyboard artist at Pixar Animation Studios.

scenarios.title: Trample on "Schatten!!" ~Kagefumi no Uta~
scenarios.description: When a chance encounter drops him into the middle of a war between a secret organization of superheroes and the shadow creatures known as schatten, Himehagi Aisaku must awaken the hero within if he hopes to protect all that he holds dear.
scenarios.setting: When a chance encounter drops him into the middle of a war between a secret organization of superheroes and the shadow creatures known as schatten, Himehagi Aisaku must awaken the hero within if he hopes to protect all that he holds dear. Together with the valiant princess Keziah, Aisaku will don his blazing armor and shine a light on the shadows that infest his city. Will Aisaku find the strength to see him through the rising night?

scenarios.title: Transformers (2018 Reboot)
scenarios.description: The rebooted live-action Transformers film series (otherwise known as Knightverse) is a fresh take on the theatrical versions of the Transformers franchise that has started since 2018 and ongoing, ever since Michael Bay's original film series ended in 2017.
scenarios.setting: The rebooted live-action Transformers film series (otherwise known as Knightverse) is a fresh take on the theatrical versions of the Transformers franchise that has started since 2018 and ongoing, ever since Michael Bay's original film series ended in 2017. It is part of the "Tyran" cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse. Bumblebee is the sixth movie in the live-action film series, and the first movie of the rebooted canon. A "reset" of the film series as a whole.

scenarios.title: Transformers (Aligned Cartoon)
scenarios.description: Transformers: Prime (known as Transformers: Prime – Beast Hunters during its third and final season) is an American animated television series based on the Transformers toy franchise by Hasbro that aired on the Hub Network from November 29, 2010, to July 26, 2013.
scenarios.setting: Transformers: Prime (known as Transformers: Prime – Beast Hunters during its third and final season) is an American animated television series based on the Transformers toy franchise by Hasbro that aired on the Hub Network from November 29, 2010, to July 26, 2013. The series focuses on the Autobots of "Team Prime", consisting of Optimus Prime, Ratchet, Arcee, Bumblebee and Bulkhead, and their human allies as they attempt to protect the Earth from the villainous Decepticons and their leader Megatron.

scenarios.title: Transformers (Dreamwave Unicron Trilogy)
scenarios.description: Transformers Armada (Dreamwave) is an adaptation of the Armada toyline in comic book form, originally written by Chris Sarracini with art by James Raiz, Simon Furman took writing duties beginning on issue 6, with the artist changing after certain arcs.
scenarios.setting: Transformers Armada (Dreamwave) is an adaptation of the Armada toyline in comic book form, originally written by Chris Sarracini with art by James Raiz, Simon Furman took writing duties beginning on issue 6, with the artist changing after certain arcs. The comic ran for 18 issues, before changing its name to Transformers Energon, to match the toyline, which was also an continuation of the Armada toyline. There were 18 more issues planned, but only 12 were published before being abruptly cancelled.

scenarios.title: Transformers (DS 2007 Games)
scenarios.description: Transformers The Game for the Nintendo DS portable console was developed by Vicarious Visions for Activision, in conjunction with the 2007 live-action Transformers movie.
scenarios.setting: Transformers The Game for the Nintendo DS portable console was developed by Vicarious Visions for Activision, in conjunction with the 2007 live-action Transformers movie. It consists of two separate games: Transformers Autobots and Transformers Decepticons. The games have different storylines and environments, but the basic gameplay elements are shared between them. It is part of the "Tyran" cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.

scenarios.title: Transformers (Franchise)
scenarios.description: Transformers is a franchise originating in 1984 containing numerous toylines, cartoons, anime, manga, comics, text stories, video games, films, and OVAs.
scenarios.setting: Rovio—the Angry Birds Transformers continuity family, a cluster where the dimensionally-displaced "EggSpark" accidentally changed the natives of Piggy Island into the Autobirds and Deceptihogs. Within the multiverse 15,962,782 universal streams have been cataloged.

scenarios.title: Transformers (G1 Cartoon)
scenarios.description: The Generation 1 cartoon continuity incorporates the events of the original The Transformers cartoon, the 1986 animated film, and a number of side stories set in, around, or otherwise spinning off from these events.
scenarios.setting: The Generation 1 cartoon continuity incorporates the events of the original The Transformers cartoon, the 1986 animated film, and a number of side stories set in, around, or otherwise spinning off from these events.

scenarios.title: Transformers (IDW 2005)
scenarios.description: The 2005 IDW continuity is the storyline of IDW Publishing's Generation 1 reboot comic book series, launched in 2005 and ran until 2018, it is part of the "Primax" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.
scenarios.setting: The 2005 IDW continuity is the storyline of IDW Publishing's Generation 1 reboot comic book series, launched in 2005 and ran until 2018, it is part of the "Primax" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse. It re-imagined the traditional Autobot and Decepticon Great War as a galaxy-spanning conflict, with Cybertron abandoned as a dead husk and teams from both sides covertly operating on various alien worlds to defend or destroy the native populations including Earth.

scenarios.title: Transformers (IDW Movie Comics)
scenarios.description: The release of the first three movies in the live-action film series were accompanied by the publication of multiple pieces of tie-in media that supplemented and expanded on the world of the films.
scenarios.setting: The release of the first three movies in the live-action film series were accompanied by the publication of multiple pieces of tie-in media that supplemented and expanded on the world of the films.

scenarios.title: Transformers (Michael Bay)
scenarios.description: The original live-action Transformers film series (otherwise known as Bayverse) is a pentalogy directed by Michael Bay from 2007 to 2017, it is part of the "Tyran" cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.
scenarios.setting: The original live-action Transformers film series (otherwise known as Bayverse) is a pentalogy directed by Michael Bay from 2007 to 2017, it is part of the "Tyran" cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse. Transformers is a live-action movie released by DreamWorks in 2007, with Executive Producer Steven Spielberg and Director Michael Bay.

scenarios.title: Transformers (Unicron Trilogy Anime)
scenarios.description: The Unicron Trilogy (マイクロン3部作 Maikuron Sanbusaku, "Micron Trilogy") anime continuity that revolves around three connected action shows, and is part of the "Aurex" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.
scenarios.setting: The Unicron Trilogy (マイクロン3部作 Maikuron Sanbusaku, "Micron Trilogy") anime continuity that revolves around three connected action shows, and is part of the "Aurex" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.

scenarios.title: Transformers Animated
scenarios.description: Transformers Animated is a cartoon series which debuted on December 26, 2007, in support of the franchise of the same name.
scenarios.setting: The cartoon was produced by Cartoon Network, scripted in the United States, with character and background designs by the crews behind shows like Teen Titans and Ben 10, while animation was provided by Japanese studios Mook, The Answer Studio, Studio 4°C, Barnum Studio and Diomedea.

scenarios.title: Transformers One
scenarios.description: Transformers One is an animated film released on September 20, 2024.
scenarios.setting: Transformers One is an animated film released on September 20, 2024. It is written by Eric Pearson, Andrew Barrer, and Gabriel Ferrari from a story by Barrer and Ferrari, and directed by Josh Cooley. The movie is an origin story set on Cybertron three billion years ago in the days before the Autobot-Decepticon war, and focuses on Optimus Prime and Megatron as they go from brothers-in-arms to enemies.

scenarios.title: Transformers: Devastation
scenarios.description: Transformers: Devastation is a 2015 action-adventure game based on the Transformers franchise developed by PlatinumGames and published by Activision.
scenarios.setting: Transformers: Devastation is a 2015 action-adventure game based on the Transformers franchise developed by PlatinumGames and published by Activision. In the game, players control five Autobots as they battle to stop a Decepticon plot to turn the Earth to metal. Several creatives who worked on past Transformers media, including writers, actors, and musicians, contributed to the game's development. It is part of the "Primax" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.

scenarios.title: Transformers: Robots in Disguise (2001)
scenarios.description: Transformers: Robots in Disguise, known as Transformers: Car Robots (トランスフォーマー カーロボット) in Japan, is the first Japanese-original Transformers cartoon ever officially dubbed and broadcast for a US audience.
scenarios.setting: Transformers: Robots in Disguise, known as Transformers: Car Robots (トランスフォーマー カーロボット) in Japan, is the first Japanese-original Transformers cartoon ever officially dubbed and broadcast for a US audience. Debuting about eighteen months after its Japanese incarnation, it aired—not without problems—from September 8, 2001 to March 30, 2002, in support of the toyline of the same name. It is part of the "Viron" universal cluster of the larger Transformers multiverse.

scenarios.title: Tremors
scenarios.description: Tremors is a 1990 dark comedy creature feature about the inhabitants of small town, Perfection Valley, Nevada dealing with a sudden attack by large underground worms.
scenarios.setting: Tremors is a 1990 dark comedy creature feature about the inhabitants of small town, Perfection Valley, Nevada dealing with a sudden attack by large underground worms. The film spawned four sequels, one prequal and a TV series with the seventh instalment, Shrieker Island, released on October 20th, 2020.

scenarios.title: Trick 'r Treat
scenarios.description: Trick 'r Treat is a 2007 American anthology horror comedy film written and directed by Michael Dougherty and produced by Bryan Singer.
scenarios.setting: Trick 'r Treat is a 2007 American anthology horror comedy film written and directed by Michael Dougherty and produced by Bryan Singer. scenarios.setting: The Ultra Series is a Tokusatsu Franchise made in 1966. It has spawned countless movies, OVAs, toys, comics, manga, games, tv shows, etc. It features giants known as Ultras fighting Kaijus and Aliens, the Kaijus in this series are referred to as Ultra Kaijus.

As giant Kaiju wreak havoc and Ultraman mysteriously vanishes, the United Science Patrol struggles to regain control. A new Ultra emerges, revealing hidden secrets, while Shin Hayata must confront overwhelming odds in the unfolding mystery of Ultraseven.

scenarios.setting: Walking with... is a documentary series produced by the BBC Natural History Unit. Each series focuses on a selection of creatures common during a specific time period.

scenarios.description: Wallace and Gromit are a British stop-motion comedy animation franchise created by Nick Park and produced by Aardman Animations.

scenarios.setting: Walt Disney's Comics and Stories, sometimes abbreviated WDC&S, is an American anthology comic book series featuring characters from The Walt Disney Company's films and shorts, including Donald Duck, Scrooge McDuck, Mickey Mouse, Chip 'n Dale, Li'l Bad Wolf, Scamp, Bucky Bug, Grandma Duck, Brer Rabbit, Winnie the Pooh, and others.

scenarios.title: Wander Over Yonder

scenarios.setting: Wander over Yonder is an animated series on Disney XD created by Craig McCracken (also known for creating The Powerpuff Girls and Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends).

scenarios.title: Watashi, Nouryoku wa Heikinchi de tte Itta yo ne!
scenarios.source: Watashi, Nouryoku wa Heikinchi de tte Itta yo ne!
scenarios.description: Watashi, Nouryoku wa Heikinchi de tte Itta yo ne! (私、能力は平均値でって言ったよね!, lit.

scenarios.title: Watchmen
scenarios.description: Watchmen is a 12-issue series published by DC Comics in 1986 and created by Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons, with colours by John Higgins.
scenarios.setting: Watchmen depicts an alternate history, similarly to our world, in which superheroes emerged in the 1940s and 1960s and their presence changed history. The comic mostly focuses on the 1980s where most of the superheroes are either outlawed or are working for the government.

scenarios.title: WaveLand
scenarios.description: WaveLand is a game that was brought to life thanks to a Kickstarter campaign.
scenarios.setting: WaveLand is a game that was brought to life thanks to a Kickstarter campaign. In WaveLand, you play as a cube known as a Vessel and are trying to recollect all the shards to travel to the Dark Sky and successfully ascend.

scenarios.title: Weak Hero
scenarios.description: Once the bullies target you, it's game over.
scenarios.setting: Once the bullies target you, it's game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculating and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy.

scenarios.title: Wedding Peach
scenarios.description: Wedding Peach is a manga series created by Nao Yazawa and Sukehiro Tomita in 1994.
scenarios.setting: Wedding Peach is a manga series created by Nao Yazawa and Sukehiro Tomita in 1994. Part of the Magical Girl genre, it has themes of wedding and marriage. It follows the story of Momoko Hanasaki, an ordinary middle schooler who finds out she's the legendary angel, Wedding Peach that must keep demons from obtaining the Sacred Somethings and restore peace to the Angel World.

scenarios.title: Weird n' Wild Creatures
scenarios.description: For detailed information about this series, visit the Weird n' Wild Creatures Fandom Wiki
scenarios.setting: For detailed information about this series, visit the Weird n' Wild Creatures Fandom Wiki

scenarios.title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
scenarios.description: Kazuhiro Kitase’s only hobby is sleeping.
scenarios.setting: Ever since he was young, he would enter a wondrous world within his dreams and go on thrilling adventures. Join Kazuhiro on his new adventures through Japan with Ms.

scenarios.title: Welcome to Night Vale
scenarios.description: Welcome to Night Vale is a science fiction mystery podcast and novel written by Jeffrey Cranor and Joseph Fink.
scenarios.setting: It is a twice-monthly podcast in the style of community updates for the small desert town of Night Vale, featuring local weather, news, announcements from the Sheriff's Secret Police, mysterious lights in the night sky, dark hooded figures with unknowable powers, and cultural events; narrated by Cecil Palmer.

scenarios.title: Welcome to the Game
scenarios.description: For detailed information about this series, visit the Welcome to the Game Wikia.
scenarios.setting: For detailed information about this series, visit the Welcome to the Game Wikia.

scenarios.title: Whack The Series
scenarios.description: Whack The Series is a series of games often following a man named Patrick, and his girlfriend Lisa.
scenarios.setting: Whack The Series is a series of games often following a man named Patrick, and his girlfriend Lisa. Whenever facing trouble with certain people, including drunk creeps, Their angry neighbor, or even serial killers, they respond in extremely violent and brutal ways. Killing their victims in extremely painful manners using the objects they have on or around them.

scenarios.title: What a Beautiful Series
scenarios.description: What a Beautiful series or WAB series (also known as Steampunk series) is a series of visual novels authored by Sakurai Hikaru and developed and published by Liar-Soft.
scenarios.setting: What a Beautiful series or WAB series (also known as Steampunk series) is a series of visual novels authored by Sakurai Hikaru and developed and published by Liar-Soft.

scenarios.title: When The Cute Kunoichis Spied on Their Teacher's Secret
scenarios.source: When The Cute Kunoichis Spied on Their Teacher's Secret
scenarios.description: When The Cute Kunoichis Spied on Their Teacher's Secret is a light novel written by Kazuma Kamachi and illustrated by Ryuushi Tajima.
scenarios.setting: The story takes place in a world where Japan never ended their isolationist phase, and agents from foreign powers are always threatening to steal the country's advanced technology.

scenarios.title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?
scenarios.source: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?
scenarios.description: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego was first developed by Brøderbund software entertainment in 1985.
scenarios.setting: Films were planned but ultimately did not fall through. The cartoon reimagines Sandiego as a heroine instead of a villain, being trained as a teenager for VILE's Academy for Thieves, only to rebel and develop her own moral code.

scenarios.title: Where's Waldo?
scenarios.description: Where's Waldo? is a popular book series created by Martin Handford.
scenarios.setting: The predominant plot of these books is to find Waldo and other characters and/or objects within a huge crowded environment.

scenarios.title: White Blood
scenarios.description: Ten years ago vampires started to appear naturally in the world.
scenarios.setting: Ten years ago vampires started to appear naturally in the world.

scenarios.title: White Fang
scenarios.description: White Fang is a novel by American author Jack London (1876–1916) — and the name of the book's eponymous character, a wild wolfdog.
scenarios.setting: Much of White Fang is written from the viewpoint of the titular canine character, enabling London to explore how animals view their world and how they view humans. White Fang examines the violent world of wild animals and the equally violent world of humans.

scenarios.title: Who Killed Captain Alex?
scenarios.description: Who Killed Captain Alex? is a 2010 Ugandan film by Wakaliwood.
scenarios.setting: Who Killed Captain Alex? is a 2010 Ugandan film by Wakaliwood. The movie features Captain Alex: a highly trained soldier who is considered the best in Uganda, who was sent by the Ugandan President to kill Richard and the Tiger Mafia forever. However, he was later mysteriously murdered by an unknown person after being lured by a Tiger Mafia spy who tried to seduce him. However, the person who killed Captain Alex has been confirmed to not be associated with the organisation and ultimately remains a mystery.

scenarios.title: Wii Series
scenarios.description: Wii Series is a series of simulation games for the game console of the same name and its successor, the Wii U, published by Nintendo.
scenarios.setting: Wii Series is a series of simulation games for the game console of the same name and its successor, the Wii U, published by Nintendo. These games feature a common design theme, with recurring elements including casual-oriented gameplay, casts consisting mostly or entirely of Miis and control schemes that simulate real-life activities. The franchise consists of four major series: Wii Sports, Wii Play, Wii Fit, and Wii Party, along with several other independent games in the Wii series.

scenarios.title: WildStorm
scenarios.description: WildStorm, known in-universe as Earth-50 and Earth 483 respectively, was a comic book publisher and continuity that lasted from 1992 to 2011 before being integrated in the DC Universe after the events of Flashpoint.
scenarios.setting: WildStorm, known in-universe as Earth-50 and Earth 483 respectively, was a comic book publisher and continuity that lasted from 1992 to 2011 before being integrated in the DC Universe after the events of Flashpoint. Unlike Marvel or DC, the stories in WildStorm were more creator-driven with less restrictions. Notable characters and teams from WildStorm are the WildCATS, helmed by The Grifter, and The Authority, featuring Apollo and Midnighter.

scenarios.title: WILL: A Wonderful World
scenarios.description: WILL: A Wonderful World is a virtual novel puzzle game developed by Ren Yi Men Game (任意门游戏).
scenarios.setting: WILL: A Wonderful World is a virtual novel puzzle game developed by Ren Yi Men Game (任意门游戏).

scenarios.title: Willverse
scenarios.description: The Willverse is a literary fantasy setting authored by Will Wight and published by Hidden Gnome Publishing centered around the exploits of various characters within the multiple varied fantasy settings which exist simultaneously within a shared multiverse that is carefully watched over by an powerful organization, known as the Abidan Court, tasked with maintaining order across the cosmos.
scenarios.setting: The series consists of 4 main entries, each of which takes place within its own separate world that has its own unique magic system and laws that all tie together to the wider scope of the setting either through overt parts of the story or subtle shared similarities.

scenarios.title: Willy's Wonderland
scenarios.description: Willy's Wonderland is a 2021 American action comedy horror film directed by Kevin Lewis from a screenplay written by G.O.
scenarios.setting: It follows a quiet drifter who is tricked into cleaning up an abandoned family entertainment center inhabited by eight murderous animatronic mascots who are possessed by the souls of a cannibalistic killer and his colleagues. Instead, it was released through video on demand, with a simultaneous limited theatrical release in the United States, on February 12, 2021, by Screen Media.

scenarios.title: Wind Breaker
scenarios.description: Wind Breaker (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Satoru Nii.
scenarios.setting: Wind Breaker (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Satoru Nii. It began serialization on Kodansha's Magazine Pocket manga website in January 2021. As of March 2024, the series' individual chapters have been collected in 16 tankōbon volumes. An anime television series adaptation produced by CloverWorks premiered in April 2024.

scenarios.title: Witch Hunter
scenarios.description: In a world where witches have declared war against humanity, two-thirds of the world falls under their control.
scenarios.setting: Visual= - Logo= For detailed information about this franchise, visit the Witch Hunter Wiki.

scenarios.title: Witcher
scenarios.description: The Witcher (Polish: Wiedźmin), written by Polish writer Andrzej Sapkowski, is a fantasy series of short stories and novels about the witcher Geralt of Rivia.
scenarios.setting: In Sapkowski's books, "Witchers" are monster hunters who (with rigorous training and body modification/mutations through the Trial of the Grasses) develop supernatural abilities at a young age to battle deadly monsters.

scenarios.title: Wizard101
scenarios.description: Wizard101 chronicles the journey of a young wizard who is plucked from his/her homeworld to attend the Ravenwood School of Magical Arts.
scenarios.setting: Wizard101 chronicles the journey of a young wizard who is plucked from his/her homeworld to attend the Ravenwood School of Magical Arts. As a student of one of seven primary schools of magic, the protagonist almost immediately finds themself involved in thwarting the plans of the former Death School teacher: Malistaire.

scenarios.title: Wizarding World
scenarios.description: Harry Potter is an urban fantasy saga by J.K Rowling.
scenarios.setting: K Rowling. The Potterverse consists of the main series, Harry Potter and (the Philosopher's Stone, the Chamber of Secrets, the Prisoner of Azkaban, the Goblet of Fire, the Order of the Phoenix, the Half-Blood Prince, the Deathly Hallows, and more recently, the Cursed Child- Parts One and Two), as well as several spin-off titles, (Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, Quidditch Through the Ages, and The Tales of Beedle the Bard).

scenarios.title: Wizardly Tower
scenarios.description: A powerful Grand Wizard named Raim Horde Morpheus reappears after a millennium because of a failed experiment
scenarios.setting: A powerful Grand Wizard named Raim Horde Morpheus reappears after a millennium because of a failed experiment While setting out to regain his lost tower, he meets “Veriarre” and “Verierre”, who have both been trafficked as slaves... A combination of a weird Grand Magician who only uses his wits to make money and the cute, lovable brother and sister of the Miao tribe!

scenarios.title: Wizards of Waverly Place
scenarios.description: Wizards of Waverly Place is an American fantasy teen sitcom created by Todd J.
scenarios.setting: Wizards of Waverly Place is an American fantasy teen sitcom created by Todd J. Greenwald that aired on Disney Channel for four seasons between October 2007 and January 2012. The series centers on Alex Russo (Selena Gomez), a teenage wizard living on the titular street in the Greenwich Village section of New York City, who undertakes training alongside her siblings, Justin (David Henrie) and Max (Jake T. Austin), who are also equipped with magical abilities.

scenarios.title: Wolf Man (2025 film)
scenarios.description: Wolf Man is a 2025 American horror film directed and co-written by Leigh Whannell.
scenarios.setting: The plot follows a family man seeking to protect his wife and daughter from a werewolf, only to become infected and slowly transform into the creature.

scenarios.title: Wolf's Rain
scenarios.description: Wolf's Rain (Japanese: ウルフズレイン Hepburn: Urufuzu Rein?) is an anime series created by writer and story editor Keiko Nobumoto and produced by Bones Studio.
scenarios.setting: ) is an anime series created by writer and story editor Keiko Nobumoto and produced by Bones Studio. It was directed by Tensai Okamura and featured character designs by Toshihiro Kawamoto with a soundtrack produced and arranged by Yoko Kanno. It focuses on the journey of four lone wolves who cross paths while following the scent of the Lunar Flower and seek for Paradise.

scenarios.title: Wolfenstein
scenarios.description: Wolfenstein is a series of World War II video games, originally developed by Muse Software and released under name Castle Wolfenstein in 1981 and Beyond Castle Wolfenstein in 1984.
scenarios.setting: Wolfenstein is a series of World War II video games, originally developed by Muse Software and released under name Castle Wolfenstein in 1981 and Beyond Castle Wolfenstein in 1984. In 2001, the series was rebooted with Return to Castle Wolfenstein, developed by Gray Matter Interactive.

scenarios.title: Wolfwalkers
scenarios.description: Wolfwalkers is a 2020 animated fantasy adventure film that takes place in 17th century Ireland.
scenarios.setting: Wolfwalkers is a 2020 animated fantasy adventure film that takes place in 17th century Ireland. The story follows Robyn Goodfellowe and her father, Bill, who was recently summoned to the town of Kilkenny. The lord of the town tasks Bill with dispensing of a pack of wolves that have been causing trouble for the townspeople.

scenarios.title: Wolverine & the X-Men - Avengers: EMH!
scenarios.description: The reality in which Wolverine and the X-Men, The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes, Hulk Vs.
scenarios.setting: The reality in which Wolverine and the X-Men, The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes, Hulk Vs. series and Thor: Tales of Asgard take place in, as well as some of their comic tie-ins. From Wolverine and the X-Men spawned Earth-80920 (Days of Future Past-like world) and the Planet Hulk animated movie is often considered to be part of this continuity, though it has also been listed as being part of Earth-10022.

scenarios.title: Wolyaverse
scenarios.description: Wolyaverse is a collection of series written by Hanjung Wolya that share the same universe.
scenarios.setting: Wolyaverse is a collection of series written by Hanjung Wolya that share the same universe. The verse is primarily based around Martial Artists but there exists a fair share of other groups such as Demons, Spirits, Gate-keepers etc.

scenarios.title: Wonderful World
scenarios.description: Wonderful World is a 2D Doujin Fighting Game made by someone referred to as わんちぇん (Wanchen-san), or かいぬし (Kainushi-san) (While the West refer to him as Ainefill, no name under his credit was ever implied).
scenarios.setting: Wonderful World is a 2D Doujin Fighting Game made by someone referred to as わんちぇん (Wanchen-san), or かいぬし (Kainushi-san) (While the West refer to him as Ainefill, no name under his credit was ever implied). It runs on the FM2K engine. Wonderful World is inspired by the GUILTY GEAR series of fighters in terms of an intuitive combat system, and the fact that it's a Weapons Based Fighting Game. Each character, gameplay wise, is unique in their own way.

scenarios.title: Woody Woodpecker
scenarios.description: Woody Woodpecker is an animated character that appeared in theatrical short films produced by the Walter Lantz Studio and distributed by Universal Pictures between 1940 and 1972.
scenarios.setting: Woody Woodpecker is an animated character that appeared in theatrical short films produced by the Walter Lantz Studio and distributed by Universal Pictures between 1940 and 1972. cartoon studio in the late 1930s. Lantz produced theatrical cartoons longer than most of his contemporaries, and Woody Woodpecker remained a staple of Universal's release schedule until 1972 when Lantz finally closed down his studio.

scenarios.title: WordGirl
scenarios.description: Becky Botsford is an average fifth-grader who, when duty calls, is transformed into WordGirl.
scenarios.setting: WordGirl flies to the rescue when there is trouble in The City, and this super heroine uses vocabulary to defeat outlaws.

scenarios.title: World Doctors
scenarios.description: World Doctors is an animated internet series by Canadian creators Bart Batchelor and Chris Nielson in collaboration with MondoMedia.
scenarios.setting: The story follows two archaeologists turned doctors, who are both named James, on their nonsensical medical adventures throughout deprived areas of Africa.

scenarios.title: World Heroes
scenarios.description: World Heroes is a series of fighting games developed by ADK between 1992 and 1995.
scenarios.setting: World Heroes is a series of fighting games developed by ADK between 1992 and 1995. It is comprised of four main installments and it has become an icon of the Neo Geo era first and of SNK properties at large then, as its characters have often been featured in crossover titles and a variety of other productions. World Heroes has become famous for its solid gameplay quality and a colorful and bizarre cast of characters.

scenarios.title: World of Darkness
scenarios.description: World of Darkness is a multimedia franchise centered around a series of tabletop roleplaying games, created in 1991 and initially owned by White Wolf Publishing, passed on to CCP Games in 2006, and to Paradox Interactive in 2016.
scenarios.setting: World of Darkness is a multimedia franchise centered around a series of tabletop roleplaying games, created in 1991 and initially owned by White Wolf Publishing, passed on to CCP Games in 2006, and to Paradox Interactive in 2016.

scenarios.title: World of Horror
scenarios.description: World of Horror is a 1-bit cosmic horror game developed by a one man team.
scenarios.setting: World of Horror is a 1-bit cosmic horror game developed by a one man team. P. Lovecraft and Junji Ito, and uses many of their tricks, affects, and concepts to pass off an incredibly scary experience with things from both worlds. The game itself contains many separate stories, each covering a different human character and the horror they must deal with. The horrors vary from case to case, going between home invasion, urban legends, hospital creatures, and, of course, Lovecraftian Entities.

scenarios.title: World Trigger
scenarios.description: A gate to another dimension has burst open, and from it emerge gigantic invincible creatures that threaten all of humanity.
scenarios.setting: A gate to another dimension has burst open, and from it emerge gigantic invincible creatures that threaten all of humanity. Earth's only defense is a mysterious group of warriors who have co-opted the alien technology in order to fight back!

scenarios.title: WorldBox
scenarios.description: WorldBox, Super WorldBox or WorldBox - God Simulator is a sandbox God game made by indie developer Maxim Karpenko.
scenarios.setting: WorldBox seeks to be the ultimate God simulator experience, giving the player absolute freedom and unchecked reign over their world and its inhabitants.

scenarios.title: Worms
scenarios.description: Debuting in 1995, Worms is a series of artillery warfare games that has up to four players each manage a team of worms.
scenarios.setting: Debuting in 1995, Worms is a series of artillery warfare games that has up to four players each manage a team of worms. Each player will take turns controlling one worm at a time, and are given a limited amount of time to make their move. The objective is to eliminate all enemy worms. The Worms franchise has a nonexistent story, and very few named characters that are only referenced in single-player modes and lyrical versions of the main theme Wormsong. None of the named characters are playable.

scenarios.title: Wreck-It Ralph
scenarios.description: Wreck-It Ralph is a 2012 American computer-animated comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures.
scenarios.setting: Wreck-It Ralph is a 2012 American computer-animated comedy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios and released by Walt Disney Pictures. The 52nd Disney animated feature film, it was directed by Rich Moore (in his directorial debut), written by Phil Johnston and Jennifer Lee from a story by Moore, Johnston, and Jim Reardon and executive produced by John Lasseter. The film features the voices of John C.

scenarios.title: Wuthering Waves
scenarios.description: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom from Kuro Games.
scenarios.setting: Mid tier and High tier characters are noticeably stronger, being around City level to Large Planet level.

scenarios.title: Xeelee Sequence
scenarios.description: The Xeelee Sequence is a series of hard science fiction novels, novellas, and short stories written by British science fiction author Stephen Baxter.
scenarios.setting: The Xeelee Sequence is a series of hard science fiction novels, novellas, and short stories written by British science fiction author Stephen Baxter. The series spans billions of years of fictional history, centering on humanity's future expansion into the universe, its intergalactic war with an enigmatic and supremely powerful alien civilization called the Xeelee, and the Xeelee's own cosmos-spanning war with dark matter entities called Photino Birds.

scenarios.title: Xeno (Series)
scenarios.description: Xenoblade (Otherwise known as Xenoblade Chronicles) is the spiritual successor to Xenosaga and Xenogears developed by Monolith Software, and is a Nintendo exclusive.
scenarios.setting: Xenoblade (Otherwise known as Xenoblade Chronicles) is the spiritual successor to Xenosaga and Xenogears developed by Monolith Software, and is a Nintendo exclusive. The series has the following entries: - Xenoblade Chronicles= Xenoblade is an Action-RPG and was released in Japan in 2010, it was later released in 2011 in Europe and it was released in North America in the year 2012, it was later ported to the New Nintendo 3DS in 2015.

scenarios.title: Xiao Xiao Series
scenarios.description: Xiao Xiao (Chinese: 小小作品), also known as Xiao Xiao Series, is an Internet Flash cartoon series by Chinese animator Zhu Zhiqiang, featuring stick figures performing choreographed fight scenes.
scenarios.setting: Xiao Xiao (Chinese: 小小作品), also known as Xiao Xiao Series, is an Internet Flash cartoon series by Chinese animator Zhu Zhiqiang, featuring stick figures performing choreographed fight scenes. Some of the cartoons are interactive and game-like. All cartoons are in the Adobe Flash format, with the exception of Xiao Xiao #1, which was originally in AVI format and converted to Flash format.

scenarios.title: Xiaolin Showdown
scenarios.description: Xiaolin Showdown and its sequel series, Xiaolin Chronicles are cartoons that ran from 2003-2006 and 2013-2015 respectively.
scenarios.setting: Xiaolin Showdown and its sequel series, Xiaolin Chronicles are cartoons that ran from 2003-2006 and 2013-2015 respectively. The show typically followed the various adventures of the four Xiaolin Monks and their companions and enemies.

scenarios.title: Xionic Madness
scenarios.description: Xionic Madness is a flash series created and animated by César Soto, known on Newgrounds as Xionico.
scenarios.setting: Inspired heavily by the Madness Combat flash series, Xionic Madness follows a group of cyborgs and one robot enlisted by the nebulous organization MBORF, with the beginning episodes detailing one particular mission against a rival organization.

scenarios.title: Xombie
scenarios.description: Xombie is a series of internet strips, Flash cartoons and officially licensed comics produced by James Farr, originally released around  2003, becoming a hit on Newgrounds, and one of that website's classics to this day (the main character of the series, Dirge, even being part of Newgrounds' gang), later getting  (which was also a big hit), its , its  (which amassed tens of thousands of users) and more than .
scenarios.setting: Xombie is a series of internet strips, Flash cartoons and officially licensed comics produced by James Farr, originally released around 2003, becoming a hit on Newgrounds, and one of that website's classics to this day (the main character of the series, Dirge, even being part of Newgrounds' gang), later getting its own site (which was also a big hit), its own wiki, its own forum (which amassed tens of thousands of users) and more than one fan site.

scenarios.title: Yamato Takeru
scenarios.description: Yamato Takeru is a movie made in 1994 by Toho, the creator of the Godzilla franchise.
scenarios.setting: Yamato Takeru is a movie made in 1994 by Toho, the creator of the Godzilla franchise. It is based on Japanese legends, featuring mythological gods and monsters. Yamato Takeru received an almost 40 episode long anime series based on it as well as OVAs.

scenarios.title: Yellowstone
scenarios.description: Yellowstone is a neo-western television franchise centering on the Duttons, a multi-generational family of ranchers.
scenarios.setting: Yellowstone is a neo-western television franchise centering on the Duttons, a multi-generational family of ranchers. The series includes Yellowstone, which lasted five seasons from 2018 to 2024, 1883, a prequel series which lasted one season from 2021 to 2022, 1923, a second prequel series which lasted two seasons from 2022 to 2025, and Marhsals, which premiered in 2026.

scenarios.title: Yin Tian Shen Yin
scenarios.description: The Yin Tian Shen Yin (阴天神隐) Series is a series of novels written by Gloomy Sky Hidden God (阴天神隐).
scenarios.setting: Gao's quest leads him through bottomless abysses, tiny worlds floating in the void, parallel dimensions, and the vast multiverse. Facing Gods and Demons alike, Joshua fought through every obstacle, often relying on miracles in seemingly impossible situations. It focused on its protagonist Su Zhou, a young Chinese man whose justice was a seed for the future great upheaval across All Heavens and Realms.

scenarios.title: Yin Zhi Shoumuren
scenarios.description: Lu Shui Yin is a poor student that loves playing games.
scenarios.setting: After viewing the last moments of an old man being held at gun point, the scene forces the MC into a virtual reality game, dropping him off at a desert landscape with some pyramids.

scenarios.title: YJK Verse (Yuji Kaku)
