scenarios.setting: Set in the Edo period of Japan, it follows the ninja Gabimaru and the executioner Yamada Asaemon Sagiri as they search for the elixir of immortality.

scenarios.title: Yo-Kai Watch
scenarios.description: Yo-Kai Watch is a video game franchise developed by Level 5.
scenarios.setting: Yo-Kai Watch is a video game franchise developed by Level 5. The series involves different creatures called Yo-Kai that caused all of the mischief in people's lives. The popularity of this series was so high in Japan, that it even surpassed Pokémon at one point.

scenarios.title: Yonggary
scenarios.description: Yongary, Monster from the Deep ( 용가리 Taekoesu Yonggali, lit.
scenarios.setting: Yongary, Monster from the Deep ( 용가리 Taekoesu Yonggali, lit. Great Monster Yongary) is a 1967 South Korean giant monster film produced by Keukdong Entertainment. It was released to South Korean theaters on August 13, 1967. Shim Hyung-rae directed a loose remake, Reptilian, in 1999.

scenarios.title: YOU
scenarios.description: The novel You, a young adult psychological novel written by Caroline Kepnes, and the TV show YOU, an American psychological thriller television series based on the books, follows Joe Goldberg, a bookstore manager and stalker who falls in love with Guinevere Be
scenarios.setting: The novel You, a young adult psychological novel written by Caroline Kepnes, and the TV show YOU, an American psychological thriller television series based on the books, follows Joe Goldberg, a bookstore manager and stalker who falls in love with Guinevere Beck and develops an extreme obsession.

scenarios.title: Youjo Senki
scenarios.description: Youjo Senki (幼女戦記, literally "The Military Chronicles of a Little Girl") is a light novel series written by Carlo Zen and illustrated by Shinobu Shinotsuki.
scenarios.setting: As punishment he is reborn as the girl Tanya Degurechaff in a world similar to the real world during WWI, but with magic. The country she is born in, which resembles Germany, is an empire warring with the nearby countries. Tanya blessed with magical aptitude decides to join the Empire's army and fight in the upcoming world war, in the hope of reaching a rank high enough to guarantee her a safe and enjoyable life far from the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Zaregoto

scenarios.setting: Zaregoto Series (戯言シリーズ, Zaregoto Shirīzu) is a light novel series written by Japanese novelist Nisio Isin and was ranked the second most popular light novel in 2004 and in 2005 it was the most popular light novel. scenarios.title: Zenless Zone Zero
scenarios.description: Zenless Zone Zero (also known as ZZZ for short) is a free-to-play action RPG developed and published by HoYoverse for Windows, PlayStation 5, iOS, and Android.
scenarios.setting: Zenless Zone Zero (also known as ZZZ for short) is a free-to-play action RPG developed and published by HoYoverse for Windows, PlayStation 5, iOS, and Android. set in a post-apocalyptic metropolitan city. It features an engaging story with a futuristic art style, distinctive characters, and an exhilarating action-orientated combat system.

scenarios.title: Zero In
scenarios.description: The story takes place in Japan, year 20XX.
scenarios.setting: Zero In is a manga by Sora Inoue. The story takes place in Japan, year 20XX. In order to combat the rampant increase of violent crimes involving firearms, the Japanese National Police Agency approves the creation of an armed division to support regular police. This divison is named Minkei or Private Police, and it recruits civilians without taking into account age, nationality or former education, only taking into account their skills.

scenarios.title: Zero no Tsukaima
scenarios.description: Zero no Tsukaima (ゼロの使い魔) is a light novel series written by Noboru Yamaguchi with illustrations by Eiji Usatsuka.
scenarios.setting: Zero no Tsukaima (ゼロの使い魔) is a light novel series written by Noboru Yamaguchi with illustrations by Eiji Usatsuka. Media Factory published 20 volumes between June 2004 and February 2011, and while the series was temporarily left unfinished due to the author's death on April 4, 2013, it was later concluded in two volumes released in February 2016 and February 2017 with a different author, making use of notes left behind by Yamaguchi.

scenarios.title: ZERO Sievert
scenarios.description: ZERO Sievert is a top-down extraction shooter video game released on October 23rd, 2024, set in a post-apocalyptic eastern Europe exclusion zone prepared around a city called Zakov.
scenarios.setting: You play as a Hunter, a freelance operative in the ZERO Sievert Bunker, who works with various groups of interest in acquiring goods from the wasteland, combating creatures or other factions, exploring new areas of the Zone, and getting to the bottom of the Crisis.

scenarios.setting: The biggest expansion thus far, Marine Mania added aquatic animals to the game, in addition to dolphin shows, four new aquatic biomes, koi ponds, diving behaviors for animals such as crocodiles, polar bears, and penguins, and yet another set of twenty new animals, including sharks, dolphins, manta rays, and sea turtles.

scenarios.title: Zootopia
scenarios.description: Zootopia is a 2016 animated Disney movie written by Jared Bush and Phil Johnston.
scenarios.setting: The story is set in Zootopia, a metropolis city inhabited by anthropomorphic animals and focuses on Judy Hopps, a police officer and the first rabbit to become so, as well as her unlikely partner Nick Wilde, a fox con artist as they set to uncover the conspiracies within the city.

scenarios.title: Zorro
scenarios.description: Zorro (Spanish for "Fox") is a fictional character created in 1919 by American pulp writer Johnston McCulley and appears in works set in the Pueblo of Los Angeles during the era of Spanish California (1769–1821).
scenarios.setting: Zorro (Spanish for "Fox") is a fictional character created in 1919 by American pulp writer Johnston McCulley and appears in works set in the Pueblo of Los Angeles during the era of Spanish California (1769–1821). Diego is usually shown living with his father in a huge hacienda, which contains a number of secret passages and underground tunnels, leading to a secret cave that serves as headquarters for Zorro's operations and as Tornado's hiding place.
